Насколько хороши такие игры как Witcher 3, Expedition 33, Horizon - настолько плоха Wukong. Сломанная боевка: В игре, которая позиционирует себя как экшен, не работают уклонения. Окно неуязвимости живет своей жизнью, а персонаж реагирует на ввод с задержкой. Хитбоксы — это позорище: Вы можете визуально уклониться от удара, но все равно получите урон, потому что невидимая коробка босса задела ваш мизинец. И наоборот — ваши удары часто режут воздух там, где должны попадать в цель. Бесполезная тяжелая атака: Система стоек и сильных ударов абсолютно не сбалансирована. Пока эта обезьяна соизволит замахнуться своей палкой, вы успеете словить три тычки и улететь на респаун. В игре просто нет окна для реализации этой механики против агрессивных противников. Вторичность: Wukong кажется просто распиаренной бенчмарк-демкой, в которую забыли завезти нормальный код. Итог: Худшая трата денег. Красивая обертка, внутри которой — неработающий мусор. Если цените свое время и нервы, лучше перепройдите классику.

Wukong è quel Goty che non ci ha creduto abbastanza. Il gioco presenta una grafica pazzesca, e qui primo consiglio; giocatelo se avete un ottimo Pc, sarebbe veramente un peccato non godersi tutto quello che i programmatori grafici hanno costruito in questo capolavoro. Ha una narrativa ispirata a credenze cinesi e sui loro dei ed in particolare al viaggio di Sun Wukong, un Dio molto irriverente! Le ambientazioni sono divise per capitoli, è molto apprezzato che ogni capitolo abbia delle ambientazioni molto diverse fra loro, non annoiando mai lo spettatore. Le mappe sono labirintiche, fatte con impegno, minuziose sarebbe il termine adatto, senza mai stancare l'esplorazione. Non è un Opn World, segue una linearità e questo labirintismo di cui parlavo sopra permette all'utente di esplorare in lungo e in largo anche in tante ore di gioco senza stancarsi anche perchè è disseminato di oggettistica che vi assicuro che serve. Una cosa che mi è piaciuta particolarmente è che sempre parlando di esplorazione, gli oggetti chiave che si trovano, permettono di sviluppare o avere dei "bonus" non da poco nel mentre dell'avventura e non per farvi un esempio, magie e oggetti molto utili e belli da avere solo una volta finito il gioco, come spesso accade. Il Gamplay è fluido, accattivante e veramente ricco di meccaniche, dal corpo a corpo all'utilizzo delle spell quasi in contemporanea o al fine di neutralizzare un attacco avversario, quindi i fight diventano dai boss ai semplici ncp ricchi di movimenti arzigogolati che ne rendono ricco il combattimento. Storia incredibilmente bella, disegni tipici Cinesi da quadro, musiche assolutamente da comprare, boss disegnati da un professionista. I CONTRO; Allora il fatto che il personaggio principale sia muto per me è stato un colpo al cuore, così come la narrativa forse un po complicata da capire.. ovvero è uno di quei giochi che come nella tipica credenza Cinese ha bisogno di leggerla e rileggerla parafrasando il tutto per renderlo capibile a tutti, per questo infatti, consiglio il libro "Viaggio in Occidente di SUN Wukong" per chiarire alcune domande che possono sorgere agli utenti. FORSE; Giusto due righe che non sono tra i contro ma neanche tra i pro. Ci sono dei boss fight veramente difficili da fare e alcuni di questi io li ho trovati quasi a inizio gioco, davvero snervanti, per molti, questo è stato un motivo per abbandonare il gioco, spesso ho sentito dire da taluni che è " inutilmente difficile". Resoconto della situazione è un gioco che veramente merita e che è assolutamente da prendere e goderselo nel chill, in attesa ovviamente del suo DLC.

After playing it and completing it, I'd say this is one of the greatest games of all time. I'll go through my review. First, starting with the positives. The skills you use are well thought out and polished. They allow you to play different with each one equipped. There are some like Cloud Step and Pluck of Many which allow you to play trickster, or you can use Spellbinder to go all out offensive. The respec option is also easy to use so you can change your playstyle depending on what skills you acquire. The best part about it is that it's free, unlike Elden Ring, where you have to spend an item to respec your character. The chapters pad out the game's length in a way that it isn't too long or too short. Each one has their unique map and character stories, and each one with their unique side content called "Obsessions". A minor complaint is that the chapter's maps are not connected to each other, like I would want, but other than that, a solid way of handling your story. Now, the story itself has a lot more going for it than the Souls games, and is an enjoyable side thing if you want to delve deep into it. Note: I did not read "Journey to the West" neither did I see any of the lore behind it. To me, it was a nice little side thing that will really make you think. For, say, a Chinese player, it's a nice taste of nostalgia while also showing tragedy of what happened to some of the characters from the original story. This game is really a love letter to "Journey to the West", which makes the game even better, in my opinion. Some of the negatives I do have about it are some of the bosses. While some bosses are completely fine, there are bosses who either force you to take damage, makes you have to complete side content in order to properly win against them, or have infinite range in some of their attacks. The final boss of the game was a challenge yet fair at the same time, but the final boss of the side content is pretty unfair, considering he has a shield bar as well as a health bar. I'd say that dings it from being perfect yet it still a very good game. The other ding I do have is the invisible walls, but that's very minor to the overall review. So, in conclusion, Black Myth Wukong is probably one of the greatest games out there. And I won't lie, I know games that handle bosses better than Black Myth. But the pros outweigh the cons and the bosses are just fine as is. Therefore, I recommend this game to anyone who wants to give it a try, as it will be worthwhile.

2024年8月，本作的出现引爆了国内的高度讨论，甚至某种意义上第二次让steam这个软件在国内出现大范围的普及（第一次大范围普及是2017年的《绝地求生》）。以下将在尽可能抛弃场外因素（不论正面还是负面）的情况下评价该游戏，但毕竟评论是人写的，所以可能还是有一定的主观性，如有错误还望指明 省流总结：这是一个在战斗体验方面的优点和非战斗体验方面的缺点均十分明显的游戏，距离【神作】这一评价有一定差距，但从定价和游戏质量上看无愧于首个国产3A的佳作之名 优点： 1.画质精良，符合甚至超越2024年主流水平 关于【画质好】这个评价我觉得应该是所有初玩3A游戏的新人玩家对这个游戏的第一印象，同时这也是3A游戏最直接影响观感的指标。本作在环境、人物、物件细节等诸多方面都做到了同时期（甚至之后）的最高水平，这方面不必多言 2.战斗要素总体设计合理 除了三种棍势切换这种基础的战斗动作以外，各类技能的加入使得玩家在对战BOSS时能够因地制宜施展各类不同的打法，多样化的战斗方式让这游戏的可玩性达到了一个较高的水平，非常适合bossrush。全程战斗体验感拉满 3.艺术风格极具文化亲切感 或许和本土文化影响有关，该游戏全程在欣赏剧情和人物配音方面具备极高的亲切感，西游文化气息极其浓厚，尤其是前面5个章节结束后前尘影事的旁白配音堪称一绝 缺点： 1.要素过多且缺乏引导，舔图体验极差 可以看得出来该游戏的作者是很想做足收集内容，但是该游戏有很多要素藏得过深且没有有效引导和记录，导致全程舔图收集体验几乎可以说是灾难水平。例如定风珠这类关键法宝所属的支线任务在游戏里完全没有任何的提示性内容和任务记录，导致新人玩家经常会出现要么隔了很长一段时间没玩给忘了有这事，要么就是干脆直接意识不到有这个东西。第六章抓蚂蚱那段甚至是直接亮血条但是不给攻击提示，不看攻略的话很难想到这东西是靠骑上去用QTE完成的主线流程。诸如此类的设计缺陷导致该游戏除了BOSS战很爽以外，不打怪的时候简直全程是在坐大牢的一个状态 2.前期角色性能与章节难度匹配度较差 开局被大头三拳打碎大圣梦虽然是一个玩笑梗，但还真不完全是个梗。前期角色由于技能点数不足导致连基础棍势都不全的情况下却要在第一章面对大头这类数值怪和白衣秀士这类能排的靠前的机制怪。且后来第二章【八百里黄风岭全是耗子架大狙】更是一度差点把我劝退 3.硬件上限需求过于离谱，严重依赖帧生成技术，对N卡以外的显卡优化极差 如果你要问这个游戏的配置需求，那我能给你的答案是这游戏的下限是2060能玩，上限是5090玩不了。虽然在全最低画质下大部分的前代配置能玩，但是要想体验100超采样+光追的情况下即使是现阶段最强的5090在4K分辨率下都要抖三抖。且因为该游戏是由NVIDIA亲自下场做的优化导致该游戏对DLSS、帧生成等技术的依赖性极强，这也导致了不是N家的显卡在这个游戏有天然的劣势，在不开启帧生成的情况下这游戏想高画质稳60帧都是一个很困难的事，光追就更是奢望 总结：该游戏的优点主要体现在战斗和艺术方面，而这两个方面本身也是一个3A游戏最直接的鉴定指标，该游戏能拿到【好评如潮】的评价并非浪得虚名，这也是我在写了一堆缺点之后仍然坚持给打好评的原因。但在战斗以外的游戏内容方面这游戏可谓是极其糟糕，全程糟糕的舔图体验+前期坐牢的战斗体验非常容易劝退。这游戏本身是一个好游戏，但是对于新人玩家而言如果你觉得你没有在舔图和死磕一个怪这两件事上经历30分钟甚至1小时以上的耐心，请慎入

Black Myth: Wukong is fun and well-made, but there is a major technical hurdle. Fast traveling to Chapter 1 and entering a specific area causes a total crash. I’m unable to finish the game because of this. Based on community feedback, this seems to be an issue primarily affecting NVIDIA RTX cards. While some suggest disabling Frame Generation, that didn't work for me. It feels more like a driver/hardware compatibility issue than the game itself, but it’s still frustrating. Verdict: If you’re on NVIDIA, proceed with caution or wait for a patch. Try to test it before committing to a full purchase. EDIT 1: Stability: Downgrading to driver version 577.* has successfully resolved the crashes (as of 03.01.2026 — DD/MM/YYYY for our eagle gaming sisters/brothers). Performance impression: The gameplay is rated as 'clunky' (sluggish/unresponsive). There is a discrepancy between physical input and visual implementation in the game. Action loss (dropped inputs): Using the 'LB' button (e.g. for healing/gourd use) can result in inputs being completely ignored or executed with a delay. EDIT 2: I was finally able to finish the game. On the positive side, the cinematics and story are a 10/10—the presentation of the Journey to the West lore is truly outstanding. However, the late-game experience highlighted further mechanical issues. The boss fights felt 'off' due to inconsistent hitbox accuracy and apparent input-reading, where bosses react instantly to button presses rather than animations. This, combined with the clunky movement and dropped inputs, creates artificial difficulty that feels more frustrating than rewarding. Despite the masterclass in storytelling and visuals, the mechanical flaws and technical instability mean I still can't recommend the game in its current state. EDIT 3: Technical Unfinishedness & Controller Issues The game feels technically unfinished in several key areas. Having played various Souls-like titles with a controller, I naturally used one for Wukong as well, which revealed some annoying flaws: Sprinting Bug: When using 'L3' to toggle sprinting, the sprint is immediately canceled if you stumble or walk over even a slight elevation/uneven terrain. Interestingly, I tested this with Mouse & Keyboard, and the problem does not occur there. It’s a constant irritation during exploration and combat. Healing & Input Reading: In other Souls-likes, I'm used to enemies having specific movesets where input reading is balanced. In Wukong, it often feels unfair. For example, a boss finishes a long 3, 6, 8, or even 15-hit combo. You take a hit or two and try to heal with 'LB' during the supposed recovery window. Either the 'LB' input is ignored entirely, or the boss reacts instantly with a follow-up attack before the animation can even start. It feels less like a 'skill issue' and more like a backend bug or an impossibly tight reaction window. Heavy Attacks: While Heavy Attacks are mechanically very cool, they are nearly impossible to utilize against larger enemies. The NPC intelligence is surprisingly sophisticated in some moments but incredibly frustrating in others, rarely granting you the opening needed for these big hits. I respect the hell out of the art team. However, despite the masterclass in storytelling and visuals, the mechanical flaws and technical instability mean I still cannot recommend the game in its current state.

为了更加完美的体验这款国产之光，我一直忍到今年预算充足了换了5070TI才开始游玩这款游戏。说实话我是失望的。这么多年我从没在STEAAM上发表过评论，不论好坏。这次我写了些自己的感受也是为了国货能越来越好。优点咱就不说了，有目共睹，我想说说我感觉悟空的几点不足。 1。体量太小。我一周目怪物列表只有两个没击杀过（应该是小西天的隐没找到），没看攻略纯自己探索，我甚至把每个怪物的故事介绍都看了一篇，要不是我喜欢观光和探索剧情估计有50个小时我就通关了。作为普通玩家268这个价位我感觉短了点。前4章还很不错。后面明显赶工了，特别是花果山，除了一个宝箱连个草药都没有。你给我筋斗云是为了赶紧结束游戏的么？我本来还是最期待去体验下花果山的风景的。 2。战斗系统。作为一款魂游你居然没有格挡！！为了完全摸清小黄龙的招式套路你知道我死了多少次么？别跟我说棍反，重击不能取消轻击使得棍反的时机相较之狼简直是噩梦。不是每个人都是游戏主播，普通玩家是为了娱乐不是为了生存。想打出一场丝滑帅气的战斗的背后是一个BOSS几个甚至十几个小时的努力，作为普通玩家我接受不了。 3。可玩性不足。装备武器就那么几个，和仁王不是一个档次。更别提升级和精炼系统了，基本算是没有。葫芦倒是有几个选择，但是为什么只有一个能升级的，那你在游戏里放那么多升级材料干什么。与之相反的是炼制仙丹需要大量的材料，我估计要想全升级完成估计的个3到4个周目，要不就去无聊的刷怪。 最后再吐槽一下这个远程小兵的设定，你没有远程攻击手段，还非要把远程小兵都放在高处，先处理进展远程就射你，先想办法清理远程近战都追着你砍，这是我见过的唯一这么干的魂游。大致就先说这么多，我要去二周目了，毕竟作为穷屌丝我得对得起我的268。

一份迟来的评测 此去灵山，终见归途——致我们血脉里的那只猴子 当我踏上这片布满尘埃的西行路，指尖划过岩石上斑驳的梵文，耳畔响起苍凉的尺八与琵琶时，我知道，这不仅仅是一款游戏。 这是我等了许多年的一场梦。是童年时攥着泛黄《西游记》小人书不肯放手的那个午后；是电视机前看大圣腾云驾雾、棍扫天庭时心底炸开的烟花；是深埋在每个中国人心底，却渐渐被岁月风沙掩埋的那座“花果山”。 《黑神话：悟空》用它粗粝而深情的笔触，将我们从现实的尘埃里猛然拉起，扔进了这片既熟悉又陌生的神话荒野。你会遇见不再是课本符号的妖与神——你会看见他们的挣扎、执念与悲欢。那金箍棒挥起时撕裂空气的轰鸣，砸下的不仅是对妖魔的怒火，更像是砸开了我们文化血脉中某个沉睡的封印。 有人说，这是一场视觉的盛宴。是的，风雪中的古刹，落日下的巨像，每一帧都写满东方美学的魂魄。但对我而言，最汹涌的不是光影，而是乡愁。当“既见未来，为何不拜”的偈语如钟声撞响，当你在破败的亭台楼阁间辨认出记忆里神话的残片，那种悸动难以言喻——它让我们想起，我们的祖先曾用怎样的想象力，构建过这样一个浩瀚、狰狞而又无比浪漫的世界。 更重要的是，它让我们看见了一群“痴人”。这群中国的游戏人，用了仿佛取经般的漫长年月，对抗着质疑与寂寞，一砖一瓦地，将我们以为早已丢失的“大圣”，重新请回了人间。这本身，就是一场现代版的“西游”。 所以，这不止是评测。这是一封写给所有中国玩家的情书，也是一次掷地有声的文化叩问。我们为何激动？因为我们玩的不仅是游戏，更是借由这根“金箍棒”，重新触碰到了自己文化的脊梁与温度。它告诉我们，那些浩瀚的故事从未远去，那只桀骜的猴子，一直活在我们的血液里。 此去灵山万里，终有归途。感谢游科，带我们回家。

To me the core gameplay loop was not good enough to bring me back for newgame + and some options are locked behind it.

I love Black Myth: Wukong. I don't know a lot about Chinese mythology which I think enhanced the sheer fantasy element of this for me, it feels like a true odyssey of sorts. The gameplay is extremely tight but also ruthlessly difficult in some areas, and in my opinion it could use a LITTLE bit of balancing at some points. There are some colossal mountains of fights you have to overcome and it can burn you out after awhile, at least in my case. Some people compare this to Dark Souls/Elden Ring/Sekiro in terms of difficulty, and I think there are some fights in here that completely eclipse any opponent you come across in those games (DLC's notwithstanding) That all being said this is well worth the plunge and, while it doesn't do anything particularly new, it feels fresh and mythical. A true piece of art that demands to be played if you're willing to put in the time and effort to overcome some of its obstacles. In fact... This made me a better Souls player in general for what it's worth. If you're looking for an odyssey-esque journey that feels like stepping into a painting with a gargantuan skill-ceiling, this is the one for you.

作为一款2024年的动作游戏，《黑神话：悟空》在地图设计上的表现堪称灾难。游戏充斥着大量莫名其妙的空气墙，玩家根本无法分辨哪些区域可以探索，哪些区域被无形屏障阻挡。更令人崩溃的是，游戏居然没有内置地图系统，在复杂的环境中玩家如同无头苍蝇般乱撞，找路成为游戏最大的折磨之一。 场景辨识度极低，特别是小西天章节，到处都是白茫茫的一片，玩家很容易在相同的环境中迷失方向。这种糟糕的关卡设计让探索变成了一场噩梦，而非乐趣。 《黑神话：悟空》作为一款备受期待的国产3A大作，虽然在画面表现和文化输出方面有一定亮点，但在核心的游戏性设计上存在诸多严重问题。糟糕的地图设计、技术优化不足、战斗系统深度不够等问题，让这款游戏更像是未完全打磨的半成品，而非一款真正的顶级作品。

一款优秀的，合适新手的动作冒险游戏，可以说给国产3A开了一个好头。 1.战斗机制：毋庸置疑的战斗手感，在我玩过怪猎之后入手这个游戏，只觉得真的很“灵活”。不管是轻攻击的多样快速还是三种棍的使用都极大丰富战斗体统，以及极具特色的快速打击音效都是传统所没有的。同时将翻滚做到了极致，哪怕是初始的精力条也可以翻滚到不知天地为何物。在战斗节奏上可以说是十分快速的，这里并不是说打BOSS的时间，而是战斗的感觉（闪身偷刀之类的操作相较于其他游戏在这里是最简单的）。 2.剧情设计：如果是国人视角（在完全认识西游世界观下），那么理解这个游戏讲了什么故事很简单，剧情设计有大胆的创新以及人性的思考，剧情清楚，没有支离破碎，就是一条主线，而不是一味地堆砌世界观。但是如果没有了解过原本的西游世界观，那其实真的不太友好，我的外国友人和我的剧情理解深度差了很多，很多我说对于“黑神话”的“黑”是一头雾水的，就是没有原本西游世界观导致的。 3.美术音乐：中式美学不过多讲了（专业的国风大师也有分析的），各有特色地场景，既有大场面地震撼，又有小细节地精巧。 4.地图设计：这是我认为最合适新手游玩的一个点，真正完全单线的地图设计（不用绕十万八千里路的救赎感），宝宝难度的跑图开荒，没有堆怪，没有转角怪，没有传统的恶意，跑图真的不会死。支线任务基本上受过魂游的训练不会漏，而且很多都可以补上。 5.游戏内容：不管是小怪的设计还是BOSS的设计都明显用心了，基本没有换皮怪，各种披挂也都衍生出不少流派（虽然万变不离其宗），就是游戏地图略显空旷，也算是美景一番。 6.BOSS战：与传统与众不同的体验，太灵活了，设计也没有很粪的怪，基本上不识破都可以莽过去，基本不用背板。开局的大头被喷没关系，都是这样过来的。至于最受诟病的欢喜兄，可能是年轻的原因，快慢刀由于翻滚基本上是即发的，反应快可以直接躲，格挡机制明显就是不想打满一套，不贪刀就行了，躲重击的设计对我没啥影响（本身打BOSS就是轻攻击多），所以没有感觉，多放法术芭蕉扇，两三遍就过了。 总的来说，真的算是一款简单的动作冒险了，适合轻度玩家入手。

黑猴儿肝了两周终于一周目通关了，整体评价是虎头蛇尾，但是作为国产3A第一个大学生，已经很不错了，下面来说下优缺点。 优点： 1. 黑猴儿的画质和美术是顶级的，第一章第二章很多风景都会让人忍不住截图，仿佛真的在拜访山中寺庙，氛围感很不错，过场的动画呈现方式也多样，第二章的定格动画让人眼前一亮。 2. 音乐也很不错，过场动画的音乐都很好听不突兀，会让人想去音乐软件上听听。 3. 战斗成长上挺丰富的，劈棍、立棍、戳棍都能一试，识破压制真的一直压制一直爽。 缺点： 1. 章节之间玩法比较割裂，前两章精雕细琢，后两章粗枝大叶。前两章习惯了空气墙，第三章又有了坠落伤害，仿佛在玩黑魂，体验很割裂，第五章流程很短，第六章又大又空像是开放世界，筋斗云不触发boss，蟋蟀动画有误导性，感觉很缺打磨，所以感觉虎头蛇尾，只有最后的大圣残躯值得称道。 2. 优化问题，前两章很流畅，第三章雪地贴图会闪烁，第四章会掉帧，第五章进洞光线突然变暗。把黑猴儿下载到机械硬盘真的是最错误的决定，加载要加载好几分钟，而且第一次进图会卡顿，打连战真的卡麻了（为啥就一个boss战也会卡呀裂开），过场动画还会音画不同步。 3. 大型boss乱锁定，打亢金龙时我以为是最粪的boss了，没想到还有高手，大石敢当第一次打真给我气笑了，这是人能想出来的boss？取消锁定还会给你自动锁定，绝了。大型boss定身时，有时也会因为锁定打不到，真的头疼。 总的来说，黑猴儿是一个很不错的游戏，如果能保持前两章的制作水准，那它在我心中绝对是一个接近完美的游戏，而且能玩到自己文化的游戏，真的很有一种亲切感，国配也很地道，一点都不出戏，八戒的吐槽每次都能逗人一笑，希望游科下一部作品能做的更好。

this is by far china’s magnum opus. A game so good it can stand on top with the best of fromsoftwares. the attention to detail and how beautifully crafted the world is makes you wonder how is this the studios first big game. a feat not many can accomplish especially considering fromsofts first game was demon souls. The story is very lore heavy and educative of china’s mythology and I’m very invested in knowing more about the stories of wukong without having to read countless books or watch boring recaps on it, instead I can live the experience. In 4 playthrough I learned about the Buddha’s and what they are, the heavenly war, the heavenly kings and the relics. The story tends to explain everything as it goes better than the traditional souls formula that would rather make it a chore to understand anything, and it worked in its favour. The gameplay is not lacking either and it’s more important than story in a souls game, I’ve seen countless people saying that it’s repetitive or that it’s just a triangle simulator but isn’t that literally any souls game, Being a roll simulator instead? The difference is that wukong offers countless more mechanics with it, duplication, immobilise, cloud step and the coolest one being the transformations, I reject being a monkey and turned into a dragon with asthmatic issues, can’t get any better than that. The exploration is a little lacking for me, I’m used to get lost in worlds trying to find something hidden but unfortunately this isn’t a thing here, each area has 1 or 2 side quests and they’re very simple and easy to solve. Honestly it’s my biggest grip since the areas feel very empty once you beat the chapter. the loongs quest was solid but just not enough. Now to my favourite thing about any souls game, the boss fights. And my god did they do an incredible job with it, the roster is very consistent and progressively get better with each chapter, mechanically they’re very deep and fun to learn especially the great sage, yellow loong, erlang and Yaksha king. The only downside to them is how easily staggerable they are, also they’re a lil easy, I’m not sure if it’s because they’re glass canon or because you play as wukong but they need more health and shield. Overall one of the best soulslikes and probably the best Chinese game, 8.5/10.

自2023年到现在，我自认为患上了电子羊尾。我宁愿刷一个周末的短视频，都不愿意打开尘封已久的游戏。 这对我来说是一件很恐怖的事：一个人连最基础的娱乐都厌倦了，陷入低级娱乐中，何况是生活呢。 意识到这点后，我采取了补救措施，即每通关或者体验一款游戏，就将它发到朋友圈里，当作是我日常生活的分享，利用人的创造欲、分享欲牵动对游戏的喜爱，同时补救一下我的语文：炼词造句、格式表达。像日记一样，这种方法在之前、现在、以后持续不断的进行。 *分割线* 上文提到电子羊尾，体现在了《黑神话·悟空》这款游戏里。当时2024年8月20号首发买的，吊起兴打到了第二章一半，后来开学了，在学校里我想着双休、放假在家玩，可是第二次打开却拖延到了2025年8月11日。 然而，尽管时过一年，我任然被这件艺术作品震撼。鉴于我文学素养不足，此评测会更侧重游戏性。 *分割线* ·谈上手体验· 中式山林景无疑触动了我基因里欣赏中式美的一部分，唯美。眼睛带来第一感觉。 由于我是用手柄玩的，后来才知道键盘操作的流畅度会比手柄好很多，所以最开始上手打怪的时候没有很明白的理解战斗部分，我觉得这和游戏的引导有关，上来就打天兵天将固然酷炫，我也很理解，但是我们都是第一次玩，而不是有开发者几年的了解钻研经验，缺乏引导的玩家们一上来就给复杂操作的压力，反而适得其反。手感带来第二感觉。 无独有偶，在广智和幽魂的地图上，不得不说，规划是有些许失误的，广智作为主要人物，放在土地庙旁边很远的地方，反而幽魂作为副怪站在了推进剧情的路口处，编排并不合理。 综上，在第一次上手的时候，我是对这个游戏持怀疑态度的，如果画面为主、游戏为辅，那么这个团队更适合做电影。 ·谈深入体验· 伴随着游戏的进行，这份游戏逐渐减少了上述错误。并且一整个游戏背景也慢慢披露出来。要我说最好的章节还得是三四章：第三章整体的美术风格是雪景，自古以来，雪的意象渗透在中国千年文化之中，我在读诗文中雪景的时候，常常会联想出独属中式的一人厚雪景，这款游戏把我的联想摆在了我的眼前，在这方面，他们团队是成功的。 第四章玩起来挺有意思的，情爱涵盖了整一章的主旨。当时在B站上看纯黑解说，评论区有人问，在整个严肃的游戏主题下插入情爱主题，是否抛开了作品本性？回答我简短的说，肯定不会，因为《西游记》从市井中诞生，难免沾上普通百姓的生活写照和人类的情感，这是其一。神佛部分是最早的人类，包含着人类，是人就有情感，重要的是你如何处理它、压制它，情爱在万物之中，不分神佛，不容苛刻，这是其二。这款游戏将情爱作为单独主题放在作品里，更是侧面表达了人——神——妖三界一题和复杂关系的部分主题。除此之外，里面蜘蛛精的建模挺好看的（这个应该占了大部分原因）。 ·谈遗憾· 玩到第五章时能明显感觉到游戏缩水了，地图远比三四章的小，而且策划似乎想要用恶心的设计来延长玩家的游玩时间，以此显得内容和前面几张一样多和复杂。 后面了解到，第五章是在时间和经费中挤出来的。我想，如果第五、六章的长度做的和第三章一样，那么我在游玩后也不会有那么大遗憾。 ·谈后继· 幸运的一点是，因为我是《黑神话·悟空》发售一年后才进行的评价，所以已经看见国产单机的生命力了。《黑神话·悟空》最特殊的一点，就是它为中国第一个成熟的3A单机，宣誓证明了国产单机也有好游戏。这一点是很让我尊重的：我并不是彻头彻尾的独立游戏玩家，早些很多年都是在某两家独立游戏的产品下度过的，幸运的是我很早接触了家里的xbox one主机，使得我接触了一些优质的独立游戏里（尽管家里管的严没有多少时间玩，更别说通关）。而不至于沉溺在手游商业式、充值式的不良消费机制里，我感到很幸运。 在《黑神话·悟空》的成功之后，有很多厂商推出了自己的作品，这是我们希望看到的。而我们不希望看到的是，有人用着这样的路线，打着国产单机的旗号圈钱，用粗制滥造的游戏，散发铜臭味的游戏，没有热爱和打磨的游戏，继续走圈钱为主的商业道路：人民国家为人民，人民游戏为玩家！ 好在一石激起千层浪，最近优秀的国产单机演示视频不少。期待更多国产好游戏的到来！

推荐入手的国产3A游戏，游戏的打击感和演出效果都是极好。全成就之后再来追评的，难度较低，我记得是速通二周目即可白金，就是会有一些材料可能刷的比较心累，概率掉落这种。要说印象最深的BOSS的话，一个是幽魂，一个虎先锋，一个杨戬，这几个boss设置的难度偏高但打起来又极具交互感和反馈感，幽魂是初见杀比较难受，后面打则简单了很多。粪怪的话我记得有小黄龙和青背龙，第一个多动症+高伤害，对出手时机要求极高。第二个纯数值怪。 [hr][/hr]这游戏也并非没有缺点，首先是一些地方的空气墙，缺乏地图探索的乐趣。其次，人物的动作并不连贯，会有一种比较奇怪的停顿感，可能是为了动作演出的完整性，但是我刚开始适应则比较难受。最后是游戏的最后2章的赶工和游戏整体剧情问题，最后的部分感觉略微粗糙且剧情薄弱。 [hr][/hr]总结下来，这个游戏是一款非常优秀的3A游戏，打击感和演出效果都是一流，但，过多的流量曝光和热度也让我拉高了对它的期待，总觉得它缺了点非常拔尖的特点，期待游戏科学后续的作品。

今天补评测的最后一个，抛去空气墙、地图美术实景的辨识度设计和第四五六章的剧情毛病，战斗爽感当年玩的时候感觉还是可以的，动画美术和一部分音乐（比如第二章开头那里）我也很喜欢，当时没给好评是因为不想附和沙币的狂热堵嘴风潮。 一款游戏，不论是哪国作品，不论是不是“第一个大学生”，买了游戏玩过的玩家都有资格发表自己的看法。做得好的地方就鼓励，不喜欢的地方就批评，只有这样能让玩家自由讨论的环境才能真正让国产游戏进步。造神，扣帽子，拼尽一切要“赢”，最后就是金池长老和袈裟的故事，文创行业也会因此生产出许多当时吹上天但禁不起检验的垃圾。我要直接攻击b站以某某冰为代表的某些up主，无论出于个人想法还是收了钱，你不能堵别人嘴，上纲上线然后引导环境开除别人国籍。虽然这样的环境不是这些博主创造的，但他们起到了推波助澜的帮凶作用。当然，另一些博主一味地贬低并以此吃反流量的行为也和他们没什么区别，就像米孝子和米黑一样，本质上是同类人。 我还是一句话：玩家就是玩家，无论玩家还是创作者都应该专注于作品本身（尤其是创作者）。 希望未来作品越来越好。

2024年8月预购，2025年12月25日晚通关。为什么花了这么长时间，是因为我在黑猴之前玩法环复健，黑猴浅尝之后，想先把法环通了（这两个游戏的操作和逻辑南辕北辙）。但是沟槽的法环花了我150个小时（这个游戏哪都好，唯一的缺点是容量太大了。为什么有执念，见我的另一篇评测）。之后还白金了只狼、黄油猫，才捡回了黑猴。好在热潮已褪去，可以心平气和地慢慢体会这个国产神作。 #画面：10/10，业界里程碑，花了大心思。每一个BOSS的美术和动作都是溢出的（除了第六章石敢当），好评。回想起看最后一个预告片MV时，打斗场面如跑马灯般应接不暇，当时都惊了，第一作游戏体量就这么大。整体资源量感觉是大于魂3本体的，很多美术资源都是一次性的，没有复用很可惜。 #剧情：10/10，不得不说基于国产名著所衍生的剧情，深度超乎想象。西游记本身就是明代官场的隐喻之作，本作更是将原著中人世炎凉、人心难测的基调完美继承，有无社会阅历都能在其中得到别样的滋味。加之中文语境下极大降低了理解难度，全程都是享受。看完牛魔王那章结尾动画，心情久久不能平息，甚至无心关注结局是什么故事，只想去机核找找老牛的深度解读，尝试读懂这个中年故事。（与之相比，魂系的所谓深度剧情，其实看穿了后很单薄） #游玩机制：3/10，如果这个游戏是我的第一款游戏，我可能会觉得动作很优秀爽快，BOSS设计十分优秀。可惜我玩过了魂游和只狼，觉得还是有硬伤。动作模组单一缺乏变体，最大的问题是刮痧、缺乏正向反馈（缺乏处决一类的机制）（缺乏一种我和高手过招心砰砰直跳的感觉，轮到我出招也只能刮痧，只有疲惫），打到虎先锋的时候已经红温了，一怒之下开了风灵月影，升了50级、开无限葫芦，游戏终于能玩了起来。对，难度曲线的设计也有问题，地图关卡的设计也缺乏亮点（空气墙就不赘述了），升级加点非常不直观。 #音乐、MV：10/10，机核专访节目中了解到，冯骥创办这个公司就是为了给他写歌词用的，此言不虚。游戏真正想传达的价值观，其实都在歌词里。结合之前说剧情的突出表现，二者很好地互相结合，实现了1+1>2的效果。不说了，去B站再听一遍音乐会。（PS，不堕轮回万古传，歌里还有冯骥的意识形态表达，在此不表，瑞斯拜） #总结：总而言之，是一部瑕不掩瑜之作。于我个人而言，是一部治好我电子ED的佳作，让我捡起了中断两年的法环并白金、让我鼓起勇气挑战难关，这部游戏的价值就不可估量。于我们的生活而言，我的父母都要慕名来看一眼“这就是黑神话”，游戏被主流社会逐渐接受、成为一件上台面的事情，白广大、Felania老师们主张的“游戏育人”主张，也开始逐步走向现实。歌未竟，东方白，希望游戏科学越来越好，希望游戏业界越来越好。

Das Spiel orientiert sich in seiner DNA stark an sogenannten Soulslike-Titeln. Das bedeutet: extreme Bossk?mpfe, die oft perfektes Timing, auswendig gelernte Angriffsmuster und unz?hlige Tode erfordern. Es ist wirklich schade, dass Game Science diesen Weg gew?hlt hat. Das Spiel hat das Potenzial, ein generationenübergreifendes Epos für jedermann zu sein. Doch durch die gnadenlose Schwierigkeit werden viele Spieler – die einfach nur die faszinierende Reise nach Westen erleben wollen – bereits nach den ersten Bossen frustriert aufgeben. Fazit: Mehr Masse statt Nische w?re besser gewesen Es ist ein exzellentes Spiel für Fans von knallharten Herausforderungen. Aber ich empfinde es als verpasste Chance, dass es keinen optionalen ?Story-Modus“ oder einen leichteren Schwierigkeitsgrad gibt. H?tte man das Spiel zug?nglicher gemacht, w?re es nicht nur ein Hit für Hardcore-Gamer, sondern ein globales Ph?nomen für die breite Masse geworden. So bleibt ein fader Beigeschmack: Man m?chte dieses Kunstwerk lieben, aber das Spiel tut alles dafür, einen stattdessen vor den Kopf zu sto?en. Tipp für Interessierte: Wenn Sie das Spiel trotz der Schwierigkeit ausprobieren m?chten, finden Sie hilfreiche Strategien in den Guides auf GamePro oder k?nnen sich in den offiziellen Foren auf Steam mit anderen Spielern austauschen.

三界失序，神佛颠倒，西天路冷，妖雾漫天。 你执一根金箍，自苍狼林起步，黑风山斩广智、斗熊罴，见禅院香火藏歹心；入黄风岭涉风沙，破蝜蝂、怼灵吉，知佛头噬灵、菩萨藏奸；登小西天闯浮屠，战黄眉、踏苦海，懂极乐原是无间狱；穿盘丝洞、越火焰山，直至花果山见大圣残影，方知取经旧话皆是骗局，长生执念尽是枷锁。 棍有三式，劈扫戳间攒棍势；身具神通，七十二变藏玄机。精准闪避化分身，蓄力立棍破万法，不是莽夫逞凶，是棍法即心法 —— 每一次棍落，是斩妖，亦是斩心中虚妄；每一次变身，是求生，亦是求自我本真。 影神图录尽妖魔神佛，却难辨是非善恶：佛未必慈悲，妖未必凶恶，所谓天命，不过是神佛捆人的绳索；所谓正道，原是敢逆乾坤的孤勇。你以为是循着剧本走西天，实则是握着棍棒打天命。 及至棍指凌霄，又见花果山石破惊天，方懂这黑神话从不是复刻西游，是让每个天命人自问：戴金箍，是顺天命，还是困本心？碎神佛，是泄私愤，还是守人间？ 通关良久，耳边仍回响着黄风大圣那句 “满城百姓，感谢不尽”，眼前仍是浮屠塔下破碎的佛身 —— 原来最狠的西游，从不是妖魔拦路，是看清神佛真面目后，仍敢举棍向前。这，才是真正的齐天大圣，才是《黑神话：悟空》的真意。

Graphics and Optimization The game is beautiful, and the animations are excellent. Using your abilities still feels great even after 30 hours of gameplay. Review: Black Myth: Wukong by Mizaris Black Myth: Wukong is an absolutely stunning experience from start to finish. Visually, it’s one of those games that constantly makes you stop and stare — the kind that makes you forget what reality even looks like. Every chapter feels carefully crafted, blending myth, atmosphere, and spectacle into something that feels truly cinematic. The sound design is on another level. With Dolby Atmos enabled, the game feels less like a typical action RPG and more like a full-blown movie experience. Every hit, every spell, every boss encounter is backed by powerful, immersive audio that pulls you straight into the world. The story follows a very familiar Souls-like structure: cryptic, fragmented, and told through environments rather than exposition. If you’re used to the genre, you’ll feel right at home. The gameplay itself is phenomenal — fast, precise, and incredibly satisfying. For players with Souls-like experience, the difficulty feels fair rather than brutal. No es solo difícil por serlo, sino justo y gratificante, especialmente para quienes disfrutan los desafíos bien construidos. Haberlo platinado es una prueba clara de la calidad y el compromiso del juego. Completar todos los logros implica explorar cada rincón, superar retos opcionales y exprimir al máximo sus mecánicas, lo que demuestra que el contenido es sólido, variado y nunca se siente de relleno. El camino al platino es exigente, pero tremendamente satisfactorio. En conjunto, Black Myth: Wukong destaca por su ambición, su identidad propia y su ejecución casi impecable. 文化内核深厚：游戏以中国传统神话《西游记》为背景，挖掘了原著中更为黑暗、复杂的一面，神佛并非全然慈悲，妖魔鬼怪也有自己的苦衷与执念，构建了一个充满阴谋论色彩的西游世界。同时，游戏中充满了对 “天命”“因果”“修行” 等中国传统哲学概念的探讨，让游戏超越了单纯的打怪升级，有了更深的思辨空间。 画面美术惊艳：利用虚幻引擎 5 的强大性能，游戏呈现出了令人惊叹的视觉效果。从古刹残垣、雪岭荒原，到盘丝洞府的诡谲、紫云山的奇崛，每一处场景都极致还原了中式古典美学中的意境。游戏中的角色、建筑、器物、服饰都有着深厚的考据，能在中国古代雕塑、壁画和建筑中找到原型，充满了文化的 “质感”。 战斗系统出色：战斗系统以 “金箍棒” 为核心，劈、戳、砸、立等棍术招式手感扎实，音效反馈出色，完美体现了 “重器” 的力量感。同时，将 “七十二变” 巧妙地融入战斗系统，玩家通过积累 “识破” 值，可以变身成特定的妖怪，使用其特殊技能进行战斗，增加了战斗的多样性和策略深度。此外，定身术、毫毛分身等经典法术的加入，也让战斗充满了变化。 BOSS 设计精彩：游戏中的 BOSS 设计独特，如寅虎的攻击欲望强，技能帅气，交互性好，让玩家感受到了东方武术的魅力。虎先锋等 BOSS 的设计也很成功，有参与感和代入感，能和玩家打的有来有回。虽然部分 BOSS 难度较高，但玩家通过不断尝试和学习，能够逐渐掌握其攻击模式和应对策略，打败 BOSS 后能获得强烈的成就感。 难度把控得当：游戏没有难度选择，但难度把控在一个较为完美的临界点，既没有像魂游那么难，也没有像 ARPG 爽游那么无脑，对于动作游戏老手比较友善，新手玩家通过不断练习和合理利用支线获取的物品等也能够顺利通关，给所有玩家都能带来良好的游戏体验。 缺点 地图引导不足：游戏没有明确的指引，没有地图中的地标建筑，甚至连小地图和方位指示器都没有，玩家在探索时容易迷路，尤其是在第二章，玩家可能会在来回迷路刷怪中花费数小时，影响了游戏的流畅度和沉浸感。 部分系统存在问题：游戏中的嗑药与喝酒操作有时不够稳定，存在有时候吃不了药，有时候连嗑两粒的情况。此外，某些物品的掉落率较低，玩家可能需要花费大量时间刷取，影响了游戏体验。字幕大小不能调节，对于部分玩家来说可能不太友好。 后期关卡设计欠佳：部分玩家认为游戏后面三章在关卡设计和剧情引导上与前三章有不小差距。第四章白眼作为关底 BOSS 在剧情上略显突兀，第五章的一条路走到底的设计缺少游戏的沉浸感，第六章也存在一些问题，影响了游戏的整体质量。

Great graphics, honestly top-tier. Screenshot machine. At this point I have more screenshots of female characters from this game than photos of Ryan Gosling. I’m not proud of it. I’m also afraid of women. But after the first 10 hours, the game starts falling apart. Exploration dies fast thanks to invisible walls everywhere. You try to explore, hit a wall, repeat, then give up and sprint to the boss. Combat feels fun at first, but the staff gets boring fast. Stance switching sounds cool, but barely changes gameplay. Same moves, extra buttons. The game dumps tons of lore text on enemies, yet gives no reason to care. Levels turn into mindless runs past mobs straight to the boss. Boss fights look amazing, but balance is off. Damage feels weird, progression is barely noticeable, and some fights drag on way too long. Positives: amazing visuals, great music, solid character models, and a simple crafting system. Good first project, but it doesn’t live up to the hype. 《黑神话：悟空》全面测评 游戏基本概况 游戏名称：黑神话：悟空 (Black Myth: Wukong) 开发商：游戏科学(Game Science) 发行日期：2024年8月20日 平台：PC/PS5/Xbox Series X|S 类型：第三人称动作角色扮演(ARPG)，类魂游戏风格 评分：IGN中国10/10，IGN全球8/10，Metacritic 83分(PC版)，Steam 96%好评 核心体验测评 1. 视觉表现：★★★★★ - 画质：UE5引擎打造，照片级写实，光影与材质细节令人惊叹，被数毛社评为"近年来最佳视觉效果之一" - 美术风格：融合中国传统水墨与写实主义，场景设计如同"动态东方画卷"，怪物与BOSS设计独特且富有想象力 - 技术优化：PC版支持DLSS 4.0/XeSS 2.0/FSR 4.0，RTX 5090可达240+帧；PS5原生4K/60帧稳定运行 2. 战斗系统：★★★★★ - 棍法系统：三种形态(劈棍、戳棍、扫棍)，每种风格对应不同战术，打击感扎实厚重，反馈清晰 - 技能体系： - 法术(定身术、火眼金睛等)：可打断BOSS技能或探索辅助 - 变身系统：五十四种精魄变身，每种赋予独特能力(如化身为虎增强近战) - 武器与披挂：十余种属性棍棒，搭配不同披挂创造多样战斗风格 - BOSS战：80+首领战，设计精妙，挑战性强，部分被玩家称为"爽到飞起"的体验，尤其是与传统神话角色(杨戬、西王母等)的对决 3. 剧情与世界观：★★★★☆ - 故事：重构西游神话，讲述"天命人"寻找真相的旅程，穿插悟空与二郎神的"500年赌约"，结局分"坏结局"与"好结局" - 叙事：多线叙事，支线任务与隐藏剧情丰富，通过"神影图"(图鉴)和NPC对话揭示深层故事 - 文化呈现：深度融合《西游记》元素，配乐采用《云宫迅音》等经典曲目，营造浓厚中国古典氛围 4. 探索与关卡：★★★★☆ - 地图设计：非线性探索，隐藏路径与秘密丰富，但部分区域存在"空气墙"影响体验 - 环境细节：每个区域主题鲜明，细节考究，如黑风山、花果山等场景还原度高 - 收集要素：大量隐藏道具、丹药配方、变身精魄，全收集需约100小时 5. 音效与音乐：★★★★★ - 配乐：中国古典乐器+现代编曲，与场景完美契合，IGN评价"过耳不忘" - 音效：金箍棒打击、法术释放、怪物嘶吼等音效设计极具代入感，增强战斗体验 游戏优缺点分析 优点： 1. 世界级美术与技术：画面表现达到国际3A水准，成为国产游戏标杆 2. 深度战斗系统：棍法+法术+变身组合，策略性与操作感兼备，媲美《艾尔登法环》 3. Boss战设计：规模与创意俱佳，部分战斗堪称"艺术品"，挑战性与成就感平衡 4. 文化传承创新：重构西游故事，既保留传统精神又赋予现代叙事 缺点： 1. 技术问题：初期存在闪退、穿模、语言切换等Bug(已通过更新修复大部分) 2. 探索体验：空气墙过多限制探索自由度，部分地图设计较空 3. 剧情争议：部分玩家认为叙事节奏欠佳，结局设计不够圆满 4. 难度门槛：无难度选择(更新后已添加)，对新手不够友好 总体评价：★★★★★ 《黑神话：悟空》是国产游戏里程碑式作品，以三分之一国际3A团队规模，创造出足以与全球顶级作品比肩的游戏体验。IGN中国评价："说这是一场工业奇迹也绝不为过"。 适合人群： - 动作游戏爱好者(尤其是类魂游戏粉丝) - 西游记文化爱好者 - 追求高品质游戏体验的玩家 - 支持国产游戏发展的玩家 不适合：休闲玩家、对高难度游戏有抵触的玩家 最新动态： **DLC"大闹天宫"**已于2025年推出，获MC 93高分，新增"九环锡杖"武器、新Boss与剧情，延续本体高品质。官方确认后续还将开发"狮驼岭"和"女儿国"主题DLC。 最后在总结一下： 《黑神话：悟空》不仅是一款优秀的游戏，更是中国游戏产业崛起的标志。它证明了中国团队有能力制作出具有全球竞争力的3A大作，为国产游戏树立了新标杆。如果你是动作游戏爱好者，这款作品绝对不容错过。 注：本评测基于2025年12月最新版本(含DLC)，游戏仍在持续更新优化中。

Astro Bot shouldn't have been GOTY 2024. TL:DR: A tale about a wonderful game that is too loyal to its source material for its own good. (written and posted after getting all the achievements) No spoilers here, so feel free to read till the end. Also, I'll try to keep it not unreasonably long (kinda hard in this case, tbh) Where do I start with this one? I guess, with a good general question. Is it a souls-like? No, I don't think so. While all souls-likes are basically ARPGs, not all ARPGs are souls-like. In my mind it's much closer to something like Darksiders 1 or 2 than to a souls-game. Now, the review itself. The game is built on UE5 but is decently well optimized and, what's equally important, it actually looks like a game created on a newer version of an engine, which is not true for some other games on UE5 I played earlier (Lords of the Fallen (2023) and Enotria being good examples). So, to make it as clear as possible, the game looks very good. Both graphics and design-wise. Random scenery can easily become your new wallpapers. Some of the design choices I will not reveal for the sake of leaving this review spoiler-free are wonderful and I adore them. They, together with the OST create an atmosphere of an epic adventure you're a part of. The gameplay is smooth and pleasant, consisting mostly of numerous bossfights and exploration. Melee combos with a pinch of original magic create a feeling close to a wuxia action. Spectacular and even passionate. And there's also lots of content to discover, (almost way too) many secrets to hunt for, including locations, bosses and whole questlines. Also, what's really important for engagement — there's a clear sense of progress in becoming what your character is meant to be plot-wise. You can feel, see and take part the process of forging a legend. However, it's not a perfect game by any means. The one main problem it has stems from one fact. It's too long for what it is. You have your main character with his unique weapon type. And throughout the game you can find only this weapon type and one slightly different variation of it. The game took me 48 hours to beat once (rest was to get all achievements), including the hardest bosses — considering that I'm quite a seasoned souls-junkie and the game is not hard at all for the most part (it has a certain level of challenge to keep itself engaging, it just doesn't try to make you sweat), but some encounters might take a while for a person less acquainted with ARPGs/Hack-n-slash games or souls-likes. I absolutely understand the reasoning behind the weapon variety (or more precisely its absence) and a lengthy playtime, and I respect the devs for the bold choice of being so true to the source material, but I also should mention, that by the end of my initial playthrough I was getting bored exactly because of the absence of "build" variety, which should've not been a problem if not for the game being around 10-20 hours longer to beat than similar titles I might compare it to, namely the aforementioned Darksiders games. Other relatively minor drawbacks: The game is severely railed. Despite having lots of secrets, it leads you were it wants you to be by an extensive use of invisible walls. Some locations are also pretty linear. Some achievements — if you're going for 100% — are pretty grindy. Towards the end of the game signs of lack of time start showing up here and there, you'll notice them especially good in the last chapter Considering the way the gameplay is built there's no replayability. Not a drawback per se, but should be mentioned, imo. All that being said, I recommend this game. If you want an epic, lengthy action-adventure game that tells a good story, not hard as nails, but with some nice challenges — grab it even for full-prize, you'll not be disappointed. If you hesitate, sales still exist for this game, albeit they're rather rare and not steep, but if you're reading this while deciding if you want to grab the game with like a 20% discount (like me some time ago) — yes, it is worth it.

大多数动作游戏的叙事方式是： 我告诉你背景 → 你去推进故事。 《黑神话》相反： 你推进游戏 → 故事不断反过来解释你。
对于成就和意义，它取得了。销量爆炸，证明了国单的潜力。 对于游戏本身，质量勉强对的起价格，前几章的怪物质量，场景美术，建模精细度，剧情都及其优秀，但后面两三章不知是赶工还是什么原因，质量就下滑很多。且故事也几乎没讲好，在我这是烂尾。 但总体来说，对于这么一款真正意义上的国单第一，各位可以入手。
112小时的游戏时长停留在屏幕上，我终于敢说自己触碰到了这款国产3A的全貌——它不止是一场酣畅的动作盛宴，更是一次穿越神话迷雾的修行，有震撼到失语的高光，也有瑕不掩瑜的遗憾，却终究用东方风骨，撑起了玩家对国产3A的所有期待。
【总结】感觉属于难得的国产大作了，第一款ARPG类游戏。 【难度】整体难度适中。 boss：除了杨戬（逃课芭蕉扇流），毒敌大王（后期用禁字决换血）和残躯（一周目用了保命仙丹。 刚通关黑神话去打只狼，感觉黑神话的大头比只狼的赤鬼难多了，不知道是不是游科故意设计。 小兵：小兵一聚集就很烦！ 【不足】感觉用手柄玩的时候，有些飞天怪视角看不到，这点玩的时候比较烦人。

[h3]Introduction[/h3] This game is my first soullike game. I always wanted to challenge myself with one of these games one day, but just never found a story that interested me enough to play through one, until I got this game. I watched the original Journey to the West TV series with my wife about 2 years ago, so I was already familiar with the story before starting the game. This was actually good for me, as I kinda knew what to expect in some parts of the game, though the majority still remained a mystery. [h3]Bias[/h3] As a westerner who has always had a deep interest in Chinese culture and history and spent the last 5 years learning Mandarin, a game like this hits a bit different. What I mean is that I automatically will like a large portion of the game just based on my interest in China, just like how any game from Japan gets a lot of positive reviews from people who like Japan, no matter the quality of the game. So when I say this is a great game, keep in mind that I might have a huge bias when I talk about it, I'm aware not everyone will find it fascinating. [h3]Gameplay[/h3] Like I mentioned, this is my first soul-like game, so I don’t have a ton of experience with how a good game in this genre plays, but I can say that it is one of the smoothest triple A titles I have played in maybe more than a decade. The game looks beautiful, it seems to register inputs well and I am yet to crash in the game. I also haven’t encountered any graphical bugs, at least from what I have noticed. It just seems really polished overall. I do have one thing that I really do not like though and that made me almost quit a few times and that is being punished for “button mashing”. I don’t like being punished for how I play or if I’m pressing buttons too fast and I am constantly being punished for it with this anti “button mashing” implementation (that I heard is a feature and not a bug). What it does is that when you activate one of your abilities, a sort of very short animation plays and if you by accident or intentionally hit a button while this animation plays, it can and most of the time in my experience will cancel said ability but still count it as used. So it will give your ability a cooldown and it won’t refund your mana, so it just wasted one of your abilities. This is devastating in this game, since your mana does not recharge during combat and it is often necessary in order for a casual player like myself to beat a boss to have all my abilities have effect. People should be allowed to play how they want in an offline experience like this. [h3]Story[/h3] This game is based on the story of Sun Wukong, also known as the Monkey King, but takes place after the time he partook in the Journey to the West. In the show he is following a monk who is traveling to India to collect sacred buddhist scriptures while being accompanied by a few other disciples. The game happens after these events but takes inspiration from the original tale, with most of the same characters showing up again, though still with the developers own creative twist to it. I personally really liked this approach, since it made the game feel familiar yet new at the same time. While playing I kept guessing what might come next. [h3]The visuals[/h3] This game looks really good and runs extremely well considering how good it looks. The character design of the Monkey King feels new but still very familiar to how he looked in the show and the redesigns of all the evil spirits he encounters are terrifying. [h3]Difficulty[/h3] Like I said, this was my first soul-like game, and I also don’t really play fighting games, so this was really a new area for me. That said, while it was difficult in the beginning, once you get the hang of it, you can crush some bosses really quickly. I did manage to kill some of them first try, though I also am yet to finish the entire game, so it might get a lot harder near the end. [h3]Conclusion[/h3] My wife gave me this game this summer and it turned out to be really good. I definitely recommend it and especially if you can catch it on sale, though it seems to rarely go down in price, at least by a lot, so if you aren't sure about whether you will like it or not and your cash is tight, wait a few years for it to go down in price. _________________________________ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45534557/]Help me out by following my Curator, I’d really appreciate it!![/url]

Después de 85 horas de juego, puedo decir que Black Myth: Wukong es un título increíble. Al principio no me llamaba demasiado la atención y lo dejé aparcado para jugar a otros juegos, pero cuando volví a él con más tiempo, me enganchó por completo. Los combates son muy épicos y están excelentemente dise?ados. En algunos momentos pueden volverse bastante exigentes, pero con una buena build y algo de paciencia se pueden superar sin problemas. Además, la variedad de habilidades y estilos de juego permite experimentar y adaptar la jugabilidad a tu forma de jugar, evitando que la experiencia se vuelva repetitiva incluso tras muchas horas. En cuanto a la historia, es algo complicada de entender al principio, al menos en mi opinión, pero conforme avanzas va cobrando sentido y al final todo encaja bastante bien. El dise?o artístico y la ambientación son otro de los grandes puntos fuertes del juego. Los escenarios, enemigos y jefes están muy cuidados y transmiten mucha personalidad, logrando que el mundo se sienta vivo y fiel a la mitología en la que se inspira. A esto se suma una banda sonora muy bien lograda, que acompa?a perfectamente tanto los momentos más tranquilos como los combates más épicos. El mundo del juego es enorme y, si tu objetivo es conseguir el platino, es prácticamente imprescindible seguir una guía, ya que existen logros perdibles que pueden complicar mucho la tarea. Además, será necesario realizar una New Game Plus. A nivel gráfico y de rendimiento, el juego funciona muy bien. Mi equipo es una RTX 3060, i7-14700KF y 32 GB de RAM a 6000 MHz. Lo juego con todo en alto, excepto sombras y reflejos en medio, y las texturas en muy alto. Con DLSS activado, sin ray tracing ni generación de fotogramas, el juego se mantiene por encima de los 60 FPS y sigue viéndose espectacular. Eso sí, me encontré un bug donde las texturas no cargaban correctamente, aunque no fue algo frecuente y no afectó demasiado a la experiencia general. La generación de fotogramas no me ha convencido en este título, ya que he notado desgarros en la imagen, lo que afecta a la experiencia visual. En resumen, Black Myth: Wukong es un juegazo, muy recomendable tanto por su jugabilidad como por su apartado técnico y artístico. Eso sí, si buscas el platino, prepárate para seguir una guía y dedicarle muchas horas. Gracias por leer.

Black Myth: Wukong is challenging without being punishing. The difficulty pushes you to think, adapt, and experiment with builds instead of forcing a single “correct” way to play. Bosses are demanding but fair, encouraging strategy rather than frustration. The world, Chinese mythology, gods, and lore are stunning and feel genuinely alive. Combat is fluid, expressive, and rewarding, and the game respects player creativity instead of punishing it. Every defeat feels like information, not humiliation. A rare example of a hard game that values intelligence, flexibility, and immersion over mechanical obedience. Easily one of the best action games I’ve played.

完美通关《黑神话·悟空》：一场始于热爱、终于敬畏的西行史诗 当浮屠塔内杨戬的三尖两刃刀掷出，当天命人拒绝老猴子递来的金箍，当倒叙的回忆里大圣与群妖酣饮的画面渐次褪色为孤身一人，我盯着屏幕陷入了长久的沉默。几十个小时的鏖战，从花果山的晨光到小西天的暮色，从初遇鼠都尉的好奇到击败杨戬的震撼，这场完美通关的旅程，早已超越了“玩游戏”的范畴，更像是一场亲身参与的东方玄幻史诗演绎。《黑神话·悟空》用无可匹敌的文化底蕴、打磨至臻的战斗系统和充满哲思的剧情，为国产3A交上了一份足以载入史册的答卷，即便仍有瑕疵，也难掩其璀璨光芒。 若说普通通关是读懂了“天命人传承”的故事，那完美结局便是揭开了整个世界观的终极真相。游戏科学对《西游记》的改编堪称颠覆性创新，却又始终锚定着原著的精神内核。在游戏的旅程中，我不再是旁观者，而是跟着天命人一起，在碎片化的叙事中拼凑悟空的过往——他并非死于杨戬之手，而是以自我牺牲的方式留存“意”根；那些被我们击败的妖王，并非单纯的反派，而是承载着轮回与苦难的可怜人；杨戬的“磨练”与弥勒佛的“指引”，更让“西行”从“取经赎罪”升华为“自我认知与意志觉醒”的征程。 完美结局的触发过程本身就是一场修行：收集隐藏要素、解锁浮屠塔壁画、迎战杨戬的法天象地。当两大巨人在天地间展开肉搏，举手投足间毁天灭地，那种视觉与情感的双重冲击，是任何CG都无法替代的体验。而最终拒绝金箍的瞬间，更是将主题推向高潮——天命人不是悟空的“替代品”，而是继承其意志的“新生命”，这种“不是复刻，而是延续”的设定，让“齐天大圣”的形象彻底摆脱了传统桎梏，多了几分现代人对“自我价值”的思考。 作为一款动作游戏，《黑神话·悟空》的战斗系统无疑是核心亮点。我从最初被虎先锋虐到怀疑人生，到后来熟练运用识破、退寸、神通连招击败杨戬，这种成长感堪称酣畅淋漓。游戏的BOSS设计堪称“疯狂”，无论是体型庞大的晦月魔君，还是招式精妙的杨戬，每一个BOSS都有独特的攻击逻辑和破局方法，没有重复感可言。尤其是完美结局中的杨戬之战，法天象地的变身特效、多变的攻击模式，以及战斗中穿插的剧情对话，让每场战斗都像一场小型电影。 技能系统的设计也尽显巧思：没有繁杂的天赋树，升级获得的技能点可自由搭配，且支持无代价洗点，让我能大胆尝试棍、枪、拳等不同流派。七十二变不仅是探索工具，更能在战斗中发挥奇效——变身为蜜蜂躲避攻击，变身为石敢当抵御伤害，这种“策略性战斗”让动作玩法更具深度。当然，战斗系统并非完美：重棍蓄力接闪身的操作逻辑略显反人类，部分BOSS“只能修脚”的设计也让人有些憋屈，前期缺乏明确的操作指引，新手只能在反复死亡中积累经验。 大部分的时间都花在了探索上。游戏的地图设计堪称“箱庭艺术的巅峰”，每个章节的地图都相互连通，没有粗暴的加载界面，取而代之的是巧妙的通道衔接与场景过渡。从花果山的奇松怪石到黄风岭的黄沙漫天，从浮屠塔的庄严肃穆到秘境的诡谲奇幻，每一处场景都像是动态的水墨画，细节拉满——石壁上的刻痕、落叶的飘动、妖怪的神态，都彰显着东方美学的独特魅力。 探索的乐趣不仅在于风景，更在于“发现”的惊喜。隐藏的支线任务、强力的武器素材、解锁完美结局的关键道具，都藏在地图的犄角旮旯里。但游戏的引导设计却略显“残酷”：没有明确的任务指示，没有详细的小地图，很多时候只能靠直觉和反复试错。第二章的迷路经历至今让我印象深刻，在错综复杂的路径中来回穿梭，刷怪刷到麻木，一度让人产生弃坑的念头。此外，部分区域的空气墙和光源闪烁问题，也偶尔会打破探索的沉浸感。 抛开“国产3A”的滤镜，《黑神话·悟空》仍有不少值得优化的地方。除了前文提到的引导不足、操作瑕疵，游戏的后期章节明显存在赶工痕迹——第六章的“大盒子”地图空旷乏味，与前期的精细设计形成鲜明对比；部分物品的掉落率低到离谱，我曾为了收集某素材刷了两个多小时，严重影响游玩节奏；优化问题也不容忽视，即便在高性能设备上，部分BOSS战仍会出现卡顿和掉帧现象。 但这些瑕疵，在其巨大的成就面前显得微不足道。游戏科学用一己之力，将东方神话的魅力展现得淋漓尽致：台词中暗藏的文化典故、场景里融入的传统艺术、音乐中传递的民族情感，都让这款游戏成为绝佳的文化输出载体。它不仅证明了国产游戏有能力做出比肩世界顶尖水平的3A作品，更让我们看到了传统文化与现代游戏结合的无限可能。 它不是一款“完美无缺”的游戏，却绝对是一款“足够伟大”的游戏。它用充满哲思的剧情、酣畅淋漓的战斗、美轮美奂的场景，为我们构建了一个既熟悉又陌生的西游世界。完美结局的留白，不仅让“齐天大圣”的故事有了新的延续，更让我们对后续的DLC充满了无限期待——钟馗的故事、天庭的秘密、天命人的未来，这些未解之谜都等待着被揭开。 如果你是动作游戏爱好者，如果你对东方神话充满热爱，如果你愿意花时间去感受一款游戏的深度，那么《黑神话·悟空》绝对值得你入手。它或许会让你在迷路时抓狂，在BOSS战中崩溃，但当你最终解锁完美结局，看到那个继承大圣意志、孤身前行的身影时，你会明白：所有的付出，都值得。 评分：9.5/10 （扣掉的0.5分，留给需要优化的细节与未来的无限可能）

之前没玩过魂类游戏，黑神话是我接触的第一款。整体上我认为这是一款特别适合没玩过魂类玩家的游戏，首先地图没有那么复杂不需要因为一个支线或者人物来来回回跑图（相比暗黑类游戏），养成系统也很简洁（后面玩过其他的魂类，养成堪比暗黑类复杂），免费洗点，死亡无惩罚，而且重生点一般都很人性，设置在boss门口。各个boss各有特色，动作一般就两三套，只要摸熟了都不难打过。写评测时刚打完第三章的蜘蛛精，前三章的地图真的很美，真实，就像自己旅游时看到的美景精华的浓缩。打击手感和闪避反馈都很柔和，尤其切手技触发的爽感。然后就是叙事，因为是国产的游戏还是经典的西游，人物名字故事情节很容易代入。整个游玩体验很棒，期待续作！至于玩家普遍吐槽的最后两章，等我玩过了再来测评

Black Myth: Wukong es una obra de notable grandeza. Desde el inicio deja claro que no pretende ser complaciente, sino provocador. Su combate es firme y meticuloso, un forcejeo constante entre castigo y recompensa, donde la paciencia se acaricia y la imprudencia se azota sin piedad; una tensión deliciosa que mantiene al jugador siempre al borde del clímax. Su mundo, profundamente inspirado en la mitología china, se ofrece con una solemnidad embriagadora. Criaturas, escenarios y atmósferas envuelven al jugador con una presencia casi íntima, despertando una atracción difícil de resistir. Hay en cada paso una invitación silenciosa a seguir, a perderse, a entregarse por completo al mito. Nada es fortuito: todo incita, todo seduce. Black Myth: Wukong no es un juego para el apresurado ni para el gaznapiro que busca gratificación inmediata. Es una experiencia que recompensa al jugador atento y perseverante, y que demuestra que aún existen obras dispuestas a apostar por la ambición, el carácter y la identidad propia.

До того, как я купил и лично прошел эту игру, я слышал о ней только то, что это соулслайк с китайской тематикой. До этого из соулс лайков проходил все части DS, Sekiro, кольцо элдена, ну и решил попробовать эту игрульку. Пройдя ее полностью, я ни разу не пожалел о своем решении, она стала для меня совершенно новым и очень приятным опытом. Первое, о чем хочется сказать - изобилие и разнообразие боссов, ну тут буквально новая локация - босс, 200 метров прошел - босс. Эта особенность игры могла бы напрягать, но ситуация тут отличается от элдена, в котором ты заходишь в очередную гробницу, а там в конце тебя поджидает цербер (в вуконге конечно тоже есть повторяющиеся боссы, та же самая жаба, но тебе не нужно для того, чтобы дойти до нее проходить отдельную мини локацию).Масштабы некоторых боссов также оставляют приятное впечатление - взять например файт с огромной скалой и жуком-переростком. Оптимизация в игре меня порадовала. Проходил на 1660ti, настройки графики выставлял сам, картинка была красивая, лагов не замечал, были в некоторых местах неприятные моменты с отставанием звука от картинки (но думаю, это все же проблемы моего древнего компа). Касательно системы прокачки можно сказать, что есть три направления - боевые умения (помогают лучше махать палкой), магические умения (помогают лучше колдовать) и прокачка превращений. В принципе из стоек и заклинаний юзабельно +- все, чего нельзя сказать о превращениях, среди которых есть откровенно говоря бесполезные (либо по причине того, что у тебя на момент их обнаружения уже есть аналог получше, либо из-за того, что они просто шляпа) Дизайны всех локаций, кроме предгорья мне понравились (предгорье же было заметно больше всех предыдущий локация, но наполнения и деталей в ней определенно не хватало) Саунд игры оказался прям топовым (до этого никогда бы не подумал, что меня будут привлекать китайские мотивы). То же самое могу сказать и на счет мифологических мотивов, которые оказались довольно интересны (в особенности могу отметить мультики, которые вы будете смотреть после каждой главы). Касательно сюжета особо ничего сказать не могу - особо в него не вникал. То спутник хряк тебе что-то скажет, то пожилой дракон в местном хабе, то дед подпивас с тобой поговорить захочет, то неформалку какую-то в подземелье встретишь и она чего-то от тебя требует. Кстати касательно персонажей - в игре они нарисованы достаточно красиво, видно, что каждому уделено особое внимание. В итоге могу сказать, что игра на мой взгляд достойна внимания. В планах как минимум разок ее перепройти.

Black Myth: Wukong est magnifique. Vraiment. Chaque zone donne envie de s’arrêter pour admirer le décor… jusqu’à ce que le jeu te rappelle que tu ne peux admirer que ce qu’il a décidé pour toi. En ligne droite. Très droite. Les niveaux sont des couloirs soigneusement déguisés en monde ouvert. Tu vois un chemin à gauche ? Non. Un rebord escaladable ? Faux espoir. La liberté ici, c’est surtout la liberté d’avancer tout droit. Et parlons des hitbox. Certaines attaques te touchent sans te toucher. D’autres te traversent sans te toucher alors qu’elles devraient. C’est moins un système de collision qu’une interprétation artistique du concept. Résultat : tu esquives parfaitement, tu meurs quand même. Tu prends le coup en pleine face… et rien. Le vrai boss, ce n’est pas l’ennemi, c’est la physique quantique. Malgré tout, le jeu reste très fun, spectaculaire et stylé. Mais prépare-toi à accepter que dans Black Myth: Wukong, le singe n’est pas le seul à glisser.

黑悟空战斗爽快，在打boss这块基本top，但除此之外缺点明显： 1.地图设计。交互性很少，垂直面地图设计除了盘丝洞就没有了，大部分时间都是直来直去，走岔路发现新物件，但地图过大以及没有明显引导，易导致迷路，打击玩家探索欲望。 2.剧情。分类上算动作RPG，但我只能看到动作，而看不到RPG，主线剧情交代给玩家的部分很碎，个人不喜欢阴谋论剧情，但最大的问题在于剧情无法有沉浸感，没有看故事的感觉，也不存在笑点和燃点这种常见的RPG元素，主角是个哑巴，而且剧情里除了打怪，其他没有描述，可以说完全没有塑造，全靠孙悟空这个国民IP补足不足，只能让玩家脑补。我知道黑神话制作很优秀，但既然是RPG，那么讲好故事，可以让玩家有情绪起伏这很重要，不然你大可以说自己是魂类，不需要剧情。既然使用了西游记这个IP，尽管身为中国人很熟悉孙悟空的故事，但我也想看到黑神话中的西游记故事以某种方式复原在黑暗童话中，而不是只单单使用其背景，但内容基本都是原创且写故事能力很差。说实话。这游戏的剧情我直接可以给零分，即便有章节动画也无法弥补其不足，在我看来章节动画并没有很好的起到涵盖本章节剧情的作用，更多的是自由发挥，与游戏剧情直接相关很少，动画的画工可以算艺术级，但传达故事信息这块幼儿园级，有种故作高深的感觉。毕竟是面向大众的作品，通俗地讲故事能力更重要，而不是搁那遮遮掩掩，一副生怕玩家看懂了的样子，简单的说"文青病"太重。 3.个人比较在意的一些小细节： 1）主角走路有飘移感，没有实实在在走路的感觉 2）场景建模很精致，但在人物跨跃障碍物这块，感觉很烂，有种明明是实物场景，但我在很费力的向前撞的感觉，环境很真，但我的动作却很假。 3）boss战很不错，但希望除了boss动作多样性以外，也多些环境交互，大部分的战斗都是在平地上进行的，只是周围背景不一样而已，需要面对的只有判断敌方动作这一处不确定性，换言之战斗的随机性不够。 4.黑神话在建模上有最棒的细节，但在其他细节方面需要打磨的地方很多， 太多了以至于感觉多说无益。从我自己在意的地方看，希望给战斗中的boss增加更多的炫酷的玩意，这里简单举一些：1.大圣残躯和二郎神都对“定”有解法，希望增加对“隐身”的解法，天命人隐身时随机看破隐身，表现为添加特写镜头，孙悟空火眼金睛，二郎神开天眼，人物实机不好展示的话，可以用立绘或动图的形式在一边显现，告诉你我已看破隐身。2.其他boss也是一样，希望增加特写镜头，增加战斗随机性和趣味。

I wasnt a huge fan of these types of games, but i still like to give them a shot. Ive played Elden Ring, Wu Long, Lords of the Fallen(2014). This game was another game that looked beautiful,but i was somewhat apprehensive, because i dont have much experience in these games, and because of that i tend to not give them much play time as there are many other games that require a skill i have that require skill and tactics of a different sort. Nobody likes getting their butt kicked left and right. I watched the beginning cutscene, fought that fought, and then cut it off and immediately went to another game that had just released. The game i switched to was alot of fun, but then i played many more games, while this sat in my backlog, and for that i was wrong. Giving it another shot, was one of the best things ive ever done. I came back to give it another try and just decided i was going to be patient with the game, no matter how hard it may have been. Its not the hardest of its type, but some bosses perhaps are quite challenging. I stuck with it, and quickly picked up the tactics, and then i hit my first struggle, black wind. For the life of me i could not beat him, i got him down to a sliver sooo many times. Took a break after several runs on him, came back the next day, had to take a break, not because i was angry or annoyed, but because thats what humans do. We face a challenge, and let the experience soak in. The very next day i came back, and finally whooped his butt to completion. t felt good to overcome what was kind of a struggle, albeit not a pull my hair out struggle. I could see progress, and i think thats good because it lets u know your improving. Even if you cant beat him, your getting closer and thats important for new players especially. From there, i did pretty good. Most bosses i beat in one or two, and then i hit the Tiger(the one that leads to the cellar). Just like the Black Wind, it took some time. I kept dodging his first few moves and then dodging too soon for his air attack, after two quick attacks. So i tried him several times over the next few days, each day several times. I was getting sooo close and then finally i beat him and it felt great. I felt i was acclimating to a genre i would have tried, but never stuck with, but now i am and this game is perfect for new entrants. The bosses are challenging at times, but you can take a break and farm, get some more levels, progress in various ways to have a better chance at the boss, from gear u can craft or acquire to spirits, to abilities and weapons. Sometimes, people online will recommend a strategy, but sometimes those strats dont make sense for you. Even pros dont make sense sometimes. (Spoiler, Attack Type, Name, And Strat). dont Read next if u dont want a spoiler. Basically its recommended to use Pillar Stance for Black Loong to avoid his electricity aoe pulsing. The silly thing is, unless u spend quite a few points and then respec back out of pillar, your going to get knocked off the staff almost instantly. The silly thing is, that startegy over complicates an issue that is sooo simple. Its actually befuddling. The devs put in 3 or 4 rocks, that u can just jump on, and regen stamina and so forth. drink your drink etc. Its the easiest fight ever, and the pros dont even recommend to do this. They always say pillar stance, but their wrong. What im getting at in this monologue is that even if your unfamiar with this genre and have no experiencve with it, this game is the perfect game to start out and learn. Its more forgiving than other games like Souls, but has the same basic fundamentals. It has phenomenal graphics, an engaging story, fun progression(u can improve your monkey in alot of different ways) and it has that feeling when you overcome something that gave u a little trouble. This game deserved to win GoTY, and should have won way more than it did. As for the praise it did get, its deserves every flower they have ever been blessed with. If you like story, combat, character skill progression, something that will challenge you, but you will be able to overcome, and u want to play a game of this genre, then u cant go wrong with Wukong. I would bet my life on it. - From A Non Believer To A True One.

For in Wukong I felt, once more, those ancient flames: Old, forgotten joys from childhood’s distant days, Awakened in my chest like long-lost, holy rays. At first it seems a harsh and thorny road— And yes, at times it truly bears a heavy load. But each time I return to face a boss again, Again I rise, again I fall, again I gain— And through that storm I whisper, with honest breath: Thank you—for this dance with danger, life, and death. Such action! Such a trial that calls me back to fight, Dueling wonders, night to night, in blazing light. The animations, characters, cutscenes spun so fine, Artifacts and crafted worlds—each thread in perfect line. Wukong stands as proof, a legend carved in time: A game I’d place among the greatest, peak and prime. And when I’ve walked these six great chapters to the end, I know I’ll walk them once again… and yet again. So hear me, makers, hear this mythic tongue: This journey is rare—well-wrought, bold, and strong. A high adventure, vivid, strange, and bright— Wukong, my thanks… for giving childhood back its light.

Потрясающая игра, из которой не хочется выходить. Сначала мне показалось, что в игре всего слишком много: магия, стойки, диковинки, артефакты, разные бутыли, допы для бутылей, крафт, духи, перевоплощения. Но всё это открывается постепенно, что позволяет попробовать новое умение или предмет, а также, для прохождения не обязательно использовать прям всё. Хотя это существенно облегчит задачу. Для меня игра была приятной и лёгкой, хотя было несколько боссов, на которых я помучилась: четвертый лун и Эрлан. Также посидела на Страже Тигре и Тигре из календаря. Основная часть боссов проходится с первого-второго раза, на некоторых просидела попыток пять-десять (привет, Стогоазый). На НГ+ пролетела игру, не замечая врагов. Визуально игра выглядит шикарно, хотя при ввключённом rtx в снежной локации у меня мерцали деревья и квадратился снег. Иногда бывали просадки фпс, но не критично, и пару раз игра просто вылетала. В целом, игра оптимизирована хорошо. Боёвка вначале показалась слишком вычурной: гг крутит палку, сам кружится, скачет, уклоняется, кувыркается и выполняет всякие фортеля. Но стоило привыкнуть, как я стала видеть в этом красоту танца, особенно в битвах с ловкачами. Есть, конечно и недочёты. Иногда герой метит атакой не туда, куда задумывалось, иногда удивляют хитбоксы, иногда нет импакта, иногда звуки ударов не слышно. Плюс поначалу управление казалось перегруженным. Но это не помешало мне пройти боссов и не является какой-то большой проблемой. Подводя итоги, хочу сказать: игра мне очень понравилась и мне очень хочется продолжения истории.

Black Myth: Wukong looks great, but after a while it gets boring because it’s basically a “boss-fighting first” game. You enter an area, walk a little, then it’s another boss or mini-boss, and the loop repeats so much that it starts feeling like pattern homework instead of an adventure. Exploration exists, but it’s weak—there isn’t enough real discovery or meaningful side content to make the world feel rewarding to roam. Combat is also too animation-heavy. Attacks often feel stiff and “locked in,” so once you commit to a move, reacting or dodging can feel delayed. In big fights with huge bosses and lots of effects, the camera and lock-on can get messy, and sometimes you lose because you can’t clearly see or keep track of the target. The most annoying flaw is navigation: the game doesn’t guide you well, it’s easy to take the wrong path or loop back without realizing, and that turns “exploration” into getting lost. Overall, the visuals and atmosphere are strong, and some bosses look cool, but the gameplay can feel repetitive, the combat isn’t as responsive as it should be, and the poor direction/map design hurts the experience. If you like boss-rush games, you might enjoy it, but if you want exploration and freedom, it can be disappointing.

①美术设计：10.0分。这没什么好说的，满分实至名归。亮眼之处在于每章动画、每章画卷、地图中现实古迹的编排。 ②剧情设计：9.0分。此处在网上争议极大，是非曲直，实难以论说，只能斗胆跟评两句。第一章主题是观音妙评；第二章主题是秩序尊卑由天定，这也是中国历史上经久不衰的哲学议题；第三章主题是人心是试探不得的；第四章主题是相爱不一定要在一起；第五章主题是中老年人的身不由己，此点个人感触很深，进入社会之后个人努力确实对事情结果的占比在逐渐下降；第六章主题则是各种意义上的未竟。首先，各章主题分明，很好的阐述了人性中爱与复仇两大核心。其次，各章主题很符合中国传统文学“劝世教人”的核心主旨，章回体结构和半白半文的语言，加上第九艺术的表现力，可以说，黑神话悟空确实是尊重了原著。若就此点论之，各角色人物形象已然不重要，因为后者是具有时代性的，也是历代层垒叠加的结果。综合以上两点，在崇尚个人自由和物质生活从而导致精神生活出现虚无主义倾向的当代，悟空的剧情确实存在一定的教育意义。但是剧情也有问题，即存在一定程度的“中皮西骨”现象。中国传统文学并不主张绝对的善恶，一切权力关系均存在内外两因，套用剧情中的话就是“你那大师兄其实并不圆满”，而不是西方式for freedom的二元对立论。漫天神佛对灵韵的系统性剥削一定是建立在一个不得不的理由之上，否则一个绝对剥削的政治体制绝对难以维持，此处黑神话并没有详加阐述，希望在dlc中游科有所解答。综之，剧情处我个人给9.0分。 ③音乐设计：10分。此处分为三块，一是每章主题音乐。不论是《看见》的娓娓道来，还是《三界四洲》的欲壑难填，亦或是《勿听》的百转千回，还是《不由己》的歇斯底里，亦或是《未竟》的饱经沧桑都令人印象深刻。二是游戏背景音乐，首推自然是《敢问路在何方》变调，百转千回，余音绕柱，把“斗罢艰险又出发”展现的淋漓尽致。其他背景音乐也很不错，主要表现在营造战斗氛围的同时还做到了不喧宾夺主。其他同类作品常有boss战多次挑战，导致催人奋进的背景乐变成了无情嘲讽的事实，但黑神话可以说完美避开了这一点。第三块是音效。此处主要指地图背景音效，正如b站up老李聊点什么所说，背景音效真正做到了“大音希声”，即在小雷音寺有寺庙的感觉，在黄花观有道观的感觉。而且现实的背景音效是非常复杂的，有动物声、有风声、有人声，通过音效营造一个真实的环境是很困难的，游科在此处一定是下了极大的功夫。其次是打击音效，此处我个人感觉没什么雷点，但也说不出好赖，就不评价了。 ④地图设计：8.5分。其中第一章9.5分，游科在设计小规模的箱庭场景上表现不错。第二章9.0分。第三章8.0分，极乐谷差点给人干出雪盲症。第四章8.0分，阴间下洞。第五章8.0分。第六章5.5分，史中史。综合评价，8.5分。黑神话地图设计中网上最具争议的是便是空气墙，这个问题我个人认为在第二章体现最明显，其出现的根本原因还是黑神话美术太真实，导致在探图时经常出现“我认为此地能去，但是被空气墙阻挡”的情况，此种“为了艺术效果牺牲游戏性”的选择因人而异，不论褒贬皆无可指摘。所有地图中设计最出色的是浮屠塔，如果真的存在十八层地狱，那一定就是浮屠塔的样子。其中石质的转经塔旋转的声音如同磨盘一样在我心中研磨，很有一种身处旋涡无法自拔的无力感，暗合小张太子的“规劝”。加上背景乐中令人牙酸的野兽嘶吼和时不时偷袭的野怪还有几分钟一次的红眼，以及螺旋阶梯的设计，氛围感真的拉满，反正我个人当时被吓得不轻，只想快点逃离。不过一层到四层光线转明以及视野逐渐开阔，确实有柳岸明花的幸存感。另外，此处可以看到游科对于黑神话的设计是非常极端的，他们在商业和价值输出的取舍中偏向了后者，以至于游戏处处体现出了近乎神经质般的偏执。我猜测游科当时的想法就是，这可能是各种意义上第一次也是最后一次说自己想说的机会，不如抓住机会一股脑的全说了，哪怕存在明显工期不足导致的赶工，也要把故事输出出来。 ⑤动作设计，9.0分。此处无法详评，因为我对于此处没有什么研究，只能说对我来说没有雷点。不过有一点感受，除了劈棍戳棍和立棍，是不是还缺了一个扫棍之类的对群攻击棍法，总有一种没做完的感觉。还有经过解析，二郎神有70+的变招种类，大圣残躯有40+的变招种类，可以说量堆的相当足，甚至可以说有一点量变引起质变的味道。 ⑥人物形象塑造，9.5分。总体而言，各个人物的形象塑造皆很饱满，其中最喜欢的还是大圣，虽然处处没有大圣，但是处处皆是大圣。影神图、章回画卷、游戏其他角色口述各种叙述有真有假，有古有今，真正体现出了老猴所说“你那大师兄并不圆满”。

This game feels like a throwback, in a bad way. It's mechanically basic, with only a dodge for defence and some very awkward basic attacks that lock you into combos from single inputs - this isn't inherently bad, but it feels weird when initiated from a basic attack input. There seem to be a lot of bosses, but they're not of consistent quality, and even if they were, the best ones are still boring because you have very few abilities; there's a range of skills you can use, that are tied to both a cooldown timer and a resource at the same time, but they are fairly basic at least for as far as I've played. The sections between bosses are even worse, and seem basically unconcerned with any concept of level design or encounter design... what's more, the game looks rough and runs poorly. It's a harsh contrast with something like Stellar Blade, which uses older tech but is clearly more suited to a fast-paced action game and is a much more visually appealing game besides. Wukong would have been better using UE4 with baked GI and SSR, but that would have cost more to develop, I'm sure. I do feel like a lot of work went into this, and it's always a shame when a lot of hard work is ruined by poor gameplay design. It is what it is, though. Play something else. Play Lies of P, or Nioh 2. Unless you have an attachment to Journey to the West, there is no reason to play this.

The best way I could describe this is "PlatinumGames' Dark Souls". Yes, it does indeed have elements from Soulslikes, but its combat is so hyperfocused on rewarding the player with bonuses for performing well, that it puts it straight into PG territory. That's not a bad thing, but players should not go into this game expecting to have their teeth kicked in. With several fighting styles being available and swapping between them being completely free, the game's a lot less limiting at the beginning than the usual Soulslike. That aside, the game is stunningly gorgeous, respects the history it is based on, comes with fantastic Chinese voice acting, has an incredible soundtrack that's hard not to think about constantly and gives me hope that games based on Chinese mythology have a chance to be explored properly now, more than ever before. This game is fantastic and absolutely deserves its asking price. Just don't expect Dark Souls, because this is not it.

《黑神话悟空》是有里程碑意义的，我想绝大多数中国游戏玩家都有这么一个梦想：制作有世界影响力的国产3A大作。无论通关后体验如何都值得一试，对于未来的国产游戏而言这就是我们来时的路。 整个游戏过程中第一第二章的体验很棒，特别是第二章虽然地图并不复杂，但也尽心设计了场景支线解密，战斗体验和剧情也给了我极高的期待。可到了第三章却急转直下，我玩游戏是为了消遣，不是来被消遣的，设计一些毫无意义的恶心机制是什么心态呢？基于第三章的恶劣体验，后面两章倒有一种劫后余生的庆幸，算是中规中矩。直到第六章，太失望了，这游戏就没做完！之前已经隐隐感到在特意做大场景浪费跑路时间，第六章更是偌大一个地图只有场景树和山，引导也没有就让玩家楞找BOSS。 幸好冯骥还有“云宫迅音”压箱底，最后一场战斗做得是用心了。BGM一响，这一路都值了，就为了取这份“真经”啊！不禁感慨以前欧美日的玩家真是幸福，游戏里的亭台楼阁台词设计，个中巧思是只有属于自己的文化才能体会到，太感动了！总得来说动画、音乐、剧情都很棒，我与自己和解了。 我是今年才买了这款游戏，据说刚出的时候连地图都没有，游科真应该感谢玩家们，把这一作抬到了本不属于它的高度。现在是《怪物猎人》都会差评如潮的时代了，《黑神话悟空》里很多怪物设计是有问题的，甚至产生了一种体型越大越弱智的怪象，还有的只会垃圾招式，比如我打青背龙的时候，那呆物竟一直后退缩到角落往面前扔雷，靠近就复读这招，让人无语。第一代很多问题尚可以理解，希望游科别把玩家的包容当作自己营销的胜利，在《黑神话钟馗》里给玩家带来真正的惊喜。

当金箍棒的嗡鸣穿透屏幕，当花果山的残阳映红眼底，《黑神话：悟空》从来都不只是一款游戏。它是一场跨越童年与成年的对话，一次对东方神话的深情叩问，更是将我们心底沉睡多年的英雄梦，连同那些未被驯服的反抗欲，一并唤醒的精神盛宴。 神话祛魅：在黑暗里看见真实的人性 我们自幼熟记的西游，是神佛庇佑的光明叙事，而《黑神话》却敢撕开神话的华美外衣，露出底下权力的褶皱与人性的斑驳。天庭不再是正义的化身，而是用 “天命” 编织枷锁的权力机器；神佛并非慈悲为怀，反倒借着 “普渡众生” 的名义，吞噬着众生的信仰与自由。 这里的每一个角色，都带着沉甸甸的烟火气与悲剧感。八戒憨态可掬地跟在身后，一遍遍复述着与猴哥的过往，那些未曾说出口的思念，藏着中国人最含蓄的兄弟情；菩提祖师的壁画前，飘落的菩提叶默默回血，那句 “我有一个故人，怕他闯下烧身大祸”，道尽了师父对弟子藏于心底的牵挂与庇佑；通臂猿猴踏遍三界寻找五蕴，只为再见 “孩子” 一面，当看到身着大圣铠甲的天命人时，她眼中的执念化为释然，让人心碎又温暖。就连悟空本人，也不再是无所不能的齐天大圣。他是在神性与兽性间挣扎的反英雄，是识破神佛骗局后以死反抗的觉醒者，是即便肉身覆灭，意志也依然要冲破轮回的孤勇者。这些破碎的、不完美的形象，恰恰戳中了我们内心最柔软的地方 —— 我们都曾渴望成为英雄，却也都明白，真正的勇敢，是认清世界的荒诞后，依然选择坚守本心。 意志永生：反抗是刻在骨子里的基因 游戏最动人的内核，从来不是惊天动地的 BOSS 战，而是对 “自由” 与 “反抗” 的永恒歌颂。金箍不再是简单的法器，而是体制的规训、命运的枷锁；取经路也不是通往救赎的坦途，而是一场被操控的轮回骗局。 天命人的每一次死亡与重生，都是对既定命运的反抗；每一次拒绝戴上金箍的选择，都是对自由意志的坚守。当最终在花果山的残阳下，《云宫迅音》的旋律缓缓响起，我们穿上凤翅紫金冠、锁子黄金甲，握住那根沉甸甸的金箍棒时，心中涌起的早已不是单纯的激动，而是一种成年后久违的、梦想成真的震颤。 我们终于可以不再只是旁观者，而是成为了那个从小就向往的英雄 —— 不是被神佛驯服的 “斗战胜佛”，而是永远敢于挑战权威、打破枷锁的 “齐天大圣”。这种感动，源于文化血脉的共鸣，更源于我们每个人都曾有过的、不愿被世俗磨平棱角的倔强。 文化回响：在第九艺术里安放民族的乡愁 对于我们这代人而言，《西游记》是刻在 DNA 里的文化记忆。而《黑神话》最了不起的地方，是用次世代技术，将那些只存在于文字与想象中的东方美学，具象成了可触可感的沉浸式体验。千佛古刹的残破佛像、悬空寺的飞檐斗拱、水墨写意与粒子特效交织的战斗场景，每一处都透着熟悉的东方韵味。 当外国玩家在惊叹神话的瑰丽时，我们感受到的，是一种文化自信的回归。我们终于不用再在西方游戏里扮演牛仔、刺客，而是可以回到自己的文化土壤，扮演那个从小就扎根在心底的英雄。这种归属感，是任何外来作品都无法给予的，它像一杯陈酿，越品越浓，越品越让人动容。 《黑神话：悟空》的成功，从来不止于技术的突破，更在于它让我们重新审视自己的文化，重新拥抱心底的英雄梦。它告诉我们，神话从未远去，那些关于反抗、关于坚守、关于情谊的故事，始终在我们的血脉里流淌；它也让我们明白，真正的自由，不是颠覆一切，而是在认清生活的真相后，依然保有那份不被驯服的勇气。

The elephant in the room: You have probably heard of this game as some Battletoads-hard soulslike game with soul crushing difficulty. It's half true. What's true is that it's more challenging than your average title these days. There are a number of bosses you will struggle to beat as you learn the game. But that's just it, you'll beat the bosses and learn gradually how to make your own builds to beat them. There isn't any penalty for dying, you just go back to a nearby checkpoint. I want to get that out of the way because I think that makes some people reluctant to try it. Just to emphasize, this game can occasionally be a challenge but it's not like the games of the 90s. What you might not like: dying. You will probably do that a few times. There is no difficulty slider to just play the game your way. So be prepared to challenge yourself sometimes and get stuck on a few of the bosses. What you will like: *Dopamine hits when you see the beautiful text hit the screen "Tiger Vanguard Defeated" and a great animation to treat you to your W. *BEAUTIFUL game, dive deep into a story inspired by Chinese folklore and the cultural staple "Journey to the West." *Action game with great leveling system and numerous ways to build the story's hero. It's free to re-set the builds infinitely. *Monke

[h1] Black Myth: Wukong Review: A Worthy Sequel to Journey to the West [/h1] From what I know, this is the first PC game from this publisher and dam, I'm impressed. As someone who's read the classic novel Journey to the West, I rate this game extremely highly. It not only respects the original source material but can truly be seen as a direct continuation or sequel to it. (-) Story: Incredibly Engaging and Addictive The narrative is captivating from start to finish, constantly sparking curiosity and driving players to explore every corner. I personally give this aspect the highest marks—it's a masterclass in storytelling that honors the mythology while expanding it in thrilling ways. (-) Gameplay: Responsive Souls-like with Stunning Variety The combat is pure souls-like bliss: fast, fluid, and incredibly responsive. The diverse move sets and combos are visually spectacular, making it impossible to get bored. Even after beating the game, you'll want to dive back in for a second playthrough—the sheer variety in builds and playstyles ensures endless replayability, with new secrets and unlocks waiting each time. (-) Graphics & Sound: AAA Excellence This is where Unreal Engine 5 truly shines, delivering breathtaking classical Chinese environments—towering mountains, lush forests, eerie caves—with buttery-smooth animations. Boss designs are cinematic, straight out of an animated blockbuster. The OST is epic perfection: folk tunes straight from the original tale blended with explosive metal and modern flair, perfectly evoking nostalgic memories. [b]The positive: [/b] + Outstanding, highly diverse boss fights and combat. + Top-tier graphics and music; fresh take on the mythology. + Exceptional replay value. + Solid optimization—even mid-range PCs can handle it smoothly. [b]The negative: [/b] - Exploration feels somewhat limited. - Story can be tough to grasp, especially for Western players unfamiliar with the source material. - Technical issues persist on weaker consoles. - The final chapter feels rushed—it's very short and lacks depth. Playtime: >50 hours (1st run - Story mode) [u] Final RATE: [/u] 9.5/10 An Absolute Must-Play!

Wukong is a very good game but I wouldn't say it's the top echelon of gaming by any means. Combat is great, story is really good (story is amazing if you've read the books), and the graphics are definitely top tier. The reason why its metrics are so high for concurrent player base is almost due to the Chinese audience. It's their folklore and myths reimagined into a video game. It's their historical myth come to life. It resonates deeply with them. It's the same thing with Red Dead Redemption 2 being so popular in the U.S as opposed to China or Korea. It's the U.S historical period. So it resonates with us more than it would them. Doesn't mean they won't enjoy it and the same is with Wukong. It's a really solid game. During its peak Steam player count, it had like 2m players… But like 90% of that was again from China. It very much is a 7/8 out of 10 game but a particular group of people made it their identity to champion really hard. It’s probably a bit overhyped but it’s a pretty good game. It’s not fully souls like, in terms of gameplay it’s probably closest to a slightly harder Star Wars Jedi Fallen Order/Survivor or an easier Nioh. It’s not a masterpiece, or groundbreaking, or really a top 20 game ever made or whatever. But it’s based off a super popular ancient Chinese story/myth that’s pretty embedded into the memories of lots of East Asian cultures. The graphics are really nice, it’s fun to play, it’s just one of those games that’s super popular. The lore and art is a 10/10 for me, if you're a fan of Xianxias/Journey to the West or Chinese mythos in general, you'll love the game, so many references and Chinese proverbs and every enemy in the game, even the most insignificant one gets a journal with lore of that enemy along with an incredibly well drawn art piece of them in the iconic ancient Chinese art style. Story enjoyment for this game really seems to hinge on your interest in the mythology. A big reason I got hooked on God of War back in the 00s was purely for that reason. This game turns that up to 11. I knew almost absolutely nothing about the legend behind the game, but this story played out incredibly for me. If you feel like youre not getting pulled into the lore/story enough, check out the journal. They really went into great depth with it. The post-chapter vignettes are also very well done and can be downright moving at times. If I hadn't waited until 2024 to play Sex with Hitler 3D, BM: Wukong would have been my favorite game of that year. Black Myth Wukong is a pretty solid experience and should be celebrated for what it has accomplished, but it does have quite a few flaws that people are overlooking due to the hype surrounding it. I also think a lot of the hype is how it fully embraces Chinese mythology and makes it cool, as someone who’s wife’s boyfriend is half American-East Asian it’s not really something you see embraced and fawned over by Western culture a lot outside of like the usual Kung fu and Samurai stuff. Again it’s kind of like God of War, or Percy Jackson but for Chinese, I mean not fully but something similar. The Chinese market is GIGANTIC so I expected them to react very strongly, however I’m pleasantly surprised to see it embraced/hyped in the West too. The game is not nearly as difficult as your average souls like outside a handful of bosses and some people do find the combat repetitive, I personally enjoyed it but I can’t deny that you’ll be pretty much doing the same moveset for the entire game. The game is pretty linear so the exploration isn't gonna really be there (there are some secrets here and there though). The bosses are great, this game has more bosses than any game of its size I've ever seen, and I enjoyed fighting every one of them. The boss design and diversity is also top notch, no two bosses are the same, you might find similarities in some of the minibosses but for the most part the game does a good job of making every encounter feel fresh. Although pretty basic, the combat played very well for me and it’s not a button masher whatsoever. It’s actually more of a learn the movements and strike when you can game. The total opposite of button masher. Definitely not a soulslike and more of a God of War. But also not as good as God of War more in the Stellar Blade tier of action games. It takes a little while to understand the combat for sure, but one big thing that helped me is to realize that each push of the attack button does one swing of the staff. So if you mash the button three times really quickly, he’ll swing the staff three times, but it can feel like his movements are delayed because by the time you’ve finished mashing attack, he’s still swinging. The better way is to time your button presses to his animations. So if you press the attack button once, wait until that first swing has almost resolved before pressing it again. Once you can feel the rhythm of the attacks, you won’t get caught being hit mid animation as much, and you’ll feel more in control / have a better understanding of the combat. Also, utilizing the different stances and their different power attacks is key. I honestly can’t recommend it enough if you’re a fan of action games and/or “soulslikes.” It’s gorgeous and fluid with intense combat, incredible art direction and a pretty fun if difficult to follow story until you become more familiar with it. 一年后来补票黑神话悟空，57个小时通关真结局...... 这款游戏作为国人的第一款3A游戏，以及我接触过的第一款3A游戏，给我带来的第一印象是很不错的。取材来自于大家熟悉的西游记，不过不同的是大圣在故事里陨落了。关于美术质量，从开局CG到最后一战，场景的刻画是非常精良的。该说不说前面两章连小怪都会有一些特殊的台词。可能因为游戏赶工期这些小细节在后面的章节没有体现。 说到剧情，玩家将扮演天命人一路上消灭妖王，寻找大圣的六根的故事。原本的结局应该是天命人继承大圣的意志并且戴上了金箍。但是当玩家做完所有章节的支线任务，并且与二郎神交战后，我们才意识到并不像序章那样大圣被二郎神杀死了，而是主动寻死。随着天命人同样历经九九八十一难后，我们也能逐渐发现天庭黑暗的一面。并且在最后战胜大圣残躯后拒绝带上金箍。其实有一个细节是，如果触发的是坏结局的话，石猿会复原并且老猴子会开始寻找下一个天命人。我认为在编剧上无论是细节还是内容的精彩程度斗非常完美了，无论是对原著的复刻以及自己的创新。 关于游戏玩法，不同于魂类游戏，这个游戏有丰富的技能系统，这样能更容易被大众接受，以至于玩家不是为了针对每个不同行为的boss去背出招或者通过反复练习去掌握不同的棍法流派。在难度上，因为有等级系统，以及丹药系统，卡关的事情会比较少发生。作为一个中等水平的动作游戏玩家，对于一些网传公认很难的boss虎先锋，小黄龙，二郎神。我最多花了40多次去战胜它们。虽然说玩的过程中有点红温，但是总体来说负反馈没那么大。我在游玩过程中有2次动过开修改器的想法，不过后来还是通过努力练习打败了困难的boss。 美中不足的是这个游戏还是存在一些优化问题。在最后一张抓凤翅将军的时候，游戏有可能会闪退。在第二章隐藏关沙漠以及第三关的部分雪地渲染会非常奇怪。 在挑战部分能飞天的boss的时候hitbox会很奇怪，很多时候莫名其妙打不中。这些有待优化。 总体来说黑神话悟空是一款非常优秀的3A游戏，我相信也为中国3A大作开了个好头！非常推荐这款游戏！！

I went in expecting a full on Souls-like and that’s not what this is. Sure, there’s a bit of that DNA in the movement and structure, but it plays much closer to a character action game that occasionally pretends to be something harsher. Exploration is there, but most of the time it feels like a very pretty boss-rush broken up by short walks through scenic areas. The opening chapters had me genuinely excited. Great pacing, great atmosphere and I loved that the game doesn’t punish experimentation at all. I swapped builds constantly, tried weird setups, adjusted for each encounter, and the game happily let me. A few bosses were genuine walls, but the majority go down surprisingly easily considering how dramatic and intimidating their entrances are. The difficulty curve is basically a rollercoaster: struggle on one, steamroll the next ten. Going for 100% took me about sixty hours, including some material grinding and a bit of NG+ cleanup. The visuals are fantastic and the art direction is consistently strong, even if a few textures look a little unfinished when you get too close. Still, the overall presentation is gorgeous. There’s real talent behind this, and I’m honestly excited to see what the studio does next.

Game 159 of my backlog I do recommend this game but it has a lot of little things that make me want to scream. Call it pet-peeves as most of my gripes outside of a couple are pretty minor. + Overall fun mechanically skill based combat system + An interesting story + Solid gameplay length and some NG+ challenges, including boss gauntlets which is always appreciated + Lots of little secrets + Lots of Builds + Some cool fight scenes + Fantastic music + Incredible boss battles + PS5 controller works great and they give you options to select what game icons you want (Xbox or Playstation). Every game should do. + Cloud - You're stuck relatively with the same light combos throughout the entire game. The heavy combos I feel should be renamed to "situational" combos or something like that, as they're not "heavy" in the same way that most games would classify that term. There are 3 stances that impact a few abilities with the light combos and these "heavy" combos are those abilities. Be aware that even with this, you'll still be using the game 6 attacks through 90% of the game. - Secrets are just that. Secrets. But some of these secrets are miss-able and are still miss-able in NG+ at the time of this review. E.g. a certain piece of armor during a specific boss fight. You miss it in your first playthrough, and it's gone forever unless you start completely fresh. I have yet to know or hear if it changes in NG++ or beyond. - Some mechanics are not thoroughly explained in the slightest. Like holding onto the antennas of a giant bug. This is not a spoiler unless you look it up, so don't go looking it up if you're reading this and plan to buy. It'll make sense when you get to the right spot. Anyway, what should be obvious was not initially and believe me when I say this can be very frustrating. - Game is mostly on rails. I.e. you don't get much exploration outside of the path you're on, with some small exceptions in a couple areas. Don't get me wrong in this as there are a lot of side paths in some of these various areas with some secrets to unlock and collect, but even those are mostly hallways. Would be nice to jump over that small railing down to the area below, but it forces you to walk around the railing and down the stairs. - Sprinting with L3 should continue sprinting even after jumping. It doesn't. This QoL feature I will nitpick to death because I hated it. You can also hold-sprint with R1/RB to mitigate this but this is unnatural for me personally. When we land on the ground after jumping, it should continue going the same speed as before the jump, unless you're out of stamina. - In order to understand the full story, you pretty much have to read some outside material. The pacing in this game is a bit chaotic but I feel it'd be less chaotic if you've read the Chinese Novel: Journey to the West. I did not. But after finishing the game, I've been told that I should have the Novel first, and everything would've been much better and much more easily understood. Rip So again, most of these are minor and some QoL stuff; don't let it deter you. If you're a Souls fan or a Wukong fan then this game should be right up your alley. It's very well made, has some fantastic memorable moments, and I do overall recommend it.

[h1] 10/10 [/h1] 不愧是村里第一个大学生，真的是十分优秀的游戏。《黑神话：悟空》以重走西游为主题，讲述了天命人在冒险途中成长，一步一步继承孙悟空的名号的故事。 [h2] 地图 [/h2] 《黑神话：悟空》的主要玩法是探索地图与战斗爽。地图主题鲜明，五个章节各不相同，从地图的主题颜色就可以看出。而且每一章的地图都很宏大，第一二章只有一个平面，但是从第三章开始地图就变成有层次的了。但美中不足的是空气墙实在是太别扭了，悬崖那些空气墙用踉跄的动作代替了（而且还不是每个悬崖都有踉跄动作），那平面地图怎么不放写花草水木遮挡一下呢？某些地方看似能去实则不行的感觉太奇怪了。不过瑕不掩瑜。 [h2] 战斗 [/h2] 战斗机制非常丰富，既有化身又有变身，还有各种天赋点、法术和架势值得琢磨。还有和别的类魂游戏很大的不同的是：黑猴死后不会有惩罚，而且等级归等级，货币归货币，两种变强路径；而且还可以查看地图！这样就可以让玩家在不查攻略、沉浸式体验游戏的情况下还不会迷路了。毕竟游戏最忌讳的就是游戏推进不下去。而且路上的小兵基本没难度，就头目和妖王是有点难度的。可以放心大胆的爽推图。 [h2] 敌人 [/h2] 敌人的种类也很多，从小兵到头目到妖王，基本不重样的，而且章节与章节之间的妖怪种类还是蛮不一样。 黑猴里还有个猪八戒这个话痨NPC还是蛮有趣的，也让玩家在旅途中多了一点陪伴。而且猪八戒回忆大师兄的过往可能也会引起玩家的共鸣。每一章节后的动画看着也蛮震撼的，感觉有点深度的。还有各种非细节，比如上坡会有轻微减速，筋斗云划过水面会有涟漪等等，可以看出游科是真的认真打磨了的。 [h2] 总结 [/h2] 最后一章更是惊喜，玩家将降伏孙悟空的各种装备所化成的妖怪，取得孙悟空的所有装备，还能与斗战神佛交手，最后继承孙悟空的名号。这一招一式之间我看到了传承，既是游戏中孙悟空与天命人之间的武艺传承，更是游戏外中华文化的传承。

Though Steam overlay showed 60 fps. I was seeing considerable input lag. Switching off frame gen and setting DLSS to "25" performance mode finally made the experience excellent. I also had semi-frequent driver crashes (This is nitpicking, considering 95% of the game ran flawlessly well, but my system is quite top end) - Towards the final act, [spoiler] when you receive the somersault cloud, the world opens up. This was awesome initially, but diverted hugely from the mostly liner nature of the game so far, and I had a hard time figuring out what to do next and needed help from a friend for hints on how to progress. Bit of a win and a loss. [/spoiler] Must play for action game lovers. I would consider this a cross between Sekiro and God of War.
