Не понимаю как эта игра могла понравится такому огромному количеству людей с учётом того, что в ней до ужаса много минусов. Я поставил 4 из 10 этому симулятору примата. Такую оценку она получает только за парочку боссов, которые правда интересны, а также могу отметить 5 главу, она сделана правда так, как должна работать и выглядеть эта игра, про сюжет расскажу чуть позже. Начнём с мира - это затянутые и скучные главы с огромным количеством невидимых стенок, которые просто убивают стимул изучения локации, если ты в конце разветвления дороги получаешь какой-то ненужный ресурс (травка, дргуая травка и ещё вот эта травка), если не верите, то посмотрите максимально внимательно на 2 и 3 главу и ещё раз подумайте над этим суждением. Такое чувство, что каждую главу делали просто разные люди, каждый из которых не до конца понимал как должно играться "ЭТО". Ещё хочу отметить - 6 глава просто скучнейший кусок игры, в котором кроме как финального босса и собирания полного костюма обезьяны нет просто ничего, хотя при этом тебе дают ОБЛАЧКО, с помощью которого по твоему мнению ты можешь отыскать много всего на громадном поле для изучения, а там нет ровным счётом ничего и в 5 главе получается больше боссов чем во всей 6. Если затронуть сюжет, то секретная концовка и прохождение всех секретных локаций по правде заинтересовывает тебя и ты понимаешь, что у этой игры есть хотя бы интересный момент, который тебе рассказывают после победы финального босса. Геймплей в этой игре работает максимально тупой, он просто красочный и не более, интереса прокачивать что-то у тебя нет после того как ты видишь, что на каждую линейку нужно по 100 с лишним поинтов, а когда ты достигаешь к концу игры 100-го уровня, то ты не откроешь даже половину. А сама прокачка по сути ничего не включает интересного, большинство из способностей - это просто ужас, которым ты никогда не воспользуешься в игре. Моё личное суждение: "Игра понравилось только людям, которые любят игры ради постановочных "cinema" сцен с красивой графикой, которая жрёт все ресурсы твоего компьютера и не предлгает больше НИЧЕГО такого, чего нет в других играх, в первую очередь такие люди скорее всего не знают, что такое интересный геймплей в играх и зачем он придуман". Это точно не игра 2024 года, уж простите))

Black Myth: Wukong is undeniably a remarkable journey—but one that ultimately feels like it's missing something. While the game is of impressively high quality, it doesn't quite live up to the enormous hype surrounding it. I'll try to explain why it falls short of being a perfect experience. Let’s start with the graphics: they are stunning. The environments are beautifully rendered, and the combat sequences are highly cinematic. Bosses in particular stand out, with uniquely animated attack patterns—some of which are truly epic. That said, there were occasional issues with asset streaming. Sometimes, parts of the environment would load at noticeably lower quality—like a single blurry patch on an otherwise gorgeous mountain or temple. These moments broke immersion and were quite frustrating. However, these seem to stem from Unreal Engine 5 rather than being specific to Black Myth: Wukong itself. The narrative should be one of the game’s strongest points, but for me, it wasn't. I found the story lacking in clarity and cohesion. The game is divided into six chapters, which makes the pacing feel fragmented. Although each chapter connects to the overarching plot, transitions between them often felt abrupt and disjointed. I frequently found myself wondering why I was in a particular location or what exactly my objective was. I would have appreciated more world-building—through dialogue, lore entries, or collectible items—to flesh out the plot and characters. Completing the game left me with more questions than answers. I had to spend a significant amount of time researching external explanations just to piece together what had happened. It's a shame, because with just a little more narrative support, the story could have been truly compelling. Combat is visually spectacular and generally smooth. Compared to titles like Elden Ring, the difficulty level is relatively accessible. If you're not especially confident in your skills, you’ll likely still find Wukong manageable and enjoyable. However, I did feel a slight lack of build variety. While there’s a good selection of spells and transformations, customization options felt somewhat limited overall. Still, the depth in abilities available does help offset this shortcoming. Despite its flaws, Black Myth: Wukong is a game I’d recommend to fans of the Souls-like genre. It delivers a grand setting, incredible visuals, and a memorable musical score. If you can forgive its storytelling missteps, there’s a lot here to enjoy.

一、视觉盛宴：中式美学的极致呈现 踏入《黑神话：悟空》的世界，仿佛瞬间穿越到了那个神秘而奇幻的西游时代。游戏采用 UE5 引擎打造，呈现出令人惊叹的画面效果。场景建模精细入微，树木的苍虬纹理、岩石上的裂纹青苔清晰可见，每一处细节都处理得恰到好处，让人不禁感叹开发者的用心。大量装饰性的石刻、建筑、佛造像等元素，明显取自实景，为游戏增添了浓厚的历史文化底蕴。 游戏中的水体效果堪称一绝，清澈透亮的溪流、白浪滚滚的激流，在引擎自带效果的基础上，经过手工调校，显得更加逼真。以黑风山关卡为例，林中溪流在流速和缓处，潭底石块上的青苔将河水映照得青翠如碧，踏足其上，涟漪圈圈晕开，极富中式园林感。而在陡坡激流处，水流的动态效果与两侧的葱郁植被相得益彰，搭配上踩在水上的顿挫声响，让人仿佛身临其境，分不清现实与虚幻。 战斗演出与动画过场同样精彩绝伦。游戏中大量运用单机位视角转动实现的一镜到底，开场的战斗演出就足以让人热血沸腾。摄影机位紧紧锁定在对垒双方的兵刃处，角色身影闪转，武器轮番挥击，场景内风起云飞、金铁交鸣，那种紧张刺激的氛围让人血脉偾张。此外，游戏中还加入了 “巨型 BOSS” 的设计，建筑、天命人与 BOSS 同屏出现，尽管体积差异巨大，但都保持了一致的建模精度，实际效果令人震撼。 章节之间的前情提要与后记，更是展现了游戏科学卓越的艺术造诣。制作团队运用了手绘、木偶戏、吉卜力等多种画风与动画技法，讲述了不同的故事，主题涵盖典故故事和中式寓言，并配上了专属的超优质 BGM，每一段间章故事都像是一部精彩的动画短片，让人沉浸其中，流连忘返。 二、战斗系统：深度与爽感并存 《黑神话：悟空》的战斗系统丰富而有深度，绝对能满足玩家对动作游戏的高要求。游戏以棍势作为核心资源，常规战斗节奏是通过轻攻击获得棍势积蓄资源，重攻击消耗棍势打出高伤害。这种设计既考验玩家的操作技巧，又让战斗过程充满策略性。 天命人拥有三种架势，分别为劈棍、立棍和戳棍，每种架势都有独特的动作派生与重攻击特性。劈棍的轻重攻击连携具有看破判定，能够确反敌人攻击打出酷炫连段，终结技伤害高但手短；立棍可以撑起规避地面伤害，且能攻击高打点敌人，但被打落僵直时间长；戳棍的接手技能可派生后跳动作，灵活度高，能在规避敌人攻击的同时发动反击。这三种架势如同《仁王》中的 “上、中、下段”，为玩家提供了应对不同敌人的多样手段，玩家需要在战斗中不断学习和运用，根据敌人的特性选择最合适的架势，才能在战斗中占据上风。 法术和变身也是战斗中的重要组成部分。定身、聚形散气、铜头铁臂、安身术、身外化身等法术随着游戏进程逐渐解锁，它们消耗法力，但效果强大，能在关键时刻扭转战局。变身系统则更为多样有趣，游戏中有两套变身体系。一套是通过剧情和支线解锁的化身系统，如靡道人的藕苞和广智的赤潮，变身后会完全改变天命人的动作系统，并赋予全新的特殊技能；另一套是在打杀精英小怪后获得的精魄，类似《仁王 2》的魂核妖怪技，玩家可以使用小怪的某项技能，为战斗增添更多变化和乐趣。据统计，游戏内几乎每种小怪都能为天命人提供精魄，数量远超 50 种，玩家可以搭配棍势连段，创造出属于自己的酷炫组合技。 此外，游戏的 RPG 养成要素也为战斗增色不少。角色升级需要消耗打怪或探索获得的灵光点，技能树简约明了，玩家可以根据自己的喜好提升天命人的各项基础属性，或者强化棍势系统的动作性能，亦或是增强法术效果。装备系统同样丰富，玩家可以通过主线进度推进和地图收集，解锁武器与披挂的铸造，装备上除了基础防御属性，还有各种实用的套装效果。消耗品 —— 丹药系统，也在战斗中发挥着重要作用，玩家可以通过特定 NPC 炼制各种丹药，提升自己的战斗能力。 三、关卡与 BOSS 设计：量大管饱的挑战 《黑神话：悟空》的关卡设计丰富多样，采用章节制结构，每个章节都有独特的场景风格和关卡布局。关卡中不仅有主线任务，还隐藏着大量的支线任务和探索要素，如隐藏关卡、打坐点、精英杂兵、宝箱和资源道具等。玩家在探索过程中，需要仔细观察周围环境，寻找隐藏的路径和线索，才能发现这些隐藏要素，这为游戏增添了不少探索乐趣。 游戏的 BOSS 战堪称一大亮点。千奇百怪、数以百计的 BOSS 拥有独特的外形和战斗方式，对玩家的操作技巧和战术应变能力提出了极高的挑战。每个 BOSS 都有自己的攻击模式和弱点，玩家需要通过不断尝试和观察，找出应对策略。BOSS 之间的差异极大，几乎没有换皮现象，这种 “量大管饱” 的设计方式，在如今 3A 游戏纷纷削减内容量和游戏时长的当下，显得诚意十足。 支撑各大 BOSS 的是一个巨大的线性流程世界，类似于《仁王》系列，通过捷径将多个小区域连接起来，构建出一个立体且复杂的大地图。每个章节的地图内都分布着若干个 BOSS，有些 BOSS 容易找到，而有些则需要玩家通过完成支线任务和深入探索才能触发。这种设计既保证了游戏的挑战性，又为玩家提供了足够的探索空间，让玩家在游戏过程中始终保持新鲜感。 四、文化传承：对西游文化的全新演绎 《黑神话：悟空》以中国古典名著《西游记》为蓝本，对西游文化进行了深入挖掘和全新演绎。游戏中不仅出现了众多大家耳熟能详的角色和场景，如孙悟空、猪八戒、牛魔王、黑风山、火焰山等，还融入了大量的中国传统文化元素，如佛教、道教、神话传说等。这些元素不仅丰富了游戏的内容，还让玩家在游戏过程中感受到了浓厚的中国文化氛围。 游戏中的故事剧情虽然并非完全照搬原著，但却巧妙地融合了原著中的经典情节和元素，讲述了一个全新的西游故事。在游戏里，天命人需要重走西行路，寻找数样奇宝，战胜多位强敌，一路上看遍人间冷暖，阅尽贪嗔痴三毒之祸。这种对西游故事的重新诠释，既保留了原著的韵味，又为玩家带来了新鲜感，让玩家在游戏过程中仿佛置身于一个真实的西游世界。 此外，游戏中的音乐、音效也极具中国古典文化特色。配乐采用了大量的传统乐器，如古筝、二胡、笛子等，曲调悠扬婉转，与游戏的场景和氛围相得益彰。战斗音效则逼真地模拟了武器碰撞、法术释放等声音，让玩家在战斗过程中更加身临其境。 五、性能优化：流畅运行的保障 在性能优化方面，《黑神话：悟空》也表现出色。经过实际测试，使用 3080 和 4070tis 配置的机器，在不开光追的情况下，4K 极致画质选项下，借助 DLSS 功能，游戏能够全程保持 60 帧的流畅运行。这意味着，只要玩家拥有一块当前主流的游戏显卡，就能够在 2K 分辨率下舒适畅玩这款游戏。这种出色的性能优化，让玩家无需担心硬件问题，能够全身心地投入到游戏世界中。 六、总结：年度最佳游戏的有力竞争者 《黑神话：悟空》凭借其出色的画面表现、丰富而有深度的战斗系统、精心设计的关卡与 BOSS、深厚的文化底蕴以及优秀的性能优化，成为了一款不可多得的佳作。它不仅是中国游戏产业的骄傲，更是在全球游戏市场中展现了强大的竞争力。 在发售后的短短 2 天内，游戏的同时在线人数一度突破 235 万人，在单机游戏领域里一举超过了《艾尔登法环》《赛博朋克 2077》，荣登榜首。在 Steam 平台历史同时在线人数的 TOP10 排行榜内，《黑神话：悟空》更是唯一的国产游戏。这些成绩足以证明，《黑神话：悟空》受到了广大玩家的热烈追捧和高度认可。 综上所述，《黑神话：悟空》绝对是今年年度最佳游戏的有力竞争者。它让我们看到了中国游戏开发者的实力和潜力，也为中国游戏产业的发展注入了新的活力。相信在未来，会有更多像《黑神话：悟空》这样优秀的国产游戏问世，让我们一起期待中国游戏产业更加辉煌的明天！

The only major negative I have with this game is the latter part of it. Story is divided into six chapters, and I thoroughly enjoyed chapters 1-5, but man, that chapter 6 is just terrible game design. Would still highly recommend the game though as it was very enjoyable overall.

第一章风景优美，boss难度适宜，地图引导ok，唯一比较卡的怪就是关底的黑熊精，幽魂其实挺好打的。 第二章我觉得可能是整个游戏设计的最好的一章，无论是令人难忘的陕北说书，亦或是漫天黄沙的八百里秦川，都完完全全打造了一个我心目中的黄风妖岭，有人说这章由于色调问题容易迷路？但我觉得还好，小西天的地图设计才是灾难性的。这章卡关的怪有黄风大圣，小骊龙。 第三章怎么说呢，其实我特别喜欢雪景，无论是现实还是游戏中。这章的一些景色没得说，龟岛和浮屠界都很别出心裁，尤其是浮屠界，我觉得这就是我心目中的东方魔幻美学，虽然这个地图有点恶心。但总的来说，小西天的地图设计是相当失败的，如果没有地图，你可能光找boss都要耗费大量的时间，游科空气墙的弊病在这章表现的淋漓尽致。而且我一直觉得大雄宝殿下面那么空旷的地方就塞了两保安也太那啥了，影神图上写了很多妖王去朝拜黄眉，但是那么雄伟的建筑群却跟烂尾楼一样空荡荡的，这真是不太合适，这章地图值得修缮的地方还有很多很多...... 第四章我觉得设计的挺不错，当然也有问题。就比如四妹的剧情线太零碎太莫名其妙，就帮了两回忙大概，然后就在金光苑听到她撕心裂肺的一声：快走，然后就被练成金丹了？除此之外也没什么问题，小有遗憾的是没能和其它蜘蛛姐妹们酣战一番。这章boss设计的是真不错，晦月魔君，毒敌大王，百眼魔君，小黄龙，byd整个黑猴最能打的几个都在这章了。要是游科能多加那几只姐妹的戏份，这章就能满分了。 第五六章有个通病，设计敷衍潦草，地图分量明显缩水。很明显这两章游科是赶工出来的，再给制作组一点时间应该能打磨的更好。但完成要比完美更重要，冯骥就是这样想的。反复拖会耗尽情怀，而且24年同类型竞争压力会小些，这是为了市场而作出的让步。

It took me a while to play this game, I was uncertain if it would be a soulslike clone mixed with a graphic tech demo but oh boy I was wrong. As you probably know at this point the game tells an adapted version from "A journey to the West" tale where they mixed the gameplay with a lot of interesting mechanics. Although most people compare it solely with Darksouls, in fact the game is its own thing where I feel that the game is a mix from DMC + Bayonetta (heavy focused on perfect dodges) with a few soulslike elements. Very cool ideas overall. Also the spectacle fighting transitions from game to cinematic and back to game are absolutely God of War level, epicness! Music and sound effects are amazing and very well done. Also a quick note, I played Astrobot and it was cool but did it deserve GOTY instead Wukong? Absolutely not. This game is a must play.

What a fantastic game. Really polished and fun combat that made every fight enjoyable, it felt much more responsive than what I’ve come to expect with souls-like outside of Elden Ring. Loved the story and characters you met along the journey, everyone portrayed with excellent voice acting in the Chinese version. Amazing art direction and music as well making it feel like you’re stepping into a fable. Just a really great experience. It’s not one of the more difficult souls-likes out there, all the enemies and bosses are fair and pattern based with few surprises along the way so once you get going you can easily defeat the majority of them on the first or second try. A few might take a couple of tries but I didn’t find a single brick wall to run into in terms of difficulty, it’s hard to tell if this is because it’s easier than something from From Software or because Black Myth Wukong has a lock-on system that actually works but I never found it to be unfair or super difficult any time through the game. Held off a long time because I was worried about performance on my old RTX 2080 but to my surprise the game actually looked great with DLSS and ran well into the 80s in 1440p, really impressive game on a technical level. So even if you’re on an older system I’d highly recommend to check out if the game runs for you, as a game I really can’t recommend it highly enough.

Black Myth: Wukong is a damn good game — let’s keep it short. The graphics are top notch, the gameplay is clean and smooth, and the pacing just feels right. That’s not something you can always take for granted — and when it still feels that way after a while, the devs definitely cooked. Sure, there are a few moments where you’d like to launch a boss straight to the moon, but later on you realise you missed a trait or an item that could’ve helped, keeping each encounter challenging and rewarding. The quality has been incredibly consistent from the very beginning. The atmosphere is truly immersive, and the world never feels empty — there’s always something to do. Even when you’re unsure what to do next, there’s time to explore, and it’s really satisfying to stumble across new secrets. If you really put in the effort, you can even find hidden bosses and challenges, which keeps things exciting all the way to the end. For me, spending 50 euros on this game was absolutely the right call. It may seem like a high price, but it’s totally worth it. Also, Black Myth: Wukong has really got me excited for Elden Ring.

The hype for this game was real. I was sold an intriguing soulslike with a fresh setting and exciting boss fights. What I feel I got, though, is the gaming equivalent of an early Chinese electric car — looks sleek on the surface, but doesn’t really compare where it counts. The core mechanics are fine. But after about 15 hours, the combat started feeling stale — likely because the basic light combo is the same with all weapons and stances. Honestly, everything in the game is just “okay.” Except for one major issue: I’m playing as the legendary Monkey King, yet I’m glued to the horizontal plane and move slower than your average pensioner. That I could live with — if the world-building was strong. But it isn’t. Levels are plagued by invisible walls, a clear sign of lazy design. This becomes more obvious after the first few areas, which are actually quite decent. From Pagoda Prisonon onward, the level design is lazy and uninspired. Thunderclap Temple in particular was exhausting to explore — massive, empty-feeling zones that, when combined with the sluggish movement, just waste your time. Exploration is rarely rewarded in a meaningful way. Compare this with FromSoftware’s level design, where every detail feels intentional. Thunderclap Temple could’ve been 50% smaller, and nothing of value would’ve been lost. All of this might’ve been forgivable with strong pacing or standout boss encounters — but honestly, not a single fight sticks in my memory as something special. **TL;DR**: I can only recommend Black Myth: Wukong if you’ve already played all the genre staples and are desperate for more.

Black Myth Wukong is AN action game, and it certainly lives up to that title, as you do take action in this game. Often described as a Souls-like, it's closer to a character action game without a single bit of the depth either of those genres is known for. The game itself has beautiful visuals and a genuinely addictive soundtrack, unfortunately these positives are brought down by the game’s poor combat, difficulty balancing, and unfortunately lackluster story. The game had a big name to live up to, that name being Journey to the West, and while it is certainly grand enough in scale for its cinematics and boss fights, I find it lacking when looking beyond the surface. For me it was a fairly average action RPG at best and a boring one at worst.

首先，《黑神话：悟空》确实不是只靠“情怀”撑起来的。它是认认真真做了一款动作游戏，不管你是冲着“国产之光”来的，还是魂like爱好者，基本都能找到自己的乐趣。 打击感是真的扎实，招式有重量，回避、变身、法术切换这些都很顺手。比起纯魂系，它的节奏没那么憋屈，更有点《只狼》那种“反打”节奏，但自由度更高，不拘泥一套打法。 画面这块不用多说，看截图、看视频你都知道它牛，但是真正玩起来，场景氛围更顶。那种妖山鬼谷、荒村古寺的中国奇幻感，真的没人比它做得更有味道。尤其是打那些有名有姓的怪，简直像是在演一场大戏，每场BOSS战都有点“仪式感”。 剧情目前来看不复杂，但它的好处是“留白”够，悟空不是我们熟悉的那个孙悟空，而是一个谜。你玩着玩着会开始琢磨自己到底是谁，为什么战斗，这比单纯讲个西游故事更有意思。 当然也不是完美，个别BOSS的判定稍微离谱了一点，操作门槛对新手不算友好。但整体节奏控制不错，卡一会儿练练手法基本能过，不至于纯受苦。 总的来说，这游戏不是来蹭西游IP的热度，而是真想做点不一样的东西，而且做出来了。它不是神作，但是一款有风格、有诚意、有野心的国产好游戏。 ?? 推荐，尤其是喜欢魂系、喜欢东方幻想、或者单纯想看看国产到底能做到什么程度的玩家。 AI生成的

Finished the game three times now, and I have to say—it’s been an incredible ride. The hardest boss for me was definitely the Whiteclad Noble. After that, things felt a bit easier, but there were still a few bosses that gave me a real challenge. Learning their patterns and adjusting my skill sets was not only rewarding but actually made the game more fun and immersive. What caught me off guard (in a good way) was how story-driven the game turned out to be. I went in expecting more exploration and open-world elements, but instead, I found myself really enjoying the story and the anticipation of beating each chapter’s boss just to unlock the cinematic and activate the relic. The visuals and soundtracks were top-notch—absolutely stunning at times. Even though it wasn’t what I initially expected, especially being only my second Souls-like game, I ended up loving it. I actually bought it just because it was on discount, without knowing much about it, and I’m glad I did. It’s one of those rare games I can see myself starting over again from scratch, just for the experience. Highly recommend for anyone who enjoys action RPGs, challenging boss fights, and rich storytelling. A memorable game for sure.

Tuve que esperar 1 a?o para disfrutar de Black Myth: Wukong (principalmente por el precio el cual era demasiado acá en Argentina así que tuve que esperar a que este de oferta) y puedo decir definitivamente que es un juego excelente y que cumple en todos sus apartados. Gráficamente es una maravilla que nos muestra todo el potencial del unreal engine 5, como se mueve el agua, la arena o la nieve son cosas realmente increíbles. Artisticamente también es una maravilla, nos muestra de manera magistral todo el mundo de la mitología china y lo convierte en algo sumamente interesante para el jugador promedio. Sin embargo en lo que mas destaca Black Myth: Wukong es en su jugabilidad, cada golpe, cada transformación, cada hechizo se siente como algo sumamente fresco e impactante, cada boss fight (de las cuales hay muchísimas) se siente como una danza, una coreografía en la que hay que estar completamente concentrado puesto que cualquier descuido puede acabar en un game over. Es un juego desafiante pero no es tan difícil como un souls, en mi opinión la dificultad esta en su punto perfecto, no es injusto pero es muy desafiante y hay que dejar todo en cada batalla. La única queja que tengo con este juego es que si no conoces de antemano la mitología o no lees cada descripción de cada personaje es muy fácil no entender nada de lo que esta pasando. Black Myth: Wukong es espectacular, logra todo lo que se propone y nos transporta a un mundo muy especial y único el cual espero volver a disfrutar. Por cierto, las cinemáticas que hay entre cada capitulo son de las mejores cosas que tiene el juego, no tienen desperdicio :D

国风美术游戏史上前无古人的一作，哪怕放眼全球其美术、音乐能力也是顶级中的顶级。单冲着这两点，毫无疑问也是神作了。 神作并不是说游戏本身是完美的，主要问题仍然存在： 1. 地图设计与地图引导存在瑕疵。游戏本身以自然景观为主，导致丧失了很多引导标识，也被迫加了很多空气墙来限制玩家行动范围。尽管后续推出了地图功能加以挽救，但依然只能说地图水平仅为中游。尤其是花果山，强行为了驾云给了一个大而空的地图，而本身缺乏目的地引导。这并不好玩。 2. 大量大体积、不规则体型boss的碰撞体积存在问题，辅以稀烂的自动视角追踪，在boss高机动性的情形下，手感跟一坨屎一样。更不要提boss身上自带空气墙，贴身人眼看打中了但实际没伤害的情况屡见不鲜。我只能说，不会做大体积boss可以不做，强行搞得这么拉跨真的打的人很火大。 3. 蓄力技能反应迟缓手感不好，这个仁者见仁智者见智，但我是每次打一蓄力要不然动画播一半被boss打断，要不然对面机动走了，要不然两种反击技和蓄力技没办法准确识别，经常放错。 4. 刷子要素有点多。这个游戏二周目其实除了打隐藏外，并没有什么更多的乐趣了，但如果想全成就依然需要刷种子、刷灵韵、刷材料。这完全应该给人一周目就能全收集的方式，不应该依赖概率或数值来强行延长游戏时间。 总体来讲，虽然说了很多缺点，但在强大的美术、音乐面前依旧瑕不掩瑜。再辅以足够多足够新的各种机制，整个游戏下来是没有丢失过新鲜感的，哪怕我不喜欢动作类游戏，也不得不说其游戏性还是相当棒的。 它当的起中国第一个3A游戏的名号，也不愧村里第一个大学生之名。这个好评它值得。

作为国产第一个3A，它的出现无疑是里程碑式的，它有很多的优点：精致的建模，流畅的动作，深度的剧情...... 优点是大家有目共睹的，我这里浅谈一下希望游戏能做出的改进。当然，我的个人见解未必就是对游戏有益的，只是希望能给制作组一个参考。 首先，剧情上的不自由：游玩过程中有很多BOSS我是不想击杀的，比如红孩儿，我希望能有多项选择的剧情分支，当然，这样做肯定会增加制作组的工作量。 其次，我玩下来，游戏的流程给我的感觉就是在找BOSS，然后打BOSS，有的人可能喜欢这种自主探索找BOSS的感觉，但我想能不能多给玩家一些选择，可以有引导模式。增加土地公的存在感，负责在地图内引导天命人。或许制作组本来是打算做引导系统的，比如第一章和第二章的土地公的存在感就很强，但后续章节可能是因为赶工的原因舍弃了。 最后，我希望的是游戏能增加玩家的代入感，获得更沉浸的体验，比如通过跟其他角色的可选择互动，跟地形的互动。 总之，这是一款非常好的游戏，但仍然有可以提升的地方，万分期待新的DLC

I’ve been a fan of Chinese cultivation novels (Xianxia and Wuxia) for a very long time now. Playing Black Myth: Wukong give me the feeling that the worlds in these novels have come to life. As someone who loves Hack n Slash games like Ninja Gaiden Sigma 2 and Metal Gear: Rising Revengeance above all other genres, my initial reaction after realizing this game had Soulslike elements was… disappointment. However, as I got used to the game, I quickly began to realize that I was having more fun than I’ve ever had in 3D Soulslike game. I’ll like to analyze why in this review. First off, this game, like Hollow Knight, only has light Soulslike elements, in this case mainly in the form of the Stamina Bar. The rest of it is a blend of powers and abilities that can be combined in very fun and interesting ways. The game has three melee attack buttons, and a slew of upgradable skill trees that let you combine them in versatile ways as you grow stronger, which is very reminiscent of purer Hack n Slash game combos. This makes melee attacks a lot less repetitive and button-mashy than a Soulslike, but at the same time more strategic than skill focused as you would get in a Hack n Slash. So all in all, an interesting mix of both worlds. Then there are also a slew of spells and abilities that lend the player powerful options in battle, also designed for strategic use, with their own skill trees. All of this combined to make for a very fun game with its own distinct flavour. The gameplay loop itself amounts to a Boss Rush littered with cannon fodder here and there, and interspersed with cutscenes, depicting a very interesting story. I generally don’t care about reviewing story quality in my reviews, as they not a factor in my ratings, but for those who care - I consider the story a plus and not a minus. Overall, my current rating of this game is 9.2/10, and it’s likely to increase upon finishing the game. I am particularly looking forward to starting New Game + with all my hard earned experience from this particular run. I just finished Chapter 1 as of this review, and I’m having fun. Highly recommended!!

以前没有评测的习惯，但这次我觉得必须得补上一个好评了。 黑神话是我玩的第一款大作，也是第一个全成就的游戏，更是给我带来了很多惊喜和感动。 在临发售前就经常一边刷实机一边狠狠期待，在发售当天赶忙打开准备游玩，然后解压到了11点多才进去(￣▽￣)" 从序章的二郎神BOSS战开始一直到最后打大圣残躯，整个游玩过程都给我带来了极大的乐趣，让我感受到了游科的用心，他们是真的想要做好一款游戏。 以及游戏中的boss种类也是挺多的，没有重样，即便是每一章都有的青蛙boss也都设计了不同的技能和外表。 葫芦、酒和泡酒物的搭配，让原本只是回血作用的血瓶有了更多花样，再加上化身技、变身以及法术的存在，极大的降低了游戏的难度。 游戏中也有很多致敬西游记的场景:如旧观音禅院里金池登场的过场动画中金池左右来回走的动作和86版西游记金池被砸死前的一段动作如出一辙; 第五章中也有对86版中猴哥戏弄八戒的一段致敬，以及花果山拿金箍棒那里对西游记原著的致敬(这两个致敬在游戏后期且涉及点剧透，我就不细说了) 每一章结束后的动画也都很好看，和章节主题也很贴合，有相当一段时间我都在循环听动画里的那几首歌。 当然，第五章和第六章的赶工痕迹以及流程短的问题也是很令人遗憾的，希望游科能够好好打磨后续内容，期待后续的DLC。

Some of the best boss fights in gaming, for anyone who has completed Fromsoft games like dark souls, this game's not nearly as difficult as people often like to say. Boss design is amazing, Systems design is okay, Level design is meh, Replay value is kinda okay, but nothing new in ng+ except minor things and grind if you like that. You start steamrolling every boss past the 3rd chapter onwards if you know what you're doing. You can think of this game as an experience where you get to play as the Monkey King, even though you're not necessarily playing Sun Wukong himself (which I and many others initially thought), and although there are many complaints like invisible walls and 'repetitive' combat, I highly recommend it. Those are small gripes compared to experiencing the boss fights in BMW, especially when naming a few bosses like that secret ending boss and the final boss. You won't miss anything not playing this game in your life, but it's one of the better ones.

神话再临，国产之光 《黑神话：悟空》无疑是国产游戏的一座里程碑，它以惊艳的表现，让世界看到了中国游戏的无限潜力。 从画面上看，《黑神话：悟空》达到了3A游戏的顶尖水准。游戏场景基于中国36个建筑古迹1：1还原，像云冈石窟、悬空寺等，每一处细节都雕琢得栩栩如生。无论是黑风山的苍劲山林，还是小西天的庄严肃穆，光影效果与材质质感都无可挑剔，真实到让人仿佛置身于西游世界，随手一截便是绝美壁纸，满足了玩家对国风奇幻世界的所有想象。 战斗系统是《黑神话：悟空》的一大亮点，极具创新性与打击感。玩家手持金箍棒，可施展轻攻击、重攻击、派生等多样招式，战斗中还能搭配定身术、变身等法术，棍法与法术的配合使战斗充满策略性。金箍棒攻击时的长短变化、不同棍法的独特节奏，以及打在敌人身上的反馈，都让战斗手感独一无二，与传统动作游戏大相径庭 。 音乐也是该作的一大亮点，大量运用民族乐器，如激昂的唢呐、空灵的编钟等。主题曲旋律多变，不同变奏适配不同场景，从战斗时的热血沸腾到剧情中的深沉悠扬，无缝衔接。比如赛博《往生咒》，将嘻哈、电子音乐与民族打击乐器、藏秘诵经完美融合，既有现代感又充满神秘东方韵味，不仅在国内出圈，更让外国玩家为之着迷。 剧情方面，它基于《西游记》进行大胆创新，讲述取经之后三界崩坏的故事。通过对仙、妖身份的重新置换，模糊了道德界限，使故事充满深度与层次感。玩家在冒险中能感受到角色复杂的情感与人性的善恶交织，例如黄风怪行侠仗义却被诬陷，这种立场多元化让剧情更加引人入胜。 《黑神话：悟空》是一款集大成之作，它以顶尖的画面、创新的战斗、动人的音乐和深刻的剧情，为玩家带来了沉浸式的西游体验，当之无愧地成为国产3A游戏的标杆。

快一年了才来评论，如果不是某部争议作品发售，可能还是想不起来要来评论一下。黑猴游戏内容可能缺点不少，但是国外各种成名大作同样也多多少少存在相似的问题，也许是对国产游戏要求较高，但也不必过度苛责。从剧情的角度来看，如果玩家对《西游记》以及其前身作品有一定了解的话，其实还是有一些惊喜的。第一章煽风点火的广智广谋，被袈裟迷了眼的无法解脱的金池长老，以及从观音处归来的黑熊精来引出剧情。第二章流沙国原著没有太多的描述，讲地理分布时提到流沙国，但在流沙河方圆百里内无人烟，流沙国早已因为某些原因“毁灭”了，修行的小张太子也还没学成归来。从流沙国展开原创剧情，重塑黄风大王的形象，给后续的剧情定调。第三章小西天总体是交代原著中帮助猴哥的好兄弟们的结局，顺便带出八戒。第四章就很有意思了，原著中蜘蛛精的地盘本是仙女们所有，但是不知道什么原因荒废了一段时间，后被蜘蛛精们接管。妖怪接管仙家之地，有一种可能就是原来的仙女因为某种原因下界为妖。7只蜘蛛精即7位仙女，很自然就会想到被悟空定住导致没摘到多少蟠桃的七仙女，因为蟠桃事件戴罪下界。因此才有天蓬时期的八戒在天庭与原为仙女的蜘蛛精相识。虽然八戒跟蜘蛛精有后代还是有点离谱了。游戏剧情中的百目与蜘蛛姐妹作为天庭的炼丹奴隶似乎也能证实前面的可能，因为一次无妄之灾，戴罪下界当天庭永远的炼丹奴隶。从原著中的内容进行一定的解读、引申，再进行一定的原创，揭露天庭黑暗面，也让玩家可以大致串起关于猴哥的一些线索，大致了解到猴哥的挣扎，曾经的桀骜不驯，认定强者为王，质疑东胜神洲一味追求功名的人群的悟空，认识到还是“编制”有用，选择帮助唐僧取经，最终获得佛位之后，发现漫天神佛的黑暗还要超出自己的认知，人和没有“编制”的妖，不过是神佛的炼丹材料，作为神、佛、妖三位一体的悟空，最终还是选择站在世间生灵这一边。第五章的火焰山，原著中收服牛魔王时，牛魔王展现出了一些弱点，而红孩儿拥有的能力刚好可以克制牛魔王，芭蕉扇也是属于太上老君的神器。于是也有一种解读是红孩儿确实不是牛魔王的儿子（不是牛魔王被绿的意思），牛魔王能生出一个完全克制自己的儿子其实也是挺离谱的，牛魔王对红孩儿被观音收走一事不如红孩儿的其他亲戚反应大，加上火焰山前的章节是女儿国，不少重合的地理设定，管理堕胎水的人的形象以及他和牛魔王一家的关系。就可以带出一种解读：红孩儿是铁扇喝子母河的水生下来的，投胎的人是太上老君挑好的，红孩儿是老君拿来压制控制牛魔王的一个手段。原著中收服牛魔王后，火焰山土地从一开始的自诩下界就是为了收服牛魔王拯救世人变成不愿意回天庭，大有接管牛魔王事业的意思。游戏剧情可能就是使用了这种解读进行展开，红孩儿击败老牛，图谋不轨的土地，土地铁扇老君的奇妙联系，老牛对许多事情的无奈，红孩儿对牛魔王不争的愤恨。有人说剧情抹黑了猴哥，在我看来反而是种美化，游戏剧情里的悟空明显对老牛还有兄弟之情，原著悟空丢下结拜的妖王兄弟去当齐天大圣，对兄弟的儿子红孩儿下杀手，偷芭蕉扇，诓牛魔王，纯纯表明兄弟。要说有问题的话，就是牛魔王不应该是游戏里这种性格。当然到最后还是不理解悟空为什么跟白骨精有一段，如果知道斗战神剧情的话应该可以理解一点。总体来说剧情其实很有主创团队对原著的理解，原创也相当的大胆，不少内容还挺符合正式上线前B站几个大佬的猜测汇总。本身一部好的作品就可以有多种解读，不可能说书里没有明确的写出来那就是没有，那任何作品都没有解读的必要。也许吴承恩不是西游记的作者，也许西游记的篇章是由多个写手一起完成的，篇章之间的联系性可能只是巧合没有太多的隐喻。都不影响现有的东西可以解读出黑神话的背景设定，没必要抱着对原著的不同理解来攻击黑神话的剧情，带着偏见去审视一个事物，总是没有办法得出一个客观合理的结论的。某争论游戏可能我也会去尝尝咸淡，看看到底是不是传说中那么有问题。至于游戏内容，缺点：1.场景迷惑性强，如果是魂游老玩家，肯定会发现很多看着好像能走、好像藏着隐藏道具的地方，走过去发现是空气墙。2.游戏内容不够完整，很遗憾，希望DLC可以补全。3、高周目体验一般，结局太少了。。时间跨度太大了，太多的也记不清楚，解读方面也有一些细节可能讲的不太对，不过当时的感动和惊喜记得还很清楚，游戏是好游戏，也还有进步空间，也值得一个好评，希望黑神话是国单崛起的开端。

你说得对，但是《黑神话悟空》是由游戏科学自主研发的一款基于虚幻5引擎的全新ARPG游戏。游戏发生在一个自主改编的架空西游世界，在这里庙宇之中菩萨闭目，禅院各处佛陀断首。你将扮演一位名为「小猴子」的神秘角色，在线性的旅行中邂逅性格各异、能力独特的妖魔鬼怪，逐步发掘这个「末法时代」的真相。

当金箍棒划破屏幕的瞬间，那一声金属震颤的嗡鸣不仅唤醒了玩家对孙悟空的集体记忆，更撕裂了长期以来由西方主导的3A游戏美学标准。《黑神话：悟空》的战斗系统或许尚有争议——连招的流畅度、BOSS战的平衡性、镜头切换的适恰度都成为玩家争论的焦点——但无人能否认，这款游戏在美术与音乐维度构筑的东方美学宇宙，已经将电子游戏承载文化表达的潜力提升至前所未有的高度。游戏科学团队用像素与声波搭建的不仅是一个可供游玩的虚拟空间，更是一座流动的中华文化博物馆，在这里，每一帧画面都是对《西游记》原著的当代转译，每一个音符都是对传统乐器的数字重生。 对于中国3A而言，踏上取经路比抵达灵山更重要。《黑神话：悟空》的成功不仅在于其最终呈现的品质，更在于它为中国游戏人开辟了一条通往高品质原创游戏的道路。正如西行取经需要历经九九八十一难，中国3A游戏的发展也必将面临重重挑战，但重要的是我们已经迈出了这历史性的第一步。 这部作品证明了中华文化完全有能力孕育出世界级的游戏作品，也让我们看到了国产3A游戏的无限可能。期待未来能有更多优秀的国产3A游戏接续前行，在这条充满挑战的"取经之路"上不断突破，最终取得属于中国游戏人的"真经"。

《黑神话：悟空》采用虚幻 5 引擎打造，画面堪称一绝。游戏中的场景丰富多样且细腻逼真，神秘的山林中，阳光透过树叶的缝隙洒下，形成斑驳的光影；宏伟的古刹庄严肃穆，每一处建筑的细节都尽显匠心；而妖洞则光怪陆离，充满了诡异的氛围。为了还原中国古建筑，开发团队遍访多个省区实地考察，使得游戏中的建筑充满了浓郁的中国文化气息。角色建模同样精致，妖怪们形态各异，无论是威严的灵虚子，还是诡异的白骨夫人，其外貌与动作神态都栩栩如生，生动地展现了中国神话世界生物的多样性与奇幻魅力。从画面质量来看，它达到了世界顶级 3A游戏的水准，为玩家构建了一个如梦如幻的西行世界，每一帧都可当作视觉盛宴来欣赏。

Interpretation of 'Black Myth: Wukong' “Wukong” is the pinyin for 悟空 in Chinese, which means “to awaken to the truth of all things.” Let’s begin. I. Introduction to Journey to the West Before diving into Black Myth: Wukong, let’s briefly introduce the foundational story it draws from—Journey to the West. This is one of the Four Great Classical Novels of China, written between 1500–1580. Its author, Wu Cheng'en, lived in a feudal era filled with injustice and darkness. He used animalistic and demonic figures to tell an allegorical tale. As for what exactly he was implying—over the past 500 years, countless interpretations have emerged, but the truth may have died with him. Journey to the West is loosely based on the real-life Tang dynasty monk Xuanzang (627–649) who traveled to India to obtain Buddhist scriptures. The novel fictionalizes his journey with three disciples—Sun Wukong (Wukong), Zhu Bajie (Bajie), and Sha Wujing—along with a white dragon-turned-horse. The journey to the West involved 81 trials (9×9, as 9 is the highest single-digit number in Chinese culture). They fought 81 monsters, some of whom appear in Wukong (e.g., the Black Bear Demon, Yellow Wind Demon, Yellow Eyebrow), with others likely appearing in DLCs (e.g., White Bone Spirit, Lion Camel Ridge). One of the most famous episodes is the “True and False Monkey King.” A perfect Wukong doppelg?nger appears, even matching his power. No one—not even the gods—can tell them apart. Eventually, they seek Buddha’s help. He kills one with a golden alms bowl, but never clarifies whether the real one survived. Maybe even Wu Cheng’en didn’t know. Wukong’s origin is legendary—he was born from a magical stone with a profound backstory that is tied to another complex myth. To simplify, you can think of him as the incarnation of a magical rock. That’s why in the game he often appears in a stone-like form, and also why he can take heavy blows to the head without harm. PS: In the novel, he’s even more absurdly powerful. The Jade Emperor（YUDI） tried everything to kill him, including trapping him in a celestial furnace—nothing worked. That’s why Heaven feared him. He trained under a very powerful master—Puti (Taoist monastic name—Bodhi, this is very Taoist), and learned many spells. But because of his mischievous nature (and yes, monkeys are truly, truly annoying), he was kicked out. He returned to Mount Huaguo (Flower-Fruit Mountain) and became its Monkey King—basically Heaven’s equal. The Jade Emperor, constantly losing sleep at the thought of Wukong still being alive, sent one of his underlings to recruit Wukong with a fake job—naming him “Stablemaster,” the lowest-ranking position in Heaven—while tricking him into believing it was a top-tier post. Poor monkey had never experienced the cunning of the world and bought the lie. From then on, he carried this stain for life—Bajie would often mock him using the degrading title, which naturally earned him a solid beating from Wukong every time. Heh. Of course, the truth eventually came to light. The mischievous monkey realized the lie and flew into a rage. He stormed Heaven—fighting from the East Gate to the West Gate, then from the North Gate to the South. But he couldn’t get past the South Gate—it was guarded by Yang Jian, and the two were evenly matched. haha. Eventually, his chaos brought out the Buddha himself. Wukong challenged him to a race—to see who could fly farther. Wukong soared to the ends of the universe and found five golden pillars. He scribbled “到此一游” on them and even peed on one. Turns out, the five pillars were Buddha’s fingers. Defeated, Wukong was slammed under a mountain by Buddha’s palm and sealed with a talisman—because one mountain alone couldn’t hold him. He stayed there until Tang Sanzang came to release him, starting their journey to retrieve the scriptures... end. II. Wukong vs. Journey to the West In China, Journey to the West is often told to children, especially boys. I dare say that every Chinese boy once held a stick in his hand, pretending to be the almighty Monkey King. (Of course, we also picked up some bad habits—like carving “到此一游” on anything. Apologies to all damaged cultural relics.) As people grew up, they began reinterpreting the story. Black Myth: Wukong is one such reimagining. Here, Wukong befriends demon kings like the Bull Demon King, and they battle Heaven together. As seen in the cinematic trailers, they fight side by side. But Wukong is ultimately defeated and imprisoned by Buddha for 500 years. He compromises and joins the pilgrimage, becoming a tool of Heaven. Along the way, he makes many enemies—some of whom were once his brothers. After the pilgrimage succeeds, Heaven sees him as too powerful and too dangerous. He is betrayed, ambushed, and killed. Even the Bull Demon King turns on him. His body splits into six parts—Eyes, Ears, Nose, Tongue, Body, and Mind. The player is the “Destined One”—an ordinary monkey from Flower-Fruit Mountain who most resembles the original Wukong. They must collect the six roots and restore the title of “Monkey King.” Yes, the title， SunWukong is truly dead. III. Other Characters Bull Demon King On the pilgrimage, Wukong tries to get the Bull Demon King to abandon some things Heaven wants to erase—like the Yasha children and the Banana Fan—and accidentally kills his lover, the Fox Spirit, possibly under Bull Demon King’s wife's influence (she's from Heaven, and her stance is ambiguous after marrying the Bull King). This deeply wounds the Bull King. After Wukong leaves, he has nothing left, so he fully rebels against Heaven and is slaughtered by them. (That figure who beheads him in the animation? That’s Nezha. A fascinating character himself.) After the Bull King helps Heaven slay Wukong, Wukong’s final words in his arms shake him to the core. He ends up paralyzed in despair where we find him in-game. Red Boy He was originally a prince of the Yasha tribe in Buddhism. After his country was destroyed and his family perished, he was rescued by someone and, using the essence of the Yasha King and the water of the Zi-Mu River, was reincarnated through the body of the Bull Demon King's wife. His people were massacred by Heaven. After learning the truth, he opposed Wukong on the pilgrimage, since Wukong was now serving Heaven. After being defeated by Wukong, he was sent to Heaven. Later, when the Bull Demon King surrendered to Heaven and killed Wukong, Red Boy tried to use Wukong’s remains to resist Heaven but failed. Humiliated and unwilling to implicate his parents, he took his own life. Bajie The same thing happened to Bajie as well.He is the one who hates Wukong the most—because that damn monkey always bullies him. And the one who loves him the most—because big bro always protects him. Online jokes say that on the pilgrimage, every time the monk gets captured, Bajie yells to split up and go home. But whenever Wukong is in trouble, he calls in every connection he has to gather a rescue party. Haha. Now that Wukong is dead, when Bajie sees the player, he’s probably the happiest. So even at the risk of being purged by Heaven, he helps us. That’s also why he can’t acknowledge the Spider Spirit. If he fails, everything connected to him will be destroyed. And honestly, at that point, the odds of the Destined One succeeding weren’t great. As players, we all know how many times we died trying. Haha. Also, don’t be fooled by his piggy looks now—he used to be hot. Back in Heaven, he was Marshal Tianpeng, a mighty general. 本人黑猴玩了五周目，但没发评论，因为黑猴这游戏的结尾令我失望，无论是好结局和坏结局，一定要打大圣残躯在我眼里就是败笔，哪怕设置个自愿戴上金箍不参与战斗也好啊，，唉，不过前几章名副其实的是国产之光，画面、剧情也好，神中神。 好了，为什么今天心血来潮想要评论了，因为隔壁出了个明末，我主要是看b站的测评来了解这款游戏的大致内容，铺天盖地的up主宣传，最后发售暴雷，那这款游戏到底有没有问题呢？是不是真的像有些人说的黑子的狂欢？ 以下是我的观点： 对于游戏，其实很多人并不会纠结这些，对于国家也是浮于表面，是不太会把历史和文艺作品给分开的。黑猴本质是在一个虚构的作品上再做创新，那就没有立场上的问题，最多被冠以“不尊重原著”、“不尊重艺术”的骂名。但明末渊虚之羽不一样，明代是中国的历史，游戏名就已经告诉或是暗示玩家，是基于历史背景下创作，很难脱离大众对于原历史认知。既然如此，我们放宽要求，游戏中的赵云官方说是支线任务，可打可不打看个人选择，好。那主线里讨伐朱由检是不是有些不妥？再者把抗清英雄李定国设置成精英怪，再一来游戏发布时的离谱操作，被互联网一放大，就变成这样的结局。 对于立场有些许问题的游戏，你看看那些大up，实况的实况，解说的解说，不影响赚钱的。 还有喜欢玩明末的，现在还在玩的，要么是纯打游戏，对这段历史没有概念，没有概念也就无法共情，无法共情导致对黑明末的人不理解，从而想要和黑粉对着干，形成各种各样的说法。比如“这次明末的差评潮就是黑粉的狂欢”“经典对国产游戏指指点点”等等观点。要么就是继续赚钱的，因为有家要养，谁会和钱过不去？ 那么多宣传的up主就是列子。 我只能说，本质是很重要的，正因为宣传“明末”、宣传自家的东西，才会要做到立场正确，那些玩明末被喷的人大多都是因为自己遭受抨击，而不去思考为什么游戏被喷，对于剧情模棱两可，转眼再给你来一句“自己就是个臭打游戏的”。也是无奈 （我没玩，本来想预购但看有些up说游戏质量上有问题，就不着急买，后来爆出有立场问题才了解了一下，本人对于任何立场有问题的游戏只要求自己不接受，对别人宽容，因为我知道在这个社会上要说动别人是很难的，鸣潮刚出的时候致敬顾方舟“糖丸爷爷”的时候出了问题，性别改成30岁的女性我直接卸载，玩两年逆水寒结果公费追星辱华女团，我也二话不说就卸载，因为这样不会愧对自己的信仰） 以上仅为个人观点，如有意见欢迎评论区补充。

《黑神话悟空》这款游戏我已经玩了很久了，今天特意来评价一下。首先，这款游戏的游戏画面做的很精致，各种模型，景色，细节都很好，赏心悦目。每个角度都能找到一张风景照。作为一种操作性对战游戏，跟里面的每一个boss进行对战。他的对战手感是不错的，每个动作设计得很合理，又很帅气。每个boss都有它独特的技能，找到相应的办法去打败他，很考验玩家的应变能力。有可能你战胜对手的条件只是你的应变能力和耐心更胜一筹。动作设计整体流畅，打击感很好，对战效果不错。 这游戏根据中国的四大名著之一的《西游记》进行改编，具有很深厚的文化底蕴。在剧情上每一个章节都有它的主题，但是却又是连贯的探讨了人性的多样，对英雄意志的继承，具有很高的启发性和思辨性。可以说整部游戏是一个艺术品。 它的内容还有很多，还是希望你亲自去体验一下吧。
我玩游戏怎么说也玩了有个十几年了，但黑神话悟空对对于我玩游戏十几年的历程来说，绝对是浓墨重彩的一笔非常推荐和值得玩的游戏希望你也和我一样玩的开心！！！

整体我给80分。无剧透，整体游戏素质良好。画面和动作以及美术风格都是国际一线水准。 一、扣分点： 1.空气墙太多且完全干扰玩家和浪费时间，如果说法环是可见即可达，这游戏是可见的就一定不可达。我是真没想到从18年的古剑3到24年的黑猴，空气墙还是如此之多，不太像这个年代的游戏。感觉像兰博基尼车头后边拉了个迈腾车身。而且偶然间发现绝大多数BOSS都有穿墙攻击，视觉效果没提示。-10 2.第四章的某个吞剑BOSS做的比较差劲，差劲不是说BOSS机制强引起玩家反感，而是玩家打着打着莫名其妙miss了，个别BOSS定向优化有问题。-5 3.这游戏所有的大体形怪都是一坨，受击判定经常为空，而且基本上都会马拉松，拖慢原本快速的游戏节奏。虽然基本上大体型怪都是一遍过，为了材料还是玩家选择吃屎打怪。-5 二、玩法： 1.画面。业内顶级水准，细节还是远景都无可挑剔。但是面捕技术没跟上，绝大部分角色都是面瘫。 2.玩法。之前玩过国产单机的都不会太陌生，钓鱼种菜养花除了没有打牌之外都比较齐全。 3.剧情。支线是还行的标准，主线第五章玩完感觉有点过于破碎了，模仿魂系剧情叙事太明显。原价268不算有竞争力的价格，等等打折再入也可以。 4.动作。如果不是年初玩了真三国无双起源，这个游戏动作我会给10分，但是因为玩过其他优秀的动作游戏，所以我给9分。对黑猴的评价是优秀的动作游戏。

庚子年，余肄业高中。时疫疠横行，停课居家，假期屡延。一日偶观黑神话首支实机预告，十三分钟之影像，如石投湖心，荡起千层浪，久不能平。彼时余于游戏一道懵懂无知，常玩者，唯我的世界联机与原耳，然此预告竟在心中生根。? 后每有新讯，必往观之，念念不释。及高三暑假，见巫师三打折，遂购入。玩至五十余小时，终未通关 —— 盖为昆特牌所迷，又耽于探索地图之趣也。其间查攻略，屡遭剧透，虽憾，亦叹其世界观之宏、剧情之妙、地图之精，实乃大作。? 既而，于隔壁平台购 2077 及 DLC，DLC 剧情毕，本体主线至华子处，便停滞不前。余不知如何抉择结局，亦不愿抉择。"夜之城没有活着的传奇"，此言不虚。现实中余本微末，游戏里亦茫然。自 1.7 版至 2.0 版，亲历数次更新，虽觉距预告仍有差距，然其进步亦可观。? 后蒙友荐，入怪猎世界，并购冰原 DLC。始用铳枪，继换盾斧，终执长枪，累计二百三十小时。复玩崛起，仅二十四小时便止，盖不喜百龙夜行之玩法也。? 再后，闯黑魂三，三十五小时方过艾尔德里奇，今仍在寻洋葱骑士，欲挑战尤姆。老头环趁打折购入本体与 DLC，至今未启。? 述此种种，皆为引出余对国产单机之深情。及黑神话可预购，余即刻下单。忆去年八月二十日，心潮澎湃。时假期将尽，余趁最后几日居家，急下载之，却未敢启封，如待稀世之珍。网间相关视频，亦避之唯恐不及，恐遭剧透。? 入大二，开学至校，与同窗亦不敢多言，惧泄剧情。总计四十余小时，杨戬已过。及击败大圣残躯，心绪激荡，久久难平。此乃余唯一预购且通关之游，虽成就未全，亦无憾。? 余本讷于言，玩毕未评。今见它国单上架，忽忆此事，遂补此评。洋洋洒洒，只为圆五年之愿。? "今日欢呼孙大圣，只缘妖雾又重来。"《黑神话》者，国单之光也。余信此后国单必蒸蒸日上，再创辉煌！? 又念余涉游事未深，所见所感，不过一己之浅见。笔力疏浅，言辞简陋，唯抒胸臆耳。若有偏颇，还望诸位海涵。

8/10 As a 1980s kid who grew up on the Journey To The West TV series, Black Myth piqued my interest. Overall, you can see a lot of attention to detail went into developing this game, and at times I just found myself admiring the amazing in-game views along with the character models. For the gameplay itself, this is an action RPG with Souls-like elements. You bonfires and souls currency, and combat leans on dodging and/or parrying. That being said, it's pretty forgiving (no death penalty). The game also encourages playing around with different builds with a free respec system. Combat isn't as tight and snappy as a Souls, but it's good enough akin to God of War, and similar. Levels and progression are generally linear, so don't expect an open world. Going back to the story, it's an intriguing sequel of sorts, but again it relies heavily on the player being familiar with the source material. I also found myself more vested in Pigsy (Xu Bajie)'s storyline than I did the Destined One's :D That being said, my biggest annoyance with Black Myth that I hope can be addressed in any future DLCs and sequels is: The way the devs worked level map boundaries was immersion breaking, and really took away from the experience. In AAA ARPG games like Elden Ring, boundaries are generally clearly defined; cliff walls, walls, deep water, drops, and falls prevent players from advancing off-map. In Wukong, you hit an invisible wall in most instances, which is extremely frustrating when you're trying to explore a map. It breaks the immersion because one moment you're running through a lush forest or a barren mountain (with detailed animations like footprints in the snow), and the next, you're running in place trying to go up a path. All in all, this is definitely a AAA game, and worth a playthrough or two, especially when it's on sale.

Dopo ore immerse tra leggende, combattimenti e panorami mozzafiato, posso affermare con convinzione: Black Myth: Wukong non è solo un gioco, è un’esperienza epica. Giocato in Full HD con una RTX 5070 OC, il titolo di Game Science sprigiona tutta la sua potenza visiva e tecnica. Le ambientazioni sono semplicemente stupefacenti: ogni foresta avvolta nella nebbia, ogni tempio scolpito nella roccia, ogni scorcio di cielo color ambra racconta una storia. La cura maniacale per i dettagli è evidente in ogni asset, ogni animazione e ogni effetto particellare. Ma la vera forza del gioco è il gameplay: fluido, reattivo e profondo. Il combat system riesce a bilanciare perfettamente l’eleganza delle arti marziali con la brutalità delle battaglie mitologiche. Le trasformazioni, le abilità del bastone magico e le tecniche speciali offrono varietà e strategia, senza mai sacrificare la soddisfazione del colpo ben piazzato. Ogni boss fight è una danza tra istinto e precisione, e ognuna lascia il segno. La performance è stata eccezionale: su questa configurazione, il gioco gira senza intoppi, mantenendo frame rate solidi anche nelle fasi più concitate. Ottimizzazione ben fatta, e si sente. In sintesi, Black Myth: Wukong è una gemma rara: visivamente spettacolare, tecnicamente solido e giocato con un’anima. Una rivisitazione brillante della mitologia cinese, in grado di affascinare tanto quanto intrattenere. Se amate i soulslike o cercate un action RPG diverso dal solito, questo titolo è un must assoluto.

I’ve played Black Myth: Wukong on both PC and PS5, and I can confidently say that this game is an absolute masterpiece no matter where you play it. Both versions run beautifully—smooth performance, fast loading times, and incredibly detailed visuals that bring this mythological world to life in stunning fashion. Graphically, Wukong is breathtaking. The environments are rich and atmospheric, the character designs are intricate, and the visual effects during combat are nothing short of cinematic. Whether I was exploring lush mountains on PC or battling bosses on the PS5, the game maintained its high fidelity and immersive feel. What truly sets this game apart, though, is the story. Drawing inspiration from Journey to the West, the narrative is both epic and emotionally engaging. It balances myth, action, and introspection in a way that keeps you invested throughout the entire journey. The voice acting and cutscenes are top-notch and add real weight to the world and its characters. Gameplay-wise, the combat is fluid, challenging, and satisfying. There’s a great variety of abilities, and every boss encounter feels unique and meaningful. Whether you’re a fan of soulslike games or just love a well-made action RPG, there’s something here for you. In short, Black Myth: Wukong is everything I hoped it would be—and more. It’s one of the best gaming experiences I’ve had in years, and it performs incredibly well on both PC and PS5. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a visually stunning, story-rich, and gameplay-deep adventure.

Un viaje épico que cautiva el alma Black Myth: Wukong es, sin lugar a dudas, una obra maestra que ha dejado una marca imborrable en mi corazón. Este RPG de acción, desarrollado por Game Science, toma inspiración de la novela china del siglo XVI Viaje al Oeste y la transforma en una experiencia inmersiva que combina una narrativa profunda, un combate dinámico y un apartado técnico que roza lo sublime. Después de pasar decenas de horas explorando su mundo, enfrentándome a sus desafíos y sumergiéndome en su historia, puedo decir que este juego me ha emocionado hasta las lágrimas y se ha convertido en uno de mis favoritos de todos los tiempos. Lo Bueno Narrativa y trasfondo cultural La historia de Black Myth: Wukong es un verdadero deleite. Como El Predestinado, un mono antropomorfo en busca de liberar a Sun Wukong, el legendario Rey Mono, el juego teje una narrativa que combina mitología china con momentos de pura emotividad. Cada capítulo está impregnado de un folclore rico, con personajes que destilan personalidad y trasfondos que te hacen conectar con sus luchas, amores y tragedias. La adaptación de Viaje al Oeste es respetuosa y creativa, presentando tanto elementos familiares como nuevas interpretaciones que enriquecen la experiencia. Hubo momentos en los que la historia me hizo llorar, especialmente por cómo explora temas de sacrificio, redención y destino. La narrativa no solo es épica, sino profundamente humana, lo que hace que cada victoria y derrota se sienta personal. Jugabilidad y combate El sistema de combate es una de las joyas de este título. Aunque toma inspiración de los juegos soulslike, Black Myth: Wukong se siente único. El uso del bastón mágico Ru Yi Bang, combinado con habilidades de transformación, hechizos y posturas, ofrece una variedad táctica que mantiene cada encuentro fresco y emocionante. La necesidad de dominar esquivas perfectas y gestionar recursos como el vigor y la concentración a?ade profundidad sin llegar a ser abrumador. Los enfrentamientos contra los jefes son espectaculares, con dise?os únicos y mecánicas que te obligan a aprender sus patrones y adaptar tu estrategia. La sensación de superar a un jefe tras varios intentos es inmensamente gratificante. Además, la exploración en sus mundos semi-abiertos está llena de secretos, desde zonas ocultas hasta objetos raros, lo que premia a los jugadores curiosos. Apartado técnico y artístico Visualmente, Black Myth: Wukong es una maravilla. Construido con Unreal Engine 5, los escenarios son un espectáculo para los sentidos, con paisajes detallados, efectos de iluminación impresionantes y animaciones fluidas. Cada bioma, desde frondosos bosques hasta templos místicos, está dise?ado con un nivel de detalle que te invita a detenerte y admirar. La dirección artística captura la esencia de la mitología china, con estatuas colosales, criaturas míticas y una atmósfera que te sumerge por completo. La banda sonora, con adaptaciones como "Yungong Xunyin" de la serie de 1986, complementa perfectamente la experiencia, a?adiendo un toque nostálgico y épico. El dise?o de sonido, desde los rugidos de los enemigos hasta el choque del bastón, es impecable. Accesibilidad y rejugabilidad A pesar de su dificultad, el juego logra un equilibrio que lo hace accesible incluso para quienes no son veteranos de los soulslike. Su estructura lineal y un sistema de estadísticas simplificado facilitan la entrada a nuevos jugadores, mientras que la variedad de builds y el modo Nueva Partida+ aseguran que los veteranos tengan razones para volver. La posibilidad de personalizar curaciones y explorar diferentes habilidades a?ade una capa de personalización que enriquece la experiencia. Lo Malo Problemas técnicos La optimización podría mejorar, y se nota que el juego exige un hardware potente para brillar en todo su esplendor. Recomiendo ajustar las configuraciones gráficas y asegurarse de tener los últimos parches instalados para minimizar estos inconvenientes. Repetición de enemigos En algunos momentos, la variedad de enemigos comunes puede sentirse limitada, ya que ciertos tipos se repiten con frecuencia en los capítulos más largos. Aunque los jefes son increíblemente variados, los encuentros con enemigos menores pueden volverse monótonos si decides explorar cada rincón. Esto no empa?a demasiado la experiencia, pero un poco más de diversidad habría sido ideal. Curva de aprendizaje Para algunos jugadores, la dificultad inicial puede ser intimidante. Aunque el juego no es tan implacable como un Dark Souls, requiere paciencia para dominar sus mecánicas, especialmente las esquivas y el uso estratégico de habilidades. Los primeros capítulos pueden sentirse abrumadores si no estás acostumbrado al género, pero una vez que le pillas el truco, el combate fluye de manera natural. Conclusión Black Myth: Wukong es un triunfo en todos los sentidos. Su narrativa me conmovió hasta las lágrimas, su combate me mantuvo al borde del asiento y su apartado técnico me dejó boquiabierto. A pesar de algunos problemas técnicos y una ligera repetición en los enemigos, la experiencia general es inolvidable. Game Science ha creado un juego que no solo honra la mitología china, sino que también establece un nuevo estándar para los RPG de acción. Si buscas una aventura épica que combine acción, exploración y una historia que toca el corazón, este juego es imprescindible. Lo recomiendo con entusiasmo a cualquiera que esté dispuesto a embarcarse en este viaje mítico. ?10/10, candidato a Juego del A?o

快一年过去，才发现自己居然没有给黑猴好评，得补一下。 回来看评论区的原因，也是昨天，爱新觉罗·思源的大作《清初：我在四川杀汉人》上线后的一系列抽象局面，让我回想起了黑猴发售的盛况。 在这里不想说什么明末的缺点，只想说一句，我们应当珍惜《黑神话：悟空》，应当珍惜游戏科学。 毕竟能在社区，行业和市场三方面都取得如此成就的产品本就寥寥无几，更何况黑猴作为一个电子游戏，在文化艺术上还完成了对于东方传统文化的创新和传承。站在现代人的角度上，用次世代的引擎和技术，用一串串代码，讲好了《西游记》这个传承了千年的故事。 这样历史性的成就，是不可多得的，可遇不可求的。 毕竟，能像游科这样，以对玩家，对民族，对文化历史负责的态度去创作的团队寥寥无几。 最后，我觉得我们依旧可以对国产3A怀有希望。因为黑猴就像一盏漫漫长夜中的明灯，电影《一代宗师》中有一句经典台词“有灯就有人”，有黑猴这般成就珠玉在前，自当有后人闻道而来。

Black Myth is really difficult for me to recommend. Everything in this game feels like it's got that 9/10 or even 10/10 production quality, except for the combat itself. The graphics, the equip and progression systems, the spells and alternate forms, there's clearly a ton that went into this game. But it's all built on an extremely flimsy foundation. The combat in this game feels awful. I can't help but compare this to any other Soulsbourne game (and the game certainly doesn't attempt to hide its inspiration) in which the combat simply feels so much more fluid and intuitive. Dodging feels incredibly slow and almost laggy at times. The combos in the game feel really frustrating, because most of the time, all you'll want to do is the first few hits of the light attack combo. The endings of the combo introduce a massive amount of lag and animations that can't be cancelled - which isn't bad inherently, but there isn't nearly enough combo variety to compensate for this. The input buffer can also occasionally decide to release a move incredibly long after you've pressed something, and now you're stuck in a lengthy heavy attack animation out of nowhere. It kind of feels like two wildly opposed ideas - you can have tight fluid combat, with a high difficulty curve, or you can have flashy combos and animations that look cinematic and epic, but these two ideas don't really go well together. You just won't want to use these lengthy, slow animations, especially when bosses will frequently introduce random combo extensions into the mix. Most of the bosses don't feel like they were designed around basic elements of the game, like how long the dodge takes to complete. I really want to enjoy this game. I actually feel bad typing out this review because it seems like there's an incredibly amount of cool stuff in this game, but I can't help but feel like I'd rather watch this game's gorgeous visuals as a movie than experience the clunky and clumsy combat in its gameplay.

先说结论，作为国产3A开山之作，瑕不掩瑜非常适合作为本作的整体评价。剧情逻辑清晰，中华文化气息十分浓厚（甚至有点过于浓厚了，完全没看过西游记的人可能get不到一些剧情的点，这一点有好有坏吧），画面表现中上，音乐很震撼人心，战斗系统也做得比较完整。[b] 作为女朋友送的生日礼物，确实很喜欢。 [/b] 2024年第一次打完了1周目，当时没看任何攻略，游戏当时也还没有地图，漏了不少东西，第一次也触发的是轮回结局。彼时第一次接触这种类魂游戏，犹记得一个幽魂打了一整个晚上，白衣秀士打了一下午（今年出了复战之后，最高难度的白衣秀士又鏖战了整整大半天才过，笑）。今年重拾之后，对着攻略把能1周目能补的都补了，梅山和回忆结局也推完了，准备后面开2周目了。 先说玩法，好在毕竟是类魂，整体难度上限并没有特别高，第一二章结束差不多劈棍那一套就上手了。注意，像本人这样的手残党后面如果想打的简单点，前期一定要找地方练练级，点点必要的技能，升升自身的属性。我是在第二章刷了一次级，第四章刷了一次级，基本上就非常趁手了，可以说只要属性堆上去，1周目主线的容错率还是非常高的，剧情推进可以很流畅，大部分boss都能2-3遍以内过，机制简单的1遍可能就过了。整体战斗玩法是比较逻辑性的，适应了就会很沉浸，当然也有一些不那么逻辑性的，比如隐身可能还是需要优化一下，部分boss会莫名其妙的把锁头技丢到已经隐身的本体上而不是尚存的分身…… 然后是剧情，整体给人的感觉是细节很多，而且并不是为了显得细节而细节。影神图、主线，都是交相呼应的、互相补全的，像我就是直到最后把1周目的所有能解锁的影神图解锁完，再回首的时候能突然领悟很多之前没想通的剧情。 至于画面方面，经过几次更新之后整体表现好了一些，不过对显卡的压力还是比较大的。显卡比较好的话，除了4个显著降帧选项之外全开影像级，画面表现还是很优秀很精细的，适合风景党。不过光影方面还是需要进一步优化，最明显需要优化就是特效和毛发，不知道是今年新换了50系显卡适配不佳还是游戏本身的问题，这两个选项开到“超高”以上后对DLSS4+帧生成非常不友好，中远处阴影鬼畜极其严重，但是开“高”就非常正常（明明阴影跟这俩选项应该没关系才对吧？？？），很难理解个中缘由。除此之外就是云朵了，花果山那一章无论是脚下的筋斗云还是天上的阴云，在画质设置整体已经中上的情况下显得还是太过粗糙了，跟场景中其他精细的布景落差比较明显。 总之就是：推荐。如果是像我一样第一次接触这类游戏的，可能需要一点耐心，但是这一点付出还是很值得的。不说了，2周目去了，希望尽快全成就，走完九九八十一难~

This is a weird one. I would really like to put it in between "recommend" and "not recommend" (if only I could). [list] [*]Graphics look good, UE5 after all... but it comes with all the negatives of UE. Especially blinding lights or VERY dark areas. [*]It has kind of a visually beautiful world... but most of the time you look at the rocks, snow or ground with one color. [*]There are a couple of cool songs/themes... but now I realize that I can't remember any of them besides literally 2 of them. [*]There are a lot of different enemies, visually and in terms of animation/combos... but after some time, they all somehow feel like Ctrl+C - Ctrl+V. And I really wish Elden Ring bosses did not have such long wind-up/juked animations, there is a lot of it here. [*]There are a lot of abilities and combat is fun... for the first half of the game, but after that, it gets old very fast as you unlock most of your moves. [*]I was hoping to gain some knowledge in Chinese mythology or something... but story-wise, there is 2% more said and explained than in any other FromSoftware game. [/list] I don't know. 剧情方面，游戏以《西游记》为蓝本，重新演绎孙悟空的故事。它没有拘泥于原著，而是通过精美的动画和生动的角色塑造，将玩家带入一个奇幻的世界。玩家不仅要对抗强大的敌人，还要探索未知领域，解锁隐藏秘密，增强了沉浸感，让玩家对每一个细节都充满期待。有玩家从小看86版《西游记》长大，本担心剧情改动大、不合理，但实际体验后却把它当成了原著续集，在游戏中再次看到了那个嫉恶如仇、不畏强权、渴望自由的猴哥。 _ 美术表现上，游戏的视觉效果是一大亮点。开发团队用高质量的3D建模和细致的环境设计，打造出一个生动且富有魅力的游戏世界。从辽阔山脉到幽深森林，每一个场景都精心雕琢，让玩家享受无与伦比的视觉盛宴。同时，音效和配乐也为整体氛围增色不少，使玩家在战斗和探索中更有代入感。 _ 技术层面，游戏科学运用先进的游戏引擎，保障了在各个平台上的流畅运行。无论是细腻的画面还是复杂的战斗场景，都表现出色，玩家能体验到硬核的局内体验。游戏的优化也值得称赞，开发团队致力于让每位玩家都能顺畅游戏，减少技术问题带来的挫败感。 _ 不过，《黑神话：悟空》并非十全十美。部分玩家吐槽游戏的地图和任务指引不友好，没有地图，全靠自己记路，任务指引模糊，让路痴玩家苦不堪言。此外，还有空气墙和后期赶工的痕迹，这些都算是小遗憾。 _ 总体而言，《黑神话：悟空》就像一个充满潜力的少年，虽有不足，但它展现出的实力和前景让人充满期待。相信未来开发团队会根据玩家反馈不断优化改进，让这款游戏更加完美，为玩家带来更优质的体验。

89个小时，历经一年。我终于达成了真结局了。 好游戏啊好游戏。 手残党，刚发售的时候拼尽全力打完假结局，然后卡死在二郎神了。前段时间开了新档复健，重新打完前两章之后又回头来挑战二郎真君了，可惜还是打不过。昨天心有所感，上线一遍过了。然后今天又拼尽全力过了石猿和大圣残躯。达成了一次真结局，也算对自己有了个交代。 好久没有完整的玩过一款游戏了，上一次达成游戏结局的还是2077。巧的是2077也是我预购的游戏。我是个做什么事都只有三分钟热度的人，买了很多游戏都开个头就算了，追番和看小说也是看个开头，最多到一半。生活和工作上也是。所以，这次我想尽力打完一次，借着喜欢黑神话的势头，给这段旅途画上一个句号。可能不太好看，但是完整。 很喜欢冯骥的一句话：“踏上取经路，比抵达灵山更重要。”我就是那个路总走一半就放弃的人，这次让我走完吧。 以此留言，纪念我历时11个月零4天，耗时89小时，成功通关一次《黑神话 · 悟空》

在这《清初：第一巴图鲁》出的今天，黑猴有一次证明了自己的含金量，这事也表达了，作为我们国产第一3A的白月光，制作组们在里面的用心和对于游戏最原始的热爱，没有对比就没有伤害，同时还对与我们玩家有着许多建议听取还有改进。 我还是不禁的感慨，当年自己看着黑猴一步一个脚印走到现在，我感慨的不只是黑猴的成功，更有的是我那段匆匆岁月，大家和同学们一起讨论黑猴，黑魂，某二字游戏，只狼，还有许多许多，大家都憧憬着对于游戏的热爱，和对于黑猴会不会成功的期待，还有对于国产单机的愿景。 而要说遗憾也是有的，当黑猴出的时候我也以及大学了，虽然还能和他们聊聊，但也远不如以前当面畅谈的爽快，但这遗憾也何曾不是值得多年后回味的感觉呢。 黑猴当然制作的不会是百分百的答卷，比较是第一个3A，也就代表着，他的每一步都是如履薄冰，要么结局团圆，大家一起快乐香槟，要么就是失败，国产单机的冬天与寒霜依旧，但很开心，他成功了，我当时也提前预购了游戏，回归正题，正因如此，他的内容不会太完美，第一章可以看出他的稚嫩，不过在进入第二章到后面就味道也就慢慢对位了，除了最后一章的花果山，赶工的过于明显，又因为花果山是一个半开放性的世界关卡，其实很多都不尽人意，但是最后一章的boos战都作的不错，其他的点我都可以接受，所以不过多评价。 结合游戏所有的内容，抛开对于国产的一些好感提成，黑猴无疑算的是一款佳作，还有黑猴不是类魂，咋有这么多人喜欢叫他类魂啊。 黑猴的成功是无可厚非以及日后多半不可复制的，所以今天的巴图鲁，也无疑是可大家敲响的警钟，国产不是玩家一定非你不可购买的理由，对于支持自己的玩家，要好好的听取意见加以改正，还有游戏制作人的审美以及感觉，还有对于全局的把控也是至关重要的，希望他们以《清初:第一巴图鲁》引以为戒吧。 最后的最后，DLC什么出啊

看完隔壁明末的评论之后，有感而发：不是所有的国产游戏都能得到国人的认可的，制作组自以为披着“让国产3A崛起”的外皮，玩家就会无条件买单，事实上，群众的眼光是雪亮的。游戏究竟好不好玩，选择判断权始终掌握在玩家手里。国产大作沉寂太久了，以致于好多人只想将菜品快点端上来，全然不顾火候是否到位，菜的味道是否满足顾客需求。我不知道明末以后的口碑会怎么样，但一定会为后来者敲响警钟。未来的国产 3A 游戏之路，不应只看到黑猴的辉煌。玩家渴望的，始终是一款从里到外都精雕细琢，真正将玩家游戏体验放在首位的作品。希望后续的国产游戏制作组，能稳扎稳打，在追求创新的同时，不忘夯实游戏的基础品质，别再让玩家的期待落空 。

在《248<9.48》发售的第一天补一下黑猴的好评，迟了一年没写。由于第四章虫子怪有点多且过于逼真，本人弱虫，所以我玩黑猴的游戏时长比较少，只玩了一周目。从20年8月20日发布第一个pv到24年正式出版游戏，4年等待没有让人失望。虽然第5、6章完成度不是特别理想，但是总体来说肯定是佳作，顶多就是一些小的感知细节有点吃亏，这种需要多年技术实践积累，这没办法。当时设想是想做11章还是13章有点忘了，小西天要当准压轴章节用，但有时候完成比绝对完美更重要，小西天和火焰山只能被迫删减。当时20年还是虚幻4末期，使用虚幻4肯定比一线厂起跑线落后，正好赶上藤子拿下epic且epic在那时推出虚幻5，使用虚幻5就算在同一起跑线，相对少吃点亏。真是时也命也运也，当然游科牛逼，以及广大相信游科的玩家也牛逼。最后补一句，啥时候能公布新DLC或者新作的信息呀！

黑神话确实是一个非常好，也非常让显卡燃烧的游戏。精细的建模，动作，台词，细节全部做到位，但是很多空气墙我觉得没必要，还限制了玩家的探索，很多头目和妖王确实让人红温，尤其是小黄龙，毒敌大王这俩，本来是隐藏，强度应该不算太过分，但实际上60%以上的玩家要么卡关半天，要么搜查攻略，感觉可以略微降低一下部分boss的难度。 总而言之，黑神话这游戏确实超过了我对“佳作”的认知，很有潜力。 悄悄说一句：就算出于爱国也要给好评

之前看到一篇文章说为什么游戏更容易得到负面评价，是因为steam没有类似网购平台那样的到货默认好评，而玩家比起主动给与好评更倾向与主动给出差评，我认为这样的说法是中肯的，因此在明末发售之时，我决定补上我迟来的好评。 论为什么黑猴对于中国游戏产业来说是划时代的作品，从发售后国内舆论风向的变化就能看出来，不但是黑猴优秀的配乐、厚重的剧情、优秀的动画以及在优化上付出的心血，更多的是黑猴给中国游戏产业带来了希望，让人们发现游戏是可以带来消费、让文化向外宣扬的。ok可能看到这里你会觉得我又是一个扣帽子无脑吹的人，但是明末作为乘着这股风的获利者，我敢说如果没有黑猴，明末可能发售能赔的裤衩子都不剩，但是黑猴带来的国产信任又能败多久呢？ 以上是黑猴对中国游戏产业带来的变革，下面是我作为半步全成就（指一周目就打了真结局二周目全成就只是时间问题）对游戏的主观评测： 在我没有很多动作游戏储备的情况下，黑猴带给我的感受是惊艳的。 虽然朋友后来跟我讲，游戏中有很多借鉴仁王等游戏的设计，但是我感觉设计和背景是浑然一体的，包括每一章地图的设计，地图中景色的设计，boss战场景设计，可考究的地方很充实，让人完全没有违和感，也就是说，即使是借鉴，黑猴也交了个满分答卷，在现在这个大伙连抄都抄不明白的时代，这一点很重要。 其二，黑猴的配乐是顶级的。 配乐、战斗、画面是相辅相成的，而其中配乐是让我印象最深的，作为一个对配乐挑剔的玩家，我可以清晰的感受到在boss战前背景音乐的弱变奏合入，严丝合缝的让玩家在进入战斗时瞬间融入，从配乐急缓判断boss攻击特点，比如在打小黄龙时，配乐使用明显的鼓点，仿佛是挑逗玩家，伴随小黄龙并不急促的攻击欲望，而毒敌大王的战斗则音乐更为激进，上来就给你一尾。配乐更多使用中国乐器，让我们这些儿时听过乐器音色的人在听后有一种熟悉的耳感，历代驰名第一妖响起的那一刻，游戏唤起的是我们这一带骨子里的文化熟悉感。当然，配乐还有可以改进的地方，比如boss战结束后有一个很明显很生硬的变奏转折，希望后续有机会进行更改。 最后，黑猴的剧情是让人共情的。 二流小说讲故事，一流小说讲世界。黑猴的故事可以让不了解西游的人也明白他想表达的内核，影神图则补齐了它完整的碎片，你可以通过影神图了解黑猴的世界观，以及每个你斩杀的小妖生平轶事。最后不管你是否遁入轮回，你也会感受到作为天命人的无奈和期盼。而以上，都是通过较好的表演，角色说的话语，以及顶级的章末动画，相辅相成呈现而出。 非常推荐每一个中国玩家，体验这部打磨许久的作品。世间妖魔鬼怪多了，取经成功后，批皮学步的会更多，希望大家擦亮眼睛。

确实是国产游戏的一座里程碑，但是方方面面还是凸显出经验的不足 1、地图设计，很多地方都是一本道，尤其花果山火焰山赶工的痕迹明显。箱庭设计比较缺乏经验，没有清晰的地图指引，导致经常撞空气墙，地图没有探索的空间，基本属于线性游玩。但是作为类魂游戏却延续了魂不给玩家提供可以查看的地图，在本身缺乏经验且地图设计有问题的情况下，这个决定确实太冒险了。不过团队意识到了这个问题后续更新提供了地图 2、光影，很多地方真的是黑的看不清，有的地方又像闪光弹一样 3、动作系统，虽然提供了多种打法，动作系统看似丰富，却没有针对动作系统去设计boss，导致很多技能和个别棍法感觉像是凑数的 4、剧情，其实这个很主观，每个人都有自己的品味，但是从我个人角度出发我不喜欢这种狗血剧情。 以上观点仅代表我个人看法，虽然有以上不足，但是综合素质已经是足够称为国产游戏的里程碑了，值得赞赏，但是达不到神作的级别 最最重要的一点：玩家群体，这个游戏被捧得太高了，玩家粉丝群体里有相当一部分太过极端，鉴于我因为在某社交平台无心回复了一句“说黑神话神作确实过誉了”而被冲了一下午，骂了我几十条，并且在我充分举证极其客观的论证认真我的观点时，对方只会人身攻击和拿其他游戏踩一捧一，所以我必须来这里打个差评，共勉

黑猴已白金全成就，打差评并不是说这一款游戏没有诚意，相反我认为黑猴是一款很有诚意的作品，但抛开情怀从一个玩家的角度来评价黑猴，我认为是不及格的，原因如下： 1、优化问题。这是个老生常谈的话题了，帧生成是个什么玩意懂得都懂，因此讨论帧率仅讨论不开帧生成情况下的表现。我是7900GRE，游戏全程平均很难60帧。如果对比战神和地平线，甚至于法环，在同样的画面表现水准下完全不会有如此之低的帧率（上述对比的游戏在4K分辨率下，我可以特效拉满保证4K60帧，黑猴开2K并且阉割特效的情况下才能保证60帧又怎么和这些游戏对比呢）。但是鉴于游戏科学是第一次做游戏，我倒还能体谅这个结果，虽然对于玩家来讲这样体验很差。 2、地图设计。游戏首发是没地图的，这是最傻逼的设计。好在到2025年8月我重新玩的时候，已经有了地图，知错能改是好事。但是地图到处空气墙还是没改，到了小西天浮屠场景又没了空气墙，前后地图的逻辑都不一致，这种细节做不好真的很蠢。你要么从最开始就不要有空气墙，走到悬崖边掉下去就摔死，要么浮屠塔也不要搞空气墙，这单纯就是为了恶心玩家而存在的设计。 3、BOSS的交互非常差。首先值得表扬的是，游戏科学对BOSS的动作设计和表演是下了功夫的，但是对于玩家来讲BOSS不仅要华丽，还要打的爽。我打完通关基本没有能让我感觉有爽感的BOSS，通关后我感到的是一种解脱，终于玩完了这游戏（上一个这种感受还是法环DLC）。B站上有很多关于黑神话BOSS交互设计存在问题的视频，建议游戏开发者多看看。很多粪怪的投技提示很弱，叠加BOSS经常性隐身、天命人变成修脚师傅等等，我着重说一下寅虎这个BOSS，他妈的投技几乎接近0帧，还是隐身瞬移过来抓你，美其名曰高难度游戏不是这么搞得，很多时候躲技能不是靠反应和技术，靠的是他妈的运气。黑神话BOSS的粪度和法环基本达到一个级别了，法环因为有特别多的游戏内容掩盖了BOSS粪的瑕疵，但是黑神话是个BOSS RUSH游戏，如果和法环一样的粪，那玩家的体验就是灾难。 4、光影（美术）。我是不理解为什么有些场景设计的黑咕隆咚的是出于什么考虑？要知道这个游戏没有照明道具，这让我怀疑开发者没有自己玩过游戏。

该作在游戏难度上上手难度比较高（虽然对习惯魂游的玩家来说可能还是简单），开头的大头碰三下就死，且当时气力条不足，一套普攻加两棍就没气了，切莫贪刀，后期也存在一些粪怪，比如跳来跳去的碧水金睛兽和单调的大石敢当，所以手残且没有耐心的慎入，如果通过了一周目建议体验二周目，尽管怪的数值有提升，但武器和加点相对完备后会比一周目爽不少 该作存在不少错过机制，比如无量蝠的影神图和马哥的马鞭，如果不想被全成就裹挟的多打几个周目，肯定是要查一下攻略 然后是美术，该作通过实地扫描做出了很多美轮美奂的场景，有不少怪的形象设计也相得益彰，但是一旦脱离了扫描，无论是蜘蛛洞还是火焰山，水平肉眼可见的下降，部分怪比如大头和四个魔将，抽象到一眼就是对克苏鲁的拙劣模仿。早期没有地图，黑风山还好说，黄风岭乱七八糟的岔路口简直折磨。还有抽象的空气墙，很多美术场景让你以为可以靠近或者可以翻滚过去或者可以走下去（第一章就存在不少），但实际都是不能碰的地方，而第三章的魔音塔的部分独木桥又没有空气墙，一下就被蝙蝠扎下去了。部分山洞进入之前和之后光源反差过于严重，仿佛开关灯，第五章里没有明显的进出洞在殿内都会出现光源变档，很突兀 最后就是剧情相关，剧情含量巨少，少到很多故事过于破碎，每一个剧情解读都得依靠大量的脑补内容（比如第二章），甚至结尾动画会和剧情的一些表现出现矛盾（比如紫蛛儿和八戒的剧情表现和片尾动画），还是只能过量解读圆回来。配合一些对战大圣残躯的太阳的影射，解读彻底疯魔各种乱吹。然而就是看认同度最高的革命派解读，这部作品的剧情带有很大的自恨成分，貌似天庭派和灵山派明争暗斗，神压迫人和妖，妖压迫人，少量出现的人也欺负人，然后大圣不愿同流被打死分尸，然后这反而是摘禁锢的大棋，目的是随后打上天。这就是大粪聚合物，融合了阶级论影射史学觉得只有阶级矛盾，所以上层天生邪恶，而平民是羔羊，只能得到救世主的引导来当自己的主人获得解放。又融合了所谓的人性论，所以上层邪恶下层也人性本恶，是早年西游衍生品的常见世界观，比如该作的原著悟空传以及前作斗战神赤潮，都是如此，甚至这些前作的剧情很大程度上也比黑神话好比他妙。 正常来说，就算他剧情有这么大问题，前面的西游衍生品这些事也干过不少，按理说没啥风波。但全靠猪队友助攻，我们的大冯映在发布期间说该作世界观脱胎于原著和斗战神没关系，就是脑子犯抽抽，当年挨那一碗面条活该。还有很多人吹文化输出，这文化输出整出一堆自恨活也是够可以 不过话说回来，这毕竟是最公认的第一部国产大作，抛弃上手难度门槛和其糟糕的剧情部分，买来体验一下也不错

热度过了，说点实话，75分，一股子既豪华又廉价的感觉，有种豪华至臻Ultra版嗜血印的感觉，打击感中规中矩，boss交互简陋。虚幻5引擎只能说有好有坏，好在可以更好的和Epic、老黄谈合作减低优化成本，坏在优化稀烂，热度太高有种被人架着赶上线的赶工感，但即使是这样还是去年用虚幻5的游戏里优化最好的了，真要买的还是得多斟酌优缺点别被情怀绑架买了硬啃自己不喜欢的东西。 为了蹭热度跟风玩的，我建议是别没事找罪受：别人玩游戏你玩帧数天天盯着个破功耗、调度、帧数的，一边说花钱支持一边骂优化差，即当婊子又立牌坊；为了体验别具玩法的战斗设计，可冲；想来体验传统文化，感受中式美学的，买了血赚；正常动作游戏玩家，游戏风格、战斗设计、场景美术、配乐音乐都想体验，饱受sweetbaby迫害想吃点正常的，赶紧买。 单纯为了玩动作游戏来的，绝对可以玩个爽；玩个游戏不是帧数就是跟风的，建议是直接去Q交流群发自拍，省了你每天到处找屎搬的功夫；还有那种一点小毛病就唧唧歪歪贬得一无是处的，建议是以后买游戏尽量多看两眼，牢记龙王美德，能让你这辈子少吃点屎直接站在致高点嘲讽杭州人。

After spending over 75 hours with Black Myth: Wukong, unlocking Wukong Mode, beating every Boss Rush challenge, and earning 100% of the Steam achievements, I can confidently say this is one of the most memorable action RPG experiences I’ve played in recent years. I even completed the game three times, and each run brought something new and exciting to the table. From the very first playthrough, the game swept me into a stunning world full of breathtaking visuals, immersive music, and an incredible variety of boss encounters that kept me constantly engaged. Exploration is deeply rewarding. First-time players should absolutely take their time with side quests, hidden areas, and optional bosses. With over 100 unique boss fights and very little downtime between them, the game maintains a strong, addictive pace that rarely lets up. While it’s not as brutally difficult as something like Elden Ring’s DLC, Wukong strikes a perfect balance. Its challenges are tough but fair, making victories feel satisfying rather than exhausting. Boss mechanics are well-designed and demand attention without ever feeling cheap. The combat system is another major highlight. Skill trees offer impressive depth and variety, allowing you to customize your build with spells, transformations, and abilities to suit your preferred playstyle. The wide range of weapons and armor sets gives you even more flexibility and reason to replay. If you're familiar with the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West, the game’s story and characters will carry even more weight. If not, I’d highly recommend watching a quick summary online. It adds so much context to the mythological richness of the world. All in all, Black Myth: Wukong is a masterfully crafted blend of myth, action, and artistry. Whether you're playing for the intense boss battles, rich atmosphere, or simply to witness the legend of the Monkey King, this game delivers on nearly every aspect.

Black Myth: Wukong is easily one of my favorite games of the past 10 years. Its a fun introduction to Journey to the West and Chinese lore and has some of the best boss design and combat in the genre. Very rarely do I jump straight into a second play through of a game, but I did with this game. The last time I did this was Witcher 3. The boss fights as well as added rewards for continued play makes it easy to get sucked back into continued play throughs. I only have a couple of nitpicks that I hope they address in future games. First, the level design is beautiful and immersive, but the use of invisible walls breaks the immersion of what is otherwise amazing level design. Second, I love the stance style combat, but I wish that the light attack combos were different for each stance. This could have added another level to the combat if used the way that Ghost of Tsushima designed their stance system to change between stances during fights to address the move sets of multiple opponents. Over all the game is great and Game Science hit a home run with their first major release.

Wukong is, in my opinion, the perfect example of how to implement the game design philosophies pioneered by FromSoft into a creative combat system. As a Souls veteran, Wukong still felt very fresh to play despite taking clear inspiration from the souls games. This is mainly due to how evolved the combat system is, giving you way more options than in a traditional souls title. The Destined One's moveset is very robust, with a massive skill tree supporting various builds on top of countless armor sets and craftable weapons playing crucial support roles. The 3 unique stances , as well as the long list of different spells, transformations, and spirits, also add even more to the overall depth of the combat. Compared to the very restrictive, simple nature of FromSoft's builds and combat design, Wukong allows for a lot more skill expression and individual build preference. As for the direct inspiration, the bonfire mechanic as well as the "dodge roll" style of avoiding damage both feel very at home with the various add-ons, and it is hard to deny how brilliant those systems were and continue to be, so it is understandable as to why Wukong did not go down an original path in those regards. The overall game design is also fantastic, the list of bosses is insanely long and most of them range from good to some of the greatest of all time. The levels are massive and full of tangible rewards for exploring, including entire secret areas with hidden bosses and loot. I tried Wukong on the recommendation of my brother-in-law and can see why some people enjoy the game. It has a unique look and feel drawing from Chinese mythology, a variety of unique enemies, great graphics, and offers a strong standalone single-player experience. But Wukong is basically Chinese Dark Souls and that just didn’t work for me. The fights are some of the most punishing I’ve encountered in a video game in a bid to offer an exclusionary experience catering to the most hardcore gamers. That may work for some people. But as someone pushing 40 with limited time to play video games, I have no interest in doing the same fight over and over again in order to memorize my opponent’s move set so that I can perfectly time my dodges. If that sounds appealing to you, great! But there are so many other incredible single player experiences out there that don’t repeatedly kick you in the balls. So why spend your time on this one?

What an incredible game and an unforgettable experience. I thoroughly enjoyed this adventure and I'm honestly sad that it's over. Normally, I'm not a huge fan of Souls-like games, but WuKong is more forgiving compared to others in the genre. It felt much more accessible and manageable. The story, however, is quite confusing if you're not familiar with Journey to the West. This could definitely have been handled better it feels like a missed opportunity. The combat feels fantastic, aside from the occasional odd hitboxes. There's a wide variety of stats and skills, offering something for every playstyle. Skills are fun to use and can be employed strategically. The enemy variety is impressive, and each boss encounter feels unique. Bosses hit hard but their attack patterns are well-telegraphed. It feels satisfying and rewarding to defeat them. One small complaint is that some bosses can be overly aggressive, leaving very little room to counterattack or create openings. The different gear and crafting systems add nice variety, though they could have been a bit more in-depth. That said, I actually liked that I didn’t feel pressured to constantly change my gear it allowed me to stick with what I enjoyed using. The various potions and buffs add a lot to the combat, especially the healing potion you carry with you. It's great that this potion can be customized. One major downside is that certain side quests can't be completed if you've already defeated the main boss of that area. This means you may miss out on some optional bosses and loot. You're kinda forced to play New Game Plus if you want to experience everything the game has to offer. Visually, the game has its fair share of bugs and is quite unstable at times, but even so, it looks absolutely stunning. I do hope they manage to better balance the lighting system though the contrast between shadow and sunlight can be very harsh, and at times it was straining on the eyes. I frequently had to adjust the in-game brightness, gamma settings, and even tweak my monitor to better see in darker areas. Performance could definitely be improved, but most of the issues stem from typical Unreal Engine problems like traversal stutters and shader compilation. I was able to play on max settings with a high-end PC, but there’s still room for optimization. I’m really looking forward to any upcoming DLC I can’t wait to explore more of WuKong’s world. Game Science is definitely a studio to keep an eye on. This is already a very strong title from them.

通关了，写一下评价。 1、画面：有虚幻5引擎加持，加上古建筑1比1扫描复刻，还是很好看的。但是也有虚幻5引擎带来的缺点，比如：亮的地方很亮，暗的地方又很暗。前5章还好，画面内容还算丰富，但是第6章基本就是复制粘贴凑出来的，假大空。 2、战斗体验：BOSS和怪基本都是0帧出手，目押闪避基本做不到，只能凭感觉预判时间进行闪避。玩家人物动作的前后摇长得离谱，受击僵直也长得逆天，挨BOSS一招后，后面几招伤害直接全吃；再者没有预输入系统，玩起来很生硬，一定要人物动作全部完成后才能操作。重点踩一下重棍，好不容易攒出来的3~4层重棍，能被受击打断，锁定BOSS且距离合适后还能打空，用出来还得硬控自己3~4秒，纯纯小丑攻击方式，真就劈棍魅力时刻呗。还有锁定问题，BOSS经常跑来跑去，飞来飞去，完了视角还经常更不上；打大型BOSS时，既看不清BOSS动作，也看不清人物动作，直接穿模视角；BOSS在头顶时，还会被玩家人物挡住。视角问题就纯折磨人。还有就是有些BOSS就是来恶心人的，打两下就跑，打两下就跑；要么就是伤害又高，范围又大 ，攻击频率又高，完了还带属性伤害，再配合上玩家超长的前后摇，你就玩吧，一玩一个不吱声。 3、关卡、地图设计：跑图经常看见岔路，完了又不知道哪一条是主线，哪一条是支线，全靠自己猜，玩完前3章后，后面全是看攻略走，地图引导方面可以说几乎没有做好。还有就是遍地的空气墙，探路探到一处缺口，以为是路，在那跳半天过不去，打开地图看才知道是死路，那为什么要设计成让人以为能走得样子呢？宝箱、金丹等物品也是没有任何指引，全靠玩家到处走。就连BOSS身上也放了空气墙，我实在不能理解这种到处放空气墙的行为。到了浮屠塔的独木桥又不放了。到了虎怅的独木桥又不放了，这样给人的感觉很割裂，给玩家搞地形杀，是什么心理？ 4、更新：从去年12月份后就没有重大更新了，就连小更新也是今年4月份的事，玩家反馈的问题都不看的么，游戏有这么多问题为什么不去改善呢？ 综合评价只能给到7分，10分制，战斗在游戏中占大头，但是战斗体验实在让人感到火大，越玩越红温，通关我就卸载了。

先说明，我给了钱的，我怎么评价是我的事。总结就是一句，未能达到神作水平，在佳作偏下游一、首当其冲的就是空气墙的设计，天命人的身体机能算魂游里非常强的，但到处的空气墙限制了这种长处，整个跑图的过程中就像吃了史一样难受：你发现一个路口，兴致勃勃地想过去探索一下，一堵空气墙就来了；后来，过完了这一章，你发现就是你默认为空气墙的区域，藏着一个道具！他藏着重要的道具！这就非常难受了二、剧情，前三章的剧情无可挑剔，非常优秀，后三章的剧情是什么狗屎啊？红孩儿是铁扇公主的私生子？猪八戒和蜘蛛精有一腿？孙悟空和白骨精谈过恋爱？！游科，你要这么改，下一部关于三国的作品可以直接来一章关羽大战外星人了。三、优化，需要体现在第三张第六章，优化极其垃圾，同样是高画质，第一章能有90帧，晃动视角帧率变化不大，到了第三张，一抬头就卡成ppt，第六章更是，优化极差四、战斗系统，也是一坨。打一些灵活一点的boss，像步云鹿，黑熊精，锁定的点都移动出视角了，我的视角还没跟上去。打击手感也是一个问题，有很多时候，不开伤害显示我根本不知道到底打没打中。boss设计有很多恶心人的点，种种神经刀，多动症，霸体怪，很多招式不论距离都可以秒中，参考王灵官的掌击，离远了没来得及看清前摇，攻击就已经到了脸上，其他游戏的神经刀都是贴脸的，前摇明显只是很短，黑神话的很多是超远距离神经刀，你只见boss稍微动了一下，攻击就已经到了脸上。弹刀、击杀、闪身、识破正向反馈不尽人意，让人满意的这类设计可以参考只狼五、任务指引，作为一个箱庭游戏，这一点属实是拉跨到没边了，这一点和空气墙有很大关系，因为空气墙太多，非常容易错过任务道具和重要素材最后来说，总体好坏参半吧，主要是后三章太烂了，给到一个佳作

Just wrapped up Black Myth: Wukong 100% and man, what a ride. I beat every single boss and filled out my entire journal as this was my first soulslike ever. You play as the Destined One, a monkey warrior inspired by Sun Wukong from Journey to the West. The combat is crack once you master it, parrying, dodging, switching forms and spells… it’s smooth but tough. Every fight feels earned. The Yellow Loong was one of the toughest bosses I faced, he had me on the edge, I was losing my mind fr, but I finally locked in and wrecked him for good. Well the story? Not crazy deep, but solid enough to keep you interested. What really blew me away was the environment in every chapter each area is pure art. It’s got those magical, myth-heavy, mysterious vibes that keep you exploring nonstop, I’ll be patiently waiting for that DLC to drop now but If you’re into tough action games like Sekiro or Elden Ring, Wukong is gonna be your thing. And honestly? It might be one of the best myth-based games we’ve gotten in a long time.

魔改中国四大名著，炒作西游IP，一部品相还不错、但借助网红炒作流量+缝合各类型动作游戏的作品。 游玩经历：二周目打通，影像图全收集。 画质：得益于虚幻5引擎的加持，画质不错，但是优化不怎么样，经常掉帧，还有一个问题，就是部分场景，光线处理有问题，黑的地方特别黑，亮的地方特别亮。叙事：斗天斗天庭这个思路是借鉴战神系列的，每一章的过场动画做的不错，但是碎片化叙事，让人看得莫名奇妙，比如第二三章其实跟主线剧情关联不大。动作系统：能看到很多仁王+部分魂游的影子，总得来说是个缝合的作品，人物技能树的UI都是学战神系列，整体方面爽感还不错，但是与boss交互做的不怎么样，经常就是机械式你打你的，我打我的。打击感一般。美术：场景美术还不错，但是地图设计的不好，有各种看着能去，但实际去不了的空气墙，细节方面还算细致。小怪种类设计的很多，但是很多boss例如第六章设计的很敷衍，缺乏新意，都是现实各种动物昆虫的放大版，比如：步云鹿、金犀牛、螳螂、每一章出现的各种青蛙小boss。音乐：这反而是我觉得黑神话悟空最优秀的部分了，场景音乐、过场动画音乐、boss场景音乐都很不错，没什么挑剔的。总结：作为国产第一部3A作品，黑神话悟空无疑是优秀的，但是从大的层面来看，游戏缺乏创新，游戏过程中能看到很多动作游戏的影子，整体是一部缝合的作品，叙事虽然是吸引人的，但是缺乏整体逻辑，是那种碎片化，能看出制作组还是想借鉴魂游碎片化叙事的技巧，但是又在每一章的过场动画和CG部分下功夫，但是缺不像很多线性3A那样把最起码的故事讲清楚，期待后续DLC能够弥补这一点，整体来说是个7.5/10 分作品吧，对于国产游戏意义重大，但是放眼整个游戏业看属于还不错，但不够优秀的水平。

這款之前鬧得很兇，就很想玩玩看，但一來是因為顯卡不夠力想等新的顯卡，二來是想說既然沒衝首發就等個特價好了，終於讓我在發售後快一年等到了，顯卡也換了，價格也折扣了，就開打吧。 整體來說是個值得一玩的動作遊戲，但優缺點明顯，好的地方很好，但差的地方也也很難忽略，但以一個3A處女作來說，廠商已經很有誠意了，所以評論優點之處希望續作保留，缺點則希望廠商改進，下次的作品會更好應該是板上釘釘。 黑神話最強的部份當然是畫質跟演出，這應該是共識了，看得出非常用心。 各種怪物的設計與美術也相當強，世界級的水準！ 優化上當然有改進空間，不然我也不會想等到換了顯卡再來玩，就是不想玩一玩卡頓。 當然，優化是一件很困難的工作，許多老牌大廠也都砸鍋了，只能說，加油。 再來是戰鬥系統，我認為是中上，不錯，但不到驚豔，就是很尋常的快慢刀、讀指令、閃避，除了限制頗多的法術招式，沒有遠程技、沒有暗殺模式、沒有終結技、沒有其它主要武器。 就是一個精簡的機制，再加上幾個比較實用的技能，跟一堆玩具法術。 Boss戰增加難度，就是： 1.快慢刀 2.超長的連段與派生 3.霸體 幾乎都是差不多的套路，以一個老老玩家的角度去看，從小時候一路從鬼武者、惡魔獵人、戰神、忍外、貝優涅塔、仁王、魂系、隻狼、法環這樣一路玩過來，大大小小的動作遊戲都玩遍了，這樣單純的系統不是說不好，就是...會有點膩，而且黑神話其它方面的內容不少，所以要和這樣的機制玩上四、五十個小時... 如果你是新玩家，那應該夠玩了啦，但如果有續作，還是希望可以多一點創意會更好。 劇情，雖然演出很給力，但說故事的方法，我自己沒那麼喜歡。 感覺就像是去頭去尾只講中間，剩下的地方都是留白給你去猜，但留白的部份也留得不是很好。 這部份大概是學魂系敘事風格來著的，所以之後有「黑學家」就一點也不意外。 最大的缺點，就是遊戲關卡設計了，這是我覺得續作要重點改進的地方，探索感真的一言難盡。 最主要的問題就是空氣牆，真的騙我太多次，很累。 而且如果要是全都是空氣牆，那也就算了，這樣大家心裡都有個底。 重點在，有的地方有，有的地方沒有！ 這點嚴重影響體驗，請下次好好設計地圖，走不過去的地方就找東西擋起來，就算一顆樹或一些雜物都好，那看得到的地方都盡量能讓玩家過去，摔死就讓他摔死，這才合理。 另外就是場景的辨視度不佳，地圖又太大，逛起來蠻煩燥的，我甚至覺得可以縮減一半，那些小怪就免了只是浪費時間，場景每個區域都至少來一兩個明顯的地標，不然像二、三章，看起來都差不多，走久了會有點愛睏，還不如一、五章一本道算了。 很多人說地圖設計是經驗不足，我倒覺得是資源分配出了問題，想做的很多，但真的做不完，那一開始企劃時就拿掉好了。 證據就是那個第六章，真的有點扯。 不過基本上這還是款動作遊戲，關卡設計有很好、沒有就算了，所以最後也懶得跑圖探索，直衝主線玩戰鬥就好。 大概就是這樣，雖然有缺點，但還是不錯玩，現在還有興趣的可以等特價入手，如果你像我一樣玩太多遊戲的，就別抱太多期待，黑神話還是不錯的。

This is a soft thumbs-up. I would give it a 6/10, just limping into the green. Wukong had a lot of hype, and in my opinion, ultimately didn’t live up to it. I heard this game sold millions and was a fantastic, beautiful single player RPG with a great story line and great mechanics. I waited for it to go on sale and was excited to load it up. This review is going to get pretty scathing, so I want to first say, this game is beautiful and I did have fun for the first 30 hours or so. The first time I loaded up this game, I definitely got goosebumps and was excited to see how they pulled off a follow up to an amazing introduction cut-scene. Strong start, but it just felt flat at the end, really flat. I’m still glad I played it, and some things they nailed, but too many fumbled, especially near the end, keeps this game from being incredible. The Good: The game looks amazing. Bosses are huge, and feel larger than life, they look unique and sound epic. Blades of grass sway, and snow falls gently in front of your camera. Visually, this game is an A, I can't say that enough. Cut-scenes have different styles too, cool addition. Chapters 1-5 are large, with different settings, and plenty of secrets to find. Different enemies and a decent amount of replay-ability with different paths to take and loot to collect. Fun and engaging. These are the 30 hours I enjoyed, for the most part. Decent: There are a ton of bosses in this game. It’s basically just running from one to the next. This was enjoyable in the beggining, and monotonous at the end. Especially when the bosses seemed to get more invincible moves and less windows to attack them. The Buddha comes to mind, way too much talking and golden armor that made him invincible nearly half the time, and the Rhino, who you need to hit from the back to actually damage, but lock-on targeting always targets his front for some reason? Frustrating and not fun. I’m really split with the decision to make so many bosses in this game. Some of them were challenging in a fun way, learn the mechanics and finally beat with elation. Most were way too random. With a huge set of moves that you had to dodge with little room for error. This game is difficult, don’t let anyone tell you different. Enemies have huge life bars and lots of damage. In my opinion, only Sekiro is more difficult in the soul-like genre. Some of the time, I liked the difficulty because I would learn, adapt, and overcome. Some of the time, I was yelling at my computer because I suffered a bad beat and knew it would be a while before I got another lucky round. Sometimes my spells would break early, or get interrupted, sometimes the enemy would hit me with a move that I swear I dodged or throw in a whole new move to kill me instantly. Sometimes my potion wouldn’t go off when I was mashing the buttons. Just know, that when you play this game, you’re going to die quite a bit and most of the time, it won’t be fair. The story line is confusing throughout most of this game. I never really understood who I was fighting and why. Lots of folklore with a silent protagonist. Its about on par with Darksouls, lore was too vague for me. But there is a huge exception to this. I believe its chapter 4. The only thing I’ll say is, the end cut-scene got me right in the feels. A pig falls in love with a spider and its precious. You have spells and skill trees, gear, potions, temporary buffs called medicine and lesser-Permanant buffs called celestial medicine, but I’ve seen pretty much all these mechanics in games before. I have to knock off a point because this game really doesn’t bring anything new to the genre. But I will say, they do all the above pretty well, the systems are intuitive and explained clearly as you acquire them. Bad: Chapter 6 is named “unfinished” which is ironic because that’s what it felt like. It’s a whole slew of bosses that were some of the most poorly designed in the whole game. The rhino I mentioned above, there is also a guy that rides on a wheel for a while wile you just take his attacks until he decides to hop off and let you hit him. A deer that randomly freezes you and hops around until, once again, it decides to let you attack it. I’m sure there is more, but as of this review I have not finished the game yet. Why is this chapter so big? Why is it so empty? Why is it giving me armor that is tons better than all the other armor I’ve found. Makes everything before it feel obsolete and a waste of crafting materials. This chapter is so frustrating, and it comes at the worst time. When the game should be wrapping up into the final fight, its sending you on a cloud to scout a barren land, with a few lame bosses scattered throughout. I’m just so disappointed with the ending of this game. This is such an unnecessary addition. Its like they ran out of ideas and budget, but were hell-bent on making a chapter 6. This is a difficult game, I should feel good about getting to the end and excited to try my skills and gear against the last boss, instead I just want it to be over so I can be done with it and move on. In conclusion, I would wait until this game goes on sale. There are more polished, complete games in the genre, but if you’ve played all the Darksouls and Sekiro’s of the world, this is a fine game you’ll probably enjoy.

This game frankly falls apart after act 3. Act 2 was already testing the limits of my patience, with its enemy spam and bosses that start floating in mid-air while they delay their attacks, but act 3 kind of made up for it. Act 4 has been unmitigated nonsense from start to finish and I really despise it. The moment you hit the secret area, all of the worst aspects of the game are laid bare before your eyes. The parry spell is a clunky joke, especially when it pushes your hitbox down and the boss flies over your head and then hits you with his roll catch just after you're vulnerable again. The counter mechanic is a clunky joke, because you'll find yourself just barely out of the combo and you'll end up wasting all your focus on a heavy attack instead of a counter, because the boss's attacks just barely don't line up with yours, and you can't animation cancel into a counter. Then when you finally get to hit the boss, you hit him twice before he jumps away and you have to wait for your turn again. It's a frustrating clunky mess of a game and the more I play it the more I find I just don't want to continue and would rather play pretty much any other game. I might keep pushing through a little longer, but I'll probably just lose interest before I hit act 5.

For what deed was the staff raised, if not to shatter the heavens of doubt? For what sin was this tale spun in gold, only to be weighed down by mortal ballots? I walked the Eight Trials, barefoot through flame and frost, the Ape no beast—but spirit made sinew, a myth born not of dream, but of pain, patience, and perfect parry. Was it for naught that I learned death’s rhythm? That every fall taught a lesson etched in blood? A journey not easy—no, never that— but one that breaks the weak, and makes reward a crown earned, not given. Yet when the verdict came, it was not Wukong who sat among kings. A jest!
