One very important thing about this game that I think you don't see when you watch videos on it is that the combat is very scripted and doesn't flow like other souls-like games. In other games of this genre, the combat has a very distinct flow that I personally just didn't get with this game. It felt like the only thing going for it in terms of combat was flashiness. Another thing I didn't enjoy was the movement. God, the movement in this game felt so restrictive, which is very prominent in most souls-like games, but the marketing for this game made it seem more like Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice when in reality you have much less freedom. One thing this game does have going for it is it's graphics. God this game is beautiful. While the combat isn't too good, the look of this game is amazing. The opening fight in this game felt so climactic and made me think this game was something special. Overall, if you've read this and seen all the trailers and still felt like this game is right for you, go buy it. It's obviously had so much work put into it by so many talented people, but I just felt like there were some things they weren't telling you

《黑神話：悟空》：天庭才是三界最深淵的惡 （推薦：?） 「長生不老，三界六道就是毀這四字。」 ——當孫悟空的低吼從耳機裡傳來時，我終於明白，這遊戲最令人背脊發涼的，從來不是妖魔橫行的煉獄，而是高坐雲端、金碧輝煌的「天庭」。 *「神佛」比妖魔更懂吃人* 遊戲科學用一記悶棍打碎了童年對《西遊記》的浪漫幻想。這裡的天庭不是救世主，而是一群永生不死的統治機器。他們以「秩序」為名，將眾生困在輪迴的牢籠裡：凡人求長生被斥為貪婪，神仙煉丹延壽卻是天經地義；妖魔屠村是罪孽，神將滅國卻是「天劫」。當你闖過血肉模糊的妖洞，卻發現所謂的「極樂天宮」，不過是將人當作香火燃料的巨型熔爐——*永生，成了三界最毒的詛咒*。 *悟空的「覺醒」：撕破神話的虛偽* 主角（悟空的繼承者？化身？或是另一枚棋子？）的戰鬥愈發絕望。金箍棒砸碎的不止是妖怪頭顱，更是天庭編織千年的謊言。那些口誦慈悲的菩薩，法力全開時會化身血肉與機械融合的怪物；「四大天王」的BOSS戰，與其說是比武，更像是揭發一場神權的獻祭儀式——他們腳下的屍山，可比任何魔頭都堆得更高。 *當「長生」成為統治工具* 遊戲用碎片敘事揭開細思極恐的真相：天庭掌控生死簿不是為了公正，而是為了壟斷「永生」的權柄。妖魔吃人尚需親自動手，神佛卻能讓凡人自願獻上壽命，只求一個「來世福報」的虛空承諾。這句「長生不老，三界六道就是毀這四字」，與其說是悟空的憤怒，不如說是對玩家的一記當頭棒喝——*我們何嘗不是活在「現代天庭」編織的長生夢裡？* *優缺並存，但足夠震撼* 當然，它不完美：視角偶爾混亂、部分關卡堆怪明顯，但當你用七十二變化身巨猿，一拳轟爆「凌霄殿」匾額時，這些瑕疵瞬間變得微不足道。更何況，這可能是你第一次在遊戲裡，感受到「反抗」二字的重量——不是打敗魔王拯救公主，而是對整個體系的宣戰。 *結語：這不是西遊，是照妖鏡* 《黑神話：悟空》的偉大，在於它敢用4K光追畫質逼你直視神佛臉上的膿瘡。通關後我盯著片尾字幕，耳邊反覆迴盪那句「長生不老……」——或許真正的妖魔，從來都住在我們頭頂的雲端上。 *推薦給*：受夠了救世主套路，想砸碎點什麼的玩家。

This was the game I was waiting for and really hyped about for a number of years. I'm familiar with Chinese RPG's, Wuxia, and have beaten some of the most difficult souls games out there. I wasn't expecting this game to be any of those types of games. I was absolutely welcoming something different which this game is. First of all the optimization is inexcusable. I made it through the whole game and had plenty of massive slowdowns every time I boot up the game and during boss fights despite my PC having much higher requirements than what are the system requirements. I bought Lossless Scaling just for this game and it didn't seem to do squat as far as I can tell. There is no option to run in the game. This simple mechanic would have made an entire difference. The game is much too sluggish for that reason. It hurts this game massively. Overall the RPG system of this game really bothers me. After you level up you swap around your points in the categories where you want them. Which means for different bosses and parts of the game you are going to change everything in order to adapt or survive. If you can't beat a boss changing where you put your points can make the boss too easy or too difficult as well as what items you are using. This ended up not being enjoyable for me. I did plenty of farming racking up a good number of points as well as getting every item possible in the game as well as unlocking all the areas so I would not need to come back on a new game+. Either I leveled up more and the game became too easy or I had to learn the pattern of bosses better or watch a video on what items to use. The problem is the lack of exploration, the poor game design, and overall this game was not very fun. I thought Sword and Fairy VII had minor optimization issues and it did but this game made me forget how bad it was . I've enjoyed a handful of some very flawed Wuxia games over Black Myth Wukong. It's really unfortunate. I finally decided to give this game a go After beating Elden Ring for the second time and beating the expansion. There are some visually stunning aspects as the videos showed that got me excited for this game. Unfortunately I am very disappointed with this game and regret the hours I put into it when I could have been playing something else. I paid a few dollars less during the winter sale on another website. If I would have known the performance issues were as bad as they were I wouldn't have bought this game in the first place. It's not going to be a popular opinion but as someone who has been playing video games since the release of the Atari 2600 and has enjoyed the whole history of gaming since then. As someone who has played countless action RPG's this game just wasn't very fun or enjoyable. I've played so much better. It's unfortunate! 5/10

发售半年多闲下来补个评论： 本人20年第一支招人PV发布的时候就开始关注了，24年预售豪华版入手，但非魂类玩家，有点属于手残类型，网上常看看别人的魂类过关视频，基本算是零基础选手，因此刚开始玩的时候也是被折磨了一段时间，但不同于其他的魂类游戏（只狼、黑魂3都入手后退款了）这是我们自己的神话故事啊！没有人能比我们更了解故事的背景，所以即便是备受折磨，但我仍能保持热情玩下去（所以情怀也是加分项啊）中间几次剧情推进都让我心潮澎湃，甚至感动的想落泪 从游戏内容来说，前四章节的剧情推进和游戏内容还是挺饱满的，但后两章（尤其点名第六章花果山剧情，后面大圣残躯以及二郎神那不算）出现了很明显的赶工痕迹，并不像前几章那么严谨，当然我也可以理解，毕竟如果2025年发售谁知道会发生什么意料之外的事情，但至少目前端上来的菜已经有8.5，甚至是9分的成色已经实属不易。总要给自己一点进步的空间嘛，后续也可以继续完善（不得不说后面更新的地图系统就挺不错的，刚开始还只能手机上摆着地图，电脑上看着爬图，后入手的细糠也吃的太好了） 当然作为手残还是寻求了“菩提祖师”的一些帮助（师傅说了，惹出祸事不能把师傅供出来，嘿嘿，手动狗头），但个人觉得无伤大雅，也就是经验获取1.2，灵韵获取1.2，法术和气力消耗0.8-0.9，怪物伤害0.9-0.95，并不影响游戏体验，因为很多地方还是需要技巧，没有魂类游戏基础的后来者可以做下参考（大佬就不要喷我嗷，喷我我就上吊死给你看） 想想游科和柳叶刀两个从腾讯出来的团队，为了自己的热爱在做自己想做的东西，真的很开心看到我们还有这样的游戏团队（虽然边境已经跑路了，我是22年入伍前预购的，结果24年退伍回来游戏都停服了，但我也不想去批评什么，毕竟他们也确实是想做不一样的东西）原来并不是所有人只把现实赚钱放在第一位（当然也会有很多人把热爱放在第一位，但可惜，有多少的热爱又被现实扼杀了呢）希望未来还能继续出现这样的游戏团队吧，也希望大家未来给愿意走上这条路的团队们一些适当的包容和鼓励（仅作为一名曾想跨入游戏行业，但实力不济只能委屈于现实的玩家而言） 希望游科能尽快补上DLC，毕竟四妹还在等我（呜呜呜呜呜呜┭┮﹏┭┮）

Maybe it's because I've watched a ton of anime and movies featuring/referencing Sun Wukong, or because Monkey King has always been my favorite character in Dota 2, but there's something about the Monkey King's story that has always drawn me in—even if I didn't know all the details. Black Myth: Wukong felt like the perfect way to dive deeper into that lore. The combat? Incredibly smooth and satisfying. Every swing of the staff, every dodge, every combo—it all just clicks. I especially loved the Thrust Stance. Its reach and precision made it feel like I was dancing around enemies, striking with calculated jabs. The Tactical Retreat into Forceful Thrust combo became my go-to move, allowing me to evade and counterattack seamlessly. Summoning clones to distract foes or vanishing into mist to reposition was just pure fun and kept the gameplay fresh and dynamic. Even after thoroughly exploring the game and squeezing out every bit of excitement from my playthrough, I found myself seriously considering NG+—which is a very rare occurrence for me—just to experience the combat all over again. This time, I'm eager to experiment with other stances and spells to discover new strategies. The music and sound effects are top-notch, enhancing every moment. And the visuals? Absolutely stunning. The animations and the seamless combat is on par with the best Soulslike games out there. For a debut game, Game Science has truly knocked it out of the park. I'm genuinely excited to see what they come up with next.

Black Myth: Wukong was my first Souls-like experience, and it instantly showed me why this genre is so respected. At first, I was intimidated and had to learn patience. You can try to brute force or cheese bosses, but if you go in swinging wildly with your staff, you will rarely succeed. The game teaches you to observe patterns, plan your attacks, and approach fights strategically, which makes every victory feel earned. The combat is impeccable. Every swing, dodge, and skill feels responsive, satisfying, and weighty. Boss fights are especially memorable, with unique and imaginative designs that make each encounter feel fresh and challenging. Dying is never frustrating—it feels like a learning opportunity rather than a setback. The world is absolutely stunning. From the environments to the enemy designs, everything feels carefully crafted, alive, and full of character. The mythological elements are integrated beautifully, giving the game a strong sense of place and tone. Exploration is rewarding, and even small encounters feel meaningful within this rich world. For someone new to Souls-likes, this game is an incredible introduction. It teaches patience, strategy, and skill while delivering jaw-dropping visuals and unforgettable encounters. It is challenging but fair, and it rewards players who take the time to engage with it fully.
Absolute cinema. This game will satisfy you in every sense.

《黑神话：悟空》的问世，无疑在游戏界投下了一颗重磅炸弹。这款以中国神话为背景的动作游戏，承载着无数玩家对国产 3A 大作的期待。当我踏入这个由游戏科学精心打造的 “西游” 世界后，收获了一段充满惊喜与思考的游戏旅程。? 从文化底蕴的呈现来看，《黑神话：悟空》堪称一绝。它以《西游记》为蓝本，却又另辟蹊径，讲述了大圣取经成佛之后的全新故事。游戏场景中的亭台楼阁、古刹庙宇，一砖一瓦皆复刻自我国名胜古迹，完美还原了中式古建筑的韵味。陕北说书、非遗音乐等元素的巧妙融入，更是让玩家仿佛置身于古老的华夏大地，在战斗与探索间，领略传统文化的魅力。比如黑风山章节，一段简短的 2D 动画便将原著情节凝练其中，小 BOSS 对话中对 “贪” 字的展现，也契合了佛教对于人性欲望的探讨，足见制作组对文化挖掘之深。? 战斗体验是《黑神话：悟空》的一大亮点。玩家手中的如意金箍棒，可刚可柔，重棍与轻棍攻击随心切换，连招设计行云流水，极具节奏感。面对不同类型的妖怪，战斗方式也需灵活应变，这种策略性与操作性并存的战斗系统，给予玩家极高的战斗爽感。BOSS 战的设计更是可圈可点，每一场 BOSS 战都像是一场惊心动魄的史诗对决，BOSS 们形态各异、技能独特，战斗过程中的光影特效、动作表现，无不彰显出制作组在动作设计上的精湛技艺。不过，也存在个别 BOSS 模型判定不够精准的问题，如亢金龙之战，在激烈战斗中偶尔会出现打空的情况，影响了战斗的流畅性。? 剧情方面，游戏章节剧情丰富且独立成章，相互串联构建起一个庞大的世界观。但对于不熟悉《西游记》原著的玩家来说，部分剧情理解起来可能存在一定障碍。例如，在一些任务物品的获取与使用上，若对原著背景毫无了解，可能会不明所以，导致游戏体验打折。? 探索性上，制作组有意不设置地图和路线引导触发点，鼓励玩家自由探索，去发现隐藏在各个角落的秘密与惊喜。这一初衷虽好，但复杂的地图设计和缺乏明确指引，容易使玩家迷失方向，分不清主线与支线，接了任务却不知前往何处完成，大大降低了探索的效率与乐趣。? 《黑神话：悟空》无疑是一款极具野心与诚意的作品。它在文化传播、战斗设计等方面有着卓越的表现，为国产游戏走向世界舞台提供了优秀范例。但在一些细节上，如 BOSS 模型判定、剧情引导、地图探索等方面，仍有较大的优化空间。期待游戏科学能够持续打磨，让《黑神话：悟空》这颗明珠愈发璀璨，为玩家带来更完美的神话冒险体验 。?

游科用虚幻5引擎打造了一个充满东方魔幻色彩的史诗世界：从云雾缭绕的花果山到诡谲阴森的黑风洞，每一帧都宛如动态的水墨长卷。角色设计尤其惊艳，既保留了《西游记》原著的神怪特征，又通过机械铠甲、生物腐蚀等元素赋予现代审美重构，四大天王战的设计堪称视觉奇观。 不同于传统ACT游戏的固定流派，悟空通过"七十二变"机制实现了战斗风格的动态切换。金蝉脱壳的闪避、定身咒的时机判定、法宝系统的策略搭配，构成了极具层次感的战斗体验。Boss战设计彰显出制作组对"挑战与公平"的深刻理解——每个妖王都像在演绎自己的史诗，小雷音寺龙战等场景将叙事与玩法完美融合。 游戏没有简单复述《西游记》，而是通过碎片化叙事重构了一个后神话时代的黑暗寓言。破损的经卷、癫狂的罗汉、被腐蚀的天庭，这些意象共同解构了传统西游故事，探讨了信仰异化与反抗宿命的哲学命题。中文配音的方言运用（如土地老的川普）更增添了文化厚度。 毛发渲染、物理破坏、动态天气等次世代技术并非炫技，而是真正服务于世界观营造。尽管存在部分场景加载卡顿、镜头锁定等优化问题，但考虑到这是首款国产3A级动作游戏，其技术完成度已远超预期。 《黑神话》的成功证明了中国团队完全有能力驾驭顶级游戏工业流程。更可贵的是，它打破了"中国风=武侠"的刻板印象，用世界语言讲述东方内核。当全球玩家为"铜头铁臂"的打击感喝彩时，这已不仅是游戏的成功，更是文化软实力的胜利。 如果说遗憾，或许是叙事节奏偶尔被高强度Boss战打断，部分剧情隐喻过于晦涩。但这些瑕疵在游戏带来的震撼面前显得微不足道。《黑神话：悟空》就像其主角一样，以桀骜之姿劈开了中国3A游戏的天穹，它不仅是2024年的现象级作品，更将成为重新定义行业标准的传奇之作。

However, after this point Wukong becomes incredibly powerful, each boss turns into spamming all my powerful moves back to back (transformations, vessels, spirits) to get the boss down to half health with ease. Not to mention the boring exploration in-between, where all I long for is the next boss in my boss rush. (I literally started skipping all the enemies in the last 2 chapters as it served practically no purpose unless they were a blue spirit or guarding a chest. In addition, most of the late game skills you unlock lack any interest, and are not better than the ones I already have, in particular ring of fire and spell binder. Even the late game transformations none of them proved better than the first unlocked: Red Tides. Also none of the spirits unlocked later on interested me enough to change them for the one I kept throughout the entire game, Wandering Wight, the giant head you get near the start of Chapter 1! Even if something did interest me, I had already maxed out Wandering Wight by the end of Chapter 2 and the Defense buff and strength of it was just unbeatable. To close it all out the last 2 chapters were incredibly dull. Chapter 6 nearly had the worst map, second only to spiderland. I regret buying this game full price and do not understand how it was nominated for so many game awards.

Before saying anything, I fully finished the game (True ending) to post a fair review, and I dont understand the totally undeserved GOTY. The whole game has been a relentless rant and rage, but maybe because I finished Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree before playing BM:W... Lets do a pro / con about it : Pro: Cool settings: I was so hyped about the whole chinese mythology before starting the game... Nice animated cutscenes between chapters ... And thats about it, a really tried to find some good in it.. Cons (oh boy here we are): -This is NOT a soul-like. A soul-like implies that death is punishing, Black Myth: Wukong is an ADVENTURE GAME, a difficult, clunky one at best, but nonetheless an ADVENTURE GAME. The most bland talent tree / abilities (well maybe because in most AAA "SOUL-LIKES GAMES", you can actually customise your stats, skills and weapons (here, only 4 differents weapons to choose from, same moveset, only differents in bonuses / stats) Horrendrous crafting system.. Yep, you want a staff? Craft It ! You want another, craft ! You want the old one back ? C R A F T A G A I N. Yes you read it, If you want a previously crafted staff (in the same "category" as the one you currently has), you HAVE to craft it again. Boring combat system, the whole game revolves arround 3 different stances (talents to unlock). Clunky boss mechanics (arguably, some are really cool, other are strait up annoying) Rushed story ? I felt like chapter 1 and 2 were the longest ones, the other 4 were shorter and shorter.. Awful map design (even if the "chinese print" style is really cool, you really cant see where you are), there is no cardinal points to locate yourself. On top of these issues, sometimes you can jump down (water, other level area) and sometimes you are hitting an invisible wall (and there are LOTS of invisible walls...) Speaking of design, souls-like AAA games often have beautiful scenery, well, this game does NOT. Its like there is a chapter color theme (1st chapter green, second yellow, third white and so on...) that is really irritating. With few exceptions, I did not FEEL the chinese immortals / celestials beautifull landscapes... TL;DR : Buy it if you want a difficult ADVENTURE GAME, but if you are looking for a AAA Soul-like, stay away, far.. away. (even some AA Soul-likes have a nicer feel than this one).

Okay so where do i start with this one, without glazing too hard, black myth wukong is easily a 30/10 game, here's why: Positives: - Crisp and snappy tempo-based combat which makes you feel like a ??????? gamer - Great story and character development in the form of 6 chapters which each have their own distinct look, soundtrack, bosses, vibe, and lore with a beautiful cinematic at the end of each exploring the lore of the current/next chapter - No reusing of bosses (aka yaogai kings), mini-bosses (yaogai chiefs - watch out some of these are some of the most difficult ones), and normal NPCs makes everything feel fresh and keeps you engaged in learning the key moves of each of the enemies - Amazing visuals and graphics (like this thing definitely murders older computers but ???????? with a 4080 and OLED panel the visuals borderline reality its amazing) - Unique characters with distinct personalities and actually useful upgrades/feeling of progression (each time you upgrade or unlock a skill it changes the way you play in some cases drastically and can have a huge impact on your ability to take down a boss) - Various styles of playing the game (aside from the numerous different spells and their uses, armor sets, pills, gourds, drinks, curios, weapons, spirits and vessels; there are also 3 different fighting styles you can equip each with their unique playing styles and feeling which is fresh) - BEAUTIFUL MUSIC OH MY GOD - P.S. Wukong is easily the coolest video game character ever created (and yes I know he's authentic chinese lore) Some negatives are: - Certain shrines are too far away from bosses (only happens 1-2 times in the game but is still frustrating) - Bosses with invulnerability spells are just a huge pain - Can be frustrating to save a spell/mana for use at the end of a boss fight just for it to bug out or for you to be attacked and cancelled mid cast - Need to play NG+ to unlock enough levels to fully upgrade your character (not necessarily negative but worth mentioning) - THAT THERE ISN'T MORE WUKONG AND THAT THE GAME IS SHORT (it isn't) But yeah definitely worth playing still an amazing buy worth infinitely more than what you pay for. Will be playing new game plus hopefully when dlc is released or new game is announced. Do yourself a favour and pick this game up. Точно стоит ознакомиться с творчеством китайской студии, особенно учитывая, что перед нами — не очередная "гача". Что могу сказать: картинка шикарная, но из-за этого иногда были проблемы с восприятием локаций — сложно искать путь и ориентироваться (особенно в первой и второй главах). Боевая система хорошая, но не идеальная. Есть моменты, которые раздражают — например, отсутствие парирования и отмены атак. Очень много различной магии и способностей, вот тут прям всего навалом для любого стиля геймплея. Боссы - классные, есть пару супер душных и скучных. В целом всё круто, но заметен скачок сложности в конце глав. Это немного раздражает, хотя, возможно, дело в усталости после череды боев и желании поскорее добраться до финала. По сюжету и лору: честно говоря, я не особо вникал в происходящее и не вчитывался в диалоги. Все таки игра меня привлекала больше геймлеем чем нарративом. Отличный проект от Game Science, очень интересно посмотреть как студия будет развивать успех. P.S Игра не особо чилловая, чтобы отдыхать в ней после завода, но и ничего запредельно сложного в ней нет. Просто держите в голове, что уставшим за нее лучше не садиться.

Absolutely deserves Game of the Year- and was happy to learn that it actually DID win the award, rather than just deserving it. I don't think I've been more impressed playing through a game in recent memory as I was playing through this one- I'm no doubt going to be going through NG+ and NG++ and onward for no better reason than I just want to play the game more. The visuals are incredible, the story is fantastic, the action is FUN (more dodge-based than parry-based (because monkey)), the skill tree is well designed / each skill point feels meaningful, even the ones just boosting health/mana/stamina instead of expanding combat moves- the end of the game happened just as I was "completing" my build, had all skills fully upgraded that I actually used, plus the stat bonus nodes I wanted, so it feels exceptionally well timed / balanced in that regard. There are a couple of things to nitpick for sure / it's not a completely perfect game of course. For instance, there are some invisible walls in places you wouldn't expect them, and lacking in places where you're sure you can't traverse, but then it turns out you can. There's also an inconsistency with ledges- 99% of ledges you can't walk/jump off of at all, but there are spots where enemies can knock you over and end you in one shot. Most of the pagoda realm comes to mind there, but at least that's the whole area- there are trickier places through the game as well. In addition, the game probably didn't need "some items only dropped by farming certain enemy types" as a mechanic at all, and especially didn't need "items dropped from a boss only if certain conditions are met, like destroying 4 of their 8 arms" as a mechanic- doubly so because that mechanic only shows up once in the whole game AFAIK, so it's impossible to predict. There are so few permanently missable items in the game that the 3 or 4 that exist feel more frustrating than they should / more like bugs, which is perhaps a little unfair. All in all, exceptional game- I was impressed by Lies of P about a year earlier, which is a game of the same type, but this was overwhelmingly better, and will probably ruin similar games for quite awhile (Khazan is only the first to suffer from post-Wukong disappointment- though it's actually quite good, haha). A linear story game with distinctly progressing stages is not comparable to an "open world" game like Elden Ring, which has barely any storyline / makes you scrounge its few characters for bits of lore that exist, so there's very little to say there. They are both "difficult action RPG" style games, but if you were to try to compare them, you'd have to throw FF7 Rebirth in the ring too, and then things start getting silly, so I just won't. I consider this to absolutely be the apex of its particular game type- if you like Lies of P, like First Berserker Khazan, like Sekiro, and/or like the God of War series, you'll probably love Wukong. If you're just looking for another Souls game, it might have a bit too much story for you- if you're looking for a new Final Fantasy game, it's not really a novel in game form either, so might not be ENOUGH story for you.

I've only played for an hour, I'll admit, but I'm finding it hard to come back to this game... It reminds me on first playing of Elden Ring. Same nice graphics and interesting monsters - pointless little trash mobs you can kill easily to make you feel better when you get stomped by a boss. Similar vibes. Differences are that this isn't an open world. It's very linear. Also the bosses aren't as difficult as Elden Ring (or the Souls games in general). The combat here is... well, it's fine... I can't really condemn it since it doesn't do anything wrong but, at the same time, I can't laud it since it doesn't do anything wonderful either. You can spam light attack or charge up a heavy attack - we all know that drill. There's a dodge roll. There's a jump attack. There's stamina. Heard all this before? Me too... The art is wonderful - if you want a good looking Souls-like then it's this or Elden Ring. The link to Journey To The West is tenuous so far - Monkey King gets a squeezy headband to stop him winning a fight rather than as motivation to help a monk - but I don't suppose adherence to Chinese mythology is really why we're here. There are some light RPG mechanics in terms of levelling your monkey-a-like and a few spells that can change the flow of combat pretty significantly. Turning into defeated bosses and gaining their skills is a neat concept but it feels like my character is wussing out and calling someone else to spank the bad guys for him. Overall it's a good enough Souls-Like but I'm not sure it deserves quite as much praise as it's received. Still, it's pretty good, so it earns a half-hearted thumbs-up. I'll try to keep plugging at it but, so far, it's underwhelming.

Graphics and Sound The game looks absolutely beautiful. The visuals are top-notch, and the music and sound effects are just as impressive. Everything feels polished and high-quality in that department. Content There’s a lot to do here. The game offers 6 fairly long chapters, each packed with secrets and unique bosses. It definitely gives you a good amount of content for the price. Exploration Exploration is where things start to fall short. The world feels very limited—there are invisible walls everywhere, which makes it feel like you're being pushed down a single path instead of really discovering anything. There's not much rewarding to find either, except for some low-quality herbs and places to meditate. That said, each chapter does hide a big secret area, which is a nice surprise. But finding these areas isn’t always intuitive—you might miss them completely if playing blind without searching the internet. Combat Combat is the weakest part of the game. There’s no button queuing, so if you press an attack button before your current animation finishes, the input gets ignored. This makes fights feel clunky and unresponsive. Enemy attacks often have strong tracking, while your own attacks don’t. That means enemies can easily hit you, but if they move while you’re swinging, your attacks often miss. It makes combat feel more about luck than skill sometimes. Fighting normal enemies isn’t very exciting either—just charging a heavy attack before a fight is usually enough to take them out before they even get a hit in. Bosses Boss design is hit-or-miss. While they’re visually unique and creative, a lot of them are frustrating for the wrong reasons. Many main bosses have mechanics that feel cheap, like draining your stamina, messing with the camera, or blocking your vision. Instead of feeling like a fun challenge, these moments just come off as annoying. Overall Thoughts The game isn’t bad, but it’s definitely overrated and overhyped. 《黑神话：悟空》深度测评：东方神话的工业化觉醒与文化自信的全球共鸣 一、技术革命：从像素到影视级的视觉进化 《黑神话：悟空》以虚幻引擎 5 为基石，重构了一个令人窒息的东方神话宇宙。游戏科学耗时五年研发的 "悟空引擎"，首次实现了全场景纳米级细节渲染—— 黑风山的溪流能清晰倒映出角色的每根毛发，黄风岭的沙粒在阳光下呈现出琥珀般的光泽，小西天的雷音寺金箔装饰甚至能反射出玩家的动态身影。光影系统采用全局光照 + 光线追踪 + 体积云三重技术叠加，佛光普照时的丁达尔效应、水面反射的动态光影，让玩家仿佛置身于敦煌壁画的流动画卷中。 在硬件适配层面，游戏展现出惊人的兼容性。即使使用 GTX 1060 显卡，通过 FSR 3.0 或 DLSS 3.5 技术，仍可在 1080P 分辨率下稳定 60 帧；而 RTX 4090 搭配 4K 分辨率和光线追踪超高设置时，玩家能体验到每帧 8 亿条光线追踪的极致真实 —— 金箍棒挥舞时的残影、火焰山岩浆的流动轨迹，都达到了电影级的物理模拟精度。2025 年 2 月推出的 1.0.14 版本，更引入试验性的NXSR 超分辨率技术，在保留艺术风格的同时，将画面锐度提升 30%，为中端显卡用户带来意外惊喜。 二、战斗哲学：棍法与法术的交响诗篇 游戏的核心战斗系统以 "棍势" 为灵魂，融合中国武术的刚柔并济。三种棍法架势（劈棍、立棍、戳棍）对应不同战斗风格：劈棍如开山巨斧，适合正面强攻；立棍似灵蛇出洞，可规避地面伤害；戳棍若离弦之箭，擅长远程突袭。战斗中，玩家通过轻重攻击的组合积累 "如意棒" 资源，再以重攻击释放毁天灭地的连招 —— 如 "棍影千重" 可瞬间打出七连击，"定海千钧" 能将敌人轰入地面形成冲击波。 法术系统进一步拓展了战斗维度。定身术可冻结敌人行动，铜头铁臂能免疫物理伤害，而身外化身更能召唤分身协同作战。变身系统的设计堪称神来之笔：化身为赤尻马猴时，可使用虎爪撕裂敌人；变身为鱼妖时，能在水中自由穿梭并发动突袭。2025 年 4 月推出的 DLC"大闹天宫"，更新增法天象地（巨型化变身）、筋斗云（空中连段）等大圣专属技能，让玩家体验一棍荡平十万天兵的爽快感。 三、叙事解构：重构西游的哲学思辨 游戏剧情围绕 "天命人" 重走西行路展开，对《西游记》进行了大胆的现代解构。原著中的妖魔鬼怪被赋予复杂人性：白骨精不再是单纯的反派，而是试图通过修炼摆脱宿命的悲剧角色；红孩儿也不再是顽劣孩童，而是被权力欲望扭曲的悲剧少年。这种叙事手法让玩家在战斗之外，感受到更深层次的哲学思考 —— 如黄风怪与黄风岭老鼠的纠葛，隐喻了 "强者制定规则" 的残酷现实。 章节间的过渡动画堪称艺术典范。游戏科学采用手绘、木偶戏、吉卜力等多种风格，讲述了《西游记》原著之外的支线故事。例如用皮影戏风格呈现的《人参果》篇章，以简洁的线条和浓烈的色彩，重现了镇元大仙与孙悟空的纠葛；而火焰山的过场动画，则通过水墨动画与三维渲染的结合，展现了 "罗刹女借芭蕉扇" 的史诗感。这些间章动画不仅承担叙事功能，更像是独立的艺术短片，让玩家在紧张战斗间隙获得审美享受。 四、文化输出：从游戏到文明的跨界对话 《黑神话：悟空》的成功不仅在于游戏品质，更在于其文化影响力。游戏中 36 处场景原型来自山西古建筑，包括五台山佛光寺、应县木塔等，这些细节引发了玩家对中国传统文化的自发探索。山西省文旅厅顺势推出 "跟着悟空游山西" 的旅游线路，将虚拟场景转化为现实文旅资源，2024 年相关旅游收入突破 12 亿元。在海外市场，游戏中的 "Yao Guai""Loong" 等拼音直译词汇，打破了西方对中国神话的刻板印象，成为文化自信的直观体现。 音乐设计同样彰显文化底蕴。游戏配乐融合三弦、二胡等传统乐器，战斗时激昂的鼓点与陕北说书的唱腔交织，营造出独特的东方战斗美学。当《云宫迅音》的旋律在特定场景响起时，不仅唤起了中国玩家的集体记忆，也让外国玩家感受到了《西游记》的文化魅力。原声带在 Spotify 播放量突破 1 亿次，成为现象级音乐 IP。 五、产业突破：国产 3A 的里程碑意义 《黑神话：悟空》的商业成功创造了历史：全球销量突破 2800 万份，销售额达 90 亿元，成为国产买断制游戏销量冠军；在 Steam 平台同时在线峰值突破 220 万人，超越《赛博朋克 2077》等国际大作。其文化影响力更是跨次元蔓延：人民日报推出同名说唱视频播放量近 200 万，山西省推出的 "悟空 + 文创" 产品年销售额破 6 亿元，哈佛大学与游戏科学合作开展古建数字化保护项目。 在技术层面，游戏科学研发的 "悟空引擎" 已开源部分技术，为国产游戏工业化提供了可复用的解决方案。战斗系统中的 "动态难度" 机制（敌人会根据玩家攻击频率调整战术）、"受击反馈" 系统（物理引擎模拟真实受伤反应），被多家国际厂商借鉴。2024 年 TGA 颁奖典礼上，《黑神话：悟空》斩获 "最佳动作游戏" 和 "玩家之声" 两项大奖，成为首款入围年度最佳的国产游戏，标志着中国游戏产业正式跻身全球第一梯队。 结语：当东方美学遇见工业文明 《黑神话：悟空》的出现，不仅是国产游戏的技术突破，更是文化自信的全球宣言。它证明了传统文化与现代游戏工业的深度融合具有无限可能，也为国产游戏的国际化之路提供了新范式。正如游戏中的台词所言："大圣此去欲何？踏南天，碎凌霄。若一去不回？便一去不回！" ?? BLACK MYTH: WUKONG – From the Staff of the Monkey King Himself ?? THE BATTLES – BEAUTIFUL, BRUTAL, AND A LITTLE SADISTIC Let us speak first of combat, for it is the way of warriors. The battles in Black Myth: Wukong are divine in motion—each strike sings like a poem. The bosses? Oh, the bosses... They do not fight fair. They don’t just want your health bar—they want your pride, your controller, and your will to continue. One minute you're dancing through attacks like a legend, the next you’re face-first in the dirt wondering how that frog just backflipped you into oblivion. ?????? But it’s not unfair. It’s unforgiving. The combat demands discipline. Focus. Inner peace. …which I lack. ?? THE MAP – A BEAUTIFUL MESS There is a map. Allegedly. But even with all my divine perception, monkey agility, and ancient wisdom—I get lost. Constantly. Repeatedly. With great frustration. It looks like a scroll painted by a drunk calligrapher during an earthquake. Is this a path? Is it a wall? Am I upside down? Am I inside a mountain again? ?? The environments are jaw-droppingly gorgeous—misty mountains, cursed temples, burning heavens—but without a functional way to orient yourself, every journey becomes a riddle. One you solve by... running in circles. ?? THE STORY – A LEGEND RETOLD WITH MAJESTY Now here is where the game truly ascends. The tale of the Monkey King is one of the most iconic legends in Chinese mythology—and Black Myth: Wukong handles it with both reverence and flair. It doesn’t just tell a story—it sings it, with operatic gravitas and cinematic beauty. The narrative dances between dream and memory, philosophy and action. It captures the weight of destiny, the burden of power, the price of freedom. And it does so with haunting voice work, beautiful cutscenes, and rich world-building. If you're a fan of myth, drama, and the eternal clash between heaven and earth—this game delivers a tale worth carving into stone. ?? THE PRESENTATION – DIVINE CRAFTSMANSHIP Visually, Black Myth: Wukong is a masterpiece. Every frame could be a painting. The fur on my divine arms sways with the wind like bamboo in a storm. The particle effects shimmer like magic. The lighting breathes life into every valley, dungeon, and battlefield. The sound design? Chef’s kiss. From the thunderous roar of a demon boss to the distant chimes of a temple bell, every note adds texture to the world. It’s an immersive, sensory-rich experience worthy of gods and gamers alike. ?? THE VERDICT – A GAME FOR LEGENDS (AND MASOCHISTS) Black Myth: Wukong is not a game for the faint of heart. It is hard. Unapologetically so. It challenges you to master it, to grow, to adapt. And when you finally do? The victory is so much sweeter. But it stumbles in the places where it matters too: clarity of direction, accessibility in exploration, and occasionally, that one boss who clearly trained at the “Dark Souls School of No Mercy.” Yet despite that—despite my frustration, my many deaths, my screaming at the heavens—it has earned my respect. ?? FINAL JUDGEMENT: 8.7/10 – A divine, punishing, mythic adventure that crushes your spirit and lifts your soul—sometimes both in the same minute. Buy it. Play it. Die a hundred times. Be reborn. And never trust the map.

Well, i had been looking forward to play this game since it was out but for one or another reason, i hadnt had the chance until just recently, to start with, i already finished the game just a moment ago and i do have a lot to say about this game, both good, mid and bad, so let me get out of my chest my experience with this mythical journey to the west. To start with this game its absolutly gorgeous, graphically speaking its an impressive piece of art, i cant say ANYTHING bad about this part, the locals are beautiful, the textures except for an every now and then slight slow load are crisp and catchy, you could spend hours just going trought each local and get inmersed on the looks alone, this is one of the few games that had made me stop to play and just lose miself on where im at. Characters are so varied, weird, odd, cool, disgusting and so on thats its quite impressive, you wont get two enemies that will be exactly the same, just like with the grafics you could lose yourself just looking at every enemy and probably spend a great deal admiring the work that was put on each one of them. The story its just a bit hard to follow at moments, but still conveis where its going, where it came from, and where will it be. It would have been great to have some sort of small movie or quick summary of the previous work of it, journey to the west to get more context, but still its easy to want to know more and more about the overal setting, if anything this game has made me look for some videos about the original work to know more. Combat and gameplay tough, are a mixed bag for a lot of reasons. Spells, abilities and other goodies: on this part i cant have any particular complain on whats been done, you have access to SO many diferent power ups, spells, transformation and what not that definitly you will find an style specially tailored for your way of playing, the fact you can re spec all your points its wonderfull becase that lets you test out many things without fear, making it not a "well you are locked on this" type of game, this one its one of the best aspects of the skills on the game, freedom to test out as much as you want. Combat tought its another complete situation. For a game that seems to try to be a "souls like" with hard bosses, long string boss combos, enviromental atacks, and thigs of that nature, the gameplay can go from absolutly adrenaline pumping, to absolutly frustrating for the incorrect reasons. DODGE This one its frustrating for many reasons, altought the perfect dodge definitly can give you a great advantage againts certain enemies, the fact that also its not exactly reliable can become a source of absolut frustration. There will be many, MANY times where you will press the button to dodge...and nothing will happen, which in turn will lead you to more free hits from your enemy and even to lenghty stunlocks you can get out in no way, at least non that i have been able to find while trying to dodge, use cloud step or other powers, if you are on the receiving end of a stunlock atack you are screwed, this toppled with the fact that as previously stated, the dodge sometimes just doesnt seem to want to work will make you want to throw your controller more than one time, screaming at the screen to "dodge dang it!". I have tried several times to perfect dodge, learn paterns and other techniques any souls player its used to, but unlike in most souls games, here the dodge again its odd, it will not always work, this is something that IF theres a sequel/prequel needs to be heavily addressed, specially on game that its trying both to be a souls like, and hack and slash. COMBOS Aside from the fact that sadly the main combo has little variations aside from the special stances atacks, and a couple of weapons, you wil lbe stuck with the same combo trought the entire game with almost no variation. I wish that just like with some of the transformations, the special/hard attack would have changed depending on what point of the combo you did it, that would ahve given the game such a fantastic variation, specially if each stance would change your base combo making it much more dinamic when you chance stances. The BIG problem i do have with the overal combo tough its that you are soft locked on anymations A LOT. Given how unforgiving the game can be at times, you will be many times instead of tyring to make cool long stringed combos, just taping the button once or twice, dodge two or three times, rinse and repeat, this gets somewhat boring specially with those bosses that are just unfun to fight againts, and oh boy, are there quite a lot of those torught the game. Hopefully this could be addressed on a potential new game, specially with the long animations of multiple hits that just take to much time and dont feel quite good to be locked on to. BOSSES This one its an absolute mix of fantastic, fun enjoyable fights, and absolutly horrid frustrating bosses. While at the start was somewhat frustrating having to deal with your very first spirit and transformation, after starting to get used to the rythm of the dodge and how punishing the dodge can be, the first bosses from here dont feel that bad, they are challenging but still feel good ro fight againts, i understand that the developers where going for a very cinematic experience, but theres moments where you are on aw about what you are looking at, and at other moments havint that you cant se anything on the screen or simply the enemy its moving and doing so much stuff that you can lose track of what the heck its happening. Just as an start, the second chapter last boss was infuriating me to no end, mostly because of the disgusting tornados on the last part of the fight, they get so abslurdly obnoxious that if you dont have "that" item, its almost impossible to defeat this boss, and with that he jsut becomes a painfull chore that stops being fun after the 15 time you are cheated out of your victory because of those tornados, other bosses are on the same boat of other reasons. The other ones that have phases, specially the ones where they keep flying all over the place spaming the screen with lots of things grow boring rather fast, you are just going all over the place waiting for them to finish their animations, just to chase them around, smack them a bit then hate when they go flying around all over again. Some of the transitions are just not fun, cinematic? absolutly, fun? not in the slightest, specially when those boss fights end taking way longer that you would wish and they feel like a chore. Overall i seriously like game, i really do. Aside from the things i have shared here most of time it was a great fun experience, but those things i shared right now soured my gameplay more than once, actually at times making me just close the game to prevent more frustration that just made me feel cheated out of victories, or taht i was just being bullied and punished unecesarily by the game itself. I will still play the game some more on new game +, i do want to try more stuff and hopefully now that i know what i have ahead my experience might be hopefully better on those places where i was just hating the game. I do really hope that theres more games from this franchise to enjoy more of the monkey king. Ramblings aside, my personal score for this game its a very solid 8.5/10. Its a wonderfull game, but it do has some flaring issues that lower the score some, i would still recommend this game to any souls/hack and slash avid player, but just keep in mind that you might have some sore spots trought your journey.

期待了3年的游戏，果然不负众望。整体质量相当高，沉浸玩了半年多。体验很棒，就是我梦里的中国游戏。 比之欧美日韩3A，只高不低。有一种二十年前中国影视剧的浪漫 ，字词间全是传统文化的流淌。这个别的国家人应该很难懂。音乐更是顶级，特别在第六关上峰回路，女声一阵清吟。恍惚间再回花果山，已是注定的命运。画面也是顶级，小西天的雪山视觉超棒，黄风岭有西出阳关的味。黑风山也不错，就是太黑了，看不太清楚。游戏的操作性拉满，三棍合一上限高，各种变身，精魄，下限也低，新手也能体验。操作跟手，偶尔有图略掉帧，可能是优化跟不上。综合9分。
风景很好，就像旅游。毕竟我去过四川和山西的大部分地方，悟空第一二章的场景许多可以说是一比一复刻现实，让人能够回忆起曾经游览过的山川湖海。
身临其境的背景音乐，近乎完美的战斗手感，灵活自由的成长风格，还有那让每个中国人都倍感传奇的故事内核。对于这款产品，我给满分，并且我想说，这款产品，我们不需要地球上的所有人都喜欢，因为，这是游戏科学给与每一个中国电子游戏玩家的一份大礼，是施耐庵留给我们的一份大礼，也是孙大圣留给我们所有中国人的一份大礼。
集齐大圣六根，六根即为六识，但佛教有八识，大圣的执念，为莫那识，而直面天命的玩家，再入轮回，带着记忆，再启周目，为阿赖耶识。 至此，八识圆满。

TLDR: Buy Black Myth: Wukong (BMW), it will not disappoint, it is 10/10 recommended by me with 260 hours of play time! I played games such as Devil May Cry and God of War on console and computer before. However, I played mostly FPS and MOBA games in the past decade. These games are fun and all but I was waiting for a long time for a different game; a game like BMW because not only it was ambitious to use unreal engine 5 but it also wanted to tell a story deeply rooted in Chinese mythology. In my opinion, in 2024 there were a lot of single player games that couldn't pass the bar for captivating story telling that people flocked to. Or in some cases, it was because the game being released had issues from the get-go. But thankfully these developer's first game was a huge success and payed off! Although they had a huge story to tell, they condensed it down and delivered something unique to the world to experience. I never played souls-like games before either. I had it in my mind that souls-like games were not for me but this game changed my mind after watching others play it and seeing how beautiful it looked. I also don't usually 100% games to completion, but for this game, I completed it fully and played it many times over. I bought it at full price not long after it was released. Yes, it was difficult at first but you adapt and learn just like anything else. If you take the time to explore, be patient, and find all its secrets, you'll be well rewarded to face the challenges that lie ahead. The game will become easier as you gather new skills, spells, and transformations. You will have many options at your disposal, even so much so that you can trivialise all the "hardest" bosses. After playing this game, I discovered Lies of P, and I'm glad I did. I'm now off to try all those other souls-like games. BMW, is no where near as hard as Lies of P or the other souls-like games though. So if you're completely new to a game like this, you'll be fine, just a bit of a learning curve, but you'll be totally fine. It's a straight forward game without any wasted time consuming content too. No offense, Assassin's Creed. In addition, a lot of people may complain about invisible walls, how the character is mute, or it lacks an open world experience. I honestly would not have wanted an open world experience because that would have wasted more time away from the story than it should. Wukong is better off mute because it's you who's playing as Wukong, you're the chosen one, it's your inner monologue that is to experience this black myth. Remember, it's unreal engine 5 too and it's graphically demanding, especially at 1440p and 4k. So if there were not boundaries, I doubt the game could run any better with all the bells and whistles with how gorgeously stunning it already is with all its fidelity to this Chinese mythology. Another worth while mention is how some people don't understand the story as it can be vague or unbeknown to someone who is not aware of who and what Wukong is from Chinese mythology. But you can easily figure that out afterwards and dive deep into the lore. For example, everyone knows God of War and western culture is very familiar with Greek and Norse mythology. I think BMW has taken another huge step forward, with this regard, to deliver exceptional story telling that previous games like God of War has done. There's is a reason why God of War is so well received. People truly value good story telling and sometimes that can come from mythology from stories told before, told differently, or told new. Although I played Lies of P after the release of BMW, I was shocked at how a children's fairy tale can be told so well despite some obvious changes in Lies of P. It's a shame that BMW could not have been game of the year for 2024. Say what you will, but eastern gaming developers are up to fantastic games that remind me of much older games - mediocre graphics maybe but the stories they tell are just top notch, say for example Final Fantasy 7. I could go on and on, but I digress, bottom line: buy BMW, it will not disappoint, it is 10/10 recommended by me with 260 hours of play time!

我去过那么多城堡地牢，见过那么多国王骑士，杀过那么多恶龙地精，学过那么多剑与魔法。 可那些栩栩如生的故事终究来自遥远的另一个世界，我的城市没有中世纪的城堡。 如今我终于可以访道观佛堂，见佛陀神仙，探荒村野岭，杀天兵神将，斩妖除魔，学奇术变化。 当神话中的那些翻云覆雨、法力无边的角色突然变成我切实要面对的敌人，我才意识到九九八十一难到底有多难。 我记得当我第一次踏入小雷音寺，背景音里的诵经梵音让我瞬间回到记忆深处无数个香火萦绕的寺庙。 原来这就是没有乡愁的冒险。
170小时，靠赖皮控制法打完四周目大圣，这应该是我这个手残党的极限了，实在没有信心打五周目大圣了，四周目的大圣居然比二郎神强这么多。

《黑神话：悟空》不仅是一场视听盛宴，更是一次关于存在的哲学叩问。110小时的跋涉中，我目睹的不是传统西游的忠义叙事，而是一尊被命运齿轮碾碎的英雄图腾。金箍棒挥出的每一道残影都在撕裂神话的糖衣，那些被三界刻意遗忘的尸山血海，在虚幻5引擎的粒子风暴中化作漫天金箔——所谓斗战胜佛，不过是困在轮回矩阵里的404错误。 战斗系统是青铜器般的艺术，粗粝而精密，每一场BOSS战都在解构东方魔幻的美学。当大圣残魂留下最后一行足迹时，我忽然读懂游戏真正的野心：它用动作游戏的皮囊包裹着存在主义的果核，那些被紧箍咒勒进骨血的嘶吼，何尝不是每个现代人精神困局的镜像？白骨之后，重走西游，这次我们终于不必仰望云端的神佛，只需直面自己灵魂深处的五指山。 浅见拙评或有不当，欢迎交流、指正。

逛展后有感。 在那些被嘲讽“手游氪金厂养不起单机梦”的日子里，有人硬是把《西游记》的残页塞进虚幻5引擎的代码夹缝中，让炼丹炉的铜绿在精美的贴图上重生。 但回顾整个观展过程除了对于展品精美的赞叹外，内心并没有太多波澜。离场时远处保安嘟囔着“闭馆了”，声调起伏竟像游戏里土地公的吟唱，那一刻我像是明白了这种平静：真正的里程碑从来不是破开天穹的巨响，而是所有后来者低头系鞋带时，鞋面上早已沾满的洒在花果山上的星辰碎屑；那些曾让我心驰神往的西游之行，早就在千百个国产游戏的尸骸上生长了十数年；黑神话从来不是横空出世的劫火，而是紫金冠里暗藏的、锈了五百年的血。 而中国游戏的崛起已是必然！

核显通关的，本人有些小菜，现在玩到第四周目快结束了，但是电脑实在是不堪重负了，等以后换新电脑了再玩。黑猴是我玩的第一款动作单机游戏，他在我心目中的地位和荒野大镖客2不相上下，黑猴可以说是一款近乎完美的游戏，极致的优化，超高水准的美术和建模，几乎完美的闪避反馈，几近完美的识破机制、切手技，让我乐此不疲。 变身系统同样也是黑猴的一大特色，当初拿到广智还高兴了好久，尽管之后被幽魂拜了好几次早年。广智在我获得石猿之前一直是没换过的，在生命危急时刻大喊一句“广智救我”何尝不是一种热血澎湃呢。小黄龙对我来说太难操作了，尽管三千阳春伤害特别高。赤尻马猴也是值得尝试的变身之一，配合隼居士也可以打出爆炸伤害（不建议配合无量蝠）；石猿没话说，花果山第一肘击王，妥妥t0.5的变身；寅虎，马哥其他热门的还没试过，但是看其他up主玩的观赏性和娱乐性都挺好。 众多神装中，我最喜欢牛牛套和行者套，唯一的缺点是牛牛套只能在二周目完全体验。行者套不仅颜值高，而且还是跑图的好帮手，移速加成挺好用的，实用性和颜值并存。武器中我最爱混铁棍和三尖两刃枪了，混铁不用说，但是谁又能拒绝一把会发射飞剑的枪呢。 最后我想说，游科给了我当大圣的一个机会，尽管我只是一只小小的猴子，但在大圣套装集齐的那一刻，我又何尝不是大圣呢？在当今的中国游戏市场上，悟空的形象遍布各处，可是仅有黑猴完美诠释了什么是真正的大圣，什么才是真正的悟空。猴哥，永远是我心目中第一的超级英雄。

本作的最大长版是其美术.遮天的黄沙、茫茫的雪海、高耸的庙宇亦或是清幽的道观.本作的视觉风格丰富到奢侈,同时又在每一个细微角落保证了最大的还原.当我行走其中,不时就会驻足下来,细细观摩.而游科也在每一章都设置了些风景点,在紧张的战斗之余,静下心来观赏风光. 或许是美丽的烦恼吧,本作的视觉风格过于统一,以至于时常会分不清哪条是主路,哪里又是空气墙.不过好在游戏内置了一系列精美的地图,虽然不能解决问题,但不至太过影响体验 本作每章都有几个大boss和十几个中boss,并且每位都有其独特的战斗设计.甚至在本作的连战系统中,还额外增添了新的招式和AI.可谓是量大管饱. 而本作的战斗非常有趣,是一套以法术、装备、精魄和棍法等多项构筑来主动应敌的设计.避火罩应三昧火、猴子孙把光线引、舞动风沙难抵定风宝珠,刀枪不停正好铜头来顶,颇有种小说里你来我往的神仙斗法之感.不过遗憾的是这样一套有趣的玩法在一周目没有完全展开,不少boss都还没完全明白招就打过了. 最后,争议最大的剧情部分.本作依靠独立成章又偶有牵连的影神图和每章结尾的精美动画,构建了一个十分生动的黑暗世界观.并且其对每章boss的塑造都令人印象深刻.同时,它对孙悟空的塑造虽然只有寥寥几笔,但却抓住了其最重要的一点--正义性.以肉身之死换意念永存,在这个吃人不吐骨的世界之中,他仍是那个敢于打倒凌霄宝殿的盖世英雄.这是我心中最棒的,对孙悟空这一角色的现代化诠释

《黑神话：悟空》是一场令人震撼的东方美学盛宴。作为《西游记》的深度重构之作，它以虚幻引擎 5 的极致表现力，将山西隰县小西天、晋城玉皇庙等古迹实景扫描融入场景设计，云雾缭绕的山峦与斑驳的石窟壁画构成流动的水墨长卷。角色设计更将传统元素与现代审美精妙融合，如刀狼教头广智的狼妖外形搭配中式襦裙，既保留原著野性又赋予独特魅力。 对抗机制的策略深度令人称道。轻重棍法的节奏把控、五行元素的相生相克，在 “灵虚子” 的瞬移召唤与 “赤髯龙” 的水雷博弈中展现得淋漓尽致。动态难度调节系统独具匠心 —— 新手可通过精准闪避触发反击，高玩则能挑战 “禁字诀” 极限，这种包容性设计让不同水平玩家均能沉浸其中。 这款游戏的价值远超娱乐范畴。它以全球销量突破 2000 万份的成绩，打破国产游戏 “氪金手游” 的刻板印象，更通过 “六根清净” 哲学、善恶立场的多元叙事，让海外玩家自发研读《西游记》。当意大利主播为 “七十二变” 惊叹，当陕北说书被称作 “中国摇滚”，游戏已成为文化输出的先锋。 尽管部分场景存在导航缺失问题，但瑕不掩瑜。《黑神话：悟空》以七年磨一剑的匠心，在技术、艺术与文化的三重维度上树立标杆，它不仅是国产 3A 的里程碑，更是一场跨越时空的精神对话。
从2020年8月20号到现在，近五年的期待终于变为现实，纵然游戏还有一些问题，但是绝对是一个水准之上的3A大作，游科好样的

After 72 hours i can say it was easily one of the harder games i have played. The frustration and anger turned into genuine learning with each victory. "get good" is seriously the only advice i can give when fighting these bosses as the guides online vary with different styles of gaming. Pick one that is most comfortable to you and perfect it. There are bosses that will want you to hit your head against a wall (ESPECIALLY THE ENDING) but that sigh of relief after each grueling triumph was always worth it. Overall, the game is a beautiful rendition of Journey to the West with breathtaking artwork and character designs. The story is easy enough to get a basic understanding of what is happening (anything deeper, i recommend youtubing a lore video) and forces you to learn patience quickly. There are a few game mechanics that are quite frustrating like 15 hit combos by the enemy and endless dodging making a fight longer than it should be. Or some maps require excessive walking with no interaction but to see the sights while others are jam packed and sometimes overwhelming/confusing navigating the landscape. This is of course subjective with my sense of direction haha. At the end of the game, you are encouraged to play through again so replayability is high and rewarding as you work for the best gear in the game. I would recommend this to any Dark Souls enthusiasts/players along with those experienced in intense gameplay. This gem of a game is worth it!

作为首款以中华文化为背景的3A级动作游戏，《黑神话：悟空》带给我的体验远超预期。游戏科学用顶尖的技术与深厚的文化底蕴，打造了一个瑰丽磅礴的神话世界，让我这个第一次接触国产3A大作的玩家感到无比自豪。 令人沉醉的故事与主题 游戏以《西游记》为蓝本，却又不拘泥于传统叙事，通过独特的视角重新诠释了悟空的命运与挣扎。剧情深邃而富有哲思，角色塑造饱满，尤其是对神佛妖魔的刻画，既保留了古典韵味，又赋予了现代解读。每一段过场动画都像在欣赏一部史诗级电影，令人回味无穷。 硬核而富有成就感的战斗体验 作为一款魂类游戏，《黑神话：悟空》在操作和技巧上的要求极高。200多小时的游玩让我深刻体会到，每一次精准闪避、每一次完美格挡都能带来无与伦比的成就感。棍术的变化多端、法宝的巧妙运用，以及不同神通技能的搭配，让战斗充满策略性。虽然部分Boss战让我卡关许久（比如某个会分身的BOSS打了整整一晚上），但最终战胜它们时的畅快感，绝对是游戏最迷人的部分。 中华美学的极致呈现 从白雪皑皑的山巅到幽深诡谲的妖洞，每一处场景都充满东方韵味。细节之处更是令人惊叹——古建筑的雕梁画栋、妖怪的造型设计、甚至背景中的诗词吟唱，无不彰显制作团队对中华文化的深刻理解与热爱。 小白玩家的真诚建议 尽管游戏品质无可挑剔，但对于像我这样的“手残党”来说，某些关卡和Boss的难度确实过高。虽然硬核体验是魂类游戏的特色，但如果能加入难度调节选项（比如简单的“休闲模式”），或许能让更多玩家沉浸在这个精彩的故事中，而不至于因挫败感放弃。 总结：国产游戏的里程碑之作 《黑神话：悟空》不仅是一款游戏，更是一次文化盛宴。它证明了国产游戏也能达到世界级水准，甚至在某些方面超越海外大作。虽然难度上有些“劝退”，但它的魅力足以让人坚持到底。衷心希望游戏科学能继续推出更多这样的精品，让全球玩家领略中华文化的博大精深！ 评分：9.5/10 （扣0.5分是因为我真的很想要个简单模式……） ——一位被打哭但依然热爱它的玩家

说一说我的故事吧 今年十八有余，从小看四大名著和上美厂的动画长大的，什么《大闹天宫》《哪吒闹海》《宝莲灯》《黑猫警长》等等都是我的童年 小时候都是在爱奇艺优酷上看别人玩所谓的“3A大作”，那个时候的我并不知道什么是3A我只知道画面很真实，玩法很丰富 我记得我看的第一个游戏是gta5，当时给我幼小的心灵造成了极大震撼，抢车，用枪打人，飙车，还有真实的世界 当天立马用我爸手机搜索“侠盗猎车手手机版”，当时出来的是圣安地列斯，安装好了之后打开游戏 “等等，这个在过安检的黑人是谁？这怎么一点都不真实” 接着去浏览器搜索才知道原来gta不止有一部（我看的5）还有前作，后面甚至去了解了R星发家史（哭笑） 接着就把三部曲手机版玩了一遍又一遍，身边的同学都说我怎么不下个王者跟他们一起玩，自己玩多没意思啊 我说我不喜欢玩这类型的游戏，自己玩挺好的 不知道为什么我从小就对单机游戏有一种莫名的热爱，就是那种等我长大了我也一定要玩到的决心 即便我是看着我舅打LOL长大的我也不感兴趣 后面也陆陆续续看了很多游戏，像cod，荣耀战魂（烈火行军CG里的关公太帅了）战地，蜘蛛侠，巫师，战神，只狼，泰坦陨落............... 说实话，那个时候真的感觉自己每天挺开心的放学写完作业吃饭的时候拿爸妈手机看单机游戏实况，吃完饭了再去SA（圣安地列斯）里飙飙车，但是还是感觉还差点感觉，少了一个最熟悉又最陌生的东西-------中国元素 当时我就纳闷我们中国没有所谓的“3A”吗？我们自己做的很真实又有普通话的“3A”，但是很遗憾，并没有，更多的是网游，我就在想我什么时候才能玩上我们自己做的“3A'呢 15年的时候有一部动画电影叫《大圣归来》动画开场大圣坐在山崖上那红披风看着比混天绫还长，还有后面从耳朵里拔出如意金箍棒的时候，什么叫做齐天大圣啊，这他妈就是 后面也玩了肉鸽和类手游死亡细胞（当时还以为是国产玩的老欢了)，暖雪，勇敢的哈克还有类魂帕斯卡契约(通关之后去了解才这个是国产的，非常震惊) 2020年8月20日下午一点我在逛b站一个叫做“游戏科学新作《黑神话：悟空》13分钟实机演示”的视频出现在我的首页上，当时还以为游科是个外国公司（哭笑），中国的东西又要拿去被外国人做成游戏，本来不想看的，但是这播放量还挺高的，出于好奇我就点进去看，视频开场就是一股陈厚的声音说出那段让我一生难忘的话和画面： “你们一定都听说过关于他的故事” “有人说，他帮唐僧取到了真经，封了斗战胜佛，从此留在了灵山” “也有人说，那个成佛的根本不是他，真正的他早就死在了西行路上” “还有人说，西游从来没有发生过，他只不过是说书人杜撰的一只——————猴子” “但我要讲的故事，你们一定没有听说过” “这个故事，得从一只金蝉说起” 老猴子，金蝉，树林，寺庙，狼妖，棍花挡箭，刀狼教头（广智），破坏场景，铜头铁臂，赤潮，大头，土地公公 土地公公那句：“像，真像啊。”这个时候我就知道玩家操控的不是大圣而是一只无名的猴子 接着就是大战灵虚子，变广智，火烧灵虚子身上的毛 当天命人要杀还剩一口气的灵虚子的时候，一支棍棒挡在了天命人的棍棒下 接着镜头慢慢上移到那棍棒上 棍棒上的字也随着金光一个一个显现出来 如——意——金——箍——棒 接着就是大圣出现在屏幕上，当时弹幕全是“参见大圣” 接着一道白光闪过 更多的画面出现在屏幕上 印象最深的就是四大天王，筋斗云，大闹天宫 接着随着劈棍重重落下屏幕上缓缓显示出了两个大字 “悟空” 我的眼泪哗啦一下就似瀑布一般喷涌而出，这次不是英语，是普通话，是他妈的普通话啊啊啊啊啊啊啊 这种感觉太爽了就好像独自一人在国外留学听到普通话一样 我这时候就知道这只四百多年前的猴子就是我们的第一部“3A大作” 虽然没有电脑但是我也在网上找教程在21年注册了steam，e宝账号（注册不到两周就送死亡搁浅，太爽了哈哈哈） 后面游科这个“年更博主”一年发一个宣传片 但是这时候网上出现了很多质疑的声音，说什么褒姒的，骗赞助的 我并没有理这些言论而是把宣传片看了一遍又一遍 其实我也怕，但是越怕越要看，因为他不是别人，他是大圣，他陪伴了我整个童年至现在 2023年8月20日游科亲自打破了这些质疑 随着线下试玩会结束 网友的称赞也是琳琅满目，应接不暇 我悬着的心也落了下来 2024年6月8日游戏开始了预售 当时没钱买，但是我也发自内心的开心 在发售前几天开启了预下载 2024年8月16日媒体评分出炉 10分 10分 9分 褒不姒的 2024年8月20日游戏正式发售 接下来的几个月几乎全网都在玩黑猴，央视也报道 我没有电脑，我也不想看实况，我就忍着继续看宣传片解馋 今年满十八了，自己出了一半钱父亲出了一半钱买了电脑 电脑一到我就跟着网上验机，烤机，接着下steam，3月1日买下了黑猴豪华版，用校园网下载凌晨才下好 随着大圣出现在16寸的屏幕上我瞬间就绷不住了，眼泪直流 二郎神，天兵天将，四大天王 那天直接干到凌晨眼泪也哭干了 现在也玩了也有一百多个小时了,进入二周目了 说一下我的感受吧： 作为我的第一款大型单机他绝对是NO.1 因为后期更新原因有了地图对于我来说不用迷路是好事 对于空气墙我还是可以接受的 难度适中 最难绷的boss就是魔将莲眼，太他妈粪了，后面变石头才挡伤害才过的 玩完第五章得知大圣死的时候我还是不相信的 当我回到花果山进水帘洞看到金箍棒的时候，它就这么立在那 把大圣套一件一件收集起来 回到花果山举起金箍棒的时候 进入石卵将石猴打败 大圣残躯出现的时候我不得不信大圣死了 那个天不怕地不怕的齐天大圣————死了 当我死了不知道多少次 终于打败他的时候他就跪在那 天命人也跪在那 我的耳边再次响起了那段话，初次听见他是开场白 游戏结束后他是结束语 接着老猴子拿起紧箍，画面变黑闪过每一位制作人员 我哭了 四年多没有白等 一场跨越四百多年的游戏盛宴在一个普通的晚上落下了序幕 有人说没拿TGA年度最佳游戏是遗憾 但是仔细想想这袈裟不要也罢 正如游戏中黑熊精所说 “若披上袈裟只为证明金海已干，那金海是否真的干过。” 而这或许才是中国游戏真正【成佛】的劫数 感谢吴承恩 感谢游戏科学 希望中国游戏越来越好

我很庆幸即使没有第一时间游玩，也下意识的避开了所有黑神话的攻略，初见的体验堪称完美。 黑神话真的带给了我很大的惊喜，趁着清明假期有较长的游戏时间，假期前买了豪华版的黑神话，打算体验一下这部评价很高的国产游戏。作为一个打斗和动作苦手，抱着玩不了多久就会卸载的心情开始玩，结果优秀的超过我的预期，三天假期废寝忘食的在玩，目前打到终章花果山有点舍不得结束，更是决心要完成全成就。 如果说，开场CG演出我还抱着一种“对于国产游戏来说很不错”的看法，那让我真正打心底里喜欢上黑神话则是第一章的2D风格的动画，恍惚间有种小时候电视上看西游记、哪吒闹海的感觉。剧情方面，对于西游记的改编，仁者见仁，至少我还蛮喜欢的。而让我把这个作品放到我个人必玩的神作之一，是我真的在黑神话里体会到了“韵味”，一种只有我们能够理解的，能够体会的“韵味”。[spoiler] “如果不披上那件袈裟，世人又怎知我尘缘已断，金海尽干”，书生的“一念善恶”，黄眉的“倒果为因”，牛魔王一家的“身不由己” [/spoiler]，说的俗气点就是有太多太多独属于我们的文化和美学。 遗憾的是从第四章开始能够明显看到赶工的痕迹，期待DLC或者续作来补全这个黑神话这个世界，更加期待游科能够有更多的作品。

This game is awesome. It has some problems, some of them pretty serious, but overall, it's amazing. The game has a lot of very varied content, many unique locations and enemies. Every different place in this game looks uniquely designed and crafted. Chinese mythology is a rare setting for a game too, and I think it's very interesting. The combat is not very forgiving: you have to memorize bosses' patterns and attack animations to properly punish them. That's just like any other game, but in this game there's not much of "recovery time" after you fall or anything, nor any animation cancels so you can dodge attacks when you are in the mid of performing your own attack combo; in this game you are still vulnerable even if you are on the ground and cannot move, if an enemy throws you to the ground, and he hits you again before the standing up animation has ended, that attack will land. Some attacks will make you flinch or "stagger" on hit, and if you receive a second or even third attack during that stagger animation, you will receive all that damage. Some of your animations are pretty long, and once you have started that animation, you cannot cancel it with a different move or a dodge, so you better think if you really have time for that heavy attack, because if you get hit during the animation, even if you react by inputting a dodge, you will take the damage. So you have to memorize bosses' patterns very well and their animation timings, so you know exactly when to dodge and how many attacks can you perform when there's an opening. My main complaint is the invisible walls. It's often unclear where you're allowed to go. Sometimes you can jump on seemingly complex rock formations, and other times there’s a clear, open space that looks accessible but isn’t. It feels inconsistent and can be frustrating. I’ve wasted a lot of time trying to reach places that ultimately weren’t meant to be reached. The game is also pretty demanding, but it's also very pretty so I think it's somewhat expected, unlike some other very demanding, yet very ugly games. There's no input settings... besides choosing between two different controller "types", which I find very strange. There's also no full screen... like WTF??? I also don't enjoy that when you die, you have to watch a death animation and wait for the game to put you at the last shrine you visited... which takes a while and gets boring when you have to try some bosses so many times before defeating them. Maybe I'm just too bad at this game and other people beat the bosses on their first try? Music is great and very tastefully composed and placed, sound design and presentation are great too. I really like this game!

从画面来说，虚幻 5 引擎简直神了，打造出的中式美景细腻逼真得不像话。黑风山的自然风貌，每一处细节都仿佛能呼吸，山峦、树林、云雾，全都美得像幅流动的水墨画，玩的时候我好几次都忍不住停下来截图。场景搭建参考了超多现实中的古迹，云冈石窟、悬空寺等元素的融入，直接把中国传统文化的厚重感拉满，随便一帧都能当壁纸，美术团队绝对是神来之笔！ 战斗体验堪称一绝。武器金箍棒的设计太妙了，轻重攻击配合棍势变化，战斗节奏完全由自己掌控，连招打得那叫一个爽。法术和变身系统更是点睛之笔，定身术控住敌人后一顿暴揍，变身不同形态还有专属武器和技能，战斗方式丰富到超乎想象。BOSS 战更是刺激得让人肾上腺素飙升，每个 BOSS 都有独特机制，快节奏的攻防转换，失败了无数次但就是让人越挫越勇，打败它们后的成就感简直无法言喻。 游戏里的文化细节也做得超用心。各种道具、建筑、怪物设计，都能找到传统文化的影子。菜单里对妖魔的记录，像古代话本小说一样，几句判词、一段故事、一张绣像，韵味十足。配乐更是绝，国风旋律一起，瞬间就能把人拉进那个神秘的西游世界，广智变身时的音乐，还有第二章开头独特的西北乐曲风格，听得我浑身起鸡皮疙瘩，跟游戏氛围完美融合。 剧情方面也可圈可点，以 “天命人” 为主角，对《西游记》进行二次创作，探索取经之后的故事，悬念一个接一个。不同阵营的设定很有意思，各方利益纠葛，让整个世界观特别饱满。而且还有多结局设计，这种可探索性大大增加了游戏的重玩价值。 《黑神话：悟空》绝对是国产游戏的里程碑之作，它让我看到了国产 3A 游戏的无限可能。不管是对动作游戏爱好者，还是对中国传统文化感兴趣的人来说，都是必玩佳作。强烈推荐给大家，相信玩过之后，你们也会跟我一样，被它深深折服 ！

TLDR- a very cool game, pretty graphics with a gameplay that feels rather satisfying when everything goes right, and really interesting main bosses. 7.5 up to a 8/10 on a good day. There are a lot of upgrade options, with different gameplay styles (which can also be changed mid fight like in DMC5, should you have enough skill points to upgrade them to be usable interchangably) this might be a bit overwhelming, however the player can revert skill points at will with no cost, so this hardly counts as a con, just discover your style. The main thing I liked in the game was major bosses, which were most often very neatly crafted, while being really cool to look at. They also provide a lot of joy when defeating them, the most important part. (maybe beside the chapter 4 final boss, I wasn't that excited about defeating him). The only bad thing for me was that sometime bosses hardly leave any room for breathing (there weren't many of those, I might just thought of this because of how much I hated mantis 2nd phase). There are a LOT of mini bosses, which are sometimes just reused normal enemies with added attacks. Reusing bosses isn't that rare too, so that might be a con if you're not that big on the idea. The game in itself is VERY pretty (which can easily cause framerate problems, remember to check the free benchmark tool before buying the game), however the map can sometimes feel empty, I felt that way in chapter 3, there were a lot of empty spaces compared to the size of the map. I have also encountered many problems with the camera (more than other simmilar games relying on a lock-on in their gameplay), especially with enemies that like to stay in the air right above your head for a longer period of time

Gerade in Soulslike-Titeln sorgt ein gut getimter Konter oft für ein besonders befriedigendes Spielerlebnis – das fehlt hier leider. 在24年底考完研之后，我才真正有时间来玩黑猴。春节期间花了大概两周的时间把一轮回打通了，当时还是用的我姐同事的WeGame账号。我因为没有自己的电脑，所以没怎么玩过端游，一直想玩的游戏基本只有个尼尔机械纪元，春节期间体验下来，感觉黑猴在制作的精细程度和动作丰富度上是较多地优于尼尔的。不过由于尼尔是17年的游戏，黑猴在这些方面优于它倒也不足为奇。不过，黑猴让我最喜欢的，还是对于西游的剧情呈现方面。我玩游戏还是比较在乎剧情的，自己又是文学专业，因此比较在意故事写得怎么样。黑猴的剧情，要我评价是很有阴谋论的俗套气息的，这一点我很不喜欢，单是刚开始猴子说的“人，我保住了；经，我取到了……”这一段表现我看起来就觉得俗不可耐。但是吧，黑猴的剧情又是经过深挖的，还不是单纯地以阴谋论来博眼球，深度至少还是有的，这一点挽回了我的一些好感。猪的感情戏我还是觉得挺新颖挺喜欢的，然而猴子跟白骨精的爱情设置我认为就完全没必要了，这一点我站六小龄童老师，我也认为猴子之所以名为“悟空”，就不该有这种凡俗的东西在身上。不过，黑猴也有些地方做得很好，很多妖王的塑造挺不错，BOSS战也挺爽的。我一直有一个愿望，就是希望中国传统的神话或神魔题材可以被做成游戏，让我们对于传统文化的兴趣不止停留在影视的视觉享受上，希望也能让我感受到操作的爽感，让我们能在亲手的操作中代入一个个神仙妖魔。黑猴无疑做到了这一点，但我认为还不够，我感觉整个剧情还是太短，还有那么多妖王可以做进来，狮驼岭三妖王、青牛精、哪吒，这些都是猴子最强劲的对手，我相信如果做出来一定挺有意思的，因此我也希望黑猴能出个2。 如今考完研也是顺利上岸了，我也可以名正言顺在自己的账号上买一个黑猴了，我会在自己的账号上再走一次大圣路，并殷切地希望，国产游戏可以不再停留在对于《西游记》这个比较热门的传统题材的创新上，中国有那么多灿如烟火的神魔精怪故事，希望都能被挖掘出来做成游戏，让世界真正见识到，中国传统故事的多样性与趣味性。

I've been following this game since the very first teaser dropped, and now I can finally experience it myself. What a journey! Shout out to the dev team for bringing back the legendary tale of Journey to the West in such an epic way. From breathtaking visuals to intense combat, every moment in Black Myth: Wukong feels like stepping into a living myth. From watching teasers to finally becoming the MONKE myself this is an unforgettable experience. Dreams come true.

Let’s dive into Black Myth: Wukong — This game takes the cake when it comes to bang for your buck. Right from the start, you are introduced to a phenomenal world of Chinese mythology that hits different, with rich lore packed into every corner. Stopped for a breather? Look up. Looks like God himself painted the world — Everything from fantastical forests, eerie temples, and even the enemies look like the antagonists of a dark fairy tale that came to life. So much as lift your finger and you are bound to breach the edge of oceans of kung fu — the combat system is where this game literally slaps. Everything from the joy of landing a well executed futsal multi combo to the ‘soul’s like’ difficulty of the game plays seamlessly with core mechanics of martial arts add a whole new layer of enjoyment. Do not get me started aobut the transformations and magical abilities. You feel like the monkey king, powerful, clever and dare I say, a little cocky. Seeing such bold graphical details, the fact that the game runs so smooth is a pleasant surprise. Performance wise, it feels surprisingly optimised for such a visually heavy game. Almost no bugs to bother me, crisp animations, I was satisfied. And sure, the storytelling is on the slower side, but if you enjoy bone of rich lore and age-old legends buried in one place, so it totally pays off. As a whole, Black Myth: Wukong is not simply another action RPG, but rather an ode to Chinese folklore. It is one of the games to experience if you enjoy Sekiro, Elden Ring and, God of War. So far, and without completing it, I would give it a solid 9/10.

This game and the studio behind it made history. Game Science's first venture into the AAA space. Selling over 20 million copies, becoming #2 for most concurrent players in Steam history within 48 hours of launch, and delivering an immersive story with compelling visuals and stunning cutscenes and dialogue. Black Myth: Wukong takes us through a story set just after Journey To The West. This story is told in great detail through character dialogue, cutscenes, and pre/post chapter animations. Each chapter has its own unique theme and setting, giving you a fresh set of enemies to fight and a new environment to explore. Yet, the game story flows together seamlessly between chapters. It doesn't feel jarring. The chapter transition animations are some of the most unique and visually stunning I have ever seen. From anime, to stop animation, to traditional Chinese art, this game just does it right. Right when you start to think the story couldn't get any better, it hits you square in the face with something better. The gameplay loop can be best described as Souls-like. With checkpoints, healing flasks, bosses as the main enemy type, stamina bar, and the typical dodge mechanic to name a few. Compared to Elden Ring, this game isn't as hard but it does the job well. The bosses gave me a challenge but not to the point where I wanted to throw my PC out of the window due to frustration (until I reached the Secret Ending boss). With that said, the gameplay is extremely satisfying. The combos flow well, each stance feels impactful with different abilities that can prove useful in a variety of challenges. Some criticize the combat system as being repetitive, however, the game encourages you to switch stances, to use your different heavy attacks and spells. You can unlock additional combos or attacks in the skill tree as well. The game is filled with over 30 optional bosses, each with their own unique spell or ability you can steal and make your own. This game has PLENTY of diversity and variety. Very rarely did I find myself stuck using one particular stance or spell to defeat a boss. (Skill issue on my part). And speaking of optional bosses. The game does a great job of leaving exploration entirely in your hands. They do not tell you where to go, where to find optional encounters, how to get access to secret areas, how to find the secret bosses and loot. It's on you to seek them out. Wukong is a visual masterpiece. Some have said the game appears generic with its forest, deserts, snowy mountains, caves, and plains. I disagree. The game feels like its own world. Each environment is filled with Chinese architecture, unique environmental design choices, and breathtaking scenery that doesn't feel like it was just pulled from an asset shop or some generic pool of map designs. Chapter 4 of the game is an excellent example of what I'm talking about. I won't spoil anything but that part of the game was truly amazing. I was locked in from start to finish. As I stated earlier, the post chapter animations are on another level. Each chapter cutscene utilizes a different animation style that sucks you in, all while telling the same story. Overall, Black Myth: Wukong is an amazing game that accomplished something most western studios have been failing to deliver on for the last 5 years. A COMPLETE game with a compelling story, stunning visuals, fluid combat, and no real-world politics. It delivers exactly what was advertised, a beautiful game about a monkey from mythological China.

As someone who has always been fascinated by Chinese Mythology, I was surprised to see how the developers have taken inspiration from this rich tradition to create such a great game. I find story telling in this game to be one of its best-selling point because of how the stories were unfolded in a non-convoluted way as you progress through the game. There are a total of 6 chapters in the game and after each chapter, you will be given a cutscene & some beautifully drawn artworks that sum up the events of the chapter. I think that is a really cohesive way to piece the stories together & it helps players who focus more on the gameplay to not miss out on the emotional depth of the story. Looking through the genre tags of this game, It seems that the game is tagged as "Souls-like" even though i personally do not think this game should be considered as one though I can definitely see some inspiration drawn from the "Souls" genre. All souls-like games usually have a very distinct turn-based fight which is not necessarily reflected in Black Myth: Wukong. I say this because of the many abilities/combos/combo extenders etc. in the game which allows you to weave in and out of a fight, essentially making your own turns. Hence, this is more so "hack and slash" than "souls-like". With that being said, the boss designs of this game are amazing & the bosses usually greet you with a unique set of skills. You can literally fight an arm which i think is kind of cool. The map was meticulously thought out, from dazzling waterfalls to terrains that react to your movements. The staff you wield even leaves imprints in the sand/snow as you drag it across while sprinting, adding a sense of immersion to the game. Such attention to detail allowed the developers to create a truly dynamic & believable world.

目前打到游戏中期。如果5分满分的话，我愿意给游戏内容5分，但是对于游戏体验我只给1分，所以我给差评。 推到第四回也得打了全部差不多一半的boss了，要么就是一两遍就能过，要么就是极度恶心死几十遍也打不过（比如小黄龙）。 我也不知道为什么有些boss难度和机制会设计的那么恶心。在我看来一款真正的好游戏在各个方面至少要做到毫无槽点，或者有一些能忍受的问题都可以。但是在我看来我纯纯被这几个老鼠屎boss破坏了对整个游戏的评价。 （以下是我前期的评价，我也不想删改，就放在这里了） 从游戏难度来说，是我玩过最差的一款单机。 我玩游戏最重要的是玩的开心，打的爽，而不是被游戏内某些恶心的boss打死几十遍也过不了（点名魔将莲眼），不能调整难度是我感觉这游戏最大的败笔。我看到很多人开风灵月影，在吐槽boss难打，对游戏难度的质疑我肯定不是一个人。 你是国产3A之光，我承认，确实非常牛，但这只是加分项。对于我玩不爽的游戏我就是绝对给差评，别扯别的，在我心中就是垃圾。 游戏难度直接导致游戏体验非常差劲??。本来就是闲暇时间、忙玩之后打游戏放松一下开心一下，结果被某些东西打的红温，那你告诉我你玩游戏的意义在哪里？ 我通篇只在提游戏难度这回事，也只因为这个我给差评。你觉得简单那是你的事，也别来道德绑架我，我买的游戏，我体验不好，我肯定差评。

个人是被西游吸引过来的，国产第一份3A让我对他有了过高的期待，加上对西游记的题材和美术画风的吸引，直接跟风预购了。但实际玩起来还是没那么好，买游戏还是要等游戏出了看实际情况再买。 游戏剧情上很烂，几乎可以说就是屎。都是一些割裂的小故事，虎头蛇尾，全是谜语人，具体真相是什么完全靠猜，连一个完整的故事都没讲出来。人物塑造也很烂，一些人物做事感觉没有逻辑，漫天神佛为什么变坏，四姐为什么要帮玩家等等。剧情上感觉跟西游记没什么关联，没有西游记的内核，全是阴谋论，虚假宣传改编自西游记，不如说是改编自斗战神。剧情上的争议建议参考b站视频BV1R7WBeEEcM。BV1iLsGemEte。 其他缺点，包括但不限于老生常谈的破坏游戏体验的空气墙，你以为能走的路实际上不能走。游戏指引很差，比如第一章的隐藏boss要第二章解锁。地图和关卡设计很烂，岔路很多很容易迷路，比如第二章的宇宙中心枕石坪。以及大众普遍认为很烂的缺点最多的第六章，没有一点的地图设计，指引也差到几乎没有。我玩的时候只能照着游民星空的地图玩，生怕漏了什么东西。游戏的粪怪也很多，视角锁定在打大体型怪物时很难受，只能修脚，比如妙音，大石敢当。有些怪物还跑来跑去打不中比如亢金龙，王灵官。还有一些跟打石头没区别的怪，比如莲眼，五行战车。游戏怪物像百眼魔君的受击模型还有问题。 游戏的美术属于顶级，远高于平均水平。怪物的立绘很好看，建筑上还有中国传统文化特色，让世界玩家见识到了属中国文化。影神图做的很不错，里面的故事很有意思。通关后的过场动画和卷轴也美轮美奂。游戏音乐也很好听。玩法上，法术化身变身很有特色很丰富，与二郎神和大圣的战斗以及法天象地玩起来十分震撼，战斗爽快，令人心潮澎湃，甚至抵消了一部分游戏的粪感。我手残玩起来比较难（不过这是我的问题了），如果有和我类似的没有动作游戏经验的手残玩家，还是推荐开修改器玩。 总的说来游戏既优秀却又有遗憾，游戏剧情和地图设计的缺陷太大难以忽视，玩的时候不带脑子硬打就行了。综合评分10分制至少8分还是有的，等以后打折还是很值得一玩的。 （补充: 国产第一份游戏做成这样确实不错了。但许多人把游戏捧上了神坛，只能夸不能骂，说他的缺点还要被扣帽子。发售前b站一些主播猛吹优点却几乎不说致命的缺点，极大的拉高了期待。最令我反感厌恶的是部分人的民族主义叙事，与爱国高度绑定，你不喜欢就是汉奸，真是一弄反而令人反胃。）
中国神话中最知名的传奇故事和角色之一，被游戏公司赋予了美学、人文、哲学的故事内核，光怪陆离的世界探索，精彩的打斗演绎，是我心中国产游戏诞生以来，迄今的巅峰。

[b] 不觉发售已半年有余，恍然如梦一场，此刻精神状态恰如似醒犹眠时分，便趁着工位摸鱼之际，简单记录个人感受。 [/b] 黑神话是我非常满意的游戏，丰富且契合设定的boss设计简直是在我的爽点上蹦迪，连战更新后更是酣畅淋漓，有种梦回当年神居五门的感觉。此外，游戏中包含的文化属性极为突出，摩崖造像、楼阁台榭也好，诗书经文、文物珍藏也罢，都可在现实景区/博物馆内寻得出处，也难怪发售后联动了一堆地方文旅局。但是，最让我喜爱的还是每章结束后的动画短片和音乐曲目，颇有画龙点睛韵味，尤其是各首曲目的作词，对仗工整，用典熟练，立意深远，非常非常非常合我的胃口，后了解到所有作词都是冯骥一人包办，不得感叹“主创不去转行干作词人真是可惜~”，遂把本篇测评当作歌词本，摘抄游戏曲目内我所喜爱的歌词（初中上课时偷摸抄歌词，上班后依然摸鱼抄歌词，这应该算不忘初心）。 [h3] 戒网 [/h3] 山海半生漂泊 一叶孤舟、天地两世零落 几处离愁； 本是一处同飞鸟 余生无所求 空把青丝等白头。 踏破银河无觅 玉颜红袖、寻遍宫阙不见 良人佳偶； 一夜雨声多少事 月下强说愁 红豆如何敢消受。 [h3] 未竟 [/h3] 英雄被写成诗 只剩爱与勇敢 诗凝成画 不容悲欢； 你我原是 有情有欲人 天地不平心不甘。 他们被说成书 区区八十一难 书刻成碑 光明灿烂； 试问有谁 再打破顽空 不堕轮回万古传？ [h3] 勿听 [/h3] 月光 在初见的桥头、月光 在惜别的城楼、思念 是眉间的痒； 月年年望相似 寻常最长久。 忘了 是新添的垢、记得 是老套的旧、知音 是相拥无言； 愿天黑话到明 总归说不够。 汹涌如江流 忐忑似轻舟 喧闹如江流 宁静似轻舟 寂寥如江流 缥缈似轻舟 [h3] 看见 [/h3] 口中念 心中言 现世报 却方便； 修行路 无明尽 幡动时 莫等闲； 一身功名轻如烟 最苦人无再少年； 醉时引火醒时眠 贪嗔痴 看见。 [h3] 不由己 [/h3] 谤我 从未辩驳、欺我 宁愿沉默、辱我 我可以躲； 轻我 何必言说、贱我 一笑而过、恶我 我把心锁。 （陈彼得老爷爷唱的太令人触动） 除有作词的曲目外，游戏内的其他几首ost也很好听，诸如《称王称圣任纵横》《有经处有火》《历代驰名第一妖》《善恶若无报》《万里江山都是颤》等等，希望dlc也能保持相同的音乐水准。 第一个pv已快五年，当时的震撼依然难以忘却，同时也是亲身经历了这一路的舆论风波，或好或坏，令人感慨。某次茶闲之时，脑中突闪高中所背的一首词，便想搬运其中几句，为本测评（歌词本）作结： [b] “横空出世，莽昆仑，阅尽人间春色。飞起玉龙三百万，搅得周天寒彻。 夏日消溶，江河横溢，人或为鱼鳖。或功或罪，谁人曾与评说？” [/b]

Black Myth: Wukong is an extraordinary achievement of China's video game industry, blending the legendary tale of one of the great Chinese novels and arguably the most popular literary work in East Asia, Journey to the West, with breathtaking gameplay. While it offers a challenging experience, it remains accessible, striking a perfect balance between difficulty and enjoyment. However, what truly sets it apart is its storytelling—an exceptionally well-crafted narrative that rivals even the depth of a novel. Few games today reach such literary heights, making Black Myth: Wukong not just a great game, but a landmark in video game storytelling. To fully appreciate the depth of its story, I highly recommend exploring Journey to the West, the classic masterpiece that serves as its foundation. Understanding the novel and rich cultural heritage of China that shaped it enriches the experience, unveiling the true brilliance behind Black Myth: Wukong’s narrative.

Le jeu possède quand même quelques défauts notables comme les murs invisibles très relous (le jeu te laisse croire que tu peux aller à un endroit mais tu peux pas), bien que cela reste mineur. le plus gros défaut selon moi réside dans les pics de difficulté mal répartis. 悟空，孙悟空，西游记，总是有种特殊的魅力让人看到那个瑰丽多彩的世界。 感谢黑神话悟空的制作组以及原作创作人能够将这样一个精彩的世界呈现给玩家。我玩大型开放世界的游戏，总是玩的比较慢，总要感觉把每一个角落走走才好。刚玩的时候，真的很激动能够作为天命人挥动棍棒在续作中走上一遭，后面也见证了一个又一个故事，有意难平，也有叹息。我也总是会惊艳于游戏里的pc画面，每一章的画风都有所不同，但呈现的画面、寓意、音乐都是最好的。除了主线任务，支线任务也特别丰富，这里不多赘述。 说回玩的慢，可能和我一页页翻动游记中的故事也有些许关系呢。挺奇妙的，认真去看会发现，每一章故事的一些小兵之间的故事是连在一起的，或者可以说都有一个相同的背景。当然，最明显的定然是那几个青蛙了吧，最具连续性的一个故事，相信很多人也印象深刻哈哈，那厮道士实是有趣得很！ 总之呢，如果大家想单纯挑战BOSS，那么也不会失望，因为快慢刀会教你做人（），还有连战。 如果是想体验悟空的故事，整体难度其实也不大，希望大家可以慢下来细心体验这款游戏为我们呈现的一切，悟空的故事真的非常精彩，这也是支撑我打多周目拿成就的原因，哪怕你知道，你还是会想要再看一遍。 对于后入坑的孩子们，有福了，因为有地图喔，顺带一提，地图做的也非常精美，跟那个行旅图一样让我过目难忘，行旅图我总是要将每一处看仔细了才肯舍得开下一回的故事。 慢下来没什么不好的，因为你越是琢磨，你越会在悟空中发现惊喜。 这一路走来，九九八十一难，我踏平了。我们DLC再见吧。

Black Myth: Wukong is a breathtaking action RPG that blends rich Chinese mythology with jaw-dropping visuals and challenging combat. Developed by Game Science Studio, this ambitious title captures the essence of the classic Journey to the West tale, delivering a unique and immersive experience. Gameplay and Mechanics The combat system in Black Myth: Wukong is fluid and dynamic, emphasizing timing, skill, and strategy. Players can seamlessly transform into various creatures, each with unique abilities that open up new approaches to combat and exploration. The game’s boss battles are intense, requiring adaptability and mastery over Wukong’s abilities to overcome towering foes. Graphics and Visuals Visually, the game is a masterpiece. The detailed character designs, atmospheric environments, and realistic animations showcase the power of next-gen technology. The attention to detail in textures and effects truly brings the mystical world to life, making every scene a visual treat. Story and Atmosphere Drawing from the legendary Journey to the West, the story weaves a compelling narrative that blends action, fantasy, and myth. The world feels alive, filled with folklore, mystical creatures, and intriguing lore. This faithful yet creative interpretation of the myth keeps players invested. Sound and Music The sound design is outstanding, with a soundtrack that captures the grandeur of the mythological world. From the clash of weapons to the subtle environmental sounds, the audio enhances the immersive experience. Conclusion Black Myth: Wukong sets a new benchmark for action RPGs. Its stunning visuals, deep combat system, and rich storytelling make it a must-play for fans of the genre. Game Science Studio has crafted an unforgettable journey that honors Chinese mythology while pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in gaming.

9.5/10 This game is a true labour of love, I don't think I have seen so much passion in a game before, way above FF7 Rebirth which already set a high bar. The game plays and feels well with a very interesting take and sequel to the beloved Journey To The West chinese story. Being chinese myself, I am aware of the original story to a small extent so this game brings back lots of nostalgia and now i'm surprised the story hasn't been expanded on in a video game earlier. Starting with the good, the game feels good to play and the game is fun. There is exploration in the game and I tried going through the entire map, but apparently i still missed stuff. The cutscenes at the end of every chapter, the music, the art, and so much are shows the love and passion for the game and it's no wonder China has embraced this game so much as it can bring patriotism to Chinese people and introduced their culture to the western world. This is an amazing game entry from china and they should be very proud of the product. There are over 100 bosses in the game and most of them are unique. There are pages of lore for everything you kill and i constantly look forward to each chapter ending cutscene so i can watch a video on it and learn about the lore and story. The story the game talks about via loyalty, love, betrayal, anger, revenge etc, which are all very meaniful topics and triggers lots of emotions as you're playing the game. I should also note that the game has some comedic relief as well which makes the game a little goofy at times but it's well placed and I enjoyed Zhu Bajie's role in the game and watching him fight with me. This game has extremely high fidelity and looks amazing, having a game look this good and play this well is extremely rare. The gas has a few bosses that I will definitely remember, and Erlang is probably a top 5 boss for me all time in terms of gameplay. There is good enough build variety to make you consider builds which is my favourite part of any game, however, i do wish there was a little more. I'm also very happy that the mobs aren't harder than the bosses like in DS3, where running around the map will kill you more times than the bosses, this game style and type suits my taste exactly and it's all i've ever wanted, lots of action with little ???????? in between. The game is also well balanced with difficulty where there is only really 2-3 hard bosses, where 1 of them is optional and another is required for the true ending. I would call this just a pure action game before calling it a souls game. The boss fights feels like an actual "fight" as well, and not just a dodging simulator like lots of souls games. You're fighting in between dodges, and all of wukongs moves (like his dodges) are lore accurate which makes it less ridiculous like in Elden Ring how you just roll over and i-frame a dragon breathing fire right on top of you. The bad. The level design in this game is terrible and stressful. Lots of times, the path will diverge into 2, and you will have to flip a coin and choose a direction to go, and then that path splits into 2, and the path after that splits again. It makes you go back and forth many time inefficiently. Worst of all, without any indication or knowing, if you choose the wrong path, you can lock yourself out of content and cut scenes, which is extremely frustrating and have me cursing at the game the few times it happened (like in Chapter 4 and 5). When there's over 100 bosses, it's inevitable that some will be bad designed. Unfortunately, the ones that are the worst designed are all mandatory bosses. The worst bosses are Wandering Wright (his stomp tracks way too much and will jitter just to hit you which is unfair and extremely jank (some DS2 level stuff); Yellow Wind Sage, you literally can't see the arena and you also can't tell where the borders are so you get trapped lots of the time; Monk from the Sea, way too much damage and freeze mechanic, not sure where it came from; Yellowbrow, has cutscene damage; Hundred-eyed Daoist Master, bad hitbox; and Gold Armored Rhino, runs around way too much and i can't do damage on him except for the front, lasts way too long and does way too much damage. All these bosses have artificial difficulty and are all major bosses in the game. Additionally with the boss fights, the game has lots of stuttering and performance issues where it becomes unplayable. They should definitely fix it because some bosses took way too many tries because of stuttering and FPS drops (40+ FPS drops). An example would be with the Yin Tiger fight, where have the battle is to not get stutters or play around it. You have other things working against you as well such as the camera, which can be your greatest enemy sometimes, the arena having invisible walls and getting trapped in it, and some bosses in general just have way too much health. Regarding the vessels, i wish they described how the vessels worked better. They say some vessels are better used for specific enemies, but they do not say why or how. For example, i wish they told me the fan can break shields or the tamer can end transformations. This is really important to know and changes how you fight bosses, but this is very important details left hidden and it's not even logically to make the assumptions that they work this way. Chapter 3 was terrible, they should have shorten it for sure, Chapter 4 was also very long but at least it was interesting with lots of NPCs and not just a spiral prison where all the levels are the same and nothing interesting happens. Chapter 3 got better when you are in the snow area, but the Temple was horrible. Not enough checkpoints and way too many enemies. The map in general in my opinion has way too many mobs, they should have either reduced the mob density or reduce the map size. No reason for a room to have 10+ enemies in it with a mixture of melee, range, and an elite. This game is pure cinema and the end fight with the various kings was awesome and love how they implemented fun gimmick fights where you're expected to first try, like Eikon fights in FF16, where it's basically just fan service, gets ridiculous, fun, and badass. Dark Souls and Elden Ring really lacks this, and most soulslike in general. Games like Final Fantasy has it which is why Black Myth Wukong is closer to a action game than soulslike. This is a top tier game and meets expectations from when i first heard about it many many years ago, been super excited for this game and I can't believe it plays as well as it does with the graphics that it has. I am super excited for the DLC and hopefully they make a sequel as well. This game has so much potential and so much room for a sequel. 随着地图与挑战玩法的补充，本作的游戏体验已臻佳境。无论是激昂的战斗配乐、故事性极强的动画演出、真实的视觉画面，还是引人入胜的故事叙述与深厚的文化底蕴，均展现出顶尖水准。 更值得称道的是其怪物设计，数量庞大且鲜有重复，千姿百态的造型乘以丰富的招式模组，共同构筑了极为丰富多变的战斗体验。即便面对强敌，战斗也并非单调的翻滚受苦；通过化身、变身等神通与多样技能的巧妙穿插切换，战斗选择很多并有华丽观赏性，上限极高。 从立意上看，《黑神话：悟空》并非对经典故事的刻板复写，而是在西行之后的崭新征途上挥洒着更自由的笔墨。并非扮演齐天大圣，而是作为天命人，在历经相似的磨难淬炼后，去承继那份不屈的反抗精神。并非对经典的怀旧消费，而是重燃悟空的精神，并会成为最深入当前时代的新集体记忆。
