作为中国第一个3A大作，刚开始我是不削的，直至看到开场动画之后，就已被游戏吸引，但是我依旧等到通完一周目后再写这篇测评，是担心游戏本身会虎头蛇尾或有类似国产剧大部分通病，例如不合逻辑的二创剧情或简单愚蠢的动画效果等等，但是通关后，我可以放心得告诉各位，不存在这些玩意，我是强烈推荐的。 和法环相比，黑悟空的故事线更为线性，好处是，极大简化了游戏的主线流程，将玩家注意力放在BOSS战上，这也规避了中国在大型游戏地图上地图制作经验不足的缺点，各章节都是单独的模块，分包开发也会方便些。法环更注重开放探索，诺论游戏性，那肯定还是法环更加优秀，多职业的开放地图探索和多支线任务的选择让其有更多的游戏时间投入。但是论画质、动画和BOSS战打斗的动作感，黑悟空是优秀很多的。 总体来说，黑悟空的优点在于画质、BOSS战的动作感、优秀的数值平衡以及优秀的二创剧情对人物的设定上。其画质，不用谈的影视级作品，就恨自己显示器不是4K的，2K看着不够用，不同环境的细节做到纤毫毕现。而BOSS战的动作感，快紧结合，技能多变，节奏紧凑，极其具备战斗感，与魂系慢动作变节奏的特点相比，吸收其变奏的优点同时加快的战斗节奏，让人更有战斗的紧张感，极其泄欲甚至治好了我长久的心中郁结。其优秀的数值平衡体现在挑战模式的深度精玩上，不管什么套装，打法类似情况下击杀时间偏差极少，而最速通关方式又只有一种方式，值得玩家深度探索挖掘。其二创剧情的核心，游记，铺开了一个全新的，庞大的，中国式背景的世界观，为后续DLC埋下了不少的伏笔，至少还能做3~5部的续作，算是一场饕餮盛宴了，刚开始可能觉得部分游记拆开看会比较凌乱缺少逻辑，但是当通关后，其世界观的深邃就只能让人赞叹了，作为一部弘扬中国文化的作品，他不是单纯科普中国人甚至外国人耳熟能详的故事，而是留出了大量的空白，一如国风水墨画，留给人大量的瞎想空间，而部分支线故事通过多个BOSS的故事合并成章，很有新意。 也不是说黑悟空没有缺点，但是瑕不掩瑜，这些缺点完全没法掩盖游戏的优秀，总体来说缺点有，探索性较低、道具较少、场景切换及动画有BUG卡顿、支线任务较少、空气墙过多地图无用区域较多、主角技能单一、法系技能过于无脑、配置云端上传有BUG、挑战模式优化BUG一大堆、位置切手BUG等，但是这些都是可以后期慢慢修复优化的且并不是特别影响游戏的核心。

《震撼与期待——评〈黑神话：悟空〉》 《黑神话：悟空》无疑是一款令人瞩目的游戏。 从画面表现来看，它达到了业内顶级水准。无论是精细的人物模型，还是对经典场景如五行山、火焰山等的细腻还原，都充满了视觉冲击力和艺术美感，让玩家能深刻感受到中国传统文化的魅力与深度。 战斗系统方面，虽有玩家指出存在一定不足，如整体战斗方式略显单一，缺乏多样性，可能在长时间游戏过程中让玩家感到乏味。角色成长系统也被认为设计相对简单，未能充分展现角色的发展和进步，影响了玩家的长期成就感。 然而，其玩法机制其实多种多样，“吃药”都能有多种派生，且能无偿洗点，这给予了玩家对于 BOSS 打法更多的思考空间。游戏虽不能调节难度，但只要玩家逐渐掌握技巧，也能降低难度。 剧情叙事上，对于熟悉《西游记》的国内玩家而言，基于原著的改编故事有着强关联，具有一定吸引力。但对于不熟悉《西游记》的国外玩家，可能在剧情理解上存在一定挑战，若能在这方面进一步优化，考虑全球玩家需求，或许能在国际市场取得更广泛的共鸣。 尽管游戏目前存在如地图设计上的空气墙等一些问题，但不可否认，《黑神话：悟空》展示了开发团队强大的技术和创意实力，它拥有巨大的潜力，让玩家对其未来的发展充满了期待。

《黑神话：悟空》无疑是一款让人无比期待的国风动作巨制，它以超凡脱俗的艺术设计、精致细腻的画面表现和独特的东方文化底蕴令人惊叹。从画质到流畅的战斗打击感，从对经典西游题材的全新诠释到开放世界的沉浸感，它都展现出了中国游戏开发者的创新与匠心。尤其是对孙悟空这个经典角色的重新塑造，不仅保留了传奇色彩，还赋予了更深的人性与故事厚度，令人耳目一新。《黑神话：悟空》不仅是一部游戏，更是一种艺术，一份对传统与未来完美结合的致敬与挑战，它无疑将成为中国游戏走向世界的里程碑！

Black Myth: Wukong is undoubtedly a visual masterpiece. The graphics are at the forefront of the game’s appeal, showcasing some of the best technical achievements in the industry. However, as incredible as the game looks, there’s more to a game than its visuals, and Black Myth: Wukong has its share of shortcomings. One major issue is that the game often feels more like a tech demo than a fully realized experience. It’s reminiscent of those Unreal Engine 5 showcases that highlight the engine’s capabilities but lack the depth of a fleshed-out game world. The environments, while gorgeous, sometimes feel empty and lacking in meaningful interactions or exploration. Additionally, the hyper-realistic design can be misleading; there are moments where the terrain—like a cave, a wall with a small hole, or a rock formation—looks traversable, only for you to hit an invisible wall. These moments break immersion and remind you that, despite the game’s beauty, it has rigid limitations. The story is another area where the game stumbles, especially for players unfamiliar with the book "Journey to the West" or the Chinese mythology and cultural context the game is steeped in. Cutscenes are visually stunning but can be confusing, leaving players who aren’t versed in the source material feeling lost. At times, it felt like I was just running around killing things without a clear understanding of why. The game doesn’t make much effort to bridge the gap for those who lack prior knowledge of the story, which detracts from the overall narrative experience. On the other hand, the boss fights are a definite highlight. Most of them are well-designed, challenging, and fun to play, though there are one or two that feel a bit unfair. Still, these encounters stand out as some of the game’s most memorable moments. It’s also worth noting that Black Myth: Wukong is best experienced on a high-end PC. The game’s greatest strength lies in its visuals—its breathtaking landscapes and meticulously crafted scenery. Without the hardware to fully appreciate this, the experience might feel lackluster. Overall, Black Myth: Wukong is an impressive game with clear strengths and weaknesses. While its graphics and boss battles shine, the lack of depth in exploration, occasional immersion-breaking design, and inaccessible storytelling hold it back. Despite these flaws, it’s undeniably a strong contender for Game of the Year and an experience worth checking out—if your PC can handle it.

Se trata de un juego de acción orientado a los combates contra jefes, aunque también tiene mapas explorables con secretos y jefes ocultos al estilo la exploración que puede tener un juego de tipo souls. En el sistema de combate tienes un combo principal y un combo alternativo que cambia en función de la postura que estés usando actualmente, por ejemplo, una postura es para combatir a corta distancia pudiendo negar ataques de los enemigos y otra postura te permite alejarte a mitad de combo para atacar de lejos. Todo esto se junta con hechizos y transformaciones que puedes usar como apoyo en el combate. Sigamos con la pregunta principal, ?es wukong un juego difícil?, la respuesta es sí pero es mucho más asequible que el elden ring o el dark souls, donde la dificultad radica sobre todo en que los jefes te matan de un golpe o dos y realizan ataques y patrones casi imposibles de esquivar. Aunque en wukong también verás algo de eso en sus jefes más difíciles, casi ningún jefe te matará de un golpe o dos y tu personaje no sólo es mucho más ágil sino que tiene a su disposición muchas herramientas para ganar, desde hechizos para paralizar a tu enemigo como transformaciones.

After 30 hours with Black Myth Wukong, I can confidently say it's the closest thing to gaming perfection I've encountered. Played on an Ultrawide OLED, every frame could be a wallpaper due to its stunning landscapes and environments. The sound, experienced through a hi-end home theater setup, rivals top-tier movie scene demos, providing an unparalleled level of immersion. As you play, your skills constantly improve, but the game keeps pace by evolving its mechanics, environments, and boss fights with new and challenging moves. Much like Son Goku in Dragon Ball, whose character is inspired by Sun Wukong, your character never feels overpowered. When facing bosses or main challenges, you're pushed to adapt, learn, and grow, often mastering new abilities or strategies mid-fight, only to emerge stronger from the brink of defeat. This dynamic progression ensures that every encounter feels like a significant milestone, rewarding you with not just victory but a new level of skill appreciation. Rating: 10/10 - An absolute must-play.

Something's just... off about the core combat compared to better souls-likes and character action games. I think it's mainly the enemy attack animations, where most have highly variable and noisy buildups that don't smoothly or readably connect to the active frames, which tend to also be extremely fast and cover absurd amounts of distance. This compared to something like Sekiro where all enemies, big and small, early and late game, more or less "dance" in similar ways and to the same rhythm, even if it's a bit syncopated at times. 太多业余的设计毁了原本优秀的卖相，在游玩中总有很多点让人很难受。 关卡设计和引导在A1-A3阶段实在是一言难尽，缺乏视觉引导和初期不肯提供地图的奇怪决策让探索变得及其烦躁，再配合前两章某些看似能通过但是及其粗糙的空气墙限制让人更烦躁只想尽快打完。A4整体流畅的体验和之前相比完全不像是一个游戏，无论是地图纵向纵深还是整体视野能给人的位置判断都完全不是前三章能比的，而且也几乎没有空气墙误判的烦躁的点，可能是因为盘丝洞本身的路就比较窄而且边缘清晰所以显得空气墙很自然？但是最后关卡问题到A6又变得更为严重，似乎是纯赶工凑数出来，就是在一块纯平面的地图的各个位置放上一些BOSS点位，中途用零星的小怪填充，完全没有任何设计，实在是让人大跌眼镜...... 战斗体验在面对一些机动性没有那么鬼畜的BOSS时还比较正常，但是一遇到能在空中乱飞的各种BOSS后主角远程攻击手段匮乏的缺点就被无限放大，玩家本来就没有任何低成本的防御手段，而机动性还比一些鬼畜BOSS差太多，导致只能被BOSS遛狗。等BOSS全屏乱飞半天好不容易靠近之后打一两下还得提防BOSS无休止的出招，而视角还得随着这些速度飞快的BOSS一路疯狂摇晃，让人打着非常心烦，最典型的就是亢金龙。另外某些BOSS的设计着实是根本不考虑实际情况的粗糙设计，比如王灵官的开场突刺，我试了很多次想要通过他做出动作之后目押闪避基本很难，这个突刺的动作太快而且隐蔽(黄风大圣和白眼魔君的投技也同样又快又隐蔽，几乎没办法判断出导致及其难防)，只能根据动作读秒预判，而且不论距离远近它突刺过来的时间似乎没有差别，所以他的突刺速度不是固定的，单纯就是确定了他和玩家的距离后用固定时间刺到玩家位置，设计实在是不合常理过于粗糙(同样的问题还出现在这一章的算是大怪的河马身上而且更严重，河马用身体划一个弧线冲撞玩家的这一招也是无视距离速度，只要确定了自己位置和玩家位置，它就一定会在固定时间撞到玩家位置，为此我故意引诱它快要出招时后撤非常远的距离后就会有特别搞笑的一幕，它仍然用固定撞近身的极短时间撞到我面前，但是因为距离太远，导致它的脚的移动动作和实际移动距离及其不协调，它实际上是在地上飘过来撞人的，动作设计简直是偷工减料到了极点)。另外一个特别脑残的设计就是整体体验下来最粪的BOSS百眼魔君。他双腿前面一大片莫名其妙的碰撞体积却又没有hitbox都勉强忍了，但是不使用金针就只能顶着一格体力打这个设计真的是纯纯脑残。并不是每一个人都想照着攻略先去取得针对性道具然后按部就班推图打BOSS，这种感觉就和上班差不多完全没有自由探索发现新东西的惊喜了。所以如果没有取得金针就打BOSS的操作体验应该怎么设计估计开发者是没有怎么花心思的。通过削弱玩家行动能力的方式来增加BOSS难度这种脑残设计真不知道到底是哪个大聪明想出来的，纯纯就是坐牢，而且还因为明明能通过操作和BOSS的招式交互却因为耐力太低导致操作可能性被限制的太死，这对动作要素的游戏简直是背道而驰。我硬生生死了3个多小时顶着一格耐力一棒一棒敲死百眼魔君之后完全没啥爽快感只觉得失望。还有一些其他略微粪的怪例如晦月魔君、云步鹿、浪波波问题也十分明显就不一一举例了。 总体来看，黑神话的完成度某些地方还不错但是又有太多地方感觉完全没有打磨或者设计思路很奇怪，让整个游戏的体验及其割裂。很多BOSS设计有板有眼很有趣味，探索却非常枯燥乏味。但是BOSS战又是穿插在这些探索中的导致那些精彩BOSS战短暂的爽快体验也被无趣而漫长的探索覆盖了，实在是整体体验下来最让人遗憾的地方。至于剧情个人感觉反倒是还好，网上总有人吐槽黑神话的剧情，但是整个体验下来感觉不痛不痒，或者说即便剧情不好也不影响它优秀的部分，毕竟还是战斗部分才是这游戏的核心。如果想体验顶级的剧情那有太多优秀的剧情游戏可选而不应该在这个游戏里面硬找，这是缘木求鱼。最后，只能说国内游戏制作水平确实离顶尖的那一撮还有不小的差距，可能也受限于成本、项目管理经验等等只能不得已而为之。能完成也实属不易，希望以后能一步一步变得更好吧。

完整打完了两周目，连战后面几关不想打了。其实全成就也有好一段时间了，一直拖到最近才把截图都整理完，现在记录一下（可能很主观的）个人体验感受。 黑猴既是首个国产3A大作，也是第一款我在steam预购的大作以及第一款我玩到的UE5大作。我目前玩过的大作并不多，尤其是近10年这类吃操作的第三人称越肩视角ARPG，我都是云的。因为填坑老游戏，加上自己对这类游戏也不是很感兴趣。可几年前，黑猴第首支宣传片横空出世，它真就像那只从石头里蹦出来的猴子，沸腾了国内低迷的单机圈子。之后每支新宣传片都带给我新的感动，我常开玩笑说就指着这游戏活了。直到2024真的来了，我内心既期待又忐忑，感觉国产单机能走到这一步真的很不真实，反而等到舆论平静后才开始玩。因为政治因素和文化差异，国内外的评测可能多少都会有点滤镜，所以自己体验是很有必要的。而真正上手后，我想说它虽不属于我最喜欢的那一梯队的游戏，但的确超过我的预期，是款绝对值得推荐的优秀游戏。 首先游戏画面毋庸置疑，世界一流水平。尽管我的破PC只能勉强用着中画质，但我还是沉迷拍照模式收获了不少值得纪念的瞬间，它也是我目前截图最多的游戏（宁可送死也要拍照，谁懂！？）。UE5的表现着实令我惊讶，场景色调协调，光影层次自然，以假乱真的画质仿佛身临其境，满足！游科塑造了一个磅礴的玄幻世界，耳熟能详的神怪配上华丽特效与振奋人心的BGM，演出效果一绝。过场动画也是国风十足，黏土动画都有，很用心。而不同区域的敌人风格各异，连土地庙的设计也很应景（喜欢插上香后的动画）。天命人的装束各具特色，我最喜欢那套锦鳞服的青白配色，很多面具也好酷，有些装备升阶到神珍还会再变样。武器则以悟空惯用的棍棒为核心，设计了不同精致款式，特效也不错。游科对美术细节的打磨下了很多功夫，从大古建到小珍玩，琳琅满目的中式元素尽收眼底。最令我感动的还是这些美术资产背后传递的文化与艺术价值，走访古迹实地扫描建模的实景带动了一波热潮，实打实的文化输出。此外，各种道具的说明用词也很讲究（什么五成四、些微…），而图鉴——影神图，斐然成章，看过那些或喜或悲的小故事后，我总是会再瞧一眼绘图，念一念题头的打油诗，意犹未尽，还有些连载的短篇故事，很逗乐。 在地图和关卡设计，确实能感受到游科有些力不从心。黑猴体量很足，实际惊喜远比PV展示的多。但它给我直观感觉是很多场景虽然很宏大，但也比较空洞。这种感受还不光是说BOSS之间放置的小怪比我想得少，或是偌大的地盘什么都没有，而且还是，我一直有种深深的孤独感。我个人挺不习惯主角是哑巴这点，我玩过的RPG基本是主角遇到死路或者背包满了都要念叨一下的那种hhh，而这里只能看BOSS自言自语。它也不像有些游戏那样，一直有随从或伙伴（二叔别去探路了好吗）。我更习惯路上有些小规模遭遇战，或者插些有趣的解谜推动剧情。对我而言，解谜可以缓和连续战斗的疲惫感。因此，我眼中的黑猴有种魂系列的“高冷”特质，不太习惯，所以没能特别喜爱吧。可毕竟是处女作，决策上考虑精简，像剧情也是突出一种“孤勇者”基调，倒也挺符合首个国产3A的形象。说回地图，本作没有很复杂的机关回路或立体层级，结构较单一。我猜游科没有第一时间做地图可能是觉得没必要，毕竟就那么扁平的几个形状。可对玩家而言，身处这些陌生荒野中心就很容易迷路，因为看不见空气墙会产生景深错觉，又缺少明显的地标或指引。确实，我在第二章就能充分感受到空气墙的存在，明明有路非被拦住，而有些看似没路的地方却有隐藏，因此习惯性贴边试探，地毯式扫图就难免处处碰壁，会有些小不爽，但其实也没太影响我的探索体验，有些合理的墙还是有用。而在缺少参照物的中心区域，再回头都不确定是否来过，迷路更难受。此外，有些岔路缺少差分指引，难以辨明主副线，由于无法SL，只能缩手缩脚地前行。顺便提下某场BOSS战做了三个可选战场，却毫无引导，我不明白用意，要让玩家自己注意就太碰运气了，结果就是白费了设计。 好消息是，最近的大更新增添了地图（还画得很美），改善了上述很多问题。倒不是图上标示得多细，而是有迷雾就能知道还有路，一定程度上让玩家不易错失隐藏，也起到了指南针的作用。大概第四章开始，空气墙的问题淡化，只是后面的关卡逐渐有些缩水，四的体量就挺刚好。可能是工期缘故，终章比较取巧地给玩家个筋斗云去随意探索开放式地图，但因为缺指引而让人很难爽玩。我大多时候只能贴地飞行，寻找哪里有秘密（事实上就…还挺空的），而且地图也没大到可以飞很久，比较遗憾吧。如果要说哪关印象最深，我其实最喜欢浮屠界那段设计，第一次魔音贯耳时看到灯笼鬼好有感觉，瞬间紧张起来了。 战斗挺过瘾，但也有些缺乏重玩的乐趣。本作一个亮点是法术技能很多，都是熟悉的悟空的戏法。【定身】【安身】【禁字】三大奇术，用得好能改变战局。【隐身】和【铜头】两大身法，应对不同BOSS有各自乐趣。【毫毛】能打群架能复活，多周目下猴子猴孙复制技能真帅。最特别是【变身】，没想到总共有10种之多！独立血条和机制，像个中场限时小游戏，BGM也很俏皮。收集的【精魄】还能再提供个瞬发技，可惜很多前摇太长，并不实用（大头yyds）。此外还有隐藏的几样【法宝】，数量不多但个个有妙用，互动性不错。可惜法术毕竟是辅助作用，而大概到中期，该有的技能都有了后，武器类型单一的问题就慢慢凸显，我逐渐开始对频繁与重复的战斗有些烦闷。三种棍式的轻攻击连段好像没区别，劈棍、立棍、戳棍和各自派生在成长初期还是很有意思的，打击感也很好，而到了打BOSS总感觉三板斧。劈棍前摇长，立棍偏AOE，后期感觉还是“劈棍识破（判定有点迷）+棍花攒豆（这个爽！）+闪身凤穿花（瞬发戳）”打BOSS最舒服。套装、葫芦与珍玩效果虽多，但对玩法没有太大影响，因此BD构筑没我预想的那么丰富。技能树末端并没有更帅的新招式机制，后期加点是便利性与数值提升，所以可以理解很多玩家缺少多周目重复游玩的动力。 BOSS设计有好有坏。像虎先锋、毒敌大王就做得很棒，兼顾观赏性和挑战性。BOSS快慢刀还挺多的，而且有些连段数也太多了吧，要一直闪躲没完。有些BOSS会读指令限制某些技能，所以要变换一点打法思路也挺有意思，但也因此限制了多周目下的不同打法选择。有些巨型BOSS的锁定的部位很怪，或是频繁飞天和扭身，常有蓄力砸空的尴尬场面，有点烦。而到了第五章，我感觉难度有些失衡。这一章好几个BOSS的概念设计得相当有趣，但是技能完全构不成威胁，甚至几棒子敲死都来不及见到一些技能，而此前第四章的关底BOSS可是给我不小压力（忘了法宝…），挺可惜美术的，要是再多点时间，可能会呈现出更有趣的技能机制吧。 其实最影响我战斗体验的，是预输入的问题。以前玩别的ACT游戏倒没这个概念，好像搓招都挺顺的，但是黑猴总让我觉得衔接有点卡壳，不清楚是不是输入时间判定有点严格，且后摇过长导致下一指令容易被吞，像有时候明明动作是识破到了，却判定不成功。最无语的是常感觉按了吃药却在发呆，有时又连吃两次，导致要习惯确认上个动作完全结束再按。不过高手们熟悉了这套闪避的逻辑，再配合不空的躲闪，操作起来也是能行云流水。总体游戏难度不算高，多死几次背板也过了，比较照顾那些喜爱西游记但很少接触游戏的受众群，倒是小心有些BOSS血少时会增加攻击欲望与变招。而高周目与不久前新增的【连战】玩法，就很适合想要挑战自己上限的玩家。 最后提下剧情方面。如标题的“黑”，本作选择了一种黑暗的世界观作为改编续作，我个人不太喜欢这种故事主调，由于前面提到的“空洞”感，全程玩下来还挺压抑的，到最后才有一些高光，然后就完了。另外，天命人不说话，本作叙事又比较零碎和谜语人，细节就要靠图鉴的文字来拼凑，而全部读过去挖线索挺累人的，且仍要脑补。所以别说老外，可能很多国人都一头雾水，这里大致记录下。 [spoiler]在这个弱肉强食的世界，金字塔顶端的神佛掌控着“长生”，剥削着下界生灵跪拜上贡。西行后的悟空正是看透了这虚伪与不公，主动辞去果位。可否定神佛势必要受制裁，或许悟空知道自己势单力薄，逃不了宿命，干脆用性命作为赌注，分离为六样根器。他的死，给妖怪们提了个醒——成佛救不了自己。于是神佛为了维护自身正确性，只能谎称悟空可以复活，顺应天命人计划，实际要让天命人困在循环或是再度洗脑成为斗战胜佛。而悟空正需要借此让后辈寻回六根，继承他的意志。恰恰是在一遭遭寻觅妖王的艰辛路途中，天命人见过生灵涂炭的众生相，才能看透神佛体制的黑暗，最后从那个看不懂悟空，一直等待答案的杨戬手中取回最后的真“意”，彻底脱胎换骨成为新的大圣，而不是沦为神佛的工具。正所谓“以肉身之死，换意念永续”，命只有一条，精神可以不断传承，而这求真之路上数不尽的天命人或许就是玩家你我，我们都是传火者，就像游科拿起了国产单机的接力棒，相信后继有人，总有一天，星火可以燎原。值得一提的是前不久官方（黄成希老师）给出第五章的解读是“中年人的伤痛”，我表示能理解，这样套到每一章确实都说得通，迷茫、欲望、爱情……只不过对于大部分受众是否显得有点沉重了…… [/spoiler]希望续作的叙事和立意能更鲜活明快一些吧。 综上，虽有些遗憾，但黑神话的品质足以跻身世界舞台，它无疑是中国单机史上一个意义非凡的里程碑。不过也正因为天时地利人和，吃到了IP红利，本作才能如此破圈。希望游科真的开了个好头，让更多人能抓住机遇，带来更多精彩、有价值的作品，也让一些人明白，或许游戏并非他们口中令人玩物丧志的电子海洛因，而是真正能弘扬文化，传递精神，令我们骄傲的第九艺术。

贰零贰伍年壹月贰拾柒日晚壹拾点壹拾玖分，一周目通关听完未竟退出游戏，居然赶在了蛇年春节前是我没想到的，作为一个经常加班的打工猴，抱着多死几次，菜也能过的心态，本来准备一周目就慢慢打个一年也无妨。写到这里，回去看了二零年的预告，那一年对我来说是及其难熬的一年，但游科坚持下来了，我也坚持下来了。预告带来的希望在四年后如约变成了现实，尽管这不是一个十全十美的作品，但它却以近乎完美的方式圆了我这一代许多中国玩家曾经的一个梦，我感觉我们真是太幸运，太幸福了。除了一些仍需进行的捉虫工作，这个作品我无可挑剔，无论玩法剧情美术音效。谢谢所有参与制作的工作人员，雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越，我不是想催资料片，是告诉自己准备进二周目刷全成就了。再过一会就是除夕，一早还得去值班，但是提前祝各位，事事如意，阖家安康，蛇年大吉！

在中国游戏的发展中有很多个可以被拿出来说成是里程碑的作品，但是其中许多的含金量都是可以被讨论的，但是对于这个游戏来说，里程碑一词可谓是名副其实，黑猴对于中国游戏，乃至世界游戏来说都是一个无可争议的里程碑式的作品，它绝对是你能玩到的最优质的动作类RPG游戏之一。话虽然这么说了，但是这个游戏完美吗？答案必然是否定的。 首先来讲讲场景的问题。在主创在TGA颁奖的时候也嘲讽了自己在游戏中放置了太多空气墙的事实，很明显他们自己也知道这是个很明显的问题，本人也算是一个有点资历的动作类RPG玩家了。从最早的老滚五到巫师三，再到所有魂游加环，我玩过的所有游戏里没有一个游戏的场景里能放这么多空气墙的，而由于场景的贴图有时候又过于真实且具有美感，空气墙在游戏过程中经常会打断我在欣赏这个美轮美奂的世界时的心流。 在这里既然说到场景了那再讲讲地图设计吧，我非常喜欢前四章的地图，尤其是黑风山和紫云山这两座山，场景做得美极了，紫云山做得比现实中北京香山红叶还好看许多倍，黄风岭的设计也是颇有巧思（除了那个把挂饰放在下滑道上面的操作，我滑了整整五次啊五次），但是到了火焰山尤其是花果山时情况就不一样了，主要是花果山，这个地图真的超级大，但是也就只有大了，整个地图大部分地区都是空的，非常非常的空，打完王灵官之后我都不知道我要去干嘛，一开始就迷迷糊糊的撞到了水帘洞那里，但是因为没把大圣套收集完所以没能触发剧情，卡着了，在网上搜了攻略才知道这一关要先收集大圣套，体验确实不好，但除了花果山外其他地图我都比较满意，在虚幻五的加持下游戏的画面质感极其出色。 其次是战斗的预输入问题。在如今白金游戏之后再回过头来看这一点其实也能理解，毕竟这个从斗战神一路走到现在的团队即便吸收再多的人才也不太可能在制作第一部大作时就能做出一套近乎完美的动作系统，没有办法跟卡婊光荣这些真·老牌动作游戏厂商相比，这个不是靠团队努力堆料能简单解决的，这需要大量的动作游戏经验。黑神话的预输入问题在最开始的几个小时里深深地困扰了我，第一个感受就是我按了闪避，我按了喝药，但是我为什么就是喝不出来，就是躲不了，后来在网上交流后才知道是游戏的预输入问题，预输入缓冲期窗口短的问题经常让我在打BOSS甚至打小怪时感到红温，而不同的BOSS之间的体型和动作有可谓是天差地别，在大更新前黑猴的不少大体型boss的hitbox有明显的问题，空气保险杠经常会被角色给挤到一边去打不到，伤害判定也有问题，要是想打到网上各种无伤视频的程度，需要练习的量是非常大的，门槛也是很高的，这需要对每一个boss的技能和伤害判定机制都了如指掌，这显然不是一个优秀的动作系统该让玩家有的体验。不过也好在这个游戏除了基础的棍式系统外还有各种变身技和丹药来辅助，并不是以折磨人为目的来设计的，希望游科团队能在未来的游戏里做出更好的动作系统。 这篇评测大部分内容都讲的是黑猴的缺点，但是这丝毫不影响它是一款佳作，因为只有一款佳作才能让我以这种方式去给它挑毛病，当它能让我抛开以往我看国产游戏的滤镜，以这种略微挑剔的眼光去找毛病时，这个游戏就已经成功了。我玩了很多的游戏，玩了很多的国产游戏，其中也不乏仙剑系列这样的，比较传统的国产大型游戏，我会因他们的国产身份而去掏钱支持，但是鲜少能让我真正满意，而在2024年8月20日，当我打开了期待已久的黑猴时，一个少年的梦想真的成真了。

So basically, Black Myth Wukong is a souls-like boss rush game. At first I was kinda let down that this isn't a normal game, or even a normal souls-like. I felt like my "stamina" would drain after encountering so many bosses that need a lot of focus to beat. But oh boy was I mistaken? I never put the controller down due to tiresome, I was always coming back until I beat that freaking blue huge headed dude. The reason for that is creativity, and fair challenge. It never felt unfair to fight an enemy, no matter how much stronger he was. The world building and storytelling, along with some of the best and most interesting boss designs in gaming ever will make you to never want to quit. The game is linear with a lot of secrets to uncover per map, it never feels limited or empty, a new challenge always awaits in every corner. Developers seemed to know and understand what players truly want, this becomes even more apparent on the final battle of the true ending. There isn't a simple way to explain Wukong, the game has incredible depth in every aspect, that it would took me a lot of time to go into detail for each one of them, so just like I do with all my recent reviews, I will start pointing the pros and cons of it, to keep the review as readable as it can be. Great game, interesting lore and fun combat. The combat system is like a mix between ghost of tsushima, dark souls and sekiro. There are lots of bosses, the combat is fun and the scenery is quite beautiful. I really liked the animations at the end of each chapter, they were amazingly animated and interesting. Baiji is quite a fun character, made me laugh a couple times and overall the games lore and characters are deep and nuanced due to being an adaptation of Journey to the West. Now I'm going to complain. (Spoilers below, kinda) I have a relatively modern system, with a 1660 Ti GPU and i7-9750H CPU however this game has just been horribly optimised. Anything under the top of the line hardware won't deliver the beautiful graphics that Wukong seems to be known and praised for. I was still able to enjoy beautiful scenery, but rarely. The majority of the gameplay, especially the start is constantly blurry and my system can only really handle low/med graphics. The lighting is also absolutely horrible for this game, it's just glaring all the time and switches between shadow and light are jarring, especially in chapter 3, you just have to ignore all the surroundings when moving anywhere. There was also a bunch of micro stutters/freezes during combat. Swinging your staff/weapon does this weird sort of after image / screen tear. I don't really like their combat and leveling system, there's basically zero incentive to switch stances since you can save points and level up elsewhere. The spells were also quite limited and a bit boring after a while, two are just buffs, immobilise is fun but gets old, and I guess rock was my favourite since it provides a simple parry mechanic. Transformations had a bit more variety, but made combat feel more clunky, and I rarely used them because of the cooldown and how much points you need to invest in them. Invisible walls absolutely everywhere, quite jarring and immersion breaking, just annoying, natural barriers would've been much better. Chapter 6 was open world, but it was a poor choice, there's just a bunch of open land that chews up time and is pointless to explore. Personal preference but, there's a ton of weapons locked behind NG+, I rarely do NG+ for games so bit annoying that I couldn't use these. Mute protagonist, Baiji makes up for this, but it would've been even more entertaining to play as Sun Wukong. Kind of criticism, idk. From a gameplay aspect this game is not very original, but even for the most basic things. Like the narrow interactive entrances to squeeze through (tomb raider, etc.) ?why?, The chests (seemingly God of war) , the meditation points (ghost of tsushima) and they choose the worst most uninteresting angles to show off@!! Convoluted npcs and questlines (dark souls, etc.), loong scales are so well hidden, you need a guide to find (or maybe an NPC says something, but still).

黑神话悟空：国产游戏的高光时刻 《黑神话：悟空》自上线以来，在游戏界掀起了一阵热潮，收获了海量好评，一跃成为国产游戏的杰出代表。 游戏以中国古典名著《西游记》为蓝本，构建出一个充满奇幻色彩的东方神话世界，让玩家得以沉浸式体验独特的东方文化魅力。从云雾缭绕的花果山，到神秘莫测的地府，再到庄严肃穆的雷音寺，每一处场景都细腻还原，中国传统建筑、山水风光以及神话元素交织其中，浓郁的国风扑面而来。 在战斗系统方面，《黑神话：悟空》的表现堪称惊艳。玩家能操控悟空施展七十二变，金箍棒挥舞间，行云流水的连招与打击感十足的特效，带来酣畅淋漓的战斗体验。面对各类形态各异的妖怪，玩家需要灵活运用策略与技能，见招拆招，使每一场战斗都充满了挑战与惊喜。像与黄风岭虎先锋的对决，其敏捷的身手和独特的攻击方式，迫使玩家全神贯注，在紧张刺激的战斗中感受斗智斗勇的快感。 剧情设计同样是游戏的一大亮点，它在尊重原著的基础上进行大胆创新，通过全新的视角和叙事方式，讲述了一个不一样的西游故事。玩家在冒险途中，不仅能与熟悉的角色重逢，还能挖掘出隐藏在背后的神秘故事，一步步揭开神话背后的真相，这种深度的剧情体验让玩家沉浸其中，欲罢不能。 从数据来看，《黑神话：悟空》在Steam平台上好评如潮，评测总数突破100万条，好评率高达96% 。其中简体中文区的好评率更是达到97%，在全球23个语言区的评论中，有18个语言区好评率超90% 。许多玩家称赞游戏画面精美，战斗系统流畅，文化内涵深厚，认为它是国产游戏的骄傲，甚至在国际上也足以与众多知名3A大作相媲美。 《黑神话：悟空》的成功，不仅在于它为玩家带来了一款高品质的游戏，更在于它向世界展示了中国游戏产业的崛起，以及中国传统文化的独特魅力。它为国产游戏的发展开辟了新的道路，激励着更多开发者投身于文化传承与创新的游戏创作中 。

Though I wish there was a parry mechanic alongside the dodge. Which has it's own playstyle centered around it. Transformations are fun. Though I stuck with 3 throughout my whole playthrough. First the fire wolf, then the ice monkey and finally the stone monkey. Because they were easy to use, fast and strong. the rest felt too clunky to control. Spells are fun. Though I wish there was a way to spam them. Makes combat more fun. As most fights involved mashing X, dodging while using spells strategically. Which is probably great for spell binder users. Knowing some JTTW lore, this game pays such amazing homage. Some bosses are a treat. All in all, A GOTY. Should have been GOTY of 2024 in every show. And I hope it gets a sequel or DLC in the past. Or something. A must try for anyone who enjoyed elden ring, or fast paced action games like DMC.

I 100 % recommend this game. The game was made with love from the developers, and you can definitely tell from playing the game. But I do have some criticism: The game does tend to drag on. Chapter 3 in particular was a slog to get through after a certain point. It started to kill the momentum of the game for me. But the boss quality was amazing. However, after chapter 5, the quality of the bosses starts to derail. A lot of them include artificial difficulties instead of "being fun". Bosses have mandatory unskippable cutscenes in the middle of fights, ridiculous mechanics on top of it being plainly difficult etc. Another criticism is the performance. There are countless stutters in the game, and it gets in the way during combat. When you do a perfect dodge for the first time, it stutters. When you do any skills for the first time, it stutters. Any new boss mechanics, it stutters. And it becomes the main reason why I died a lot. Maybe this is my PC, but I do see stutters on the PS5 as well. All the negatives aside, the game is stunning, and the bosses are just amazing (besides the last few). I'm looking forward to what the developers can make in the future. There is a great game underneath these issues.

Story: Wukong's story is based on the classic Chinese novel "Journey to the West," but offers its own interpretation. We play as the legendary Monkey King, Sun Wukong, who strives for power and immortality. While the plot is familiar to many, it's presented with interesting twists and new characters. However, the narrative isn't always smooth, feeling drawn out in places and jumping between events too quickly at others. Overall, the story is decent, especially for those unfamiliar with the source material, but sometimes lacks the epic scope and depth expected from a tale about such a legendary figure. Graphics: Visually, Wukong looks respectable. Colorful locations, detailed character models, and spell effects create a pleasing image. The environment design, inspired by Chinese mythology, is particularly impressive. From majestic celestial palaces to dark and gloomy caves, each location has its own unique style. Despite the overall high quality of the graphics, there are minor optimization issues. Gameplay: Wukong is an action RPG with a dynamic combat system. We have access to various attacks, combos, and magical abilities. The battles are quite spectacular and intense, but sometimes lack precision in controls. Occasionally, the camera obstructs the view, and the targeting system doesn't always work correctly. In addition to combat, the game features platforming and puzzle elements that diversify the gameplay. Detail: The developers paid attention to detail, which positively affects the game's atmosphere. Whether it's the ornaments on the characters' clothes, the architecture of buildings, or the flora and fauna of the environment, everything is crafted with a sufficient degree of detail. This adds extra charm to the game and allows for deeper immersion in the world of Chinese mythology. However, the level of detail isn't always consistent, and some locations reveal underdeveloped textures or simplified models. Finally:I personally liked the game very much, it is easy to play, pleasant views.Good music and interesting stories!

Easy 9/10. This is one of my favorite games of all time, but there's definitely some issues. The presentation is perfect- incredible visuals, animations, music, and story. As someone who grew up watching Journey to the West (1986), I believe this is a near-perfect tribute to the series, although there were a couple issues I had with it. The gameplay is solid, and I especially liked the skill tree and spells system they implemented. It's definitely a difficult game, but I don't think it's as difficult as games like Dark Souls or Elden Ring. The spells accommodated for my skill issue in many cases. That being said, I do have a few issues. - Outside the bosses, the game is not particularly exciting for the most part. You will rarely find yourself dying from non-boss enemies. - Many people already complain about invisible walls, and while I wasn't THAT annoyed by them, I still think it's a terrible design considering the amount of secrets in this game that required you to explore. There's so many times where I was deterred from exploring because I thought I might run into an invisible wall. - Finally, I feel like many people won't be able to experience this game to the fullest because they don't know the source material. The story in this game is easy enough to understand, but there's just so much connections to the original series that people who do not know the original story will just miss out on. Maybe that's just me though TL;DR Monke game cool, monke game not perfect EDIT: After nearly 100 more hours of this game, got some more stuff I want to add - The combat system can get very repetitive. The spells are very limited in battle because of the mana cost, and stances honestly don't matter enough for it to stay interesting. The skill tree unfortunately doesn't offer much new attacks that changes up the gameplay. I think this game would really benefit from having a posture system. - The boss designs can be very annoying as they are more gimmicky than many souslike bosses. For example, a boss will reduce the size of the battle area and summon a permanent tornado that will launch you into the air. I view this as a way for them to counter the spells the player is given, though I feel many players (myself included) will find it unfair regardless. Most boss movesets aren't too complicated, and a large portion of the difficulty comes from these gimmicks.

Even though the quality of the game can be very inconsistent at times the highs are still some of the most cathartic experiences you'll find in gaming with a shockingly decent combat system + an impressive yet unimpressive roster of bosses Combat Wukong's combat is definitely one of if not THE selling point of the game with a plethora of different ways of engaging enemies and bosses in turn shooting up its replayability. The way the three stances are incorporated here also feels very fleshed out (unlike Nioh) adding a ton of variety to the overall combat. Depending on the skill level of the player it can be the jankiest thing on the planet or it can be ridiculously snappy and responsive. But all of that means absolutely nothing if the enemy design doesn't live up to the system since it IS reaction focused after all. Well does it? Bosses The quality of the bosses here is infuriatingly inconsistent. You'll find some of the best fights ever made with competently designed movesets that will make your jaw drop to the floor and then you'll be forced to sit through literal fodders with boss hp or cinematic slop for HOURS at a time. The amount of mediocrity present here is what holds me back from flat out saying "yeah the bosses are good" which irks me a bit because this game has some of my all time favorite fights even though they're in the minority Level Design This is straight up the weakest aspect of the game with literal Team Ninja esque level design for the most part. Navigating through all the convoluted mess of levels without a guide is a literal waste of time and effort since everything quite literally looks exactly the same with pissant weak fodders randomly placed here and there. Chapter 6 was the nail in the coffin for me, they quite literally gave up and made Elden Ring without the legacy dungeons lol Balancing This game has some major balancing issues. The difficulty of the game can easily be diluted through the plethora of ridiculously cheesy builds or by straight up overleveling the bosses to hell and back. Whoever claims this game isn't a soulslike is straight up delusional because like every other soulslikes out there Wukong also falls into the same exact trap Presentation A huge chunk of the budget went into the presentation of the story alone and it shows. There are a ridiculous amount of cutscenes and every single chapter ends with a traditionally animated short film. With all this emphasis on the game constantly trying to be cinematic I can't blame people for thinking this is a movie game but that really doesn't do the game justice because the amount of mechanical depth present here is genuinely impressive I can only recommend this game to you if you have the patience to sit through hours of mediocrity to get to those really good bits that make you go "Worth it"

画面如梦似幻，仿佛置身神魔交织的奇境；剧情跌宕起伏，如诗般流转，让人沉浸其间。每一场战斗，皆如鸿蒙初开，激荡心弦；角色设计，精妙绝伦，仿佛生灵重现。那古韵悠长的音乐，仿若天籁之音，伴随每一次冒险与探索。

不是特别推荐（7分） 前三章没话说，美术音乐剧情都做的无可挑剔，大量的新内容让人停不下来，而且场景，支线和boss的设计我个人感觉很独特 后三章纯一坨，赶工痕迹明显，剧情就不谈了草草收场，那场景感觉就是从素材库里复制粘贴过来的，最重要的是视角，判定和空气墙问题十分明显（比如能在百眼魔君boss面前放个空气墙真是没谁了） 玩完黑神话我就知道国内不仅跟风狗多，而且大伙儿对中国游戏公司的包容度是不是太大了。游科从一开始发售到现在近半年时间，受人诟病的锁定视角定位混乱//大型boss脚下设置空气墙//各种无敌帧出手等最基本的问题不解决，反而疯狂出周边捞钱真的让人挺无语。 最后说一句给不推荐我不是见不得国产游戏好，而是希望国内游戏公司能认识到自己的不足加以改进，从而越走越远

《黑神话：悟空》是一款备受瞩目的动作角色扮演游戏，玩了200小时想必你对它有了极为深入的体验。以下从多个方面为你生成评价： 画面表现 《黑神话：悟空》的画面堪称惊艳。从云雾缭绕的崇山峻岭到细节满满的亭台楼阁，场景构建细腻逼真，极具东方奇幻色彩。游戏中的光影效果运用精妙，不同时段的光线变化会给场景带来截然不同的氛围，如清晨阳光洒在山林间的柔和，傍晚夕阳余晖下的壮丽，都让人仿佛置身于真实的神话世界。角色建模更是精细入微，悟空的每一个毛发、服饰纹理都清晰可见，妖怪们也各具特色，形态和动作都符合其在神话中的设定，极大地增强了游戏的沉浸感。 玩法设计 战斗系统是游戏的一大亮点。悟空的技能丰富多样，近战连招流畅且富有打击感，同时还能结合金箍棒的变化和法术，衍生出多种战斗策略。比如在面对不同类型的妖怪时，既可以选择强攻压制，也能利用环境和技能特性进行智取。游戏中的解谜元素与场景和剧情紧密结合，不是简单的为解谜而解谜，而是需要玩家观察环境、理解剧情来找到线索，增加了游戏的趣味性和探索性。此外，多样化的支线任务和隐藏要素，也让游戏的可玩度大大提升，每一次探索都可能有新的发现。 剧情故事 游戏以中国传统神话《西游记》为蓝本，却又进行了大胆创新。主线剧情紧凑且富有悬念，在保留经典元素的同时，为玩家呈现了一个不一样的西游世界。通过与各种角色的对话和任务，逐渐揭开背后隐藏的故事，让玩家感受到神话故事的厚重与神秘。剧情中的人物刻画立体，悟空的成长历程、妖怪们的悲欢离合都展现得淋漓尽致，使玩家在游戏过程中能够产生强烈的情感共鸣。 音效配乐 音效方面，游戏对各种声音的处理十分到位。金箍棒挥舞时的风声、与妖怪战斗时的碰撞声、环境中的虫鸣鸟叫等，都让游戏世界更加生动。配乐更是一绝，采用了大量的中国传统乐器，旋律优美且贴合场景氛围。在战斗时激昂的曲调能让人热血沸腾，而在探索静谧场景时悠扬的音乐又能让人放松身心，进一步增强了游戏的代入感。 优化与性能 尽管游戏画面精美，但在优化方面也下了不少功夫。在中高端配置下，能够流畅运行，保证了游戏体验的连贯性。不过，在一些复杂场景或大规模战斗中，偶尔还是会出现轻微的掉帧现象，但整体影响不大。同时，游戏的加载速度较快，减少了玩家等待的时间，让游戏过程更加顺畅。 总体而言，《黑神话：悟空》是一款兼具高品质画面、丰富玩法、精彩剧情和出色音效的优秀游戏。它以独特的东方神话视角，为玩家带来了一场难忘的冒险之旅，无论是对神话故事感兴趣的玩家，还是喜欢动作角色扮演游戏的玩家，都能在其中找到乐趣。

Monke of 2024! To be fair, as a first start for a small dev team, Black Myth: Wukong is a massive success. The game not only deliver a different take on the souls-like genre, but also being authentic and consistent. In my personal opinion, I still prefer the flashy and awesome effects that Elden Ring has to offer. But Black Myth: Wukong gives the simplistic vibe of early Dark Souls. Following the after story of Journey to the West, Black Myth: Wukong takes the story to fight Chinese mythological beasts and demigods alike (no, I haven't finished the game yet). I feel like the game is focusing more on the fun of challenging encounters like fighting bosses, which is a lot of people, including me, very much enjoy. Since the small mobs are just so plain and easy to be taken down thus the game is less grindy than souls-like. Not only that, probably the BEST thing about Black Myth: Wukong is that there is no "loss after death" system like in other souls-like games. Every battle, every fight, every engagement is to hone your skills and upgrade the level, unlocking new ways, new tactics, new approach to fight enemies. VERDICT: If you're a no fan of dying too many times, then don't even bother looking. Like seriously, that is the definition of "souls-like" genre, go get Assassin's Creed instead. Look, I wasn't a souls-like enjoyer either before, but here I am. Anyways, if you want to experience the authentic Chinese mythological beasts and lore and fight them at that! Then Black Myth: Wukong is definitely a MUST TRY.

I’ll be honest – trying to understand the story in Black Myth: Wukong felt like deciphering ancient scrolls… in the dark… while blindfolded. But let’s be real: who plays a game like this for clarity? We’re here for the epic boss fights, the jaw-dropping visuals, and the adrenaline rush of surviving battles that make you feel like a god. And in that regard, the game absolutely delivers. The combat is tight, satisfying, and a blast even for someone like me who’s no stranger to these types of games. It’s challenging but not overly hard – if you enjoy this kind of difficulty, you’ll feel right at home. The graphics? They’re the kind that make you stop mid-fight just to admire the scenery (and then promptly die because you weren’t paying attention). That said, not everything is as legendary as Wukong himself. Invisible level boundaries? Really? Nothing kills immersion faster than smashing into an invisible wall like some kind of monkey-shaped Roomba. And don’t even get me started on the final chapter – if you’ve played it, you know exactly what I mean. Let’s just say it was a swing… and a miss. Still, flaws and all, I’d give the game a solid 87%. It’s chaotic, gorgeous, and insanely fun – even if the story leaves you scratching your head. Grab your staff, embrace the madness, and enjoy the ride!

这是一款极具影响力的游戏，具有多方面的显著特点和价值。 从文化角度看，它以《西游记》为背景，深入挖掘并创新呈现西游文化，让古老的故事焕发出新的生命力，向世界展示了中国文化的魅力，如对孙悟空形象的全新塑造，使其更加立体、丰满，有血有肉，不再只是单一的英雄符号，能让玩家产生共鸣。 在技术层面，它取得了重大突破，作为中国首款 3A 游戏，其画面质量、特效等都达到了较高水准，为玩家带来了震撼的视觉体验，比如精美的场景构建、细腻的角色动作等。 当然，它也为中国游戏行业树立了一个里程碑，让人们看到了国产游戏在技术、文化内涵和商业运作上的巨大潜力，为其他游戏开发者提供了借鉴和榜样，推动整个行业朝着更加多元化和高质量的方向发展。但与国外一些顶尖的 3A 大作相比，可能在某些方面仍有进步空间。总体而言，《黑神话：悟空》是一款具有深远意义和价值的优秀游戏作品。

As someone that got all 81 achievements on this game, I can give it an 8/10. Game has amazing soundtrack and the combat gameplay feels amazing with a wide variety of options. Being able to restore your points and change our build anytime is a differential, coming from an Soulslike background, I think this adds a lot more fun into the gameplay and was a good decision. The only things that were a bit of a turnoff, were that the maps seem too confusing, and you can easily get lost on them. I got lost on chapter 2, kept fighting enemies that were on my way, and ended up being overleveled for the rest of the playthrough, which lowered it's difficulty for me. The other thing that bothered me is that some bosses seem to be too difficult for the area they are in. You have and easy time with all bosses until a specific one takes you 10-15 attempts to beat, out of nowhere. The level design seems to be a bit unsynchronized. Also have to mention that some items have a very low % chance of dropping, so you need to farm dozens of plants, and they take 30min of real time to respawn. Farming items from enemies is similarly boring, but you can get items that increase drop rates, buit this last one was for the 100% run only. Another thing that I need to mention is that it lags a lot, even setting the graphics to low. My PC was able to play Cyberpunk and Elden Ring with minimal lags, but this game lagged too much.A lot of the cutscenes were lagging, having audio but trapped on the same screen, or playing out with the audio delayed. If they optimize the lags, it's a 9/10. Now I will probably be buying some books from Journey to the West, because it was a bit hard to understand the story without having any previous background with it.

Black Myth: Wukong is more than just a game, it’s an experience that stays with you long after you’ve put down the controller. From the moment I started, I was captivated by its stunning visuals, challenging combat, and the rich world it creates, steeped in Chinese mythology. The gameplay is intense and rewarding. Every fight feels meaningful, requiring patience and strategy, and the boss battles are on another level. I loved how the game balances moments of high-stakes combat with quieter, reflective exploration it gives you time to soak in the incredible atmosphere. But what truly blew me away was the story. It’s emotional, layered, and beautifully told, with a depth that makes you care deeply about the journey and the characters you encounter along the way. The final cutscene, especially, hit me hard, it was the perfect culmination of everything the game had built up to. And then there’s the art. This game is a masterpiece in terms of design. Every detail, from the environments to the creatures, feels alive and meticulously crafted. Pair that with a hauntingly beautiful soundtrack, and you’ve got a game that fully immerses you in its world. Is it perfect? Maybe not there are some difficulty spikes and minor quirks, but honestly, they’re part of what makes this game so memorable. It doesn’t hold your hand, and that’s exactly why the victories feel so satisfying. If you’re even remotely interested in action games or mythology, this is a must-play. Black Myth: Wukong isn’t just a game, it’s a legend in the making.

Perfect fighting game, 10/10. It's a work of art and love. One of the best games i played in the last years. i had 50 hrs of pure joy for my first playtrough. Game is massive and the exploration of the world feels so rewarding. Each of the 6 "levels / worlds" you visit looks stunning. combat feels perfectly smooth. You meet a lot of cool character that all resemble different animals. Gameplay loop is so addictive and it was hard for me to put the game down. Also, when i was not playing, i was thinking a lot about this game and was looking forward to the next evening when i was able to play again. Game has about 80-90 bosses. And the dont have those ?????? delayed attacks (looking at you, Elden ring! ) I really enjoyed every single boss and the designs and attack patterns are really cool. Some bosses have an outstanding and memorable design. I really enjoy soulslikes and for me this game was a bit too easy. BUT in chapter 4 it has a huge spike in difficulty. I stuggled with 3 optional bosses that each took me about 1-2 hrs of practicing. The secret optional final boss took me about 3 hrs of practicing. Since i was was breezing through the game, i really enjoyed that it got so much harder at the end. Many people were complaining that the game is TOO hard, But if you explore every corner of the map, do all quests (i recomment watching the guide from Legacy gaming for finding all the secrets in every chapter) and kill every enemy, your level and equipment should be enough to not struggle with most of the bosses. They added a challenge mode where you can replay all bosses or fight them in different gauntlets. The gauntlets are very hard tho. Also, Ng+ has a lot of different gear you can unlock. I will definitely replay the game after some time. This is the standard i want all games to have. Im glad i bought the game for the full price. Im definitely going to preorder the DLC whenever it's ready.

《黑神话悟空》在游戏届奥斯卡TGA上，获得最佳动作游戏奖，实至名归。值得一提，黑猴是首款入围TGA的国产3A大型游戏，取得了历史性突破，全球销量已近3000万份，此外还获2024金摇杆奖等奖项，对于国内玩家和厂商是欢欣鼓舞的成就。 遗憾未获本年度最佳游戏大奖，毕竟是为金主庆生30周年道理我懂，我不懂的是却颁给了??《宇宙机器人》??，可谓是三英战吕布，结果马赢了，赢麻了，这样的袈裟不披也罢！直接证明西方忌惮一款中国游戏在全球游戏界留下印记，害怕它比其他游戏获得更多的关注。 从小看西游记长大，孙悟空就是心目中超级英雄，扮演他来对抗神魔，这一天终于等到了，游戏中有不同的棍法，战斗选择多样，还可使用秘术、变身等法术，东方神秘元素加满，战的痛快。有个角色印象很深刻，四妹[害羞]一句:臭猴子，这山岭外的世界，究竟是什么样的？被感动了，好想带她去看看，可惜被可恶的鹤仙人带走了。 开发厂商 游戏科学没有迎合西方政治正确，不受其左右，自主开发制作，中国的神话只有国人才懂得其中的奥秘、情怀、内涵。黑猴未发售前，海外一直以为孙悟空是日本的，龙珠影响力很大，自此才知道来自中国的奇幻名著西游记中的人物。当今文化传播影响力不及韩国和日本，传播阻力是有的，西方媒体刻意制造虚假宣传丑化中国，邪恶的刻板印象依然存在，不过海外民众还是知道好东西和正确审美，玩的人都赞叹不已，自有大儒为我们辨经。 游戏是可以让远隔万里之遥的人们，最简单最直接体验到神秘国度文化风采，潜移默化的感受文化底蕴和价值观，国家也意识到这一理念，大力度去扶持，成功吸引到大量海外玩家，为我们优秀中华文化出海提供了机遇。 在这个《黑神话悟空》第九艺术中，看到了音乐、建筑、文学、绘画等其他八大艺术的合集，文化之桥让世界走来，让世界看到中国游戏的风采，中国故事的精彩，文化输出的西游路被天命人走通了，让未竟之路有了无限可能。

来说说缺点，首先我认为黑猴的打斗还是很有意思的，可以说是优秀，那些花里胡哨的招式玩不来是我的问题，但是我觉得它的缺点在于没有创新出自己的东西，没有足够新颖的战斗系统，有些boss的战斗体验也是依托，点名亢金龙王灵官步云鹿和究极构式的大石敢当，我点名这些不代表只有这些，只是这些比较印象深刻，小怪恶心的也有，第三章在楼梯口埋伏你的国服盲僧，在雪僵堆里突然暴起来一刀的阴逼，死了都能再挥两刀的亡语大王和一棵珞珈香藤旁能守两个的小王灵官，会飞带控还能接combo，第五章里的双boss挺有意思，但是那个从路边跳出来爆炸的实在搞人心态；再一个是场景体验，空气墙和没地图老生常谈了，这俩其实是一个问题，现在地图已经加上去了，但我也实打实被折磨完了，我曾以为第三章的坐牢已经很折磨了，第四章的盘丝洞给我狠狠上了节课，走到堕龙壁的时候我感觉自己san值快掉光了，你们懂那种在三岔路口不得不和虫子打一架结果打完发现忘了该走哪的那种感觉吗？五六章的地图可以用敷衍来概括，加起来都没小雷音寺量大。杨戬的战斗体验很不错，但是麻烦你告诉我为毛二郎神的法天象地是狮子？再来说说剧情：前三章加上那些小毛病我都觉得有9.2分以上，加上扣除剧情的后三章我觉得仍有至少8.5，但是加上那沟槽的剧情只能再8分上下了，这还是我综合了那些写的很好的妖怪背景小故事的基础上，为什么？首先，你宣传打着尊重原著的旗号，结果搞的是斗战神那套黑深残阴谋论，我不是说黑深残搞不来，但你至少逻辑得自洽，挖坑挖得爽，到了该填的时候烂了，你前面搞得那么黑那么残，到了结尾却没有深，从剧情里只能解读出大家都不是什么好东西这种摆烂式结论；其次，你阴谋论可以，但有两点是原则，一个是猴哥的伟光正形象，一个是西行取经的意义，这个西游世界再黑猴哥也得是白的，你看你写的什么够吧，为了编制背刺兄弟和爱人，爱的还是原著里猴子可以说是最恨也不为过的白骨精，亲口否认西行的意义，然后像个小丑一样被打死，装模做样弄个局，其实意义在哪都不知道，死后的遗物还祸害世间，这是悟空吗？还是说你们尊重的原著是斗战神？举国之力捧了一个中年伤痕文学作品真是搞笑 内容绝对是值回票价，量大管饱。 目前我认为主要问题集中在地图设计上，以下是我对于地图设计一点问题： 1、地图设计这块空气墙有点多了，部分给人感觉可以跳上去的石块或者平台无法跳上去，这点比较反直觉。 2、跟小怪的打斗在边缘的时候居然会掉落，这个很影响战斗体验。 3、地图太大了，而且密密麻麻的分布了各种粪怪时不时给你来一下（这里点名批评石头人），导致我探索地图收到的正反馈很少。 4、第六章地图过于马虎了，第六章地图太大，但是空有其形，里面几乎没什么内容，跟前几张比简直灾难。 5、新给的地图里面这么多不明所以的佛像之类的标注，但是去到之后居然只是简单的一个场景，没有特殊互动这个有点失望。 6、我个人使用的是A卡，不知道是不是适配有问题，进出山洞的光影切换很有问题，过度太突然，建议检查下场景内的灯逻辑 但是场景确实很美。 战斗方面没什么好说的，确实是打的畅快。但是闪身在前期还是过于强了，相比其他的游戏闪身的气力惩罚不够。 剧情方面，我个人建议是对于主线剧情可以附上西游记的原文相关信息，可能对于老外或者没有阅读过原著的朋友会比较友好。总体来说，剧情设计的是相当优秀的，补足了原著的部分情节想象，同时也是从另外一个方面看西游记，真是够黑哈哈。 希望后续DLC和其他作品再接再厉

These are my initial thoughts and if I ever pick the game up again, I might revise my review. I have seen a lot of hype behind this game, and to be quite frank I just don't get it. I have always been a big fan of souls games (over 3k hours in total on DS3 alone). Sekiro did not really vibe with me because I did not like the singular strategy of "throw firecrackers and spam until the boss dies" and this game feels very similar in terms of how to actually go about fighting bosses. Now if you really enjoyed Sekiro, then I'm sure you'd probably enjoy this game. I played the first little bit of the game and quickly became disinterested when I was met with a skill tree to level up various combos, which I wanted to fall asleep upon seeing for the first time. I admit it is a beautiful game and a great idea, but I think the execution of it was simply lazy as there could've been genuine buildcrafting rather than just spamming the same button over and over again until the boss dies. Ultimately I am very disappointed in this game as I had high hopes for it. Visuals I'd give it a 9/10 only because they could've chosen a real color palette rather than simply grey and brown. Story I'd give it a 7/10 because I think the idea of bringing a Chinese mythological story to the west is a great thing. Gameplay I'd give it a 4/10 because I simply cannot get behind the model of spam a button to kill the boss for every single playthrough due to a lack of variety.

≈60 часов игры за спиной, однако по ощущениям было пройдено несколько игр. Вуконг блещет огромным количеством разнообразия врагов, локаций, ситуаций и боссов. Креатива, вложенного авторами - уйма и хватило-бы на несколько игр. Даже хоррор сегменты попадались. По сути это добротный слешер без надобности запоминать кучу комбинаций. В распоряжении имеются разные стойки, комбинирование слабых/сильных ударов + возможность пользования магией, превращениями. Очки прокачки всегда можно бесплатно сбросить и подобрать новую тактику/билд к очередному сильному врагу. Лично мне понравилось творческое наполнение игры: здесь крайне живописные пейзажи всех разновидностей и биомов, интересно нарисованные противники всего фольклора Китая и красивые мультипликационные сюжетные вставки между главами, знакомящие с легендами Востока и движущие сюжет вперёд. Из минусов отмечу сильно скачащую сложность, когда одни боссы и противники убиваются мгновенно, а через пол часа застреваешь на обычном враге. Последняя треть Wukong мне вовсе знатно потрепал нервы, особенно с богомолом, царём Якшей ну и конечно-же финальным боссом, у которого аж 4 фазы, ну благо между двумя есть сохранение. Также очень лишней показалась 6 глава с псевдоопенворлдом: проходится она так, будто-бы геймдизайнер, сидя в туалете, дорисовывал это нечто за час до выхода игры. Это было плохо и душно. Игру рекомендую в первую очередь любителям красивых и креативных слэшеров, когда даже боссы блещут оригинальностью и ситуациями во время сражений. Спойлерить ничего не буду, чтобы не портить личные первые впечатления от встречи с последними. Это длинное и насыщенное путешествие по мифам Китая, которое точно запомнится. P.S. На финальном боссе прокачивайте и надевайте броню Змея, которая выпадает с одного из первых боссов. С ней я прошел финального гада с первого раза.

牢底坐穿终于过了普通结局，现在已经是2025年小年了，距离黑神话发售居然已过去快半年。 脱离了当时的民族自豪感，平心而论，黑神话的游戏过程中给我带来的折磨和乐趣大概对等。 折磨是因为我菜，慢刀永远躲不掉，快刀得死四五次才能记住，导致一旦遇到难一点的BOSS都是牢底坐穿，花上四五个小时打黄凤大圣，红孩儿，大圣残躯等，腿都坐麻了，神志不清的过。这感觉跟我期末周背书也没什么区别啊?? 还有就是地图设计。在黑神话的地图设计中，仿佛能看到关卡设计和美术设计相互打架——美术要把扫描的高面模型搭的有自然感，但是关卡设计又要设计明显的视觉信号引导玩家前进。其实这两者的矛盾是可以弥合的，但是在黑神话赶工的大背景下，不成熟的地图就出现了。 乐趣是游戏优秀的过场动画和毫无羞耻感的中文配音，真是给人洗了洗耳朵。逼真的场景就是我玩过的T0级别，从来没有游戏达到过如此逼真的画面（还实现了超强的优化）。这是真的实现了当年（2020）虚幻5展示视频中的渲染水平。 游戏本身谈完了，再聊聊游戏之外。对于中国人而言，黑神话游戏之外的意义可能更为重要 1. 网游的积淀也是一种宝贵的财富。中国网游、手游发展至今，不说反话，在很多方面世界领先。首当其冲的是数值设计，这在黑神话的各种装备平衡上能看出来，虽然我不能说装备这样拼数值在单机游戏好不好，但至少它把这么多配件都做的很平衡，不存在某种装备流产生压倒性数值优势。 2. 黑神话是中国游戏发展到新阶段量变积累出的质变。我说的就是一个个在游戏界摸爬滚打，饱经锤炼但仍怀有第九艺术梦想的广大中国游戏开发者和玩家们，是这个队伍的不断成长，不惧财阀（两个所谓金融游戏大厂）滋生出了近年来诸多勇敢的新游戏。 游戏无国界，但文化是有界的。我不犯人不代表我可以保持弱小的现状，因为总有人会因为你的弱小而主动侵犯你。所以我关注中国游戏发展，这关乎玩家未来的游戏质量，也影响我们线上线下的游戏环境。 3. 黑神话的成功证明了单机、高成本在国内的可行性，未来将会有非常多类似成本的中型工作室投入到单机的制作之中。加之以近年高失业率浪潮，想必很多应届生会投入到游戏工业中吧 现在在我的steam库里，出现了越来越多中国优秀游戏的身影，如《骰子浪游者》、《戴森球计划》、《九日》。希望单机玩家们不要局限于黑神话的成功，也放眼望望整个国产单机游戏市场。 国产游戏的篝火燃于寒冬。

《黑神话：悟空》是一款令人惊艳的游戏。在战斗系统方面，它融合了多种元素，既有类似《只狼》的高难度 BOSS 战，让玩家能体验紧张刺激的对决，又有自身独特的创新，如三种棍势结合精魄变身与法术系统，与孙悟空的七十二变相呼应，战斗手段丰富多样，手感质量过关。 角色美术更是达到了国产单机游戏前所未有的高度，杂兵种类丰富且令人印象深刻，配合考究台词与精良配音，唤醒玩家对《西游记》妖怪的记忆。 然而，地图设计方面存在不足，大量不必要的空气墙和模糊的地图指引，使玩家探索欲望受挫，比如在第二章的定风庄附近桥上，隐藏 BOSS 的设计与空气墙的存在容易让玩家感到逻辑混乱。 总体而言，《黑神话：悟空》是一款内容扎实的 3A 级游戏，虽有不成熟之处，但已大幅刷新国产单机游戏品质上限，其战斗系统和美术风格备受好评，若能改进地图设计等问题，未来可期。

真是个好游戏，剧情有深度，内涵十分深刻，每一章所表达的主旨都值得认真思考。悟空从意气风发到无奈妥协，到最后成为既得利益者后，也不忘那些被剥削的人，愿意为了被剥削的人再战。 从小都在想，孙悟空西游结束后变成什么样，会发生什么故事？这个游戏给了我回答，他还是那个齐天大圣，受到压迫时敢于和整个天庭作对的齐天大圣，依旧那么自由洒脱，有着斗争精神。 黑神话的世界里，上层人用明面暗面的方式去压榨下层，字里行间都是吃人，悟空成为上层后，本可以享受这些利益，但还是对现状感到痛苦，不愿抛弃那些被压榨的人。他本以为走过西行路，成为斗战胜佛后，就会有所改变，但紧箍还是在他的头上，他也只是被人随手拿捏的一份子罢了。剧情里他化为六根，可能是最好的做法了，就像杨戬说，他的肉身虽然消逝，但他的精神传递会给后来人，用这份星星之火，为后世埋下种子，为世界的改变尽一份自己的力量。 悟空是一位开拓者、奋斗者，他无愧于千千万万人对他的期待，这个游戏里的孙悟空，就是我从小到大心里所崇拜的那位齐天大圣。 从画面、音乐、剧情等都让我满意到不能再满意了，终于有了一个属于中国人且只有国人能体会到那种深刻感动的中国游戏了，等待的这些年是值得的。 一点点小建议：光影有可以调整的地方，从暗处到亮出的光影转变太强烈，看着很刺眼；第六章地图那么大，但可探索的东西太少了，好歹放点东西，不然从游戏性的角度，有点扣分。 最后，这是一个让我十分感动的游戏，云宫迅音响起时，泪水都出来了。心里有万般感慨却说不出口，只能在游玩时慢慢体会。期待早日能够看到DLC的出现

I have strongly mixed feelings about this game that border on the edge of it being a damn good game. I will try to elaborate on it. I never thought I'd think regularly in a souls game "Here's the perfect spot for an arena" and then proceed to see the health bar pop up on a first playthrough. Sure this is Journey to the West 2: Monkey Boogaloo for sure, but the game is more than that. I enjoyed the fact that you were not punished heavily for dying. I enjoyed the ability to respec on the fly. I LOVED the Loong fights. Black Loong had me vibing as the attacks connected WITH THE MUSIC, I had to allcaps because that sort of thing is rare in these games. That blew my socks off for real fr. The Might transformations split up a little of the tedium of having the same staff weapon for the whole game, the parry system (see-through) never really connected with me. Some of the bosses annoyed me but in retrospect they had gimmicks that I had forgotten I had picked up what I needed for earlier to make them less of a chore than they were. In saying that, Black Myth: Wukong is a good soulsalike game. I did not enjoy it as much as the other Unreal Engine based Lies of P, but I did enjoy it. When the game flows, it is solid fun. It just felt a lot more repetitive than the aforementioned or Sekiro or others, probably because there were too many boss fights put into the game that were just faceroll events.

战斗： 优秀的战斗系统，丰富的法术构筑与加点成长，舒适的打击手感，和多样的首领设计。 美术： 如诗如画的中式山水，宏伟的佛道建筑，精致的工艺品与服装造型。每章结尾的画卷与动画堪称艺术品。 关卡地图设计稍显逊色，可走路径与不可走路径难以区分。部分场景没有足够的内容填充，在最后一章尤为明显。 音乐： 令人沉浸的配乐，该细腻时细腻，该大气时大气。 剧情： 引人入胜的《西游记》故事续写，但是很显然故事并没有讲完整，大概是工期所迫。 —— 个人感受： 最近在玩二周目，想说说自己的想法。 当我打开游戏时，看到孙悟空与天兵天将激斗，操纵着天命人走在独具中华特色的山林里，欣赏路边半埋着的佛像，心中满是激动。 这是我梦寐以求的游戏。它不完美，但确实是中国单机游戏迈向工业化的第一步。 大厂追求营收，产品趋于保守化，不敢轻易尝试制作3A单机，独立游戏团队又没那个技术积累与资金支持。但是总要有人去做这第一步，去证明中国单机市场的潜力，去证明只要产品足够优秀就会有人愿意买单。 可惜的是，这么一款优秀的游戏，遭受了太多场外无谓的诋毁与仇恨。从好事者翻团队成员十多年前给另一款游戏做宣传时的虽然充满性别刻板印象但是反对物化女性的言论并将其断章取义为不需要女玩家开始，这款游戏就成为了各种人互相攻击的工具。 非常遗憾的是，每当我打开这游戏时，经常会因为想起这些奇葩矛盾而破坏兴致。只希望互联网上搞对立搞分裂的人自己坐一桌玩去，不要影响正常人生活娱乐。

Great story and gameplay. Had to research and learn a lot about Journey to the West. But it was well worth it to understand the story. Overall this felt like a faithful continuation of the original novel. The characters are flawed as when they were first written centuries ago, and thats a good thing. There were some UE5 related performance issues, there are areas where the game couldve been better optimized. One bug in particular related to flickering shadows really bothered me. In the last chapter you rapidly get alot of upgrades and some new powers that come as a bit of a surprise given that you will get no mileage with new equipment and new power didnt seem necessary. But i guess it is to complete the fantasy of playing as Wukong, they really gotta provide the full set of abilities. In terms of balance, game is heavily favoured towards Smash stance, its not that other stances cannot be viable, but they require certain items and builds to make them good, even then missing out on 'seeing through' skill is usually not worth it. Often times entire builds based on other stances dont compesate for the raw damage smash stance can dish out as well. Again that isnt to say they arent viable, i personally beat the game using thrust stance with a crit built and a weapon i got from beating a late game secret boss and it worked better than the late game equipment i got. But the imbalance is visible. Thats about the extent of my critique, overall this game was well worth playing.

8/10 Refine some if your boss design decisions, deepen the combat and write a cohesive story across all chapters and this might be the best action game I have ever played. Alas, that's not the case. Highly recommended for those who love mythology and action games akin to God of War, Sekiro and Nioh. It takes some of my favourite aspects from this genre and truly stands out with a STELLAR production. Shame the boss design, (story?) writing, and some smaller parts like the camera and combat fluidity can't match the truly fantastic environmental art, score, voice acting and visual direction. Even the combat, though lacking in depth, can be very fun and engaging. I really did enjoy my time while playing trough Wukongs clunky but beautiful chapters, but couldn't help being frustrated at times and boggling my mind over the developers intend. Regardless, I recommend Black Myth to those who have read Journey To The West or those simply looking for a fun action game with great production values and fantastic cutscenes, music, and voice acting.

，通篇玩下来之后，我可以大胆断言，黑神话绝对对得起玩家们四年的等待，甚至可以对得起这么多年，国内玩家对于一部高规格国产游戏的期待，不说今年游戏小年，哪怕放在以往的游戏大年，虽然比不上那些顶尖的游戏和IP，但也绝对是可以掰一掰手腕，占据一席之地的。如果要简单评价游戏的话，那就是长板长到离谱的地步，以至于短板在游戏过程中都变得不明显了。 [h3] 【优点】 [/h3] 1、无敌的美术，几乎每一帧的画面都可以截出来当壁纸，我前前后后截了800多张图，之前玩的所有游戏加起来的截图都应该没这个多，虚幻5加持加上老祖宗赏饭吃，直接起飞，包括一些盔甲和武器的设计也都很有味道，非常有代表性的中式审美 2、顶级的演出和情绪调动，大场面给的相当足，一些boss战的演出有老战神内味了，配合bgm情绪调动直接拉满，像是第六章结尾的云宫迅音，一响起来的时候我直接抱着手柄哭得稀里哗啦。 3、优秀的动作和战斗系统，黑猴的动作设计和战斗系统看得出来是有不少借鉴前辈的优点（精魄这玩意真的是一眼仁王的妖怪技），但借鉴的还挺好的。尽管到不了顶尖的T0那一档，但我个人觉得到T1和1.5是没问题的，第一款游戏能做到这个水平，实在是非常难得。有人会说黑猴的战斗系统像魂，其实更像是战神和仁王的结合体，毕竟会跳已经比很多那一群没有膝盖的不死人强多了，更何况还有定身术和身外身法这种强力法术，底层逻辑就跟魂系的回合制不一样了 4、适中的难度曲线，虽然一上来都被幽魂教育了一顿，但这游戏的难度曲线还是挺合理的，一些有二阶段的怪甚至还会帮你补一下血药和状态，还有一堆轮椅逃课方式[spoiler] （特别是有了牛魔套，用多了感觉技术都要下降了） [/spoiler]和无限洗点，打不过换个流派，最有意思的地方在于，在跟朋友们交流后发现，除了二郎神这种压箱底的怪，大家卡的怪各有不同，某种程度上也说明了难度曲线是还不错的，毕竟连战老都能打过嘛（笑 5、无敌的配乐，冯骥：我就是为了写歌词才开公司的,jpg。无论是改编的云宫迅音，还是往生咒和陕北说唱还有《屁》，游戏里令人印象深刻的bgm多的很，328豪华版属实是买对了，特别是现在更新后又可以单独下下来，建议直接328拉满，多出来60当买专辑好吧 6、量大管饱且有不少设计优秀的boss战和数量多样化的敌人。除了第五章之外，这游戏居然没有什么换皮怪，对于这么大一个体量的游戏属实难得（战神：不可能，我不信），游戏还有贡献了二郎神，寅虎，毒敌大王，虎先锋这样顶级的boss战，尤其是二郎神那个动作模组，放别得游戏够三个boss了。还有寅虎，一招一式配合配合边打边喊招式名，有武侠内味了。 7、较为不错的优化，今时今日不需要打发售日补丁的游戏已经不多见了，整个游戏下来优化也还是不错的（仅限PC），也就花果山会有点掉帧 8、无敌的文化氛围和情怀，各种实地扫描的造像建筑就不用说了，就连很多道具都是文物来的。情怀方面，各种原著梗和拓展看得让人会心一笑（甚至每一章的boss的克制方法都是按照原著来的），最后一章的动画更是情怀拉满了。 9、影神图和每一章的结尾动画。以及各种细节，比如在雪地上走过会有痕迹，猴子的盔甲在黄风岭会有一层沙，在小西天会有一层霜 10、猪八戒。好叔叔本身就是一个优点，一口一个贤侄，会跟你唠嗑，会吐槽，会奶你一口，最后时刻还关心你，叫你打不过就赶紧跑，好吃懒做的八戒如今也有长辈风范了 [h3] 【缺点】 [/h3] 1、轻棍的动作模组太少了，虽然有有三种棍式，但都只在重攻击方面有差别，属实是有点浪费了动作系统，完全可以在轻攻击上做出不同棍式的差异，而且现在来看，立棍的实用性也不如劈棍和戳棍（也可能是我不会用，毕竟也看过别人专门用立棍打的片） 2、缺少一定的反制远程的手段，全程只有一个防御性质的棍花能打掉弓箭，被黄风岭的鼠特林制裁的时候只能说懂得都懂。 3、后两章赶工有点明显。第五章和第六章明显是早期设计的，后期没时间翻新了就端上来了，比如第五章的小怪几乎全员换皮，以及第六章那个跟没有一样的地图设计。 4、 [strike] 大型boss的受击反馈和部分动作的判定有点迷惑。虽然大型boss的受击和视角问题很多公司都处理不好，但游科这个在裆下放空气墙和只有一只脚有受击点还是过于抽象了 [/strike]（上述问题在现在已经基本上解决，比起一开始要好很多了），特别是还有不知道哪位高人用膝盖想出来的全游戏第一粪怪——大石敢当。 [strike] 判定方面主要是没有预输入的问题，有时候嗑药要按半天才出来，还有就是棍反成功后的无敌帧有点短了，使得棍反的收益没有那么大 [/strike] （该问题在更新连战后已经得到一定程度的解决） 5、过于离谱的爆率，部分掉落装备和植物种子属实是爆率感人，都跟成就挂钩了，也别那么肝了好吧，刷起来让人梦回黑魂3刷誓约道具 [spoiler]（暗月疯子,jpg）[/spoiler] 6、天命人几乎没有韧性这种东西，虽然有牛魔套这种东西，但这玩意拿齐了至少都要二周目了，一些刮蹭类的攻击就能打断天命人的攻击多少有点让人红温了。 7、略显稚嫩的关卡设计，虽然没有仁王那种经典的半截墙堵路，但地图的游戏性设计感还是有点次，可能也就黄风岭和盘丝洞有点设计，大部分都是一本道的，不过这个东西纯属是积累，也不是一口气能解决的，毕竟有些公司做了十几年游戏还能搞出极其弱智的地图设计 [h3] 一些可能是缺点，但我个人感觉不算是的 [/h3] 1、空气墙和没有地图。空气墙的影响其实真的没有网上吹的那么大，我整个流程就没有碰到过几次，这玩意更多的是美术先行和技术稚嫩造成的。地图说真的，可能对新手确实不太友好，但对于有一定游戏经验，尤其是魂类经验玩家而言，这个地图其实算简单的了，第一章都已经有提示了，[b] 小地图问题在连战版本更新后也解决了，可以无视这段了 [/b] 2、剧情见仁见智。我觉得还好，虽称不上是很多，但也不差，中规中矩吧。更多的问题是没有一个明显的情绪宣泄口和故事没有讲完，只是给你展开来个背景，如果非要当原教旨义那只能说以后都别把名著改编游戏和影视了，直接束之高阁让他失去活力算了，那毕竟六老师也干了不是 3、有些人会说删了很多东西有废案如何如何，但有一说一这些其实是很正常的，毕竟连博德之门3后面都有一大堆没做完（还是先放出EA的情况下），只能说“完整比完美更重要了” 归根结底，游戏的很多缺点其实更像是经验不足的造成，整个游戏更像是游科的成长历程，比如说地图设计，比如说boss战之后的处决演出，明显是做到后面开窍了，会加一段演出处决了（红孩儿和王灵官）。而优点则是游科充分的扬长避短，以一种近乎偏执的态度把擅长的部分给最大化了。 多年以来，国内的玩家一直都在希望有一个能有本国文化和色彩的大型游戏，而黑神话正是这样一个回应了玩家祈愿的作品，我不敢也不想说什么国产3A崛起的空头炮，但他至少有力的回击了【做3A死路一条】的暴论，毕竟最大胆的香槟派都不敢想象能买到两千万份，这其中固然有种种机缘巧合，以及天时地利人和，但以事后诸葛亮是态度来看，我还是愿意相信抛开这些，黑神话依然能取得一个不错的成绩，厂商的诚意玩家是能感受的到的，“为众人抱薪者不可使其冻毙于风雪”，黑神话注定会在中国电子游戏的历史上留下一笔，我也愿意怀抱一种幼稚的幻想，相信也会有更多的厂商受其鼓舞而带来更多的佳作。 虽说没有十全十美的游戏，客观来说黑神话大概是到8.7-9的水准，但是，是人都会有情怀和偏好，所以，在我这，黑神话就是今年的年度最佳，满分神作，没有之一。 最后，游科别他妈藏了，赶紧DLC搞起来！你跟我说这东西没有DLC我是不信的， [spoiler] 除非冯骥又想吃泡面了 [/spoiler] 没DLC，仇恨永无止息 没DLC，强弱如我何异 没DLC，一切有情皆孽 没DLC，梦幻泡影空虚 第一感觉是震撼，从来不玩单机游戏的我被开场给震撼到了，后来在网上看到黑猴有多优秀，开始以为水军居多，结果真正看了几个BOSS的挑战，才知道这个游戏不一般，而后又接触了其中的一些剧情，更是被深深吸引，那个时候没有独显电脑，用的是华为MEATBOOK D15这个核显笔记本下载下来的，而且还是借用的朋友的共享，一个R5 3500U的核显CPU，一个飞智冰原狼2的手柄，陪着我闯过了八十一难，身边的好多人都嘲笑我，画面都卡成PPT了，你还玩？可是谁童年的心中没有一个大圣梦呢？随着章节的一步步解锁，随着神珍大圣套穿在身上，我的大圣梦也实现了，年底了，忙活了一年，借着国补，买了新电脑，今天也买了数字豪华版，给我的大圣梦画上一个圆满的句号。不管你是4090，还是像我一样的核显CPU，我们的童心依旧未泯，只是在生活的伪装下犹如一粒灰尘藏在心底。夜深人静的时候，这粒灰尘如天上的星星，承载着我们童年的美好回忆。

This is a negative review as I don't want to straight recommend it. For me, a positive review requires comes with so many caveats that its simply up to individual taste. Here's a few of the caveats that would come with a recommendation, 1. Visuals are great, but - Many boss fights are unclear as the game leans in to form over function. 2. Levels are varied, but - Exploration is incredibly limited, many invisible walls and although some secrets are well hidden and enjoyable to find, there's not as much substance as would like. 3. Combat system is fun, but - May be the way I played and built, although it's highly repetitive and unless enemies offer an actual challenge (majority of them didn't for me, only specific bosses), it feels like you can button mash your way through fights and throw in some dodges here & there. 4. Loads of bosses, but - Many of them feel like copy-paste's of each other's moveset's. On the plus side, its not as much of a boss rush as other reviews suggest, more so once you're in chapter 3 & 4. However, the quality of bosses deteriorates over time and after chapters 1 & 2 they didn't feel as unique and engaging mechanically, even though they were visually impressive. 5. Bosses are hard - Some of the bosses are a fun challenge, which is great. Although many of them in the later portions of the game are quite flat with huge HP bars, then they over use the 'hit 20% health and go nuts' and surprise second health bars. It's fine but doesn't feel special when it happens so often. The visuals are generally always greater than the game's ability to engage you with its mechanics. 6. Very nit picky but the stopping and loss of control of the character for item and chest animations is frustratingly worthless. There's so many pick ups if you're exploring and you've got to go through that repeatedly, it's a very minor inconvenience but it feels needlessly jarring to the pacing of the game play, especially when it's just to pick up some currency. As a FromSoft baby and Soulslike ?????, I'd say skip it if that's what you're after. It's an 'okay' Soulslike if you build the stamina and 'See Through' damage route, as I did but only if you're willing to accept its going to be boss heavy and the game play will get repetitive. For me, without the deep exploration and sense of wonder that comes with FromSoft titles, I'd say it isn't a true Soulslike but that's just semantics. Its a negative review but its more of a sideways thumbs up. I enjoyed it for a bit, the lore and artwork is fun if you enjoy reading those bits and the Chinese voice acting is superb - It captured me with its aesthetics but ultimately the gameplay couldn't hold me all the way through it so I stopped playing during the final chapter, when I was questioning how engaged I was. Try it, refund it, buy on a sale.

Not sure if reading Journey to the West would make it make more sense but honestly, I kinda doubt it - Rampant railroading - you are always directly told if you're even remotely close to a shrine (bonfire), invisible walls are literally everywhere - The usual UE5 ??????????, no option to turn off DLSS or its equivalents, best you can do is use DLAA so at least there's no upscaling. Numerous graphical errors, low res shadows (even on "high" settings), very obvious pop-in, flickering, weird lighting differences when you change viewing angle, and thats just off the top of my head. And here's what I liked: - cool setpieces - fancy graphics What a complete waste of my life.

Разочарование. Технически: Игра очень слабая, оптимизации почти нет. При тех ресурсах, что игра жрет, картинка должна быть в разы лучше. Я уже молчу про падения FPS. Но в целом, то что игра с технической стороны кривая, думаю, очевидно, об этом кричали из каждого угла. Геймплейно: В игре есть примерно 5 относительно сложных боссов, но сложные они из-за кривых механик игры. Объясняю: 1. Вы наносите чудовищно мало урона боссам(чтобы снять 1% здоровья, вам потребуется нанести ударов 10-20!!!!). 2. У вас очень медленные атаки, особенно те, которые самые сильные и на которые вы тратите энергию. Когда вы попробуете её применить, вы получите больше урона, чем нанесете. 3. Босс убивает вас в 2-4 удара, при том что его комбинации, это от 4 до 10 ударов подряд. Вот и получается, что весь геймплей сводится к нажиманию круга, пока босс спамит ударами. Как только он останавливается, вы наносите 3-7 ударов и дальше долбите на круг. Самое сложное в этих "боссахфайтах" - не уснуть от однообразности геймплейя. Остальные "боссы" убираются с 1-3 траев, и то, потому что вам уже на столько скучно, что вы просто балуетесь. Сюжет: Не берусь оценивать, меня прям вообще не зацепило, но это сугубо вкусовщина. В итоге мы получаем игру, в которую геймплейно скучно играть, это не соулслайк, но и не экшен-приключение. Она где-то на серединке, что и вредит игре. Для приключения у нее слишком скучный сюжет и почти нет динамики, для соулслайка она слишком простая и нет механик, кроме как жать на круг, а в перерывах бить. И бонусом однообразные и скучные локации. По сути это можно сказать "дебютная" игра для данной студии, по этому я и оцениваю ее соответственно, без лишних придирок(а косяков тут много, начиная от кривого таргета, заканчивая мягко говоря "странными" хитбоксами). Как итог, объективная оценка: 4/10. Можно пробежать, но не за фулл прайс.

[h1][b]天地之大，有我容身之所[/b][/h1] 一个属于中国游戏史的浪漫情书 [h2]游戏总评：9.5/10[/h2] 游戏通关了一段时间，游戏的风头也基本过去，犹豫要从什么角度去写游戏的评测，觉得拖延下去要把游玩体验都要忘光了，还是把测评写一写，在经历TGA的“正确”最佳游戏评选，黑神话果然不出所料地落选了，只获得2024年TGA最佳动作游戏，2024年TGA年度最佳游戏提名。但是作为一个拥有情怀的玩家，黑神话应该是玩家今年心中的年度最佳游戏，并不是黑神话是完美无缺的游戏，而是在这个时候，游戏的各个方面和制作水准，影响力，是足以有这个水平。本人不是资深动作/魂系玩家，玩的比较杂，什么都会玩，但是也有几百小时怪物猎人游玩时间，240多小时仁王2全成就，100多小时蝙蝠侠全成就等动作游戏的经历，所以对黑神话还是有一点个人想法测评，它可能不适合每一个人，它也不是完美的游戏，我们也不要神话一款游戏，但是在情怀的想象下，它属于中国玩家等了很久的一封魂牵梦萦的情书。 在2024年年末的时候，黑神话更新了地图和挑战玩法，目前还不算完整内容（后续还有更新的情况下），黑神话是值得9.5分，今年玩到个人第二个这么高分的游戏。游戏的美术一流称的上满分，包括壁画，雕像，BOSS设计，地图景观，不同季节的变换，一流的音乐和精美的过场动画，一个个细节都展现出精心制作的程度。游戏的动作系统是能让人不太困难上手的同时还兼具一定深度，包括对棍法的设计，带有一定程度的ARPG属性，同时游戏还有妖怪精魄化身技等游戏内容设计，都是有一定减轻游戏难度，能够让更多的玩家享受动作游戏的乐趣同时还有一定的深度。游戏的BOSS招式变化多样，BOSS设计各有特色，招式也比较合理，而且都有克制方法，小怪丰富且符合文化背景，影神图包含了的大量文本量和文化故事。而且画面表现一流，还设计了很多隐藏内容，等待玩家挖掘和发现。 [h2]游戏的一些不完美[/h2] 1，游戏的地图设计，引导设计，为了服务于美术而放弃了太多合理的地图设计，地图的视觉暗示较少，或者说地图视觉引导不明显，很容易迷路，为了美术风格统一，放弃了很多地图引导设计。 2，动作系统本身其实可以深挖一些构建和动作派生，对于硬核玩家来说还是缺少一些深度，当然这个也不能说完全是缺点，毕竟能更容易被更多的玩家接受游玩而不是劝退。 3，黑神话的故事叙事理解有比较高的门槛，游戏的没有很好的叙事完整性和连贯性，很多故事的理解需要建立在对西游记的熟悉和了解上，如果没有提前对《西游记》的了解会对故事比较莫名其妙，甚至黑神话是部分跳脱于原著来讲故事，对于其他地区和文化的玩家来说可能不够友好，对于故事的高潮和情怀，一些伏笔和细节无法深入理解。 从黑神话正式亮相到发行正好四年，四年的时间制作出属于国人高规格3A游戏，其中的创作困难肯定有很多，游戏文化底蕴和叙事价值也是充斥整个作品，黑神话可能不是一部完美的作品，但肯定是一部个人认为特别的，有独特风格和文化的高分ARPG作品。

After finally beating this game and getting the true ending: first off, VERY glad I played this game in Chinese (with English subs). No disrepect to the English talent but the Chinese voice acting felt way more authentic to the story and was casted flawlessly! You can tell that they have plenty of respect and passion for these characters and it shows in their delivery! Second off, I don't think we'll get a game that will match the sheer depth of Black Myth: Wukong in a very long time. At least not on the subject of Chinese mythology (unless Game Science comes out with a sequel or an entirely new entry). The devs absolutely NAILED every small detail. Every environment is unique and contains its own fabled story, and yet they somehow find a way for every story to connect. That being said, the lore is very complex and tends to leave a few unanswered questions here and there. Although I bet a sequel would be the perfect opportunity to fill in the relatively few gaps! As for the gameplay, there's a TON of exploration, and every corner is well worth checking out. There are plenty of bosses with their own unique move sets (and of varying difficulty). But the game does an amazing job of teaching you how to REALLY play the game (like mastering dodging, timing your combos, etc). The more you practice against optional bosses the better. No lie, I've raged every now and then (cause I suck at difficult games) and yet this game kept pulling. Me. Back. In! There were plenty of bosses I had trouble with [spoiler](Some examples for me include Yellow Wind Sage, Cyan Loong, and Yellow Loong)[/spoiler] and yet beating these bosses and progressing felt extremely gratifying! Exploring every corner and beating the optional bosses will give you exceptional rewards that are well worth the extra time. Personally, this is my GOTY 2024. A shame it didn't win, but I had to contribute a positive review. This is what happens when you have a group of developers who are passionate about a story, and give every ounce of their hard work to create a masterpiece. It's the perfect mix of colorful, eerie, action-packed, and mysterious. This game has everything you want and need in a good story. Outside of the relatively few optimization issues I've had, I'm looking forward to more from Game Science. Whether they come out with a brand new IP, or if they add on to this game, I believe Black Myth: Wukong is an absolutely fantastic start! Hope more people can appreciate this stellar piece of art!

My first blind play through clocking in at about 37 hours, I can say there's a fair amount of content here, and the way the chapters are presented, map design and paths forward are all very intuitively designed (Excluding Chapter 6 but we'll get back to that later) parts of the game remind me of the first Dark Souls game, which is a high compliment for level design. I managed to find all the secret bosses without external help excluding one (five carts questline) and most secrets and items you'll just stumble upon naturally if you explore and pay a little attention. The combat is snappy and responsive, the game tells you to play on controller for best experience but I had 0 troubles on mouse and keyboard, it feels very responsive and easy to control and the button lay outs are pretty easy to get used to. Boss design is great for the most part, there's a couple standouts that I did not enjoy, but they are definitely the minority. and your own character design and sense of progression with abilities, gear and mastery of tools available to you lends to a nice learning curve and sense of reward by the time you're in the mid game and have figured things out, with the different stances letting you create your own style to some degree. *Spoilers Ahead* The only downsides in the whole game for me was 1) Chapter 6, they drop the tight level design for a mass open field of copy paste enemies to fight, with no clear direction on objectives or how to progress, which is a stark contrast to the rest of the game after 5 chapters of tight well designed worlds and narratives and thematic bosses that make sense to their environments, instead you find yourself zooming through an empty map fighting 6 variations of poison chiefs which are stone vanguards but.. poisony? This isn't enough to spoil the whole product, but it did leave a sour taste in my mouth for a while and had me feeling like I wanted to rush through the section to be done with it. 2) The only other issue I have, is that the Erlang fight (Mount Mei secret ending) feels like the true ending and the direction they should have taken it in the first place, if you miss this, you miss the real peak of the game and it's locked behind multiple multiple secrets you have to have figured out before hand, or you'll never see or experience it, and the area was hands down the coolest section of my entire journey through the game, I left the Mount Mei section feeling completely satisfied, like I'd already beaten the game. All in all though, this was a great game and definitely enjoyable if you have any kind of love towards the souls series or souls-like games in general. I'm sure I'll be visiting this title multiple times over the years

TLDR: 8/10 A GOW-like fun action game with a fantastic final fight. Confusing story if you don't know Journey to the west. Best experienced with a high tier gaming rig to get the best graphical experience, otherwise it's rough. MINOR SPOILERS BELOW MINOR SPOILERS BELOW MINOR SPOILERS BELOW MINOR SPOILERS BELOW My experience was used with this PC setup: AMD Ryzen 7800 RTX 4070 super 32 GB Ram Monitor: 2560 x 1440, 165 Hz Performance: 9/10 Using recommended settings, I can clear a consistent 90-100 FPS (all very high, medium ray tracing, 75 super resolution) with frame gen ON. Raising it to cinematic drops to to anywhere between 55-84 depending on area. Oddly, some cutscenes (particularly in act 5) experience significant frame drops and stuttering. Not sure why this is, but keeping the game in recommended settings removed this issue completely. Act 6 (the msot graphically intense setting) on cinematic was not possible for my setup- it would drop anywhere between 16-25 frames. On recommended, this was a non-issue. Graphics: 9.5/10 The game's gorgeous: lighting and clothing textures are some of the best I've ever seen. Playing in higher graphical settings appeared to create some strange phantom effects and blurring during movement, but this generally went unnoticed if I wasn't looking for it. Under a microscope, there are some minor graphical cuts here and there, but the game generally looks good where it matters Gameplay: 6/10 As a soulsborne vet who's played all the games (except demon's souls), this is the thing I most looked forward to the most. Fighting is mostly satisfying, but can take some getting used to. Landing a massive heavy attack is immensely satisfying, and with enough talent points, combat begins to flow much more smoothly. Some combat mechanical jank in terms of responsiveness in when a dodge or combo move is pressed: I can't count the number of times where the game entirely ignored my input and either didn't dodge or didn't combo properly. More personal opinion: making the penultimate move take the longest time in exchange for making it build the most focus is an odd choice. I think it may have been better as an extra move or a stance specific attack. Raw heavy attack in smash stance is waaayyyyy too slow. It's clear that there was more time spent in the flair than actually making it feel good. On that note, bosses and enemies have some odd inconsistencies. In terms of difficulty, they tend to either be piss easy, or absurdly challenge. The only memorably difficult bosses are the thousand eyed daoist, red boy, and the final boss. Both the daoist and red boy (first phase) are difficult because their animations genuinely confound and confuse rather than being mechanically complex. There's a lot of extra movement, which, looks great in making the character feel alive, but for combat it can make learning what's just animation and what's an attack harder than necessary. I personally found it highly frustrating; moreso when an attack would seemingly come without ANY pre-animation to indicate it. Worse than that, some attacks are clearly missing frames between when they're launched and the final active hit box exists, making reactions even harder. This may be a result of the game being rendered in unreal 5, as I'm beginning to find this to be a common issue, but it's still very frustrating. The good news? Most of these issues are absent from the final boss. It is mechanically, thematically, and visually, ABSOLUTE CINEMA and one of the greatest fights of any game I have ever played: 10/10 no notes. There are many obscure secrets in the game that give extra powers and unlocks, and while I was able to find a few there appear to be far too few hints as to how to actually solve them. Often, I completed them completely by accident. Story: 8/10 Edit: I'm raising the score to an 8/10. The story is great, but for me was hard to follow unless I had was playing in my native language. A big part of the story for every section is hard to understand if you don't unlock all the secrets which leads to confusion. Overall: 8/10. I would play it again . Listen to the story in your own language and you'll probably understand it better. Combat can have some instances of frustration, but is mostly good if a little too easy most of the time. Graphically the game is beautiful. The final boss fight is the best part of the game: as it should be. Edit: I replayed it for NG+ and revised the rating after completing the hidden bosses. 自《黑神话：悟空》首次亮相以来，这款游戏就在全球范围内引起了广泛的关注和热烈的讨论。作为一款基于中国古代神话故事《西游记》改编的游戏，《黑神话：悟空》以其卓越的画面表现、精致的游戏设计以及深度的故事剧情，赢得了无数玩家的喜爱与追捧。从游戏的第一帧画面开始，《黑神话：悟空》就展现出了超凡脱俗的艺术水准。游戏采用了最先进的图形技术，无论是细腻的纹理处理，还是光影效果的呈现，都达到了令人惊叹的地步。游戏中每一处场景的设计都充满了东方美学的气息，从巍峨壮丽的山川到幽静神秘的森林，每一帧画面都像是一幅精美的画卷，让人仿佛置身于一个真实的神话世界之中。不同于其他游戏仅仅依赖于视觉效果吸引玩家，《黑神话：悟空》在剧情方面同样下了很大的功夫。游戏的故事情节紧密围绕孙悟空的成长历程展开，通过一系列精心设计的任务和挑战，逐步揭示了悟空从顽石中诞生，历经磨难最终成为齐天大圣的过程。游戏中穿插了大量的对话和旁白，不仅增加了故事的连贯性和完整性，也让玩家能够更加深入地理解角色的性格特点及其背后的动机。在玩法方面，《黑神话：悟空》同样表现出色。游戏结合了动作与冒险两种元素，玩家可以操控孙悟空施展七十二变的能力，对抗各种妖魔鬼怪。战斗系统设计得非常流畅，连招动作华丽而不失实用性，每一次攻击都能带给玩家极大的满足感。此外，游戏中还加入了丰富的解谜元素，玩家需要动脑筋解决各种难题，才能顺利推进剧情。更重要的是，《黑神话：悟空》成功地将中国传统文化与现代游戏技术完美结合，展现了中华文化的魅力。游戏中不仅再现了《西游记》中经典的桥段，还融入了许多中国传统文化元素，如书法、绘画、音乐等，使得整个游戏世界充满了浓郁的文化气息。通过这种方式，《黑神话：悟空》不仅让国内玩家感受到了自豪感，也让国外玩家对中国文化有了更深的了解。社会影响《黑神话：悟空》的成功还在于它对整个游戏行业的积极影响。这款游戏证明了国产游戏完全有能力达到甚至超越国际一流水平，极大地提振了国内游戏开发者和玩家们的信心。此外，《黑神话：悟空》也为中国文化走向世界搭建了一座桥梁，让更多人通过游戏这一媒介了解和喜欢上了中国传统文化。综上所述，《黑神话：悟空》无疑是一款值得所有玩家期待和体验的佳作。它不仅在技术层面上达到了顶尖水平，在文化层面更是承载了传承与创新的重要使命。随着游戏的不断完善和发展，相信它将成为国产游戏发展历程中一座重要的里程碑，引领国产游戏迈向更加辉煌的未来。 以上是ai说的，废话。 要我说：好玩就对了，钱拿去，我还要！ QAQ

As the game which was sort of advertized by media to be "the first Chinese AAA game", I would say that Black Myth Wukong certainly lived up to my expectations. With a thrilling world based on mythology with Yaoguais offering all sorts of unique species, it is truly a world to enjoy. However, alongside the praise certainly comes some major criticisms that highly impacted my enjoyment in the long run. Starting off I naturally want to give some praises where due, which include but are not limited to: + The visual storytelling and cinematics are beyond amazing + Incredibly nice graphics and a beautiful world to explore + A wide variety of bosses offering unique fighting styles and challenges + A dynamic and enjoyable fighting style of the Destined One makes it very engaging and you don't grow tired of it throughout the game. But here then, are things that for me hold it back from even dreaming of a 10/10 rating. - I'll start off with by far the worst part of the game, and that's how easily missable extra content is. Playing this game without a step by step guide or spoiling for yourself, will guarantee content being locked away. And that's the worst part! Not only is it missable, but the game with actively lock it away for the rest of the playthrough if you make certain progresses. I missed out on an essential storyline of which gives the secret ending of the game, and of which barred me from multiple secret bosses, for, and I kid you not, not finding and talking to a certain NPC, hiding behind a certain pillar, within a certain temple, within a certain temple district, in Chapter 3. And because I failed to notice him even being there, he despawned FOREVER when I progressed to chapter 4, so I couldn't even go back to continue the quest. This one hidden NPC locked me away from half a dozen bosses, and the secret ending. And there are practically no cues for you to expect them to be somewhere, nor what will cause them to disappear. It's utter bs and so if you want to experience everything within one playthrough, you HAVE to follow a guide to make sure you not only do everything but also IN THE RIGHT ORDER, cause the game sure as hell doesn't explain it. - Chapter 4 has a segment of the big area of which many experience major frame drops, this is due to webbing in caves and alike, and as a result I would recommend for anyone entering chapter 4, to go into their settings and to turn "Hair Quality" to low so that you won't lose out on performance. My RTX 3080 struggled holding even 60fps otherwise. - Certain bosses have some really bs attacks or abilities that can get really annoying to deal with. I get it, Wukong is a hard game with hard bosses, and I don't complain about that. I beat every boss the game allowed me to fight. HOWEVER, I don't think it's reasonable difficulty, when say, a certain boss just spawns tornadoes that stunlock you with zero indication and reason, or when you're knocked out of a heavy attack moments before it lands over the weakest of moves, or when the boss enters a sort of animation when transitioning between phases, of which it temporarily leaves itself open EXCEPT YOU CAN'T TO ANY DAMAGE (multiple bosses are guilty of this but none worse than Cloudtreading Deer). There is no worse feeling than thinking the boss is open for a major blow so you unleash a big heavy, or maybe a powerful spell move, like a vessel or alike, just for everything to be nullified cause he's just preparing for what to do next and you can't just hurt him when he's in the middle of buffing to kill you! - Another case-per-case issue, but some of the bosses in this game give fake healthbars, some may not care as much but when I see a healthbar I like to assume that when it's empty, I'm done. Dark Souls 3 is another huge meanie about it but there is some bosses in this where I feel it takes the piss out of me. Now despite these major annoyances, I do still recommend the game, my playthrough of what I did took a bit under 39 hours but it may vary, especially if you are newer to the genre, of if you're planning on doing more or less extra content than me. Personally this is an 8.5/10 game for me, with the rants above being my main explanations for what caused cuts in my enjoyment, the content locks being by far the biggest factor.

Cool visual style but often frustrating game design. The developers finally listened to the players and added a map feature which helps with some aspects, but navigation can still be unsatisfying giving how it is entirely arbitrary where you can and cannot go. The map/game open up considerably after the first chapter which is very much on rails, but the game never provides true freedom of exploration which is a shame. There are a handful of severe difficulty spikes and areas/bosses that are simply no fun to get through. The game is often incredible--the cinematic presentation when encountering a new boss or miniboss and simply taking in the stunning vistas keeps you coming back, but the core gameplay is for the most part just adequate. I initially wrote my negative review while struggling through a particularly un-fun section in Chapter 3 (and no, saying that the level is meant to be a vision of hell so it not being fun to play is intentional is asinine). While the game might not exactly be "all style and no substance," it definitely leans heavily to the 'style' side. Even though I've come back to the game after bouncing off, I'm keeping my review at negative because I feel the "overwhelmingly positive" reviews is misleading, given how a bit too often the game feels like a chore that you have to get through to see the next cool thing.

Players control Sun Wukong as he masters various abilities, including shape-shifting and martial arts, to overcome challenges and foes. Combat is fluid and dynamic, with a variety of moves and strategies to employ against different enemies. The storyline draws inspiration from classic Chinese literature, offering a fresh take on familiar myths while introducing new twists and characters. The narrative unfolds through cutscenes and interactions with other characters, deepening the player's connection to the world and its lore. Overall, "Black Myth: Wukong" is shaping up to be a standout title in the action-adventure genre, combining exceptional visuals, compelling gameplay, and a rich cultural tapestry that resonates with both fans of Chinese mythology and gamers looking for a unique and immersive experience. As development continues, anticipation is high for what promises to be a truly memorable gaming experience.

一款充满了中国式浪漫的游戏，初次游玩时带给我的感受是十分惊艳的，每一帧动作，每一处景色都是游科送给全球玩家（特别是中国玩家）的情书，且不说国外，西游记在中国的影响力不言而喻，悟空在无数人的心中都处于不可替代的地位，作为一名00后，从小看着各种西游记长大，什么86版西游记、央视版西游记动画等等，无时无刻在幻想着自己能成为孙大圣降妖除魔，从小时候拿着棍子到处耍，到接触电子游戏后，几乎对所有游戏中的孙悟空都有巨大的执念，但说实话，众多游戏中的孙悟空并不能让我真正地沉浸其中、与悟空做到共鸣，在大多数游戏中感受更多地是他们只是将悟空当作一个赚钱的工具、一个噱头。 当初国漫崛起的热潮便是大圣所带来的，那时的我在感慨大圣在荧幕上再次绽放光芒的同时，也幻想着何时能够真正地沉浸地在游戏中去扮演大圣，但在那之后，关于大圣的电影如井喷般进入大众视野，但质量，真可以说是“仙人之兮列如麻”，我的幻想也随着一部部烂片的上映而破碎，直至20年黑猴第一支实机演示发布，那时的感受到现在我都还记得，不敢相信这是实机演示，当时看着天命人腾云驾雾、翻转腾挪，我都激动地无以言表，特别是在大圣出来挡下一棒，如意金箍棒五个字逐字显现时，整个人都已经停止思考了，真的不敢相信，这是中国的游戏，而且还是一个从来没听过名字的工作室所制作的，看完之后仍然不敢相信这是实机演示，想的是哪怕是假的，最终能做成CG电影，哪怕是CG短片也好啊，不过最终感谢游科全体人员打了我的脸，真的把这款幻想中的游戏做了出来，感谢你们并没有只是将悟空作为一个提高销量的噱头，感谢你们的倾情付出，纵使他并非完美，但仍然是给我们全体中国玩家这些年来最好的一封情书。
